name: Superman
specialAbility: Absorbs solar radiation from a yellow sun to fuel superhuman strength, speed, durability, and a variety of other powers.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to Kryptonite, magic, and red sun radiation, which can weaken or nullify his powers.
description: The Man of Steel — last son of Krypton and Earth's greatest protector. Superman's powers are nearly limitless under a yellow sun, but his compassion and moral code define him as much as his strength.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Superman is a powerhouse with few equals, but his moral code often prevents him from fighting at full capacity. Exploiting his weaknesses or forcing him into an ethical dilemma can neutralize his overwhelming power.
notableFeats: Held a miniature black hole in his hands (Action Comics #847)
Pushed a planet-sized object across the galaxy (All-Star Superman #10)
Survived a supernova explosion (Superman #13, 1987)
Defeated Doomsday in a fight to the death (Death of Superman storyline)
Outpaced the Flash in a race under certain conditions (Superman #199)
Lifted the Book of Infinite Pages, a metaphysical object of infinite weight (JLA #48)
specialRules: can end many fights instantly if fully serious

name: Goku
specialAbility: Mastery of Ultra Instinct, allowing instinctive dodging and counterattacks with unparalleled precision.
weaknesses: Tendency to hold back or give opponents chances to recover, and stamina drain in prolonged fights at peak transformations.
description: The Saiyan warrior raised on Earth who became the universe's greatest martial artist through sheer determination and relentless training. Goku's drive to surpass his limits has made him a protector of the multiverse and a rival to gods.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Goku's power is heavily dependent on his transformations and ability to adapt mid-battle. Exploiting his stamina drain or emotional distractions can be key to defeating him.
weaknesses: stamina drain in prolonged peak transformations
vulnerability to reality-warping or extreme hax abilities
notableFeats: Defeated Jiren, a being stronger than a God of Destruction (Dragon Ball Super Episode 130)
Mastered Ultra Instinct, a technique used by gods (Dragon Ball Super Episode 129)
Destroyed Kid Buu with the Spirit Bomb (Dragon Ball Z Episode 287)
Fought Beerus, the God of Destruction, to a near standstill in Super Saiyan God form (Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods)
Overpowered Kefla's energy beam with an Ultra Instinct Kamehameha (Dragon Ball Super Episode 116)
Survived a Hakai energy attack from Toppo (Dragon Ball Super Episode 125)

name: Spider-Man
specialAbility: Spider-Sense grants danger precognition, combined with superhuman agility, strength, and web-based combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sonic attacks and ethyl chloride; can be overwhelmed by enemies with extreme durability or speed.
description: The friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, Peter Parker, is a brilliant scientist and acrobatic hero who turned personal tragedy into a mission to protect others. Empowered by a radioactive spider bite, he uses his unique abilities to fight crime while balancing the challenges of everyday life.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Spider-Man's spider-sense and agility make him extremely difficult to hit, but his damage output is limited against high-tier durability opponents. He excels in urban environments where he can use his webbing and surroundings to his advantage.
weaknesses: can be overwhelmed by enemies too durable for his damage output
limited stamina in prolonged battles against stronger foes
notableFeats: Held up part of a collapsing building to save civilians (Amazing Spider-Man #33)
Dodged machine gun fire at close range using spider-sense (Amazing Spider-Man #14)
Defeated Firelord, a Herald of Galactus, in combat (Amazing Spider-Man #270)
Lifted a subway car to save passengers (Spider-Man Vol. 1 #1)
Survived a direct hit from the Hulk (Amazing Spider-Man #328)
Outsmarted and defeated Doctor Octopus in numerous encounters
specialRules: spider-sense can pre-empt traps and direct attacks
webbing can incapacitate most opponents temporarily

name: Wonder Woman
specialAbility: Blessed by the Olympian gods, she wields divine weapons and possesses superhuman strength, speed, and combat skill.
weaknesses: Binding by her own Lasso of Truth or severing her connection to Olympus can weaken her powers.
description: Wonder Woman is the Amazonian princess Diana of Themyscira, trained from birth as a warrior and blessed by the gods with divine powers. She is a champion of justice, combining unmatched combat skill with divine weaponry and unyielding resolve.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Wonder Woman's divine blessings make her a formidable opponent, but her effectiveness can be reduced by exploiting her connection to Olympus or overwhelming her with superior magic.
weaknesses: binding by her own Lasso of Truth
can be overpowered by beings of higher divine rank
notableFeats: Held her own against Superman in combat (Wonder Woman Vol 4 #13)
Deflected Darkseid's Omega Beams with her bracelets (Justice League Vol 2 #6)
Lifted and threw a massive tank weighing hundreds of tons (Wonder Woman Vol 3 #2)
Defeated Ares, the God of War, in direct combat (Wonder Woman Vol 2 #14)
Survived a nuclear explosion with minimal injury (Wonder Woman Vol 2 #219)
Fought toe-to-toe with Doomsday (Superman/Wonder Woman #2)
specialRules: divine blessings enhance her physical stats
can deflect projectiles with her bracelets

name: Iron Man
specialAbility: Genius inventor utilizing advanced powered armor with repulsor technology, nanotech adaptability, and tactical brilliance.
weaknesses: Reliant on suit functionality; vulnerable to EMPs, hacking, or prolonged energy depletion.
description: Tony Stark, a genius billionaire and philanthropist, created the Iron Man suit to escape captivity and has since refined it into one of the most advanced pieces of technology in the Marvel Universe. His suits are equipped with cutting-edge weaponry, flight systems, and adaptive capabilities, making him a formidable force in any battle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Iron Man's effectiveness is highly dependent on his suit's energy reserves and loadout configuration. He excels in ranged combat but can struggle against opponents who can bypass his technology or engage him in prolonged melee combat.
weaknesses: vulnerable to EMP or tech disruption
limited melee durability against superhuman strength
notableFeats: Defeated the Hulk using the Hulkbuster armor (Avengers Vol 5 #44).
Survived a direct hit from Mjolnir while in his Bleeding Edge armor (Fear Itself #7).
Fought and temporarily held his own against Thor (Avengers Vol 3 #63).
Created a suit capable of fighting the Phoenix Force (Avengers vs. X-Men #5).
Defeated an army of Extremis-enhanced soldiers (Iron Man Vol 5 #5).
Repaired a Dyson Sphere and used its energy to power his suit (Iron Man Vol 4 #12).
specialRules: suit loadout determines approach and can pivot quickly
energy reserves limit sustained high-output attacks

name: Naruto Uzumaki
specialAbility: Harnesses the immense chakra of the Nine-Tails, combined with Sage Mode and advanced ninjutsu techniques like Rasenshuriken.
weaknesses: Emotional attachment to friends can make him predictable, and prolonged battles can strain his chakra reserves.
description: Naruto Uzumaki is the determined ninja who rose from being an outcast to becoming the Seventh Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village. His mastery of the Nine-Tails chakra, Sage Mode, and his unyielding willpower make him one of the most powerful shinobi in history.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Naruto's power scales significantly with his emotional state and his bond with Kurama. His versatility and adaptability make him a formidable opponent in almost any scenario.
notableFeats: Defeated Pain and saved the Hidden Leaf Village (Naruto Shippuden Episode 175)
Fought and defeated Kaguya Otsutsuki alongside Sasuke (Naruto Shippuden Episode 474)
Mastered Sage Mode and defeated the Nine-Tails (Naruto Shippuden Episode 381)
Fought on par with Sasuke during their final battle (Naruto Shippuden Episode 476-477)
Created a massive Rasenshuriken capable of devastating entire landscapes (Naruto Shippuden Episode 88)
specialRules: Clone feints create pressure and confusion before the real finisher lands
Kurama's chakra enhances all physical and energy-based attacks

name: Thor
specialAbility: Wields Mjolnir to control lightning and unleash devastating attacks, enhanced by the Odinforce.
weaknesses: Arrogance and reliance on worthiness to wield Mjolnir can limit his power.
description: Thor, the Asgardian God of Thunder, is a warrior of immense strength and divine heritage. His enchanted hammer Mjolnir and mastery of lightning make him one of the most formidable beings in the Marvel Universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Thor's power is deeply tied to his worthiness and emotional state, making him unpredictable in battle.
notableFeats: Defeated the World Serpent in single combat (Thor #380)
Lifted the Midgard Serpent, a feat of immeasurable strength (Thor #327)
Survived a blast from the God Bomb (Thor: God of Thunder #11)
Destroyed a star with Mjolnir (Thor Annual #9)
Fought Gorr the God Butcher across multiple timelines (Thor: God of Thunder #1-11)

name: Sherlock Holmes
specialAbility: Unmatched deductive reasoning and strategic planning.
weaknesses: Limited physical capabilities and overconfidence in intellect.
description: Sherlock Holmes is the world's greatest consulting detective, renowned for his razor-sharp mind and unparalleled observational skills. His ability to solve complex mysteries and outwit opponents makes him a legend in Victorian fiction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Holmes relies on intellect and strategy rather than physical prowess, making him a unique combatant.
notableFeats: Solved the mystery of the Hound of the Baskervilles (The Hound of the Baskervilles)
Uncovered Moriarty's criminal empire (The Final Problem)
Survived a deadly encounter at Reichenbach Falls (The Final Problem)
Solved the case of the Speckled Band (The Adventure of the Speckled Band)
Disguised himself to infiltrate criminal organizations (Various stories)

name: Darth Vader
specialAbility: Force mastery, lightsaber combat, and precognitive battle sense.
weaknesses: Reliance on life-support systems and inner conflict between light and dark sides.
description: Darth Vader, formerly Anakin Skywalker, is a Sith Lord consumed by rage and the dark side of the Force. His mastery of the Force and lightsaber combat make him a terrifying opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vader's power is amplified by his anger and connection to the dark side, but his inner conflict can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Obi-Wan Kenobi in a duel (Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope)
Destroyed the Jedi Temple during Order 66 (Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith)
Fought and defeated multiple Jedi simultaneously (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)
Survived severe injuries and continued fighting (Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith)
Overpowered Luke Skywalker in their first duel (Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back)

name: Gandalf
specialAbility: Wields ancient Istari magic and divine authority to combat evil.
weaknesses: Self-imposed limits and vulnerability in mortal form.
description: Gandalf, the Grey Pilgrim turned White Wizard, is a Maia spirit sent to Middle-earth to guide its inhabitants against darkness. His wisdom and restrained use of power make him a key figure in the fight against Sauron.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gandalf's power is restrained by his mission to guide rather than dominate, but he can unleash devastating magic when necessary.
notableFeats: Defeated the Balrog of Moria (The Fellowship of the Ring)
Guided the Fellowship through perilous journeys (The Lord of the Rings)
Resurrected as Gandalf the White (The Two Towers)
Defended Minas Tirith against overwhelming odds (The Return of the King)
Confronted Saruman and broke his staff (The Two Towers)

name: Hermione Granger
specialAbility: Advanced spellcasting, time manipulation, battle strategy, Legilimency resistance
weaknesses: Follows rules under pressure, emotional triggers
description: Hermione Granger is the brightest witch of her age, known for her exceptional magical mastery and relentless study. Her intelligence and resourcefulness make her a key figure in the fight against dark magic.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hermione's intelligence and magical skill make her a formidable opponent, but her reliance on preparation can be exploited.
notableFeats: Mastered advanced spells like Protego Maxima and Obliviate (Harry Potter series)
Used a Time-Turner to attend multiple classes simultaneously (Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban)
Successfully brewed Polyjuice Potion as a second-year student (Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets)
Defeated Death Eaters using tactical spell combinations (Harry Potter series)

name: Vegeta
specialAbility: Final Flash, Big Bang Attack, Super Saiyan Blue Evolution, pride-powered breakthroughs
weaknesses: Pride becomes a combat liability, slower than Goku
description: Vegeta, the Prince of all Saiyans, is a warrior driven by pride and ambition. His relentless pursuit of strength has led him to achieve god-like power levels.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vegeta's pride often drives him to surpass his limits, but it can also lead to tactical missteps.
weaknesses: slower than Goku in combat speed
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire planet with a single attack (Dragon Ball Z)
Achieved Super Saiyan Blue Evolution during the Tournament of Power (Dragon Ball Super)
Held his own against Jiren, one of the strongest beings in the multiverse (Dragon Ball Super)
Defeated Toppo, a God of Destruction candidate, using sheer power (Dragon Ball Super)

name: Batman
specialAbility: World's greatest detective, peak human combat mastery, limitless gadgetry
weaknesses: No superpowers, susceptible to magic, vulnerable without preparation
description: Batman, the Dark Knight of Gotham, is a master tactician and martial artist who uses his intellect and gadgets to fight crime and superhuman threats.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Batman thrives in situations where preparation and strategy can overcome raw power.
weaknesses: limited damage ceiling without prep tools
notableFeats: Defeated Superman using kryptonite and tactical planning (Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice)
Outsmarted Ra's al Ghul and dismantled the League of Assassins (Batman Begins)
Survived and defeated Bane despite being physically outmatched (The Dark Knight Rises)
Solved the Riddler's most complex puzzles and traps (Batman comics)
specialRules: creates advantages through terrain, timing, and gadgets

name: The Flash
specialAbility: Speed Force mastery, time travel, infinite mass punch, vibration phasing
weaknesses: Needs to eat constantly, vulnerable to specific frequency vibrations, emotionally reactive
description: Barry Allen, the Flash, is the fastest man alive, capable of manipulating the Speed Force to achieve feats of speed and time manipulation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Flash's speed makes him nearly untouchable, but his emotional vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Ran faster than the speed of light to reverse time (Justice League movie)
Defeated Zoom by outpacing him and using time remnants (The Flash TV series)
Phased through solid objects to escape traps (The Flash comics)
Delivered an Infinite Mass Punch capable of planetary-level impact (The Flash comics)
specialRules: can act before many opponents process the first movement

name: Aquaman
specialAbility: Atlantean strength, telepathic marine control, Trident of Poseidon, ocean pressure adaptation
weaknesses: Prolonged time away from water weakens him, telepathy limited on land
description: Aquaman, King of Atlantis, commands the ocean and its creatures while wielding the legendary Trident of Poseidon. His Atlantean heritage grants him immense strength and durability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Aquaman is a powerhouse in aquatic environments but less effective on land.
notableFeats: Defeated Orm, the Ocean Master, in single combat (Aquaman movie)
Lifted a submarine and threw it onto land (Aquaman movie)
Commanded a massive sea creature to aid in battle (Aquaman movie)
Survived the crushing pressures of the ocean's depths (Aquaman comics)
specialRules: can summon sea life for assistance

name: Green Lantern
specialAbility: Willpower-forged constructs, flight, force fields, reality shaping limited by imagination.
weaknesses: Yellow color historically effective, constructs powered by willpower — doubt weakens them.
description: Hal Jordan, chosen by an alien ring to join the universe's greatest police force. His will makes him one of the most powerful beings alive.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Green Lantern's power scales directly with his willpower and creativity, making him highly adaptable in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Sinestro in a one-on-one battle (Green Lantern Vol. 4 #25).
Held his own against Parallax while resisting its influence (Green Lantern: Rebirth #6).
Created a construct large enough to hold an entire city (Green Lantern Vol. 3 #50).
Survived direct attacks from Anti-Monitor during Crisis on Infinite Earths.
specialRules: versatility depends on imagination and willpower

name: Shazam
specialAbility: Solomon's wisdom, Hercules's strength, Atlas's stamina, Zeus's lightning bolts, Achilles's invulnerability, Mercury's speed.
weaknesses: Returns to human form when saying his name, magic origin creates unique vulnerabilities.
description: Young Billy Batson who transforms into an adult superhero by shouting 'Shazam!', granted the powers of six legendary figures.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shazam's powers are derived from divine sources, making him a formidable opponent against magical and physical threats.
notableFeats: Defeated Black Adam in a prolonged battle (Shazam Vol. 1 #28).
Held his own against Superman in a physical confrontation (Kingdom Come #4).
Destroyed a massive magical construct with Zeus's lightning (Shazam Vol. 2 #1).
Saved an entire city from destruction using Atlas's stamina and strength.
specialRules: transforms back to human when saying 'Shazam!'

name: Black Adam
specialAbility: Ancient Egyptian divine power, black lightning, mind domination, godlike combat experience.
weaknesses: Magic word vulnerability, emotional instability from personal tragedy.
description: Teth-Adam, once champion of ancient Kahndaq, corrupted by grief. He wields the same godly powers as Shazam but with millennia of ruthless combat experience.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Black Adam's millennia of experience make him a deadly combatant, but his emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated the Justice League single-handedly (Black Adam: Year of the Villain #1).
Destroyed an entire army with black lightning (52 Week 16).
Held his own against Shazam in multiple battles (Shazam Vol. 1 #28).
Conquered Kahndaq and ruled as its god-like protector.

name: Deathstroke
specialAbility: Enhanced senses, regenerative healing, superhumanly fast brain processing, master assassin of all known weapons.
weaknesses: Lost an eye, overconfidence against perceived lesser threats.
description: Slade Wilson, enhanced mercenary super-soldier whose brain operates at 90% capacity. The world's deadliest assassin.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Deathstroke's enhanced brain processing and combat experience make him a deadly opponent even against superhumans.
notableFeats: Defeated Batman in hand-to-hand combat (Deathstroke Vol. 3 #5).
Took down an entire squad of meta-humans single-handedly (Identity Crisis #3).
Survived a direct explosion and continued fighting (Deathstroke Vol. 2 #8).
Outsmarted the Justice League during a mission (Identity Crisis #4).

name: Lex Luthor
specialAbility: Kryptonite weaponry, genius-level engineering, powered battle suit, manipulation and resources.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on technology and kryptonite, physically outmatched without armor.
description: The most brilliant human mind on Earth, driven by a pathological hatred of Superman. His inventions and schemes have challenged gods.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lex Luthor's intellect and resources make him a dangerous opponent, especially against Kryptonians.
notableFeats: Created a suit capable of fighting Superman (Action Comics #544).
Outsmarted Brainiac and took control of his technology (Superman Vol. 2 #167).
Manipulated the entire Justice League into a trap (Justice League Vol. 2 #31).
Successfully ran for President of the United States (Lex 2000 #1).

name: Zatanna
specialAbility: Commands reality through backwards-spoken spells, enabling transmutation, teleportation, and mind control.
weaknesses: Requires verbal incantations; silencing her renders her powerless.
description: Zatanna Zatara is a powerful magician and stage performer who uses her unique spellcasting ability to manipulate reality. Her magic is versatile but dependent on her ability to speak.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zatanna is a key member of the Justice League Dark, often relied upon for her magical expertise in supernatural crises.
notableFeats: Defeated powerful magical entities like Felix Faust (Justice League Dark #1).
Sealed a dimensional rift threatening Earth (Zatanna #7).
Resurrected a teammate using advanced magic (Justice League Dark #5).
Held her own against Doctor Fate in a magical duel (Justice League Dark #10).

name: Martian Manhunter
specialAbility: Telepathy, shapeshifting, intangibility, flight, and superhuman strength rivaling Superman.
weaknesses: Psychological fear of fire and vulnerability to flame-based attacks.
description: J'onn J'onzz, the Martian Manhunter, is one of the most powerful beings in the DC Universe, combining immense physical strength with unparalleled telepathic abilities. He is a cornerstone of the Justice League.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Martian Manhunter's versatility makes him a key player in both physical and mental battles.
notableFeats: Defeated Despero in a telepathic battle (Justice League of America #38).
Lifted an entire building with ease (Martian Manhunter #3).
Held his own against Superman in combat (Action Comics #775).
Resisted mind control from Brainiac (Justice League #23).

name: Hulk
specialAbility: Strength scales infinitely with rage, gamma radiation immunity, and regenerative healing factor.
weaknesses: Calmness reverts him to Banner; intelligence diminishes as rage increases.
description: The Hulk is the ultimate expression of raw power, with strength that grows exponentially as his anger increases. His regenerative abilities and durability make him nearly unstoppable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hulk's strength and durability make him a universal threat, but his rage can be exploited.
notableFeats: Destroyed a planet with a single punch (World War Hulk #5).
Defeated Thor in combat (Hulk Annual #2001).
Survived a nuclear explosion (Hulk #340).
Lifted a mountain range (Secret Wars #4).

name: Captain America
specialAbility: Peak physical perfection and Vibranium shield mastery.
weaknesses: Limited offensive capabilities without his shield.
description: Captain America is the embodiment of human potential, combining peak physical abilities with unmatched tactical acumen. His Vibranium shield is both a weapon and a defense.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Captain America's leadership and tactical brilliance make him a cornerstone of the Avengers.
notableFeats: Defeated Iron Man in hand-to-hand combat (Civil War #7).
Held back Thanos momentarily (Infinity Gauntlet #6).
Lifted Mjolnir and wielded its power (Avengers: Endgame).
Led the Avengers against Loki's invasion (The Avengers #1).
specialRules: can rally allies for morale boosts

name: Doctor Strange
specialAbility: Master of the Mystic Arts, capable of time manipulation, dimensional travel, and astral projection.
weaknesses: Physical body is vulnerable during astral projection.
description: Doctor Strange is the Sorcerer Supreme, wielding immense magical power to protect Earth from mystical and cosmic threats. His mastery of magic makes him one of the most versatile heroes in the Marvel Universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Doctor Strange's mastery of magic makes him a universal-level threat capable of altering reality itself.
weaknesses: requires time to set up spells
notableFeats: Defeated Dormammu by trapping him in a time loop (Doctor Strange #1).
Sealed a multiversal rift threatening reality (Infinity Wars #6).
Held his own against Galactus using advanced magic (Doctor Strange #13).
Defended Earth from the Mindless Ones (Doctor Strange #5).

name: Wolverine
specialAbility: Adamantium skeleton and retractable claws, instant regenerative healing factor, enhanced senses, centuries of combat experience.
weaknesses: Magnetism controls his metal skeleton, psychological trauma from memories, berserker state reduces tactical thinking.
description: James Howlett, over a century old, with a skeleton fused with indestructible Adamantium and a healing factor that makes him nearly unkillable. Wolverine is a feral yet disciplined fighter who thrives in close combat and can endure extreme punishment.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Wolverine's healing factor and combat experience make him a formidable opponent in any close-range battle.
weaknesses: reduced tactical thinking in berserker state
notableFeats: Survived a nuclear explosion (Marvel Comics: Old Man Logan).
Defeated Hulk in a prolonged battle (Marvel Comics: Wolverine vs Hulk).
Regenerated from being reduced to a skeleton (Marvel Comics: Civil War).
Tracked enemies across continents using enhanced senses (Marvel Comics: Wolverine solo series).
Fought and defeated multiple enemies while poisoned (Marvel Comics: Wolverine Vol. 3).
v3Profile.profanityStyle: moderate — goddamn, hell, occasional stronger; gritty and direct

name: Magneto
specialAbility: Total electromagnetic field mastery, metal manipulation, magnetic force fields, EMP generation, levitation.
weaknesses: Non-metal projectiles can bypass defenses, helmet blocks telepathy but limits his own senses.
description: Erik Lehnsherr, Holocaust survivor turned mutant revolutionary. Magneto is the master of magnetism, capable of manipulating metal on a planetary scale and generating powerful electromagnetic fields.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Magneto's mastery of magnetism makes him a dangerous opponent against metal-based enemies.
notableFeats: Lifted an entire submarine from the ocean (Marvel Comics: X-Men).
Redirected Earth's magnetic poles (Marvel Comics: X-Men: Fatal Attractions).
Defeated the X-Men single-handedly (Marvel Comics: X-Men Vol. 1).
Created a force field strong enough to withstand nuclear blasts (Marvel Comics: X-Men).
Manipulated Wolverine's adamantium skeleton to incapacitate him (Marvel Comics: X-Men).

name: Deadpool
specialAbility: Virtually unkillable healing factor, fourth-wall breaking, expert mercenary combat, katana mastery, unlimited unpredictability.
weaknesses: Healing factor can be overwhelmed, cancer cells spread when healing is suppressed, emotionally erratic.
description: Wade Wilson, the Merc with a Mouth. Deadpool's accelerated healing factor makes him virtually immortal, and his chaotic nature makes him unpredictable in combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Deadpool's chaotic nature and healing factor make him a wildcard in any battle.
notableFeats: Survived decapitation and regenerated fully (Marvel Comics: Deadpool Vol. 1).
Defeated Taskmaster in combat using unpredictability (Marvel Comics: Deadpool Vol. 2).
Took down an entire mercenary squad solo (Marvel Comics: Deadpool Vol. 3).
Regenerated from being reduced to a puddle of flesh (Marvel Comics: Deadpool Vol. 4).
Defeated Wolverine in a prolonged fight (Marvel Comics: Deadpool vs Wolverine).
v3Profile.profanityStyle: heavy — constant f-bombs, crude sexual humor, zero filter, talks shit mid-fight

name: Thanos
specialAbility: Infinity Gauntlet reality rewriting, cosmic energy projection, tactical genius, immense physical power, virtually indestructible.
weaknesses: Subconscious desire to lose, Infinity Stones can be taken or separated, hubris.
description: The Mad Titan who gathered the Infinity Stones to reshape reality. Thanos is a cosmic-level threat whose power dwarfs most beings in the universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Thanos's power is nearly unmatched, but his subconscious desire to lose can be exploited.
notableFeats: Wielded the Infinity Gauntlet to erase half of all life in the universe (Marvel Comics: Infinity Gauntlet).
Defeated the Avengers and cosmic entities in battle (Marvel Comics: Infinity War).
Destroyed planets with physical strength alone (Marvel Comics: Thanos solo series).
Survived attacks from cosmic-level beings like Galactus (Marvel Comics: Thanos vs Galactus).
Outsmarted cosmic entities like Eternity and Death (Marvel Comics: Infinity Gauntlet).

name: Captain Marvel
specialAbility: Binary form energy blasts, photon absorption and redirection, space flight, energy field manipulation.
weaknesses: Memory suppression exploitable, overconfidence, human emotions can be manipulated.
description: Carol Danvers, Air Force pilot infused with Kree energy. Captain Marvel is a powerhouse capable of absorbing and redirecting energy to devastating effect.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Captain Marvel's Binary form makes her one of the most powerful energy manipulators in the universe.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire fleet of alien ships in Binary form (Marvel Comics: Captain Marvel Vol. 1).
Absorbed and redirected a nuclear explosion (Marvel Comics: Captain Marvel Vol. 2).
Defeated Thor in a one-on-one battle (Marvel Comics: Avengers vs X-Men).
Survived and fought in the vacuum of space (Marvel Comics: Captain Marvel Vol. 3).
Overpowered Ronan the Accuser in combat (Marvel Comics: Captain Marvel Vol. 4).

name: Scarlet Witch
specialAbility: Chaos magic — probability manipulation and reality warping on a universal scale; hex bolts that trigger catastrophic failure in any system; House of M level reality rewrite; Decimation-level power stripping; telekinesis; telepathy; can unmake beings by editing them out of existence.
weaknesses: Emotional instability is the core vulnerability — grief, rage, and guilt have each triggered catastrophic uncontrolled reality warps that harmed allies; her power requires conscious intent and psychological stability to deploy at full scale.
description: Wanda Maximoff said "No More Mutants" and 90% of the mutant population lost their powers overnight. She rewrote an entire Marvel universe on a whim. At full power, Scarlet Witch is not a superhero — she is a reality architect who occasionally chooses to interact with smaller problems. The Avengers are afraid of her. They are right to be.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Scarlet Witch's power is feared even by cosmic entities due to her ability to rewrite reality itself.
notableFeats: Erased 90% of mutant powers with 'No More Mutants' (House of M).
Rewrote the Marvel universe into an alternate reality (House of M).
Defeated Doctor Strange in a magical duel (Avengers: Disassembled).
Destroyed Ultron drones with hex bolts (Avengers).
Held her own against Thanos in combat (Avengers: Endgame).

name: Silver Surfer
specialAbility: Power Cosmic energy manipulation, speed of light travel, matter transmutation, near-omnipotent cosmic awareness.
weaknesses: Emotional sensitivity, banishment from Earth by Galactus, compassion exploited.
description: Norrin Radd, the Silver Surfer, herald of Galactus. He wields the Power Cosmic, a near-limitless source of universal energy. His speed and cosmic awareness make him one of the most formidable beings in the Marvel Universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Silver Surfer's mastery of the Power Cosmic makes him a universal-level threat capable of reshaping matter and energy.
notableFeats: Destroyed a planet with a single energy blast (Silver Surfer Vol. 3).
Outran a black hole (Silver Surfer: Requiem).
Defeated Thor in combat (Silver Surfer Vol. 1).
Resisted Galactus' mind control (Fantastic Four).
Restored life to a dying planet (Silver Surfer Vol. 2).

name: Ghost Rider
specialAbility: Hellfire chain, Penance Stare that burns with accumulated sins, nearly indestructible skeleton, supernatural speed on the bike.
weaknesses: Holy water, weapons forged in Heaven, the presence of pure innocence.
description: Johnny Blaze, bonded with the demon Zarathos to become the Spirit of Vengeance. He punishes the wicked with the fires of Hell. Ghost Rider's Penance Stare is feared even by gods.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ghost Rider's powers are tied to vengeance, making him stronger against those with greater sins.
notableFeats: Defeated Mephisto in Hell (Ghost Rider Vol. 2).
Destroyed a demon army with Hellfire (Ghost Rider Vol. 1).
Survived a direct attack from Thor's hammer (Ghost Rider Vol. 3).
Used Penance Stare to incapacitate Galactus (Marvel Comics).
Resisted Zarathos' control and retained his humanity (Ghost Rider Vol. 4).
specialRules: can bypass durability with Penance Stare
v3Profile.profanityStyle: light — occasional damn or hell as Johnny Blaze, ghost rider speaks more ominously

name: Daredevil
specialAbility: Radar sense giving 360-degree spatial awareness, hyper-sensitive touch hearing smell taste, fearless hand-to-hand combat.
weaknesses: Supersenses overwhelmed by sensory overload, no powers beyond heightened senses.
description: Matt Murdock, blinded by radioactive chemicals that supercharged his remaining senses. By night, the Devil of Hell's Kitchen. Daredevil is a master martial artist who uses his heightened senses to dominate close-quarters combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Daredevil's radar sense and martial arts mastery make him a formidable opponent in urban environments.
notableFeats: Defeated Kingpin in hand-to-hand combat (Daredevil Vol. 1).
Survived a fight against Bullseye despite being injured (Daredevil Vol. 2).
Took down multiple armed thugs using stealth and precision (Daredevil: Born Again).
Resisted mind control from Purple Man (Daredevil Vol. 3).
Saved civilians during a collapsing building using acrobatics (Daredevil Vol. 4).

name: Gohan
specialAbility: Mystic Unleashed form, Masenko, Solar Kamehameha, hidden power that surpasses Goku when fully awakened.
weaknesses: Overconfidence, power wanes when he stops training.
description: Son of Goku, Gohan possesses a latent power that, when unleashed, surpasses all other Saiyans. Scholar and fighter combined, Gohan's Mystic form is a testament to his untapped potential.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gohan's Mystic form represents his full potential, making him a universal-level threat when fully unleashed.
notableFeats: Defeated Perfect Cell with Father-Son Kamehameha (Dragon Ball Z).
Held his own against Super Buu in Mystic form (Dragon Ball Z).
Overpowered Frieza in Resurrection F (Dragon Ball Super).
Unlocked Mystic form through Elder Kai's ritual (Dragon Ball Z).
Defeated Gamma 1 and 2 in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero.
specialRules: requires consistent training for peak performance

name: Piccolo
specialAbility: Namekian regeneration, Special Beam Cannon, weight-shedding, organ regeneration, limitless energy boost.
weaknesses: Holy water, power ceiling lower than top Saiyans.
description: Namekian warrior and Gohan's mentor. His Special Beam Cannon can pierce virtually anything, and he regenerates limbs mid-combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Piccolo's strategic mind and regeneration make him a formidable fighter despite not being the strongest.
weaknesses: lower power ceiling compared to Saiyans
notableFeats: Destroyed Raditz with Special Beam Cannon (Dragon Ball Z).
Held his own against Android 17 (Dragon Ball Z).
Fused with Kami to achieve a massive power boost (Dragon Ball Z).
Defended Earth against Frieza's army (Dragon Ball Super).
Trained Gohan to unlock his potential (Dragon Ball Z).

name: Frieza
specialAbility: Death Ball, Nova Strike, Golden Form, absolute zero survivability in space, resurrection and power amplification.
weaknesses: Overconfidence, pride prevents retreating even when defeated.
description: The galactic emperor who destroyed Planet Vegeta. In his Golden Form, he rivals the gods of destruction themselves.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Frieza's cunning and adaptability make him a dangerous opponent even against stronger foes.
notableFeats: Destroyed Planet Vegeta with a single attack (Dragon Ball Z).
Achieved Golden Form to rival Super Saiyan Blue (Dragon Ball Super).
Survived absolute zero temperatures in space (Dragon Ball Z).
Defeated Goku and Vegeta in Resurrection F (Dragon Ball Super).
Participated in the Tournament of Power and outlasted many fighters (Dragon Ball Super).

name: Cell
specialAbility: Perfect Form absorbing abilities of all fighters, regeneration from a single cell, Kamehameha, Solar Flare, self-destruction.
weaknesses: Perfect Form requires Androids 17 and 18 to maintain, can explode recklessly.
description: An artificial life form engineered with the DNA of history's greatest warriors. In Perfect Form, he combines the abilities of all.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cell's adaptability and regeneration make him a persistent threat even against stronger opponents.
weaknesses: requires Androids 17 and 18 for Perfect Form
notableFeats: Achieved Perfect Form by absorbing Androids 17 and 18 (Dragon Ball Z).
Defeated Goku in the Cell Games (Dragon Ball Z).
Regenerated from a single cell after self-destruction (Dragon Ball Z).
Destroyed Future Trunks with a single attack (Dragon Ball Z).
Matched Super Saiyan 2 Gohan in combat (Dragon Ball Z).

name: Beerus
specialAbility: Hakai disintegration of matter and energy, God of Destruction aura, Ultra Instinct glimpses, destroying planets with a sneeze.
weaknesses: Sleep deprivation drops his power, bound by divine laws.
description: The God of Destruction for Universe 7. Even sleeping, his power dwarfs that of all mortal warriors. He fights with casual omnipotence.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beerus's Hakai ability makes him one of the most dangerous beings in the multiverse.
notableFeats: Destroyed half a planet with a sneeze (Dragon Ball Super).
Defeated Goku and Vegeta simultaneously (Dragon Ball Super).
Used Hakai to erase Zamasu (Dragon Ball Super).
Fought evenly with Super Saiyan God Goku (Dragon Ball Super).
Destroyed multiple planets casually (Dragon Ball Super).

name: Jiren
specialAbility: Power of will overcoming all limits, Power Impact, Infinity Rush, meditation-amplified strength, instinct-level reaction speed.
weaknesses: Over-reliance on raw power, isolation makes him underestimate teamwork.
description: The strongest mortal in Universe 11, Jiren's sheer willpower allows him to fight at levels that surpass even gods of destruction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jiren's unmatched willpower makes him a nearly unstoppable force in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Hit in the Tournament of Power (Dragon Ball Super).
Fought evenly with Ultra Instinct Goku (Dragon Ball Super).
Destroyed a massive energy blast with sheer force (Dragon Ball Super).
Meditation amplified his strength to new levels (Dragon Ball Super).
Survived attacks from multiple universes' strongest fighters (Dragon Ball Super).

name: Broly
specialAbility: Legendary Super Saiyan — continuously growing power with no known limit, Eraser Cannon, Omega Blaster that destroys planets.
weaknesses: Battle frenzy makes him impossible to control, no tactical thinking in berserker state.
description: The Legendary Super Saiyan, born with an incomprehensible power level. In his Legendary form, his strength has no upper ceiling.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Broly's power grows exponentially during combat, making him a threat to even the strongest fighters.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire planet with Omega Blaster (Dragon Ball Super: Broly).
Overpowered Super Saiyan Blue Goku and Vegeta simultaneously (Dragon Ball Super: Broly).
Survived a direct attack from Gogeta's Kamehameha (Dragon Ball Super: Broly).
Shattered dimensional barriers during his fight with Gogeta (Dragon Ball Super: Broly).

name: Voldemort
specialAbility: Horcrux-based immortality, Avada Kedavra killing curse, Parseltongue, Legilimency, soul possession.
weaknesses: Horcruxes must be destroyed to kill him, fear of death is his greatest flaw, love magic.
description: Tom Riddle, the darkest wizard of the age. He split his soul into seven Horcruxes to achieve immortality and commands unrivaled dark magic.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Voldemort's mastery of dark magic and immortality make him a nearly unstoppable force.
notableFeats: Created seven Horcruxes to achieve immortality (Harry Potter series).
Defeated multiple skilled wizards in duels, including the Ministry's Aurors (Harry Potter series).
Killed countless victims with the Avada Kedavra curse (Harry Potter series).
Manipulated and controlled numerous individuals using the Imperius Curse (Harry Potter series).
specialRules: requires destruction of Horcruxes to kill
fear of death limits his decisions

name: Dumbledore
specialAbility: Elder Wand mastery, Transfiguration grand master, Fawkes the phoenix healing, omniscient strategic planning.
weaknesses: Age, the Horcrux curse consumed his hand, guilt over his past.
description: Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore, considered the greatest wizard of his generation. His mastery of magic, strategy, and wisdom is unmatched.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dumbledore's wisdom and magical prowess make him a formidable opponent in any battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Grindelwald in a legendary duel (Fantastic Beasts series).
Mastered the Elder Wand, the most powerful wand in existence (Harry Potter series).
Protected Hogwarts from Voldemort's forces with advanced magic (Harry Potter series).
Guided Harry Potter in his quest to defeat Voldemort (Harry Potter series).

name: Luke Skywalker
specialAbility: Force mastery, lightsaber combat at Jedi Master level, Force projection across the galaxy, Force heal.
weaknesses: Compassion and mercy can be exploited, dark side temptation.
description: The last Jedi who redeemed his father and became the most powerful Force user of the Skywalker era.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Luke's mastery of the Force and lightsaber combat make him a beacon of hope for the galaxy.
notableFeats: Defeated Darth Vader in combat (Star Wars: Episode VI).
Redeemed Anakin Skywalker from the dark side (Star Wars: Episode VI).
Projected his presence across the galaxy to confront Kylo Ren (Star Wars: Episode VIII).
Trained Rey in the ways of the Force (Star Wars: Episode VIII).
specialRules: can project presence across the galaxy

name: Yoda
specialAbility: 900 years of Force wisdom, Form IV Ataru lightsaber mastery, Force lightning deflection, precognition through the Force.
weaknesses: Tiny stature is a physical disadvantage, age limits extended physical combat.
description: Grand Master of the Jedi Order for 800 years. His connection to the Force transcends physical form. Size matters not.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yoda's wisdom and mastery of the Force make him one of the most formidable Jedi in history.
notableFeats: Defeated Count Dooku in lightsaber combat (Star Wars: Episode II).
Fought Darth Sidious to a standstill (Star Wars: Episode III).
Trained generations of Jedi in the ways of the Force (Star Wars series).
Deflected Force lightning with his bare hands (Star Wars: Episode III).

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
specialAbility: Master of Soresu Form III, unparalleled defensive combat, Force-enhanced reflexes and precognition.
weaknesses: Excessive mercy and refusal to fight dishonorably can leave him vulnerable.
description: Obi-Wan Kenobi is a legendary Jedi Master who defeated Darth Maul, General Grievous, and Anakin Skywalker, embodying the ideals of the Jedi Order.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Obi-Wan's mastery of defense makes him a formidable opponent against aggressive fighters.
notableFeats: Defeated Darth Maul in single combat (Star Wars: Episode I)
Defeated General Grievous using Soresu mastery (Star Wars: Episode III)
Defeated Anakin Skywalker on Mustafar (Star Wars: Episode III)
Survived Order 66 and protected Luke Skywalker (Star Wars: Episode IV)

name: Palpatine
specialAbility: Supreme mastery of Force lightning, manipulation of midi-chlorians, and Sith sorcery.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and reliance on others for physical tasks can lead to vulnerabilities.
description: Darth Sidious, also known as Emperor Palpatine, is the most cunning and powerful Sith Lord in galactic history, orchestrating the downfall of the Jedi and ruling the galaxy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Palpatine's mastery of the dark side makes him one of the most dangerous beings in the galaxy.
notableFeats: Defeated Yoda in single combat (Star Wars: Episode III)
Manipulated Anakin Skywalker into becoming Darth Vader (Star Wars: Episode III)
Orchestrated the Clone Wars and the downfall of the Jedi Order (Star Wars: Episode II-III)
Survived death through essence transfer (Star Wars: Episode IX)
specialRules: can attack minds or senses directly

name: Mace Windu
specialAbility: Vaapad Form VII mastery channels opponent's darkness into combat advantage.
weaknesses: Rigid adherence to Jedi doctrine limits adaptability.
description: Mace Windu is a senior Jedi Council member and master of Vaapad, a fighting style that turns an opponent's aggression against them.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mace Windu's mastery of Vaapad makes him a dangerous opponent against dark side users.
notableFeats: Defeated Darth Sidious in combat (Star Wars: Episode III)
Mastered Vaapad, a dangerous lightsaber form (Star Wars Legends)
Led the Jedi strike team during the Battle of Geonosis (Star Wars: Episode II)
Discovered shatterpoint ability to reveal hidden weaknesses (Star Wars Legends)

name: Rey
specialAbility: Dyad in the Force with Kylo Ren, Force healing, and raw Force power rivaling legendary Jedi and Sith.
weaknesses: Untrained and reliant on instinct over mastery.
description: Rey is a Palpatine who chose the path of the Jedi, wielding immense raw Force power and rapidly developing lightsaber skills.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rey's raw power makes her a formidable opponent despite her lack of formal training.
notableFeats: Defeated Kylo Ren in combat (Star Wars: Episode VII)
Destroyed Palpatine using Dyad power (Star Wars: Episode IX)
Mastered Force healing (Star Wars: Episode IX)
Rapidly developed lightsaber skills (Star Wars: Episode VII-IX)

name: Ahsoka Tano
specialAbility: Dual white lightsaber combat, precognitive reflexes, and Force visions through the World Between Worlds.
weaknesses: Emotional connections can make her hesitate against former allies.
description: Ahsoka Tano, former Padawan of Anakin Skywalker, left the Jedi Order and became one of the galaxy's greatest fighters.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ahsoka's dual-wielding precision and precognition make her a dangerous opponent in combat.
notableFeats: Survived Order 66 (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)
Defeated Darth Vader in combat (Star Wars: Rebels)
Mastered dual-wielding lightsaber combat (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)
Accessed the World Between Worlds for Force visions (Star Wars: Rebels)

name: Sasuke Uchiha
specialAbility: Rinnegan and Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan grant unparalleled visual prowess, including space-time manipulation and god-tier genjutsu.
weaknesses: Rinnegan cost him an eye, and prolonged battles can drain his chakra reserves significantly.
description: Sasuke Uchiha is the last survivor of the Uchiha clan and Naruto's lifelong rival. His mastery of the Sharingan and Rinnegan makes him one of the most formidable shinobi in history.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sasuke's rivalry with Naruto has shaped his growth into one of the strongest shinobi alive.
notableFeats: Defeated Naruto in their final battle (Naruto Chapter 698)
Mastered the Rinnegan and Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan simultaneously
Destroyed meteor-sized objects with Perfect Susanoo (Naruto Chapter 674)
Fought Kaguya Otsutsuki alongside Naruto (Naruto Chapter 690)
specialRules: combines tactical reads with dangerous burst kill windows

name: Kakashi Hatake
specialAbility: Sharingan allows him to copy over 1000 jutsu, and Kamui grants dimensional warping capabilities.
weaknesses: Sharingan drains chakra rapidly for a non-Uchiha, and his single eye limits peripheral vision.
description: Kakashi Hatake, the Copy Ninja, is a legendary shinobi known for his tactical genius and mastery of countless jutsu. He served as the mentor to Team 7.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kakashi's tactical brilliance and versatility make him a dangerous opponent in any scenario.
notableFeats: Defeated Obito Uchiha in their final battle (Naruto Chapter 636)
Mastered Kamui despite being a non-Uchiha
Led Team 7 to victory against Zabuza Momochi (Naruto Chapter 32)
Held his own against Pain during the invasion of Konoha (Naruto Chapter 429)

name: Itachi Uchiha
specialAbility: Tsukuyomi genjutsu traps opponents in a 72-hour illusion within seconds, and his Susanoo wields the Yata Mirror and Totsuka Blade.
weaknesses: Terminal illness sapped his physical strength, and blindness progression from Mangekyou overuse.
description: Itachi Uchiha was a child prodigy who became an ANBU captain at 13. His mastery of genjutsu and sealing techniques makes him nearly unbeatable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Itachi's genius and sacrifice shaped the fate of the Uchiha clan and Konoha.
notableFeats: Defeated Kakashi Hatake with Tsukuyomi (Naruto Chapter 142)
Sealed Orochimaru with the Totsuka Blade (Naruto Chapter 392)
Fought Sasuke to a draw despite terminal illness (Naruto Chapter 393)
Defended Konoha by massacring the Uchiha clan (Naruto Chapter 222)

name: Madara Uchiha
specialAbility: Madara wields the Rinne-Sharingan, enabling Infinite Tsukuyomi, Limbo clones, and devastating large-scale jutsu.
weaknesses: Overconfidence in his own legend and vulnerability immediately after casting large-scale jutsu.
description: Madara Uchiha is the greatest Uchiha who ever lived, capable of fighting the entire Shinobi Alliance alone and nearly enslaving humanity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Madara's ambition and power nearly reshaped the world.
notableFeats: Fought the entire Shinobi Alliance single-handedly (Naruto Chapter 658)
Activated Infinite Tsukuyomi (Naruto Chapter 676)
Defeated Hashirama Senju in their final battle (Naruto Chapter 621)
Survived being resurrected and fought Naruto and Sasuke simultaneously (Naruto Chapter 690)

name: Minato Namikaze
specialAbility: Minato's Flying Thunder God technique makes him the fastest shinobi ever, allowing instantaneous teleportation and devastating Rasengan strikes.
weaknesses: Limited to marked locations for teleportation and sacrificed his life sealing the Nine-Tails.
description: Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage, is renowned as the fastest ninja in history. His mastery of space-time jutsu made him untouchable in battle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Minato's speed and precision made him a legend among shinobi.
notableFeats: Defeated 50 enemy shinobi single-handedly (Naruto Chapter 240)
Sealed the Nine-Tails into Naruto (Naruto Chapter 503)
Saved Konoha during the Nine-Tails attack (Naruto Chapter 502)
Developed the Rasengan (Naruto Chapter 150)

name: Monkey D. Luffy
specialAbility: Gear Fifth Sun God Nika form — cartoon physics reality warping, Haki mastery, Conqueror's Haki infusion
weaknesses: Cannot swim (Devil Fruit user), simple-minded tactics, gets bored easily
description: The future King of the Pirates. His Gear Fifth awakening transforms him into a god-like warrior who fights with the freedom of joy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Luffy's Gear Fifth awakening makes him one of the most unpredictable fighters in the One Piece universe.
signatures: Gomu Gomu no King Kong Gun
notableFeats: Defeated Kaido in Gear Fifth form (One Piece Chapter 1049)
Destroyed a fleet of ships with a single punch (One Piece Chapter 100)
Survived multiple battles against warlords and emperors

name: Roronoa Zoro
specialAbility: Three-Sword Style, King of Hell: Enma blade, Advanced Conqueror's Haki, Asura nine-sword illusion form, cutting through steel
weaknesses: No sense of direction at all, pushes through injuries that would kill lesser men — sometimes at the cost of performance
description: First mate of the Straw Hats, Zoro aims to be the world's greatest swordsman. He once absorbed all of Luffy's damage in a single act of willpower.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zoro's mastery of swordsmanship and Haki makes him a formidable combatant even against the strongest foes.
notableFeats: Defeated King, a Yonko Commander (One Piece Chapter 1036)
Blocked Kaido and Big Mom's combined attack (One Piece Chapter 1009)
Cut through steel and massive structures effortlessly
specialRules: Can bypass conventional durability with Haki

name: Dracule Mihawk
specialAbility: Yoru the world's greatest blade, Conqueror's Haki, Cross of Judgment beam, cutting across entire seas with a single swing
weaknesses: Prefers solitude, rarely shows full power, follows a strict personal code
description: Hawkeye Mihawk, the strongest swordsman in the world. His blade Yoru can split galleons and cut across vast distances with ease.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mihawk's unmatched swordsmanship makes him a benchmark for all aspiring swordsmen.
notableFeats: Clashed evenly with Shanks, a Yonko (One Piece Chapter 96)
Cut through massive ships with a single swing
Defeated Zoro effortlessly in their first encounter
specialRules: Can sense opponents' intentions with Haki

name: Whitebeard
specialAbility: Gura Gura no Mi — earthquake vibration waves that crack the air itself, tectonic plate manipulation, splitting the sea
weaknesses: Old age and illness by his final battle, protective nature for his crew is exploitable
description: Edward Newgate, the strongest man in the world. His Tremor-Tremor Fruit let him crack the air and sea with shockwaves that could destroy the world.

abilities: Gura Gura no Mi earthquake vibrations
v3Profile.loreNotes: Whitebeard's immense power and loyalty to his crew made him a legend among pirates.
notableFeats: Destroyed Marineford with shockwaves (One Piece Chapter 576)
Clashed evenly with Gol D. Roger, the Pirate King
Held off multiple Admirals in his final battle

name: Levi Ackerman
specialAbility: Ackerman clan battle instincts, superhuman anti-titan ODM combat, near-psychic battle prediction, never loses to a titan one-on-one
weaknesses: Not superhuman in the powered sense, relies on blades and maneuver gear
description: Humanity's Strongest Soldier. Captain Levi has killed more Titans than any other human and fights with an efficiency that borders on supernatural.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Levi's unmatched skill and precision make him humanity's best hope against Titans.
notableFeats: Defeated the Beast Titan single-handedly (Attack on Titan Season 3 Episode 17)
Killed dozens of Titans in a single battle
Survived multiple encounters with Titan Shifters

name: Eren Yeager
specialAbility: Attack Titan, War Hammer Titan, Founding Titan — controls all past and future Titans, The Rumbling: 1000 wall titans
weaknesses: Founding Titan requires royal blood (bypassed by Ymir), loses himself to future memories
description: Wielder of three Titans including the Founding Titan, Eren triggered the Rumbling — the release of millions of giant Titans to crush the world.

name: Daenerys Targaryen
specialAbility: Commands Drogon — the largest living dragon, capable of melting castle walls and incinerating armies; total fire immunity; Unsullied and Dothraki army command; Valyrian political authority; dragon fire cannot be quenched by conventional means
weaknesses: Her power is entirely dependent on Drogon — without the dragon she is a determined but physically ordinary human; her emotional decisions have repeatedly led to strategic catastrophe; betrayal from trusted allies is her recurring pattern of defeat
description: Daenerys Targaryen crossed a desert, survived assassination, walked into a funeral pyre, and came out the other side with three dragons. Drogon alone can melt stone walls and incinerate armies in seconds. She is not a fighter — she is a force of nature with a throne problem.

name: Night King
specialAbility: Raises the dead as wights, kills the Undead Army by dying but others can raise them, spear of ice, immune to dragonfire
weaknesses: Dragonglass and Valyrian steel kill him, and all his army falls upon his death
description: Commander of the Army of the Dead, the Night King transforms the fallen into undead warriors and can raise thousands with a single gesture.

name: Jon Snow
specialAbility: Resurrection from death, Valyrian steel Longclaw, Azor Ahai prophetic destiny, direwolf Ghost bond, Stark and Targaryen blood
weaknesses: Leads with honor to a fault, making politically devastating decisions
description: The resurrected King in the North, born of ice and fire. Jon Snow united the living against the dead and wielded Valyrian steel in defense of humanity.

name: Aragorn
specialAbility: Ranger of the North: decades of survival training, Andúril blade reforged from Narsil, can wield the Palantír, commands the Dead Army
weaknesses: Prolonged absence of kingship weakens morale of followers
description: Strider, the Dúnedain Ranger, rightful King of Gondor and Arnor. A warrior of centuries of wandering who wielded the sword that killed Sauron's physical form.

name: Legolas
specialAbility: Elven sight across leagues, perfect accuracy with a bow, and the ability to walk on snow without leaving a trace.
weaknesses: The sea calling weakens elves' connection to the mortal world, making them vulnerable to emotional despair.
description: Legolas, Prince of the Woodland Realm, is one of the finest archers in Middle-earth, capable of feats such as single-handedly taking down an Oliphaunt. His agility and precision make him a formidable combatant in ranged battles.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Legolas excels in ranged combat but struggles against magic and close-range opponents.
notableFeats: Single-handedly killed an Oliphaunt (The Two Towers).
Shot multiple arrows in rapid succession with perfect accuracy (The Fellowship of the Ring).
Walked on snow without leaving a trace (The Fellowship of the Ring).
Counted the exact number of an approaching army (The Two Towers).

name: Sauron
specialAbility: The One Ring grants dominion over all Ring-bearers, necromantic powers, and the ability to forge armies from nothing.
weaknesses: The destruction of the One Ring ends his existence, and his physical form can be destroyed at great cost.
description: Sauron, the Dark Lord of Mordor, is a Maia of godlike origin who embedded his vast power into the One Ring to dominate Middle-earth. His necromantic abilities and mastery of deception make him a terrifying force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sauron is nearly unstoppable with the One Ring but vulnerable without it.
notableFeats: Forged the One Ring to dominate Middle-earth (The Silmarillion).
Corrupted Númenor, leading to its downfall (The Silmarillion).
Created armies of Orcs and other creatures (The Lord of the Rings).
Battled the Last Alliance of Elves and Men, killing Elendil and Gil-galad (The Lord of the Rings).
specialRules: Power scales with the One Ring

name: Kratos
specialAbility: Spartan Rage amplifies strength and durability, and his arsenal includes the Blades of Chaos and Leviathan Axe.
weaknesses: Rage clouds his tactical thinking, and his grief for his family can be exploited emotionally.
description: Kratos, the Ghost of Sparta, is a demigod who has defeated the entire Greek pantheon and begun dismantling the Norse gods. His raw power and combat mastery make him one of the most dangerous warriors in fiction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kratos is a melee powerhouse but struggles against speed and psychological manipulation.
notableFeats: Defeated Ares and became the God of War (God of War).
Killed Zeus, ending the reign of the Olympian gods (God of War III).
Lifted the massive Temple of Pandora (God of War).
Defeated Baldur and other Norse gods (God of War 2018).
v3Profile.profanityStyle: moderate — strong language, rage-driven, not excessive but present

name: Geralt of Rivia
specialAbility: Witcher mutations grant enhanced senses, agility, and access to Signs like Igni and Quen.
weaknesses: Reliance on potions, which are toxic if overused, and emotional connections can be exploited.
description: Geralt of Rivia, the White Wolf, is a monster hunter whose mutations and combat mastery make him lethal against both humans and supernatural creatures. His adaptability and tactical mind are his greatest assets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Geralt excels in one-on-one combat but struggles against overwhelming numbers or magic-resistant foes.
notableFeats: Defeated the Striga, a cursed princess (The Witcher).
Killed the powerful vampire Dettlaff (The Witcher 3: Blood and Wine).
Survived the Trial of the Grasses, gaining Witcher mutations (The Witcher lore).
Defeated the Wild Hunt and saved Ciri (The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt).
specialRules: Can use alchemy to enhance abilities
v3Profile.profanityStyle: moderate — Slavic-flavored cursing, damn, shit, controlled

name: Master Chief
specialAbility: Mjolnir armor enhances strength, durability, and reflexes, while Cortana provides tactical support.
weaknesses: Vulnerable without armor, and dependence on Cortana can be exploited.
description: Master Chief, the last Spartan-II, is a super-soldier who has saved humanity from alien threats multiple times. His tactical mind and enhanced abilities make him a near-perfect warrior.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Master Chief is a tactical powerhouse but relies heavily on his armor and Cortana.
notableFeats: Destroyed the Covenant's Halo ring (Halo: Combat Evolved).
Defeated the Didact and saved Earth (Halo 4).
Survived the Fall of Reach (Halo lore).
Led humanity's forces against the Flood (Halo series).
specialRules: Adaptive strategy based on AI input

name: Cloud Strife
specialAbility: Omnislash seventeen-hit combo, Buster Sword and its six transforming blades, Limit Breaks, Mako-infused superhuman physiology.
weaknesses: PTSD and psychological dissociation, identity crisis triggered by Sephiroth.
description: Ex-SOLDIER of Shinra, bearer of the Buster Sword, and the warrior who saved the Planet from Sephiroth. His Limit Breaks are legendary and grant him immense power in battle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cloud's journey is defined by his struggle against Sephiroth and his own fractured identity.
notableFeats: Defeated Sephiroth in the Northern Crater (Final Fantasy VII).
Survived the destruction of the Sector 7 plate.
Defended Midgar against Bahamut SIN (Advent Children).
Mastered multiple Limit Break techniques.
Destroyed Jenova's remnants.

name: Sephiroth
specialAbility: Masamune seven-foot blade, Supernova — calls a dying star onto the battlefield, One-Winged Angel form, near-immortal via the Planet.
weaknesses: Obsession with Cloud as his foil, requires Jenova cells — destroying them weakens him.
description: The most powerful SOLDIER, enhanced with alien Jenova cells. His Supernova attack can devastate entire solar systems, making him one of the most dangerous beings in his universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sephiroth's obsession with Cloud drives his actions, making him both a tragic and terrifying figure.
notableFeats: Summoned Meteor to destroy the Planet (Final Fantasy VII).
Defeated multiple SOLDIER operatives single-handedly.
Survived the Lifestream and returned stronger.
Destroyed Nibelheim and manipulated Cloud's memories.
Fought and nearly defeated the entire party in the Northern Crater.

name: Dante
specialAbility: Rebellion and Sparda demon swords, Ebony and Ivory pistols with infinite ammunition, Devil Trigger demonic transformation, near-limitless healing.
weaknesses: Cocky and prone to toying with enemies instead of ending fights.
description: Son of the Legendary Dark Knight Sparda, Dante is half-demon and hunts demons for sport. His Devil Trigger transformation amplifies his already immense power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dante's playful demeanor hides his immense skill and power, making him a deadly opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated Mundus, the Prince of Darkness (Devil May Cry).
Destroyed the demon king Urizen (Devil May Cry 5).
Survived battles against Vergil, his equally powerful brother.
Defeated countless demon lords and armies.
Mastered multiple weapons and fighting styles.

name: Link
specialAbility: Master Sword sacred light power, Triforce of Courage blessing, champion abilities — Daruk's Protection, Revali's Gale, Mipha's Grace, Urbosa's Fury.
weaknesses: Chosen hero destiny means some foes are predetermined, limited magic stamina.
description: The Hero of Time and Hyrule's eternal champion. Armed with the Master Sword and Triforce of Courage, he always rises to defeat Ganon and protect Hyrule.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Link's courage and resourcefulness make him a formidable hero, even against overwhelming odds.
notableFeats: Defeated Ganon multiple times across timelines.
Mastered the Master Sword and Hylian Shield.
Saved Hyrule from Calamity Ganon (Breath of the Wild).
Utilized Champion abilities to overcome powerful foes.
Restored peace to Hyrule in numerous eras.
specialRules: Can channel the power of the Triforce

name: Achilles
specialAbility: Near-total invulnerability from Styx bathing, godlike combat speed and strength, divine rage in battle.
weaknesses: Single heel vulnerability, pride and wrath cloud judgment.
description: The greatest warrior of the Trojan War, blessed by the gods and dipped in the Styx. Virtually invulnerable except for his one fatal heel, Achilles is a legendary figure of unmatched prowess.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Achilles' invulnerability makes him nearly unstoppable, but his heel remains his fatal flaw.
notableFeats: Defeated Hector, the greatest warrior of Troy.
Led the Myrmidons to victory in numerous battles.
Survived countless encounters against overwhelming odds.
Slayed Penthesilea, the Amazon queen.
Demonstrated unmatched combat prowess in the Trojan War.
specialRules: Vulnerable heel is a critical weakness

name: Hercules
specialAbility: Twelve Labors strength — lifted the world itself, club and Nemean lion skin armor, demigod endurance.
weaknesses: Rage causes terrible destruction including to innocents, fell to poison.
description: Son of Zeus and the greatest hero of antiquity. His strength was so limitless he held up the sky itself and performed twelve impossible feats.

counters: Speedsters exploiting his slower reaction time
v3Profile.loreNotes: Hercules is a demigod whose strength rivals the gods themselves, but his mortal vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Held up the sky in place of Atlas (Greek Mythology)
Defeated the Nemean Lion, whose hide was impervious to weapons
Slayed the multi-headed Hydra
Captured Cerberus alive from the Underworld
Cleaned the Augean stables in a single day

name: Zeus
specialAbility: Master bolt: supreme thunderbolt, shape-shifting, weather dominion, king of all Olympian gods, divine authority over other gods.
weaknesses: Prophecies of his own overthrow, weakness for mortals, other Olympians can challenge him.
description: King of the Olympian gods, lord of sky and thunder. His master bolt is the most powerful weapon in the Greek cosmos.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zeus's power is unmatched among the Olympians, but his hubris and mortal attachments are exploitable.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to betrayal by other gods
notableFeats: Defeated the Titans in the Titanomachy (Greek Mythology)
Created storms that devastated entire regions
Overthrew Cronus to become king of the gods
Wielded the Master Bolt, capable of obliterating mountains
Maintained dominion over Olympus for centuries

name: Count Dracula
specialAbility: Centuries of vampire power, shapeshifting into bat/wolf/mist, hypnotic mind control, immortality, superhuman strength and speed at night.
weaknesses: Sunlight, holy water, stakes through the heart, crucifixes, cannot cross running water without invitation.
description: The lord of vampires, undead for centuries, commanding legions of the night. His psychic powers and physical might make him the king of monsters.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dracula's cunning and supernatural abilities make him a formidable foe, but his weaknesses are well-documented.
notableFeats: Commanded legions of vampires across Europe (Dracula lore)
Defeated multiple vampire hunters over centuries
Shapeshifted into mist to evade capture
Hypnotized entire villages into submission
Survived centuries without aging

name: The Terminator
specialAbility: T-800 hyperalloy endoskeleton, Skynet tactical programming, heat vision, cannot feel pain, tire, or experience fear.
weaknesses: Exposed biological components can be damaged, EMP disrupts systems, predictable machine logic.
description: A T-800 Model 101 Terminator. An unstoppable killing machine with a metal skeleton, target-lock precision, and no capacity for mercy or hesitation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Terminator is a relentless machine, but its programming can be exploited by skilled opponents.
notableFeats: Survived explosions and gunfire in pursuit of targets (Terminator franchise)
Defeated multiple human opponents in hand-to-hand combat
Tracked and eliminated targets with unerring precision
Resisted damage from high-caliber weapons
Adapted to various combat scenarios

name: Predator
specialAbility: Thermal vision cloaking invisibility, plasma caster shoulder cannon, wristblades, self-destruct device, hunts the most dangerous prey.
weaknesses: Cannot see in mud camouflage, follows strict honor code — won't kill unarmed or pregnant targets.
description: A Yautja hunter from an advanced alien race. Predators travel the galaxy collecting trophies from the deadliest warriors, armed with cloaking and plasma weapons.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Predator's advanced technology and hunting skills make it a deadly foe, but its honor code can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated elite human soldiers in jungle combat (Predator franchise)
Survived explosions and gunfire while hunting prey
Used cloaking to ambush targets undetected
Self-destructed to prevent capture
Collected trophies from the galaxy's deadliest warriors

name: Alien Queen
specialAbility: Acid blood dissolving any metal, inner jaw for double-striking, egg laying to build armies, psychic hive mind control, impervious to vacuum.
weaknesses: Acid blood damages surroundings indiscriminately, vulnerable to nuclear explosions or extreme cold.
description: The Alien Queen is the heart of the Xenomorph hive, commanding her species telepathically and bringing the full killing force of the alien swarm to bear. Her acid blood and hive-building abilities make her a terrifying apex predator.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Alien Queen is nearly unstoppable unless her hive is destroyed or extreme measures are taken.
notableFeats: Destroyed a human colony single-handedly (Aliens, 1986)
Survived vacuum exposure during space combat (Aliens, 1986)
Commanded a hive to overwhelm a heavily armed military unit (Aliens, 1986)
specialRules: can lay eggs to create soldiers

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
specialAbility: Zangetsu dual-zanpakuto, Bankai Tensa Zangetsu, Hollowification full-power form, True Zangetsu absorbing and expelling vast reiatsu.
weaknesses: Sacrifices power through each form transformation, can lose his Shinigami powers from overuse.
description: Ichigo Kurosaki is a human-Quincy-Hollow-Shinigami hybrid whose combined heritage gives him spiritual power rivaling the Soul King's fragments. His mastery of Zangetsu and Hollowification makes him one of the strongest warriors in the Bleach universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ichigo's hybrid nature makes him uniquely versatile, but his transformations come at a cost.
notableFeats: Defeated Aizen in his transcendent form (Bleach, Episode 309)
Fought Yhwach, the Quincy King, and disrupted his plans (Bleach, Chapter 681)
Mastered dual Zangetsu forms to unlock his true power (Bleach, Chapter 542)

name: Gojo Satoru
specialAbility: Infinity barrier blocking all attacks, Six Eyes all-seeing perception, Unlimited Void trapping opponents in infinite sensory overload, Red and Blue cursed techniques.
weaknesses: Sealed in the Prison Realm, emotionally distant which can be exploited.
description: Gojo Satoru is the strongest Jujutsu sorcerer alive, wielding the Infinity technique to make himself untouchable and the Six Eyes to perceive everything. His mastery of cursed techniques makes him a near-unstoppable force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gojo's Infinity makes him nearly invincible, but sealing techniques can neutralize him.
notableFeats: Defeated Jogo with overwhelming power (Jujutsu Kaisen, Episode 7)
Used Unlimited Void to incapacitate multiple enemies (Jujutsu Kaisen, Episode 12)
Destroyed Hanami with Hollow Purple (Jujutsu Kaisen, Episode 20)

name: Mob
specialAbility: 100% psychic power explosion shattering reality, telekinesis, absorption of others' psychic energy, out-of-body spirit form.
weaknesses: Suppresses power to stay humble, full power only emerges when emotions peak.
description: Shigeo Kageyama, known as Mob, is a quiet middle schooler who may be the most powerful psychic in existence. When his emotional meter hits 100%, his psychic abilities become unstoppable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mob's power is tied to his emotions, making him unpredictable and dangerous.
notableFeats: Defeated Claw's leader with overwhelming psychic power (Mob Psycho 100, Episode 12)
Stopped a city-wide psychic explosion (Mob Psycho 100, Episode 24)
Absorbed and redirected psychic energy from multiple enemies (Mob Psycho 100, Episode 11)

name: All Might
specialAbility: One For All passed power: United States of Smash 100% power punches that cause tornadoes, Symbol of Peace aura elevating others.
weaknesses: Time limit on powered form due to injury, One For All depletes his life force.
description: All Might is the Symbol of Peace and the greatest Pro Hero, whose smashes generate tornado-force winds and inspire hope across the nation. His One For All power makes him a beacon of strength and justice.

v3Profile.loreNotes: All Might's power is immense, but his injuries and time limit make him vulnerable in prolonged battles.
notableFeats: Defeated All For One in a climactic battle (My Hero Academia, Episode 49)
Destroyed a city block with a single punch (My Hero Academia, Episode 1)
Inspired a new generation of heroes with his Symbol of Peace legacy (My Hero Academia, Episode 50)

name: Saitama
specialAbility: Limitless physical power capable of defeating any opponent with a single punch.
weaknesses: Boredom and lack of motivation often prevent him from engaging seriously in fights.
description: Saitama, the One Punch Man, trained so hard he became invincible, losing his hair in the process. His overwhelming strength has left him searching for a worthy challenge.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Saitama's power defies conventional scaling, making him a comedic yet unstoppable force.
notableFeats: Split the sky with a Serious Punch (One Punch Man manga, Chapter 85)
Defeated Boros, a planetary-level threat, with a single punch (One Punch Man anime, Episode 12)
Survived being kicked to the moon and returned in seconds (One Punch Man anime, Episode 12)
Destroyed a massive meteor with one punch (One Punch Man anime, Episode 7)
specialRules: Can defeat any opponent in one punch

name: Storm
specialAbility: Complete mastery over weather, including lightning, wind, blizzards, and tornadoes.
weaknesses: Claustrophobia can compromise her concentration and effectiveness.
description: Ororo Munroe, also known as Storm, is a mutant with goddess-like control over the weather. Her leadership and tactical skills make her a cornerstone of the X-Men.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Storm's powers are versatile and devastating, but her claustrophobia can be exploited in confined spaces.
weaknesses: Loss of powers in contained spaces
notableFeats: Defeated Cyclops in a duel for leadership of the X-Men (Uncanny X-Men #201)
Created a massive hurricane to stop an invading army (X-Men Annual #5)
Generated lightning powerful enough to destroy Sentinels (X-Men #98)
Saved the planet by stabilizing the weather during a global crisis (X-Men #150)

name: Darkseid
specialAbility: Omega Beams that can erase targets from existence and near-omnipotent New God power.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to the Anti-Life Equation under specific conditions.
description: Darkseid, the God of Evil, rules Apokolips and seeks the Anti-Life Equation to dominate all existence. His Omega Beams are feared across the multiverse.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Darkseid's Omega Beams make him one of the most dangerous beings in the DC Universe.
notableFeats: Destroyed a planet with his Omega Beams (Final Crisis #7)
Defeated Superman in direct combat (Justice League #23)
Survived the destruction of Apokolips (Darkseid War)
Subjugated entire universes with his armies (New Gods series)

name: Killua Zoldyck
specialAbility: Godspeed Nen ability allows lightning-fast movement and attacks.
weaknesses: Emotional attachment to Gon can cloud his judgment in critical moments.
description: Killua Zoldyck, a prodigy assassin from the Zoldyck family, chose friendship and freedom over his family's deadly legacy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Killua's Godspeed ability makes him one of the fastest characters in Hunter x Hunter.
notableFeats: Defeated a Chimera Ant officer with Godspeed (Hunter x Hunter anime, Episode 116)
Outran and incapacitated multiple enemies simultaneously (Hunter x Hunter manga, Chapter 296)
Survived intense torture training as a child (Hunter x Hunter manga, Chapter 36)
Mastered Nen techniques at a young age (Hunter x Hunter manga, Chapter 60)

name: Meruem
specialAbility: Nen absorption and evolution through consuming others, granting exponential power growth.
weaknesses: Rose poison is his ultimate downfall; emotional blind spots following his awakening.
description: Meruem, the Chimera Ant King, was born to dominate all species but discovered humanity through his interactions with Komugi.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Meruem's evolution through Nen absorption makes him a unique and terrifying opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated Netero, one of the strongest Nen users, in combat (Hunter x Hunter anime, Episode 126)
Survived a nuclear explosion temporarily (Hunter x Hunter anime, Episode 135)
Absorbed Nen from multiple Royal Guards to become exponentially stronger (Hunter x Hunter manga, Chapter 310)
Displayed unmatched combat instincts and adaptability (Hunter x Hunter manga, Chapter 305)

name: Giorno Giovanna
specialAbility: Gold Experience Requiem: returns any action to zero, nullifying all cause and effect
weaknesses: Stand fight limitations; cannot use GER offensively without a trigger condition
description: The son of DIO who dreams of becoming a gang-star and protecting the innocent.

name: Jotaro Kujo
specialAbility: Star Platinum: time-stopping Stand with superhuman precision and strength
weaknesses: Time stop duration is limited; emotional coldness can be exploited
description: A stoic delinquent who inherited the Joestar legacy and fought DIO across time.

name: Alucard
specialAbility: True Immortality via Schrodinger; shadow manipulation; absorbed soul army; Casull pistol
weaknesses: Can be temporarily sealed; sunlight in weakened states; religious artifacts
description: The No Life King, Hellsing's ultimate weapon, a vampire of truly terrifying power.

weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by multiple opponents

name: Rimuru Tempest
universe: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
specialAbility: Great Sage/Raphael; predator skill absorbing any ability; True Dragon power
weaknesses: Early reliance on information gathering; mercy for allies can delay decisive action
