description: A reincarnated salary worker who became the slime Demon Lord Rimuru Tempest.

specialRules: can bypass normal durability or positioning

name: Edward Elric
specialAbility: Alchemy without a transmutation circle; Automail arm and leg; Truth's absolute knowledge
weaknesses: Automail arm can be detached; still mortal; emotional vulnerability regarding Al
description: The Fullmetal Alchemist, a prodigy who sacrificed a limb and his brother's body in forbidden alchemy.

specialRules: Can create weapons from surrounding materials

name: Doomslayer
specialAbility: Praetor Suit; glory kill health system; BFG-9000; rage-fueled power against demonic energy
weaknesses: No subtlety; ranged opponents at great distance; targeted by Maykr gods
description: An ancient warrior betrayed and condemned to fight demons for eternity — and he's very good at it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Doomslayer's rage and skill make him a nightmare for any demonic or supernatural foe.
weaknesses: Limited ranged options against fast foes
notableFeats: Defeated the Icon of Sin (Doom Eternal)
Destroyed Hell's armies single-handedly (Doom series)
Survived Maykr ambushes and defeated their leader (Doom Eternal)
Mastered the BFG-9000, capable of obliterating massive areas (Doom series)

name: Bayonetta
specialAbility: Witch Time (bullet-time dodging); hair-based Infernal Demon summons; four-gun combat
weaknesses: Running out of magic power limits Witch Time; holy water attacks
description: An Umbra Witch who fights angels and demons in stilettos, guns on all four limbs.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bayonetta's mastery of Witch Time and Infernal Demons makes her a formidable planetary-level combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Jubileus, the Creator (Bayonetta)
Summoned Infernal Demons to destroy massive foes (Bayonetta series)
Mastered Witch Time to dodge bullets and attacks (Bayonetta series)
Survived battles against angelic armies (Bayonetta series)

name: Saruman
specialAbility: White Council magic; persuasive voice of power; Palantír foresight; master of industry and treachery
weaknesses: Pride and lust for power led to his corruption and eventual ruin
description: The White Wizard who betrayed Middle-earth for promises of power from the Dark Lord.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Saruman's cunning and magical prowess make him a dangerous foe, but his pride leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Corrupted Théoden using his voice (The Two Towers)
Created an army of Uruk-hai (The Two Towers)
Battled Gandalf the Grey in a magical duel (The Fellowship of the Ring)
Manipulated events using the Palantír (The Two Towers)

name: John Wick
specialAbility: Gun-fu: fires from contact range while being choked; 128 kills documented with a pencil; perfect tactical reloads mid-throw; every room is a weapon
weaknesses: Still mortal — gets stabbed, shot, and beaten throughout every film; grief-driven rage clouds tactical judgment
description: They say John Wick killed three men with a pencil. A fucking pencil. The criminal underworld calls him the Boogeyman — and the Boogeyman checks under his bed for John Wick.

v3Profile.loreNotes: John Wick's precision and improvisation make him a nightmare for any human-level opponent.
notableFeats: Killed three men with a pencil (John Wick series)
Defeated multiple assassins simultaneously (John Wick series)
Survived being stabbed, shot, and beaten repeatedly (John Wick series)
Executed perfect tactical reloads under pressure (John Wick series)
specialRules: Highly efficient against human and peak-human foes

name: Terminator T-800
specialAbility: Titanium endoskeleton; never tires; can repair itself; tactical targeting from future AI
weaknesses: Flesh exterior can be damaged; can be melted by extreme heat sources; limited adaptability
description: A cybernetic assassin sent back from the future, later reprogrammed to protect.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The T-800's durability and strength make it a relentless combatant, but its adaptability is limited.
notableFeats: Survived molten metal and extreme damage (Terminator 2: Judgment Day)
Defeated advanced Terminator models (Terminator series)
Protected John Connor against multiple threats (Terminator series)
Displayed immense strength by lifting heavy objects and breaking through barriers (Terminator series)

name: Xenomorph
specialAbility: Acidic blood that burns through armor; endoparasitic life cycle; incredible stealth and speed.
weaknesses: Vacuum of space; fire; targeted destruction of hive queen breaks their coordination.
description: A perfect biological weapon — no mercy, no hesitation, only the hunt. Xenomorphs are apex predators with unparalleled stealth and adaptability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Xenomorphs are relentless hunters, capable of adapting to nearly any environment.
notableFeats: Destroyed entire human colonies (Aliens, 1986).
Overpowered heavily armed marines (Aliens, 1986).
Survived extreme environmental conditions (Alien, 1979).
Demonstrated hive intelligence and coordination (Aliens, 1986).

name: Neo
specialAbility: Sees the Matrix as cascading code — bends physics at will, stops bullets in mid-air, learns any martial art in seconds, and can fly; The One.
weaknesses: Bound by rules of the Matrix; EMP shuts him down in the real world; love for Trinity is his only exploitable vulnerability.
description: Thomas A. Anderson became the most dangerous person in history the moment he chose the red pill. Inside the Matrix, Neo is not fighting — he is rewriting the rules of reality itself.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Neo's abilities are unmatched within the Matrix, but his real-world limitations can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Agent Smith in hand-to-hand combat (The Matrix, 1999).
Stopped bullets mid-air (The Matrix, 1999).
Flew at supersonic speeds (The Matrix Reloaded, 2003).
Resurrected himself after death (The Matrix, 1999).

name: Sun Wukong
specialAbility: 72 transformations; cloud somersault; Ruyi Jingu Bang (magic staff); immortality from Heaven's peaches.
weaknesses: Pride; the Five Elements Mountain seal; Tripitaka's headband.
description: The Monkey King, a trickster deity of limitless power who challenged Heaven itself. Sun Wukong's cunning and strength make him a near-unstoppable force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sun Wukong's immortality and cunning make him a formidable opponent in any scenario.
notableFeats: Lifted the Ruyi Jingu Bang, a staff weighing thousands of tons (Journey to the West).
Defeated Heaven's armies single-handedly (Journey to the West).
Survived being burned in Laozi's furnace (Journey to the West).
Traveled 108,000 li in one somersault (Journey to the West).

name: T'Challa / Black Panther
specialAbility: Vibranium Panther Habit that stores and releases kinetic energy; enhanced senses and healing.
weaknesses: Suit has energy absorption limits; political pressures can limit decisive action.
description: Wakanda's warrior king, whose suit turns every blow against him into his greatest weapon. T'Challa is a master strategist and combatant, blending technology and tradition.

v3Profile.loreNotes: T'Challa's Vibranium suit and strategic mind make him a formidable opponent in close combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Killmonger in ritual combat (Black Panther, 2018).
Outsmarted Ulysses Klaue (Black Panther, 2018).
Led Wakanda's armies against Thanos (Avengers: Infinity War, 2018).
Absorbed and redirected kinetic energy to defeat opponents (Black Panther, 2018).

name: Optimus Prime
specialAbility: Transform between truck and robot; Matrix of Leadership; Energon axe; trailer arsenal.
weaknesses: Protective nature causes him to shield allies at personal cost; Energon dependency.
description: Leader of the Autobots, who fights to protect both Cybertron and humanity. Optimus Prime is a symbol of hope and resilience, wielding immense power and wisdom.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Optimus Prime's leadership and combat prowess make him a beacon of hope in dire situations.
notableFeats: Defeated Megatron in multiple battles (Transformers: The Movie, 1986).
Lifted and wielded the Matrix of Leadership (Transformers: The Movie, 1986).
Destroyed Devastator in combat (Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen, 2009).
Led the Autobots to victory against overwhelming odds (Transformers series).

name: John Rambo
specialAbility: Guerrilla warfare mastery; survival expert; explosive traps and compound bow; fights through extreme injury.
weaknesses: PTSD flashbacks; fully human — enough firepower can kill him.
description: A Vietnam vet pushed too far who wages one-man wars against entire armies. Rambo is a master of survival and guerrilla tactics, capable of taking down heavily armed forces with improvised weapons and traps.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rambo thrives in natural environments where he can use terrain to his advantage.
notableFeats: Single-handedly defeated an entire platoon using guerrilla tactics (First Blood).
Survived extreme injuries and continued fighting (Rambo III).
Took down a heavily armed convoy with improvised traps (Rambo: Last Blood).
Escaped capture multiple times using stealth and survival skills (Rambo II).

name: John McClane
specialAbility: Improvised combat; refuses to quit; turns any environment into a weapon; extraordinary luck under pressure.
description: A New York cop who somehow survives every disaster imaginable, usually barefoot. McClane is a master of improvisation, using his surroundings to overcome seemingly insurmountable odds.

v3Profile.loreNotes: McClane's greatest strength is his ability to adapt to any situation, no matter how dire.
notableFeats: Defeated a team of terrorists while barefoot (Die Hard).
Survived multiple explosions and gunfights (Die Hard 2).
Stopped cyber-terrorists with minimal resources (Live Free or Die Hard).
Took down a helicopter with a car (Die Hard 4.0).

name: Ethan Hunt
specialAbility: Master of disguise and infiltration; tactical genius; impossible stunt execution; zero-failure mindset.
weaknesses: Operates alone — team casualties are his greatest vulnerability.
description: IMF's top agent, who accepts missions deemed truly impossible — then completes them. Ethan Hunt is a master strategist and stunt performer, capable of infiltrating the most secure locations.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hunt's ability to execute impossible stunts and adapt to high-pressure scenarios makes him a formidable operative.
notableFeats: Scaled the Burj Khalifa without safety equipment (Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol).
Infiltrated a secure CIA vault (Mission: Impossible).
Survived a high-speed motorcycle chase (Mission: Impossible 2).
Completed a HALO jump into enemy territory (Mission: Impossible – Fallout).

name: James Bond
specialAbility: MI6 license to kill; master spy and seducer; Q-Branch gadgetry; expert marksman and driver.
weaknesses: Overconfidence; can be caught off-guard by personal attachments.
description: Her Majesty's most dangerous secret agent — suave, lethal, and always in a tuxedo. Bond is a master of espionage, combining charm, gadgets, and combat expertise to complete his missions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bond's charm and gadgets often give him the edge in espionage and combat scenarios.
notableFeats: Defeated Le Chiffre in a high-stakes poker game while under surveillance (Casino Royale).
Survived a train fight and defeated an assassin (Skyfall).
Destroyed a satellite weapon using a stealth plane (GoldenEye).
Escaped a sinking building while rescuing a hostage (Spectre).

name: The Punisher
specialAbility: Military-grade arsenal; expert tactician and marksman; no hesitation — will kill any villain.
weaknesses: No superpowers; obsessive tunnel vision on vengeance.
description: Frank Castle, a Marine whose family was murdered and who declared one-man war on all criminals. The Punisher is a relentless vigilante who uses military tactics and sheer firepower to eliminate his enemies.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Castle's relentless pursuit of justice makes him a dangerous adversary for any criminal.
notableFeats: Defeated Jigsaw and his gang in a brutal firefight (Punisher: War Zone).
Took down multiple mob families single-handedly (Marvel Comics).
Survived being hunted by elite assassins (Punisher MAX).
Destroyed a drug cartel using guerrilla tactics (Punisher: Welcome Back, Frank).

name: Ellen Ripley
specialAbility: Xenomorph survival expertise; power loader operation; improvised flamethrower warfare; unbreakable will.
weaknesses: Fully human; isolated from backup; emotional attachment to survivors.
description: Ellen Ripley is the ultimate survivor who faced Xenomorphs repeatedly — and lived every time. Her resourcefulness and determination make her a formidable opponent despite her lack of superhuman abilities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ripley's encounters with Xenomorphs showcase her adaptability and resilience in extreme situations.
notableFeats: Defeated the Xenomorph Queen using a power loader (Aliens, 1986).
Survived multiple encounters with Xenomorphs despite being unarmed (Alien, 1979).
Successfully led survivors against Xenomorphs on LV-426 (Aliens, 1986).
Sacrificed herself to prevent the spread of Xenomorphs (Alien 3, 1992).

name: Bryan Mills
specialAbility: A very particular set of skills: CIA-trained kidnapping retrieval; hand-to-hand and interrogation mastery.
weaknesses: Fully human; driven by emotion when family is threatened.
description: Bryan Mills is an ex-CIA operative with a very particular set of skills that make him a nightmare for kidnappers. His relentless determination and tactical expertise allow him to overcome seemingly impossible odds.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mills' expertise in combat and tracking make him a formidable opponent in urban and tactical scenarios.
notableFeats: Single-handedly rescued his daughter from a human trafficking ring (Taken, 2008).
Defeated multiple armed opponents in close combat (Taken series).
Tracked and eliminated high-profile targets across international borders (Taken series).
Outmaneuvered corrupt officials and criminal organizations (Taken series).

name: Sarah Connor
specialAbility: Military training and weapons expertise; tactical planning against machine uprisings; fierce maternal drive.
weaknesses: Fully human; can be overwhelmed by Terminator-level threats.
description: Sarah Connor transformed from a waitress into a hardened resistance fighter, becoming the mother of humanity's future savior. Her military training and fierce determination make her a key figure in the fight against Skynet.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Connor's maternal drive and tactical expertise make her a symbol of human resilience against overwhelming odds.
notableFeats: Survived and defeated a T-800 Terminator (The Terminator, 1984).
Trained her son to become the leader of the human resistance (Terminator 2: Judgment Day, 1991).
Successfully escaped and fought against Skynet forces (Terminator series).
Led guerrilla operations against machine uprisings (Terminator series).

name: The Bride (Beatrix Kiddo)
specialAbility: Deadly Viper assassination techniques; Hanzo steel sword mastery; Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique.
weaknesses: Emotional drive for revenge can override tactical thinking.
description: Beatrix Kiddo, known as The Bride, is a former assassin who awoke from a coma to take revenge on everyone who wronged her. Her mastery of martial arts and assassination techniques make her a deadly force in combat.

abilities: Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique
v3Profile.loreNotes: The Bride's emotional drive and unparalleled combat skills make her a relentless force in battle.
signatures: Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique
notableFeats: Defeated O-Ren Ishii in a sword duel (Kill Bill Vol. 1, 2003).
Eliminated the Crazy 88 single-handedly (Kill Bill Vol. 1, 2003).
Used the Five Point Palm Exploding Heart Technique to kill Bill (Kill Bill Vol. 2, 2004).
Survived an assassination attempt and escaped from a coffin (Kill Bill Vol. 2, 2004).

name: Jason Bourne
specialAbility: Treadstone super-soldier conditioning; fights with anything at hand — a pen, a magazine, a toaster.
weaknesses: Fractured memory causes disorientation; avoids killing unless necessary.
description: Jason Bourne is a black ops assassin who lost his memory and went on the run from the very agency that made him. His adaptability and resourcefulness make him a dangerous opponent in any situation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bourne's fractured memory and adaptability make him a unique and unpredictable combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple armed opponents using improvised weapons (The Bourne Identity, 2002).
Evaded international surveillance and assassins (The Bourne Supremacy, 2004).
Uncovered and dismantled the Treadstone program (The Bourne Ultimatum, 2007).
Survived high-speed chases and combat against elite operatives (Bourne series).

name: Indiana Jones
specialAbility: Bullwhip mastery and unparalleled archaeological expertise.
weaknesses: Afraid of snakes and relies heavily on luck in dangerous situations.
description: Indiana Jones is a daring archaeologist and adventurer who often finds himself in perilous situations while seeking ancient artifacts. His resourcefulness and quick thinking make him a formidable opponent despite his mortal limitations.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Indiana Jones thrives in situations requiring quick thinking and adaptability, but his mortal nature limits his durability in prolonged combat.
notableFeats: Recovered the Ark of the Covenant (Raiders of the Lost Ark).
Survived a nuclear explosion by hiding in a lead-lined fridge (Kingdom of the Crystal Skull).
Defeated a Nazi convoy single-handedly (Raiders of the Lost Ark).
Escaped a collapsing temple with the Golden Idol (Raiders of the Lost Ark).

name: Martin Riggs
specialAbility: Fearless combatant with LAPD special forces training.
weaknesses: Emotionally unstable and prone to reckless behavior.
description: Martin Riggs is a highly skilled LAPD detective and war veteran who uses his fearlessness and combat expertise to take down criminals. His emotional instability often leads to unpredictable and dangerous actions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Riggs' unpredictability and fearlessness make him a dangerous opponent, but his emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated a trained assassin in hand-to-hand combat (Lethal Weapon).
Survived multiple shootouts against heavily armed opponents (Lethal Weapon series).
Rescued hostages during a high-stakes operation (Lethal Weapon 2).
Took down a helicopter with a single shot (Lethal Weapon 3).

name: Snake Plissken
specialAbility: Special Forces black ops training and survival genius.
weaknesses: Mistrustful of allies and operates alone.
description: Snake Plissken is a cynical and resourceful ex-soldier who excels in high-pressure situations. His mistrust of others and lone-wolf mentality often put him at odds with potential allies.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Snake's survival instincts and tactical expertise make him a formidable opponent, but his mistrust of others often isolates him.
notableFeats: Successfully escaped from New York under extreme time pressure (Escape from New York).
Defeated multiple armed opponents in stealth combat (Escape from LA).
Survived a high-stakes mission with limited resources (Escape from New York).
Outsmarted government forces to achieve his goals (Escape from LA).

name: The Driver
specialAbility: Unmatched vehicular control and precision stunt driving.
weaknesses: Avoids direct confrontation and is vulnerable outside of vehicles.
description: The Driver is a masterful wheelman who uses his unparalleled driving skills to evade and outmaneuver opponents. His cold and calculating demeanor ensures he never misses a window of opportunity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Driver's mastery of vehicular movement makes him nearly unstoppable in chase scenarios, but his reliance on vehicles limits his versatility.
notableFeats: Evaded multiple police units during a high-speed chase (Drive).
Executed precision stunts to escape from armed pursuers (Drive).
Outmaneuvered professional hitmen in a getaway scenario (Drive).
Maintained composure under extreme pressure during a heist (Drive).

name: Hans Gruber
specialAbility: Masterful heist planning and manipulation under pressure.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and underestimation of adaptable opponents.
description: Hans Gruber is a brilliant and calculating thief who orchestrates complex heists with precision. His arrogance and reliance on scripted plans often lead to his downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hans Gruber's intellect and strategic planning make him a dangerous adversary, but his arrogance often blinds him to unpredictable threats.
notableFeats: Successfully infiltrated and took over Nakatomi Plaza (Die Hard).
Manipulated hostages and authorities to buy time for his heist (Die Hard).
Orchestrated a complex escape plan involving misdirection (Die Hard).
Nearly outsmarted John McClane in a psychological battle (Die Hard).

name: Anton Chigurh
specialAbility: Unstoppable determination and use of a captive bolt pistol for precise kills.
weaknesses: Rigid adherence to his coin-flip philosophy makes him predictable in certain situations.
description: Anton Chigurh is a relentless hitman who operates by his own pitiless philosophy, offering a coin flip as mercy. His cold, calculated approach makes him a terrifying force in any confrontation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Chigurh's philosophy makes him a unique and dangerous adversary, but his predictability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Successfully eliminated multiple targets despite severe injuries (No Country for Old Men).
Survived a car crash and continued his mission.
Outmaneuvered law enforcement and rival hitmen.
specialRules: Determined to complete mission at all costs

name: Hannibal Lecter
specialAbility: Master manipulator of the human psyche, capable of exploiting psychological weaknesses.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on intellect and planning, making him vulnerable to brute force or unpredictable actions.
description: Hannibal Lecter is a brilliant psychiatrist and cannibalistic serial killer, feared for his unmatched intellect and psychological manipulation. His ability to exploit weaknesses makes him a lethal adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lecter's intellect makes him a formidable opponent, but his reliance on planning can be exploited.
notableFeats: Manipulated FBI agents and escaped captivity (The Silence of the Lambs).
Outsmarted multiple adversaries in high-stakes situations.
Demonstrated surgical precision in psychological and physical attacks.

name: The Joker
specialAbility: Unpredictable chaos generation and use of Joker toxin to incapacitate foes.
weaknesses: Lack of long-term planning due to chaotic nature; dependent on Batman's refusal to kill him.
description: The Joker is Gotham's Clown Prince of Crime, a force of pure chaos who thrives on anarchy and psychological warfare. His unpredictability makes him a dangerous foe for even the most prepared heroes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Joker's unpredictability makes him a nightmare for strategists, but his reliance on chaos can be exploited.
notableFeats: Successfully orchestrated the downfall of Gotham's elite (The Dark Knight).
Outsmarted Batman in multiple encounters.
Spread chaos across Gotham using Joker toxin.

name: Bane
specialAbility: Venom serum grants superhuman strength and pain resistance, making him a tactical powerhouse.
weaknesses: Critical dependence on Venom mask; destroying it leaves him vulnerable and in pain.
description: Bane is a tactical genius and physical powerhouse who broke Batman's back, fueled by the Venom serum. His combination of brute strength and intellect makes him a formidable foe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bane's reliance on Venom makes him a powerhouse, but his vulnerability to its removal is a critical weakness.
notableFeats: Broke Batman's back in combat (Knightfall).
Defeated multiple opponents while under Venom influence.
Outsmarted Gotham's elite in strategic planning.
specialRules: Strategic use of Venom serum boosts his capabilities

name: T-1000
specialAbility: Liquid metal morphing allows mimicry and reshaping into deadly weapons.
weaknesses: Extreme temperatures or acid can disrupt its liquid form and cause damage.
description: The T-1000 is a mimetic polyalloy Terminator capable of mimicking any person and reshaping its body into deadly weapons. Its near-indestructibility makes it a relentless hunter.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The T-1000's adaptability makes it a nightmare to fight, but its weaknesses to extreme conditions can be exploited.
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by multiple attackers
notableFeats: Survived multiple high-impact attacks (Terminator 2: Judgment Day).
Successfully mimicked key individuals to infiltrate targets.
Resisted destruction from conventional weapons.
specialRules: Can adapt to any combat situation

name: Agent Smith
specialAbility: Can replicate himself into any human body inside the Matrix; superhuman combat ability; virus-like spread.
weaknesses: Exists only within the Matrix; obsessive hatred of Neo clouds judgment.
description: Agent Smith is a rogue program within the Matrix who evolved into a virus capable of assimilating any human within the simulation. His obsessive vendetta against Neo drives his actions, often leading to tactical errors despite his immense power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Agent Smith's power scales with the number of humans he assimilates, making him exponentially more dangerous in prolonged conflicts.
notableFeats: Assimilated the Oracle (The Matrix Revolutions)
Fought Neo to a standstill multiple times (The Matrix trilogy)
Replicated into nearly every human in the Matrix (The Matrix Revolutions)
Survived deletion attempts by the system (The Matrix Reloaded)
specialRules: Can infect others to become them

name: Colonel Hans Landa
specialAbility: Detective-level intellect; perfect multilingualism; psychological intimidation; self-serving adaptability.
weaknesses: Ultimately loyal only to himself — will betray any cause for personal survival.
description: Colonel Hans Landa is a cunning and manipulative SS officer known for his ability to uncover hidden truths and exploit weaknesses. His charm and intellect make him a terrifying adversary, but his self-serving nature often leads to betrayal.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hans Landa's intellect and charm make him a master manipulator, but his lack of physical prowess limits his direct combat effectiveness.
notableFeats: Uncovered hidden Jewish families during WWII (Inglourious Basterds)
Negotiated his own survival with the Allies (Inglourious Basterds)
Manipulated multiple characters into revealing secrets (Inglourious Basterds)

name: Frank Booth
specialAbility: Extreme unpredictability and sadism; criminal network control; sheer terrifying volatility.
weaknesses: Drug dependency impairs judgment; psychotic episodes make him reckless.
description: Frank Booth is a psychotic crime boss whose violent unpredictability and sadistic tendencies make him a force of chaos. His drug dependency and mental instability, however, often undermine his effectiveness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Frank Booth's volatility makes him dangerous in close quarters, but his lack of strategic thinking leaves him vulnerable to calculated opponents.
notableFeats: Controlled a criminal empire through fear (Blue Velvet)
Terrified and dominated opponents through sheer unpredictability (Blue Velvet)
Demonstrated extreme sadism and cruelty (Blue Velvet)

name: Nurse Ratched
specialAbility: Psychological manipulation and systematic control of anyone under her authority; institutional power as a weapon.
weaknesses: Loses power entirely when outside her institutional environment.
description: Nurse Ratched is a cold and calculating psychiatric nurse who uses her institutional authority to manipulate and control patients. Her power is entirely dependent on the environment she operates within.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nurse Ratched's psychological tactics make her a formidable opponent in controlled environments, but she is powerless outside her domain.
notableFeats: Manipulated patients into submission (One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest)
Maintained control over a psychiatric ward through fear and authority (One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest)

name: Keyser Soze
specialAbility: Master criminal who erased his own identity; orchestrates plans from the shadows; myth-level fear factor.
weaknesses: Real identity being discovered would collapse his entire operation.
description: Keyser Soze is a legendary criminal mastermind who operates entirely from the shadows, instilling fear and awe in those who hear his name. His anonymity is his greatest weapon, but also his greatest vulnerability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Keyser Soze's ability to manipulate and deceive makes him a near-untouchable figure in the criminal world, but exposure of his identity would be his downfall.
notableFeats: Eliminated his own family to protect his anonymity (The Usual Suspects)
Orchestrated a complex criminal operation without being detected (The Usual Suspects)
Instilled fear in the criminal underworld through myth and reputation (The Usual Suspects)

name: Vincent (Collateral)
specialAbility: Contract killer precision; ice-cold under fire; shoots in near-darkness; philosophy as a weapon.
weaknesses: Overconfidence that his detachment makes him untouchable.
description: A silver-haired hitman with a single night to complete five kills — methodical, brilliant, lethal. Vincent operates with cold efficiency, using his philosophical detachment to justify his actions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vincent's precision and cold demeanor make him a formidable assassin, but his reliance on detachment can be exploited.
notableFeats: Eliminated multiple targets in a single night (Collateral, 2004).
Outmaneuvered armed security in a crowded nightclub.
Defeated Max in a high-stakes final confrontation.

name: Terminator T-3000
specialAbility: Nanomachine-based body; can reconfigure itself mid-fight; magnetic disruption immunity after adaptation.
weaknesses: Magnetic fields of extreme power; still processing human host conversion.
description: A Terminator built from a converted human — molecular machines instead of metal. The T-3000 is a relentless hunter capable of adapting to almost any threat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The T-3000's nanomachine body makes it nearly indestructible, but its adaptation process can be exploited.
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by sustained attacks
notableFeats: Survived direct attacks from advanced weaponry (Terminator Genisys, 2015).
Adapted to magnetic disruption after initial vulnerability.
Destroyed multiple Terminators in combat.
specialRules: Can adapt to weaponry used against it

name: Ivan Drago
specialAbility: 2000 PSI punch force; chemically-enhanced Soviet boxing physique; absolutely no mercy.
weaknesses: Relies solely on raw power; can be broken by sheer willpower and heart.
description: The Soviet super-boxer engineered to destroy — if he dies, he dies. Ivan Drago is a symbol of brute force and Soviet engineering.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Drago's raw power is unmatched, but his lack of adaptability makes him vulnerable to skilled opponents.
notableFeats: Delivered a punch with 2000 PSI force (Rocky IV, 1985).
Defeated Apollo Creed in a brutal match.
Endured multiple rounds against Rocky Balboa.

name: Clubber Lang
specialAbility: Raw aggressive boxing power; relentless pressure; punches through any defense.
weaknesses: Overconfidence; tires in extended fights against disciplined opponents.
description: A savage boxer from Chicago who became World Champion by sheer brutal force. Clubber Lang's aggression and power make him a dangerous opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Clubber Lang's aggression is his greatest strength and weakness, as disciplined fighters can exploit his emotional outbursts.
notableFeats: Defeated Rocky Balboa to become World Champion (Rocky III, 1982).
Overpowered multiple opponents in sparring matches.
Delivered devastating knockouts in record time.

name: Silva (Skyfall)
specialAbility: World-class cyberterrorism and hacking; MI6 insider knowledge; personal vendetta with M.
weaknesses: Personal obsession with M means he can be baited.
description: A former MI6 agent turned cyberterrorist who wants to watch M's world burn. Silva's intellect and insider knowledge make him a dangerous adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Silva's obsession with M drives his actions, but it also makes him predictable in certain situations.
notableFeats: Successfully infiltrated MI6 systems (Skyfall, 2012).
Orchestrated a massive cyberattack on British intelligence.
Outmaneuvered James Bond in multiple encounters.

name: Scorpion
specialAbility: Hellfire manipulation and teleportation, combined with undead resilience and deadly combat techniques.
weaknesses: Rage blinds judgment, vulnerability to ice-based attacks, and bound to the Netherrealm.
description: Hanzo Hasashi, resurrected as Scorpion, is a vengeful specter wielding hellfire and unmatched combat prowess to avenge his clan.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Scorpion's vendetta against Sub-Zero and Quan Chi drives his relentless pursuit of vengeance.
notableFeats: Defeated Sub-Zero in Mortal Kombat (MK1).
Destroyed Quan Chi after learning the truth of his clan's demise.
Overpowered multiple combatants in the Netherrealm.
Resurrected himself through sheer willpower.

name: Sub-Zero
specialAbility: Cryomancer mastery allows Sub-Zero to freeze opponents, create ice constructs, and manipulate the battlefield.
weaknesses: Fire and heat significantly reduce cryomancy power; emotional attachment to his clan can cloud judgment.
description: Kuai Liang, the second Sub-Zero, is a master cryomancer and Lin Kuei grandmaster who fights to protect his clan's honor.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sub-Zero's cryomancy is both a weapon and a shield, making him a versatile combatant in Mortal Kombat.
notableFeats: Defeated Scorpion in Mortal Kombat (MK2).
Created massive ice constructs to trap enemies.
Led the Lin Kuei to reform into a noble clan.
Survived battles against Outworld's strongest warriors.

name: Shao Kahn
specialAbility: Shao Kahn wields godlike strength, soul manipulation, and reality-bending powers to dominate his enemies.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and arrogance often lead to tactical errors; bound by tournament rules when convenient.
description: Shao Kahn, the tyrannical emperor of Outworld, is a conqueror of realms and a godlike warrior feared across dimensions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shao Kahn's ambition and power make him one of the most dangerous beings in Mortal Kombat lore.
notableFeats: Conquered Edenia and merged it with Outworld.
Defeated Raiden in Mortal Kombat multiple times.
Destroyed armies single-handedly with Wrath Hammer.
Manipulated souls to enslave entire populations.

name: Raiden
specialAbility: Raiden commands lightning, teleportation, and divine power to protect Earthrealm from invaders.
weaknesses: Bound by Mortal Kombat rules and prone to catastrophic decision-making under pressure.
description: Raiden, the thunder god and protector of Earthrealm, is a divine warrior who balances immense power with flawed judgment.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Raiden's divine power makes him a formidable protector, but his flawed judgment often complicates his victories.
notableFeats: Defeated Shinnok and banished him to the Netherrealm.
Protected Earthrealm from multiple invasions.
Created champions to fight in Mortal Kombat tournaments.
Destroyed armies with divine lightning.

name: Liu Kang
specialAbility: Liu Kang wields divine fire, martial arts mastery, and dragon transformation to defeat his enemies.
weaknesses: Overreliance on honor and rules in a universe with none; too trusting of his allies.
description: Liu Kang, Earthrealm's chosen champion, is a Shaolin monk who combines divine fire and martial arts to protect his realm.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Liu Kang's divine fire and martial arts make him a formidable champion, but his honor can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Shang Tsung and Goro in Mortal Kombat.
Won multiple Mortal Kombat tournaments to protect Earthrealm.
Transformed into a dragon to defeat powerful enemies.
Defeated Shao Kahn in Mortal Kombat.

name: Kitana
specialAbility: Master of razor-sharp fan blades and air manipulation; 10,000 years of combat training.
weaknesses: Loyalty to Sindel and Liu Kang creates hesitation; lighter build makes her vulnerable to brute force.
description: Kitana is the princess of Edenia, a skilled assassin, and a master of deadly fan blades. Her agility and precision make her a formidable opponent, but her loyalty sometimes clouds her judgment.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kitana's loyalty to her realm and allies often drives her decisions in battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Shao Kahn in Mortal Kombat (MK9)
Survived 10,000 years of combat training
Led Edenian resistance against Outworld forces

name: Shang Tsung
specialAbility: Soul stealing and shapeshifting into consumed warriors; master of dark sorcery.
weaknesses: Requires soul energy to maintain strength; vulnerable during spellcasting windows.
description: Shang Tsung is a centuries-old sorcerer who thrives on stolen souls to maintain his youth and power. His mastery of dark magic makes him a dangerous foe, but his reliance on soul energy is a critical weakness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shang Tsung's cunning and mastery of sorcery make him a dangerous manipulator in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Liu Kang in Mortal Kombat (MK1)
Stole the souls of countless warriors to maintain his youth
Manipulated events to serve Shao Kahn's conquest

name: Goro
specialAbility: Four-armed brute strength and devastating ground stomps; innate resistance to physical damage.
weaknesses: Slow speed and arrogance make him vulnerable to agile opponents; large target due to his size.
description: Goro is the prince of the Shokan and a nine-time Mortal Kombat champion. His immense strength and durability make him a tank in combat, but his arrogance often leads to his downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Goro's brute strength and durability make him a formidable opponent, but his arrogance is often exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Earthrealm warriors in Mortal Kombat tournaments
Held the title of Mortal Kombat champion for nine consecutive tournaments
Survived battles against Outworld's strongest fighters
specialRules: Can attack with all four arms simultaneously

name: Johnny Cage
specialAbility: Shadow powers and martial arts mastery; comedic flair in combat.
weaknesses: Ego makes him underestimate opponents; easily distracted by his celebrity status.
description: Johnny Cage is a Hollywood action star turned Mortal Kombat fighter, known for his flashy moves and shadow powers. His arrogance and comedic personality often mask his true combat prowess.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Johnny Cage's shadow powers and martial arts make him a versatile fighter despite his ego.
notableFeats: Defeated Shinnok in Mortal Kombat (MKX)
Survived multiple apocalyptic battles
Mastered shadow powers to enhance his combat
specialRules: Shadow powers enhance speed and impact

name: Mileena
specialAbility: Tarkatan jaw maw and feral combat style; clone of Kitana with enhanced aggression.
weaknesses: Unstable psychology and obsession with Kitana; feral nature overrides tactics.
description: Mileena is a clone of Kitana infused with Tarkatan DNA, making her a feral and unpredictable fighter. Her aggression and deadly maw make her a dangerous opponent, but her instability is her greatest weakness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mileena's feral nature and Tarkatan DNA make her a dangerous but unstable combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Earthrealm warriors in Mortal Kombat tournaments
Survived battles against Outworld's strongest fighters
Demonstrated enhanced aggression and feral combat skills
specialRules: Tarkatan maw can bypass conventional durability

name: Mulan
specialAbility: Tactical genius; uses opponent's strength against them; rocket-launched fireworks warfare; never gives up.
weaknesses: Fully human; relies heavily on creativity in place of raw power; doubted by everyone initially.
description: A Chinese soldier who disguised herself as a man, defeated an army with an avalanche, and saved all of China. Mulan's ingenuity and courage make her a formidable opponent despite her lack of supernatural powers.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mulan's strength lies in her ability to adapt and overcome challenges through sheer determination and creativity.
notableFeats: Defeated an entire Hun army using an avalanche (Disney's Mulan, 1998).
Saved the Emperor of China by outsmarting Shan Yu (Disney's Mulan, 1998).
Mastered military training in record time despite initial struggles (Disney's Mulan, 1998).
Used fireworks to destroy Shan Yu's forces (Disney's Mulan, 1998).

name: Maleficent
specialAbility: Powerful dark sorcery; dragon transformation; sleeping curse; wings; commands armies of shadow creatures.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability — betrayal by those she loves is her true weakness.
description: The Mistress of All Evil — a faerie queen of terrifying power who cursed a kingdom over a party snub. Maleficent's mastery of dark magic makes her one of Disney's most iconic villains.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Maleficent's dark magic and dragon form make her a formidable foe, but her emotional vulnerability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Cursed Princess Aurora to eternal sleep (Disney's Sleeping Beauty, 1959).
Transformed into a massive dragon to battle Prince Phillip (Disney's Sleeping Beauty, 1959).
Commanded an army of shadow creatures (Disney's Maleficent, 2014).
Created a magical barrier around the Moors (Disney's Maleficent, 2014).

name: Hades
specialAbility: God of the Underworld; flame hair inferno; soul manipulation; commands all dead; deal-making that always wins.
weaknesses: Temper ruins his plans every single time; can be banished by heroic selflessness.
description: Lord of the Underworld and the most underpaid god on Olympus — scheming, fast-talking, and genuinely dangerous. Hades is a master manipulator with immense power over the dead.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hades' cunning and mastery of the Underworld make him a dangerous opponent, but his temper often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Manipulated Hercules into giving up his godhood (Disney's Hercules, 1997).
Commanded the Titans to attack Olympus (Disney's Hercules, 1997).
Controlled the souls of the dead in the Underworld (Disney's Hercules, 1997).
Survived being thrown into the River Styx (Disney's Hercules, 1997).

name: Elsa
specialAbility: Unlimited ice and snow creation; blizzard generation; ice palace construction in seconds; ice giant summoning.
weaknesses: Fear and negative emotion destabilize her power and can make her catastrophically dangerous to allies.
description: The Snow Queen of Arendelle — a woman of immense cryomantic power who once flash-froze an entire kingdom. Elsa's abilities are tied to her emotions, making her both powerful and unpredictable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Elsa's cryomantic powers are immense but tied to her emotional state, making her a volatile combatant.
notableFeats: Flash-froze the kingdom of Arendelle (Disney's Frozen, 2013).
Created an ice palace in seconds (Disney's Frozen, 2013).
Summoned a massive ice giant to protect her (Disney's Frozen, 2013).
Stopped a blizzard she created (Disney's Frozen, 2013).

name: Maui
specialAbility: Shape-shifting via magical fish hook; demigod strength; slowed a sun; pulled up islands from the ocean floor.
weaknesses: Without his hook he loses transformation; insecurity and need for human praise.
description: The demigod of the wind and sea — a massive, tattooed legend who shaped the world and will tell you about it. Maui's strength and shape-shifting make him a powerful ally and opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Maui's demigod abilities make him a formidable force, but his reliance on his hook and need for validation can be exploited.
notableFeats: Slowed the sun to lengthen the day (Disney's Moana, 2016).
Pulled up islands from the ocean floor (Disney's Moana, 2016).
Defeated numerous monsters using his fish hook (Disney's Moana, 2016).
Survived battles against Te Kā (Disney's Moana, 2016).

name: Shan Yu
specialAbility: Superhuman strength and endurance; expert sword combat; commands the Hun army; survived an avalanche instantly.
weaknesses: Pride; underestimates opponents; stopped by fireworks (twice).
description: Leader of the Hun invasion of China — a mountain of a man who walked through an avalanche and shook it off. Shan Yu is a ruthless tactician and a terrifying force on the battlefield.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shan Yu's strength and endurance make him a formidable foe, but his arrogance often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Survived an avalanche unscathed (Mulan, 1998)
Led the Hun army to breach the Great Wall of China (Mulan, 1998)
Overpowered multiple soldiers in close combat (Mulan, 1998)

name: Simba
specialAbility: Lion king battle roar; pride rock combat mastery; calls upon ancestor spirits; never stays dead narratively.
weaknesses: Trauma and guilt can paralyze him; took decades to confront his problems.
description: The Lion King — royalty, literally. Survived assassination as a cub, conquered grief, and reclaimed a kingdom. Simba's journey is one of growth, resilience, and reclaiming his destiny.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Simba's strength lies in his resilience and ability to rally others, but his emotional vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Scar in single combat (The Lion King, 1994)
Reclaimed Pride Rock and united the lion kingdom (The Lion King, 1994)
Survived exile and assassination attempts as a cub (The Lion King, 1994)

name: Jack Sparrow
specialAbility: Absolute unpredictability; drunken sword style that is actually deadly; cursed undead; cannot be cornered.
weaknesses: Cowardice when the odds are honest; rum is always gone; no plan survives contact with him.
description: Captain of the Black Pearl — the worst pirate you've ever heard of, or so people keep saying. Jack Sparrow's cunning and unpredictability make him a dangerous opponent despite his lack of raw power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jack Sparrow thrives in chaos, using his wit and unpredictability to outsmart stronger opponents.
notableFeats: Escaped execution multiple times (Pirates of the Caribbean series)
Outmaneuvered the British Navy (Pirates of the Caribbean series)
Recovered the Black Pearl from cursed pirates (Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl)

name: Godzilla
specialAbility: Atomic breath; nuclear pulse; near-indestructibility; regeneration; grows more powerful from nuclear energy.
weaknesses: Slow speed; arrogance; the Oxygen Destroyer; other alpha kaiju can challenge him.
description: The King of the Monsters — a living nuclear weapon 300 meters tall who ended the atomic age by becoming it. Godzilla is a force of nature, embodying destruction and resilience.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Godzilla's immense power and resilience make him nearly unstoppable, but specialized weapons and faster opponents can exploit his weaknesses.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized weapons like the Oxygen Destroyer
notableFeats: Defeated King Ghidorah in single combat (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)
Survived a direct hit from the Oxygen Destroyer (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)
Destroyed entire cities with atomic breath (Godzilla series)

name: King Kong
specialAbility: Skull Island combat instinct; bioelectric axe; extraordinary intelligence for his size; surprisingly fast learner.
weaknesses: Smaller than Godzilla; emotional vulnerability to humans; lightning is double-edged.
description: The last of his kind and protector of Skull Island — 300 feet of raw intelligence, fury, and loyalty. King Kong is a fierce combatant who combines brute strength with surprising agility and intelligence.

v3Profile.loreNotes: King Kong's intelligence and adaptability make him a formidable opponent, but his emotional ties to humans can be exploited.
weaknesses: Smaller size compared to other kaiju
notableFeats: Defeated Skullcrawler Alpha (Kong: Skull Island, 2017)
Held his own against Godzilla (Godzilla vs. Kong, 2021)
Used intelligence to wield a bioelectric axe effectively (Godzilla vs. Kong, 2021)
specialRules: Learns and adapts quickly in combat

name: King Ghidorah
specialAbility: Triple gravity beam from three heads; each head thinks independently; flight at Mach 3; rapid regeneration.
weaknesses: Heads argue with each other; Godzilla can sever heads; electromagnetic vulnerability.
description: A three-headed golden dragon from space who has destroyed entire planets and makes Godzilla fight hard. King Ghidorah is one of the most iconic kaiju, known for his devastating gravity beams and overwhelming aerial combat capabilities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: King Ghidorah is often portrayed as Godzilla's ultimate rival, capable of challenging him even at his strongest.
notableFeats: Destroyed entire planets (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)
Overpowered Godzilla in aerial combat (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)
Regenerated severed heads during battle (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)
Caused massive storms that spanned continents (Godzilla: King of the Monsters, 2019)

name: Mechagodzilla
specialAbility: Proton Scream; titanium armor; missiles from every surface; can simulate Godzilla's atomic breath perfectly.
weaknesses: Requires massive power source; vulnerable to EMP; controlled by whoever built it this time.
description: A mechanical titan built to kill Godzilla — a robotic monster that matches the original and adds missiles. Mechagodzilla is a technological marvel designed to counter kaiju threats with overwhelming firepower and precision.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mechagodzilla is often portrayed as humanity's ultimate weapon against kaiju, but its reliance on external control is a key vulnerability.
notableFeats: Matched Godzilla in combat (Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla, 1974)
Simulated Godzilla's atomic breath (Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla, 2021)
Destroyed multiple kaiju in a single battle (Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla, 2021)
Withstood Godzilla's atomic breath for extended periods (Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla, 2021)

name: Freddy Krueger
specialAbility: Dream manipulation; kills in dreams cause real death; reality warping inside nightmares; finger knives.
weaknesses: Powerless when awake if no one fears him; can be pulled into the real world and made vulnerable.
description: The burned child murderer of Elm Street — infinitely powerful inside your dreams, and you will dream. Freddy Krueger is a nightmare incarnate, capable of bending reality within the dreamscape to torment his victims.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Freddy's power is directly tied to his victims' fear, making him a formidable foe in psychological and supernatural combat.
weaknesses: Can be resisted by strong will
notableFeats: Killed dozens within their dreams (A Nightmare on Elm Street series)
Warped reality within the dreamscape (A Nightmare on Elm Street series)
Survived being pulled into the real world multiple times (A Nightmare on Elm Street series)
Manipulated victims' fears to amplify his power (A Nightmare on Elm Street series)

name: Jason Voorhees
specialAbility: True immortality — cannot be killed; superhuman strength; tracking instinct; machete mastery; back from everything.
weaknesses: Slow; can't swim (originally); water; his mother's voice can stop him.
description: The unkillable masked killer of Camp Crystal Lake — murdered, drowned, hanged, electrocuted, and always back. Jason Voorhees is a relentless force of nature, embodying pure vengeance and unstoppable pursuit.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jason's immortality and relentless pursuit make him a terrifying opponent in close combat.
notableFeats: Survived drowning and multiple executions (Friday the 13th series)
Killed dozens of victims with brute force (Friday the 13th series)
Returned from death repeatedly (Friday the 13th series)
Overpowered supernatural foes (Friday the 13th series)

name: Michael Myers
specialAbility: The Shape; near-invulnerability; supernatural patience; kills across decades; no motivation, no stopping.
weaknesses: Fire; decapitation (sometimes); seems to have a thing about his sister that might theoretically pause him.
description: Pure evil in a mask — a six-year-old who killed his sister and has spent 40 years improving at it. Michael Myers is a silent, methodical killer who embodies the concept of unstoppable evil.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Michael Myers is often portrayed as an unstoppable force of evil, driven by no discernible motive.
notableFeats: Survived multiple attempts to kill him (Halloween series)
Killed dozens of victims silently (Halloween series)
Displayed supernatural endurance (Halloween series)
Instilled fear across decades (Halloween series)

name: Pennywise
specialAbility: Shape-shifting into deepest fears; deadlights that paralyze; feeding on fear; 27-year hibernation cycle.
weaknesses: Can be weakened if its targets stop being afraid; belief and unity can actually hurt it.
description: An ancient cosmic horror that lives in Derry's sewers and wears a clown suit to eat children every 27 years. Pennywise thrives on fear and manipulates reality to torment its victims.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pennywise's power is tied to fear, making it vulnerable to courage and belief-based attacks.
notableFeats: Manipulated the entire town of Derry into ignoring its atrocities (Stephen King's IT).
Paralyzed victims with its deadlights, rendering them helpless (Stephen King's IT).
Shape-shifted into various forms to exploit individual fears (Stephen King's IT).
Survived for millennia by feeding on fear (Stephen King's IT).

name: Pinhead
specialAbility: Chains of pain from nowhere; dimensional summoning; 'no tears please — it's a waste of good suffering.'
weaknesses: Bound by the rules of the Lament Configuration; can be sent back to hell by the puzzle box.
description: The Lead Cenobite — a former war hero who solved the Lament Configuration and became an angel of absolute pain. Pinhead enforces the rules of hell with chains and torment.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pinhead's power is tied to the Lament Configuration, making him vulnerable to its manipulation.
notableFeats: Summoned chains to immobilize and torture victims (Hellraiser series).
Manipulated dimensions to trap victims in hell (Hellraiser series).
Enforced the rules of the Lament Configuration with brutal precision (Hellraiser series).
Displayed immunity to conventional attacks (Hellraiser series).
specialRules: Can be banished by puzzle box

name: Ash Williams
specialAbility: Boomstick; chainsaw hand; Evil Dead knowledge; Necronomicon expertise; S-Mart hardware improvisation.
weaknesses: Ego; his own possessed hand; time travel keeps complicating everything.
description: The Chosen One against the Deadites — a sporting goods clerk who fights demons with a shotgun and a chainsaw. Ash Williams is a brash, resourceful hero who improvises his way through supernatural chaos.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ash's resourcefulness and humor make him a unique hero in the face of supernatural threats.
notableFeats: Defeated hordes of Deadites with improvised weapons (Evil Dead series).
Survived time travel and fought medieval armies (Army of Darkness).
Mastered the Necronomicon's rituals to banish demons (Evil Dead series).
Single-handedly defended a cabin against supernatural forces (Evil Dead series).

name: RoboCop
specialAbility: Titanium chassis; Auto-9 with near-perfect accuracy; Prime Directives that override all else; never tires.
weaknesses: Directive 4 (hidden) can shut him down; still has Murphy's memories creating emotional conflicts.
description: Alex Murphy — murdered Detroit cop rebuilt as a cyborg law enforcer. Part man. Part machine. All cop. RoboCop enforces justice with unyielding precision and resilience.

v3Profile.loreNotes: RoboCop's unwavering adherence to justice makes him a formidable enforcer.
notableFeats: Defeated ED-209 in combat (RoboCop series).
Survived multiple high-caliber attacks without significant damage (RoboCop series).
Maintained law enforcement efficiency despite emotional conflicts (RoboCop series).
Displayed near-perfect accuracy with Auto-9 (RoboCop series).

name: Blade
specialAbility: Dhampir — all vampire strengths, none of the weaknesses; titanium sword; UV rounds; vampire daywalker.
weaknesses: The Thirst — blood hunger that must be managed; serum dependency.
description: The Daywalker — born from a dying vampire's bite, Eric Brooks hunts what made him with silver and fury. Blade combines martial expertise with supernatural abilities to eliminate vampires.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Blade's unique dhampir physiology makes him a deadly vampire hunter.
notableFeats: Defeated Deacon Frost in combat (Blade movie).
Survived against hordes of vampires single-handedly (Blade series).
Displayed mastery of swordsmanship and firearms (Blade series).
Resisted the Thirst through serum dependency (Blade series).
v3Profile.profanityStyle: light — occasional cool-delivery one-liners with mild cursing

name: The Mask
specialAbility: Reality-bending cartoon physics empowered by Loki's mask.
weaknesses: The mask can be removed, and the wearer's personality shapes its chaotic use.
description: Stanley Ipkiss transforms into a chaotic, reality-bending force of nature when wearing Loki's mask. His powers defy conventional logic, making him nearly unstoppable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Mask's powers are limited only by the imagination and personality of the wearer.
notableFeats: Created a tornado of weapons instantly (The Mask, 1994).
Defied gravity and physics to escape danger (The Mask, 1994).
Survived direct attacks from conventional weapons without harm (The Mask, 1994).
Manipulated reality to create impossible scenarios (The Mask, 1994).
Outpaced bullets with cartoonish speed (The Mask, 1994).

name: Beetlejuice
specialAbility: Reality warping and transformation powers tied to ghostly abilities.
weaknesses: Saying his name three times can banish him; limited ability to cross into the real world unaided.
description: Beetlejuice is a mischievous and chaotic ghost who uses his reality-warping powers to haunt and manipulate others. His antics are as unpredictable as they are dangerous.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beetlejuice thrives on chaos and manipulation, making him a dangerous foe in psychological and magical battles.
notableFeats: Summoned a sandworm to devour enemies (Beetlejuice, 1988).
Warped reality to create impossible scenarios (Beetlejuice, 1988).
Manipulated objects and surroundings with ghostly powers (Beetlejuice, 1988).
Tricked and outsmarted multiple characters using his cunning (Beetlejuice, 1988).
Displayed invulnerability to conventional attacks (Beetlejuice, 1988).

name: V
specialAbility: Master of ideological warfare and knife combat.
weaknesses: Driven by obsession with revenge and ideals, making him emotionally vulnerable.
description: V is a masked vigilante who uses his intellect, theatricality, and combat skills to dismantle oppressive regimes. His dedication to his cause is both his strength and his weakness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: V's strength lies in his ability to inspire and manipulate, making him a formidable opponent in psychological warfare.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple armed guards using knives and agility (V for Vendetta, 2005).
Inspired a revolution through ideological warfare (V for Vendetta, 2005).
Survived gunfire and continued fighting through sheer willpower (V for Vendetta, 2005).
Outmaneuvered and outsmarted government agents (V for Vendetta, 2005).
Executed a flawless plan to destroy Parliament (V for Vendetta, 2005).

name: Ellen Ripley (Power Loader)
specialAbility: Uses a mechanical exosuit to amplify strength and combat capabilities.
weaknesses: The power loader can fail, and her maternal instincts can be exploited.
description: Ellen Ripley is a resourceful survivor who uses her tactical genius and mechanical expertise to fight against overwhelming odds. Her bravery and determination make her a hero in the face of alien horrors.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ripley's ingenuity and courage make her a formidable opponent despite her human limitations.
notableFeats: Defeated the Alien Queen using the power loader (Aliens, 1986).
Outsmarted xenomorphs in multiple encounters (Aliens, 1986).
Survived and escaped from hostile alien environments (Aliens, 1986).
Protected Newt from xenomorph attacks (Aliens, 1986).
Successfully ejected the Alien Queen into space (Aliens, 1986).

name: The Bride of Frankenstein
specialAbility: Undead resilience and electric reanimation powers.
weaknesses: Emotionally volatile and vulnerable to fire and electricity.
description: The Bride of Frankenstein is an undead creation with a terrifying screech and unpredictable behavior. Her rejection of her intended purpose makes her a tragic yet powerful figure.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her tragic existence and unpredictable nature make her a unique and dangerous opponent.
notableFeats: Survived electric reanimation (Bride of Frankenstein, 1935).
Terrified and rejected her creator and intended mate (Bride of Frankenstein, 1935).
Displayed resilience against conventional harm (Bride of Frankenstein, 1935).
Used her screech to instill fear in others (Bride of Frankenstein, 1935).

name: Tanjiro Kamado
specialAbility: Master of Water Breathing and Sun Breathing techniques; Demon Slayer Mark grants enhanced physical abilities and perception.
weaknesses: The Demon Slayer Mark shortens his lifespan; human limits without the mark; requires Nichirin Blade to kill demons.
description: Tanjiro Kamado is a compassionate and determined demon slayer who seeks to cure his sister Nezuko of her demonic curse. He is the inheritor of the lost Sun Breathing form, making him a formidable swordsman.

finishers: Water Breathing: Eleventh Form - Dead Calm
v3Profile.loreNotes: Tanjiro's growth is fueled by his unwavering resolve to protect his sister and avenge his family.
signatures: Water Breathing: Eleventh Form - Dead Calm
notableFeats: Defeated Rui, a Lower Moon demon (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 39).
Mastered Sun Breathing techniques (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 81).
Survived and fought against Upper Moon demons (Demon Slayer manga, Chapters 97–99).
Activated the Demon Slayer Mark during the fight against Akaza (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 147).
specialRules: Nichirin Blade required for demon kills

name: Muzan Kibutsuji
specialAbility: Demon King with unparalleled regeneration, shapeshifting, and blood manipulation; can instantly kill demons under his control.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sunlight; requires the Blue Spider Lily for immortality; can be overwhelmed by coordinated attacks.
description: Muzan Kibutsuji is the progenitor of all demons, possessing immense power and intellect. His ultimate goal is to achieve complete immortality by finding the Blue Spider Lily.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Muzan's cunning and adaptability make him a nearly unstoppable force, but his arrogance can be exploited.
notableFeats: Created all demons (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 1).
Fought against multiple Hashira simultaneously (Demon Slayer manga, Chapters 189–192).
Survived decapitation attempts through regeneration (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 190).
Evolved sun immunity after consuming rare substances (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 198).

name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
specialAbility: Thunderclap and Flash — Godspeed; achieves lightning-fast attacks while unconscious.
weaknesses: Must be asleep to access full power; emotionally fragile; limited combat versatility.
description: Zenitsu Agatsuma is a cowardly yet talented swordsman who becomes a force of nature when unconscious, wielding lightning-fast attacks.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zenitsu's speed and precision make him a dangerous opponent, but his reliance on unconsciousness limits his versatility.
notableFeats: Defeated a demon while unconscious using Thunderclap and Flash (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 17).
Achieved Godspeed during the fight against Upper Moon Six (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 144).
Performed Thunderclap and Flash: Sixfold against multiple enemies (Demon Slayer manga, Chapter 36).
Survived intense battles despite emotional fragility (Demon Slayer manga, Chapters 97–99).

name: Sukuna
specialAbility: Dismantle and Cleave cursed techniques; Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine; regeneration and immense cursed energy.
weaknesses: Requires a host body to act freely; bound by binding vows; arrogance can lead to tactical errors.
description: Sukuna, the King of Curses, is an ancient sorcerer whose power is so immense that his dismembered fingers became cursed objects.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sukuna's mastery of cursed techniques and sadistic nature make him a terrifying opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple sorcerers simultaneously (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 9).
Activated Malevolent Shrine to annihilate enemies (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 117).
Regenerated from near-death injuries (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 118).
Overpowered Mahoraga, a cursed spirit capable of adapting to attacks (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 120).

name: Yuta Okkotsu
specialAbility: Rika grants unlimited cursed energy; Copy Technique allows replication of other sorcerers' abilities.
weaknesses: Emotional instability due to attachment to Rika; cursed energy reserves can be inefficiently used.
description: Yuta Okkotsu is a Special Grade sorcerer whose immense power stems from his bond with Rika, a cursed spirit born from his childhood love.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yuta's versatility and immense cursed energy make him a dangerous combatant, but his emotional ties to Rika can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple cursed spirits simultaneously (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 4).
Utilized Copy Technique to replicate advanced sorcery (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 141).
Overpowered Special Grade curses with Rika's help (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapter 143).
Survived intense battles against high-level sorcerers (Jujutsu Kaisen manga, Chapters 145–147).

name: Nagato (Pain)
specialAbility: Six Paths of Pain — six bodies each with a unique power; Shinra Tensei; Chibaku Tensei; Rinnegan mastery
weaknesses: The real Nagato is frail and far from battle; destroying the paths can end him; ideology exploitable
description: The man who destroyed Konoha in an afternoon with six corpse puppets — God of Pain and the Rinnegan's vessel.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nagato's Rinnegan grants him unparalleled versatility, but his reliance on the Six Paths is a tactical vulnerability.
notableFeats: Destroyed Konoha with Shinra Tensei (Naruto Shippuden, Episode 162)
Captured Naruto with Chibaku Tensei (Naruto Shippuden, Episode 167)
Defeated Jiraiya using the Six Paths of Pain (Naruto Shippuden, Episode 133)
specialRules: Rinnegan abilities scale with chakra reserves

name: Ainz Ooal Gown
specialAbility: Supreme Overlord; YGGDRASIL's greatest player; instant death magic; undead army of 100 levels; World Items
weaknesses: Emotion-suppressing undead nature removes his human judgment; genuinely improvising and pretending not to be
description: An office worker turned into his own skeleton avatar — now a world-ruling Overlord who is making it up as he goes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ainz's mastery of YGGDRASIL mechanics makes him a formidable opponent, but his reliance on strategy can be exploited.
weaknesses: Relies on preparation and layered tactics
notableFeats: Defeated Shalltear Bloodfallen using tactical preparation (Overlord, Season 1)
Destroyed armies with Death Magic (Overlord, Season 2)
Created a Black Hole to annihilate enemies (Overlord, Season 3)
specialRules: World Items grant immunity to certain hax
Relies on layered magical win conditions

name: Anos Voldigoad
specialAbility: Literally unkillable; can destroy concepts; turns any attack into advantage; erased and recreated multiple times
weaknesses: None established — plays by his own rules at all times and wins regardless of the rules
description: The reincarnated Demon King of Tyranny — so powerful he destroyed the world's logic by existing, and it worked out.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Anos's power transcends conventional limits, making him a near-unstoppable force in any confrontation.
notableFeats: Destroyed the God of Time's logic (Misfit of Demon King Academy, Episode 12)
Revived himself after being erased (Misfit of Demon King Academy, Episode 6)
Defeated the Hero Kanon multiple times (Misfit of Demon King Academy, Episode 10)

name: Shinra Kusakabe
specialAbility: Adolla Burst; Hysterical Strength; Rapid — ignites feet for jet propulsion at Mach speed; devil's footprints
weaknesses: Nervous grin makes people distrust him; emotional investment in saving his brother clouds judgment
description: A third-generation pyrokinetic who lights his feet on fire to travel faster than the eye can follow.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shinra's speed and determination make him a formidable fighter, but his emotional ties can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Sho Kusakabe using Adolla Burst (Fire Force, Episode 24)
Moved faster than light during the fight against Haumea (Fire Force, Episode 48)
Saved multiple civilians during the Infernal outbreak (Fire Force, Episode 1)
specialRules: Adolla Burst grants temporary strength boost

name: Venom
specialAbility: Alien symbiote; can copy Spider-Man's powers; invisibility; tendrils; immune to Spider-sense; 'We are Venom'
weaknesses: Sonic attacks; fire; can be separated from host
description: Eddie Brock and his alien symbiote partner — two minds in one body who have decided: We are Venom.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Venom's symbiote powers make him a versatile and dangerous opponent, but his weaknesses are exploitable.
notableFeats: Defeated Spider-Man in direct combat (Marvel Comics, Venom #1)
Overpowered Carnage in a symbiote battle (Marvel Comics, Maximum Carnage)
Lifted a tank with symbiote-enhanced strength (Marvel Comics, Venom: Lethal Protector)

name: Carnage
specialAbility: Red symbiote permanently bonded; weapons from own body; mass murder as a hobby; cannot be fully killed.
weaknesses: Fire and sonic attacks; anti-symbiote weapons; his own chaos occasionally undermines tactics.
description: Cletus Kasady merged with a symbiote that is stronger than Venom — and he just wants to watch everything burn.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Carnage thrives in chaotic environments and is nearly impossible to kill permanently.
notableFeats: Defeated Spider-Man and Venom simultaneously (Amazing Spider-Man #361).
Survived being incinerated by fire multiple times.
Destroyed entire buildings with symbiote tendrils.
Took on multiple Avengers during the 'Absolute Carnage' event.

name: Doctor Doom
specialAbility: Doom Armor; sorcery; time travel; God-level intellect; sovereign immunity; has defeated Beyonder.
weaknesses: Pride — cannot acknowledge anyone as truly equal or superior; obsession with Richards.
description: Victor Von Doom — ruler of Latveria, master sorcerer, and the smartest man alive who will tell you so himself.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Doctor Doom's intellect and sorcery make him one of Marvel's most dangerous villains.
notableFeats: Defeated the Beyonder during 'Secret Wars'.
Stole the power of the Silver Surfer.
Created a pocket universe.
Held his own against the Avengers and Fantastic Four simultaneously.

name: Galactus
specialAbility: The Power Cosmic; eats planets to survive; can recreate the universe; existence-level threat; god among gods.
weaknesses: Requires constant planet consumption; the Ultimate Nullifier; Infinity Gauntlet level power required.
description: The Devourer of Worlds — an entity older than the current universe who eats planets the way we eat lunch.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Galactus is a force of nature, feared across the cosmos for his insatiable hunger.
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by cosmic-level artifacts
notableFeats: Destroyed countless planets across the universe.
Survived battles against cosmic entities like Eternity and Infinity.
Recreated planets and civilizations using the Power Cosmic.
Defeated Thor and the Silver Surfer simultaneously.
specialRules: Requires planetary energy to sustain power

name: Juggernaut
specialAbility: Nothing stops the Juggernaut; Cyttorak gem grants unstoppable momentum; invulnerable helmet; immovable object.
weaknesses: Helmet must be removed to affect his mind; sufficiently large obstacles can slow momentum.
description: Cain Marko, empowered by the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak — once in motion, nothing in the universe stops him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Juggernaut's power is derived from Cyttorak, making him a near-unstoppable force.
weaknesses: Momentum can be slowed by large obstacles
notableFeats: Destroyed entire cities with his unstoppable charge.
Survived attacks from Thor and Hulk simultaneously.
Overpowered Colossus in direct combat.
Resisted telepathic attacks from Charles Xavier.

name: Green Goblin
specialAbility: Goblin Formula superhuman enhancement; pumpkin bombs; razor bats; glider; knows Spider-Man's identity.
weaknesses: Oscillating madness; obsession with Spider-Man as his 'true' nemesis above all else.
description: Norman Osborn unhinged — a genius industrialist who drank his own serum and became Peter Parker's worst nightmare.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Green Goblin's obsession with Spider-Man drives his actions, making him unpredictable and dangerous.
notableFeats: Killed Gwen Stacy by throwing her off a bridge (Amazing Spider-Man #121).
Held his own against Spider-Man in multiple battles.
Destroyed parts of New York City with his bombs.
Outmaneuvered multiple heroes using his gadgets.

name: Sinestro
specialAbility: Yellow Fear Ring — can manifest anything; emotion of fear amplified into constructs; former greatest Green Lantern.
weaknesses: The ring requires fear to power; can be matched by a willpower ring in the hands of the determined.
description: Thaal Sinestro — once the greatest Green Lantern, now the greatest fear-powered one. His logic is impeccable, and his constructs are unparalleled in precision and power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sinestro's mastery of fear-based constructs makes him one of the most dangerous Lanterns in existence.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Green Lanterns simultaneously (Green Lantern Vol. 4 #25).
Created a massive construct army to overwhelm Oa (Sinestro Corps War).
Held his own against Hal Jordan and Kyle Rayner in direct combat (Green Lantern Vol. 5 #20).
Destroyed a planet using fear constructs (Sinestro Corps War).
specialRules: Fear-based constructs scale with opponent's fear
Former Green Lantern training enhances combat skill

name: Reverse Flash
specialAbility: Negative Speed Force; vibration through matter; time travel; creates temporal paradoxes; obsessed with Barry Allen.
weaknesses: The obsession with the Flash makes him predictable; Negative Speed Force is more volatile than the real thing.
description: Eobard Thawne — a man from the 25th century who hated his hero so much he became the villain of history itself. His mastery of time and speed makes him nearly unstoppable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Reverse Flash's mastery of time manipulation makes him one of the most dangerous speedsters in existence.
notableFeats: Killed Barry Allen's mother and framed his father (Flashpoint).
Created a temporal paradox to erase Barry Allen from existence (The Flash Vol. 3 #8).
Defeated multiple speedsters simultaneously using Negative Speed Force (The Flash Vol. 5 #50).
Manipulated time to rewrite history in his favor (The Flash: Rebirth).
specialRules: Can manipulate time to undo defeats
Negative Speed Force disrupts conventional speedsters

name: Vision
specialAbility: Density manipulation; phasing through matter; solar beam from forehead gem; android processing speed.
weaknesses: Existential crises at critical moments; can be hacked or depowered; the Mind Stone dependency.
description: An android built from hate who chose to be human — Vision processes reality faster than thought and phases through walls. His solar beam and density manipulation make him a versatile combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vision's ability to phase through matter and manipulate density makes him a unique and versatile combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Ultron in direct combat (Avengers: Age of Ultron).
Phased through Thor's hammer to avoid damage (Avengers Vol. 5 #23).
Held his own against Scarlet Witch's reality manipulation (Avengers Vol. 6 #12).
Destroyed a massive alien fleet using solar beam projection (Avengers Vol. 4 #19).
specialRules: Density manipulation allows him to bypass physical defenses

name: Namor
specialAbility: Underwater king; flight via ankle wings; superhuman aquatic speed; Vibranium trident; Talokan empowerment.
weaknesses: Dehydration weakens him significantly; arrogance creates tactical blind spots; hates being called a mutant.
description: The Sub-Mariner — the first mutant, king of Atlantis/Talokan, and the most imperious man in any ocean. His Vibranium trident and aquatic strength make him a formidable foe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Namor's aquatic strength and Vibranium trident make him a powerhouse in underwater combat.
notableFeats: Defeated the Hulk underwater (Defenders Vol. 1 #7).
Destroyed an entire fleet of warships single-handedly (Sub-Mariner Vol. 1 #5).
Held his own against Thor in direct combat (Avengers Vol. 1 #40).
Lifted a massive submarine out of the ocean (Sub-Mariner Vol. 1 #3).

name: Loki
specialAbility: Illusion mastery; Frost Giant sorcery; God of Mischief scheming; Variant time-travel; shape-shifting.
weaknesses: Cannot resist a scheme even when he's winning; betrayal is instinct even against his own interests.
description: The God of Mischief and Stories — he's betrayed every ally he has, usually twice, and somehow we still root for him. Loki's mastery of illusion and sorcery makes him a dangerous foe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Loki's mastery of illusion and sorcery makes him one of the most cunning and unpredictable foes in Marvel.
notableFeats: Tricked Thor into banishment (Thor Vol. 1 #1).
Manipulated events to become ruler of Asgard (Journey into Mystery Vol. 1 #85).
Defeated Doctor Strange in a battle of sorcery (Doctor Strange Vol. 2 #23).
Created illusions that fooled the Avengers (Avengers Vol. 1 #1).
specialRules: Illusions can confuse even cosmic beings

name: Black Widow
specialAbility: Master spy and assassin trained in the Red Room, equipped with Widow's Bite and unparalleled martial arts expertise.
weaknesses: Lacks superhuman abilities, making her vulnerable against powered opponents.
description: Natasha Romanoff, aka Black Widow, is a highly trained operative whose skills and cunning allow her to hold her own against gods and monsters. Her mastery of espionage and combat makes her a formidable force despite her human limitations.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often underestimated due to lack of powers, but her skills and intelligence make her a key player in any battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Winter Soldier in hand-to-hand combat (Marvel Comics)
Infiltrated and dismantled Hydra bases single-handedly (Marvel Comics)
Held her own against powered Avengers in combat (Marvel Cinematic Universe)
Outsmarted Loki during interrogation (Marvel Cinematic Universe)
Neutralized alien threats during the Battle of New York (Marvel Cinematic Universe)

name: Uncle Ben
specialAbility: Moral authority and wisdom that inspire others to greatness, even posthumously.
weaknesses: Completely mortal with no combat abilities.
