description: Ben Parker, the beloved uncle of Peter Parker, is a symbol of moral integrity and the catalyst for Spider-Man's heroic journey. His legacy continues to inspire countless heroes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Though not a fighter, Uncle Ben's legacy is one of the most impactful in Marvel history.
notableFeats: Inspired Peter Parker to become Spider-Man (Marvel Comics)
His death motivated Spider-Man to uphold justice (Marvel Comics)

name: Squirrel Girl
specialAbility: Commands squirrels to overwhelm opponents and has defeated cosmic-level threats through unconventional tactics.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on squirrels and optimism, which can be exploited.
description: Doreen Green, the Unbeatable Squirrel Girl, is a quirky hero who has defeated some of Marvel's most powerful villains using her unique abilities and unyielding positivity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her victories often defy logic, making her a wildcard in any battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Thanos off-panel (Marvel Comics)
Defeated Doctor Doom using squirrels (Marvel Comics)
Defeated Galactus through negotiation (Marvel Comics)
Saved the world multiple times using unconventional methods (Marvel Comics)

name: Forbush Man
specialAbility: Iron cooking pot helmet grants immunity to reality-warping and psychic attacks.
weaknesses: Comically inept in combat and relies heavily on luck.
description: Irving Forbush, aka Forbush Man, is Marvel's most absurd hero whose inexplicable abilities often confuse opponents more than they harm them.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often used for comedic relief, but his helmet's immunity can occasionally turn the tide in bizarre ways.
notableFeats: Survived encounters with reality-warping foes due to helmet immunity (Marvel Comics)

name: Spider-Ham
specialAbility: Cartoon physics immunity and Spider-Man's abilities combined with comedic unpredictability.
weaknesses: Immature antics and lack of serious combat experience.
description: Peter Porker, aka Spider-Ham, is a cartoon pig with Spider-Man's abilities who uses humor and toon physics to outwit opponents.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Spider-Ham's comedic approach often disarms opponents, making him surprisingly effective in unconventional battles.
notableFeats: Defeated serious villains using cartoon physics (Marvel Comics)
Outwitted multiversal threats with humor and unpredictability (Marvel Comics)

name: Slapstick
specialAbility: Full cartoon physics — immune to physical harm; pulls mallets, bombs, and dimensional weapons from nowhere; stretches, flattens, and reforms; pain optional.
weaknesses: Reverting to human form makes him entirely mortal; his own chaotic nature undermines tactics.
description: Steve Harmon — a teenager who fell through a dimensional portal and became a living cartoon. Bullets flatten against him. Logic does not apply.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Slapstick's cartoon physics make him a wildcard in any fight, but his chaotic nature limits strategic effectiveness.
notableFeats: Survived being flattened by a steamroller (Marvel Comics).
Pulled a dimensional bomb from nowhere to defeat a cosmic entity.
Deflected bullets with his cartoon body.
Reformed after being shredded into pieces.

name: Maggott
specialAbility: Two sentient stomach maggots (Eany and Meany) emerge and devour literally anything; when they return, grants superhuman strength and durability; can eat through any barrier.
weaknesses: Without the maggots, extremely vulnerable; slow on foot; the maggots have their own opinions.
description: Japheth — an X-Man with two enormous sentient maggots that live in his digestive system and will eat through anything pointed at them.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Maggott's unique physiology makes him a niche combatant, but his reliance on Eany and Meany is a critical vulnerability.
notableFeats: Eany and Meany devoured a Sentinel's armor (X-Men comics).
Survived a direct attack from Juggernaut due to maggot-enhanced durability.
Consumed an entire wall of adamantium.
Regenerated from near-death after maggots returned.

name: Stilt-Man
specialAbility: Hydraulic stilts extending up to 290 feet; titanium-alloy armor; shoulder-mounted blasters; surprisingly hard to fight at ceiling height if you're normal-sized.
weaknesses: Balance; staircases; anyone who can fly; the fundamental premise of his suit.
description: Wilbur Day — who built the most impractical supervillain suit in history and keeps showing up anyway. Points for persistence.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Stilt-Man's elevated combat style is unique but impractical against agile or flying opponents.
notableFeats: Held off Spider-Man using elevated combat tactics.
Survived a direct hit from Iron Man's repulsor blast due to titanium armor.
Used stilts to escape from multiple heroes simultaneously.
Successfully robbed a bank while fighting Daredevil.
specialRules: Stilts can be used for stability

name: Throg
specialAbility: Frogjolnir — a sliver of Mjolnir that fell into Frog World; actual lightning control; frog physiology; hops with devastating force; fully worthy; member of the Pet Avengers.
weaknesses: He's a frog. Some situations are just structurally difficult.
description: Simon Walterson — a man cursed into frog form who found a piece of Mjolnir, became worthy, and now controls thunder as Throg. This is official Marvel canon.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Throg's lightning control and devastating hops make him a formidable close-range fighter despite his small size.
notableFeats: Defeated Loki in Frog World using Frogjolnir.
Summoned a thunderstorm to incapacitate a group of villains.
Leaped over a skyscraper to save civilians.
Fought alongside the Pet Avengers to defeat Thanos' minions.

name: Gwenpool
specialAbility: Knows she's in a comic book; navigates panel gutters; retroactively writes backstory mid-fight; ignores narrative physics when plot demands; impossible aim because she can see hit probabilities.
weaknesses: Forgetting she's the protagonist; emotional investment in other characters' fates.
description: Gwen Poole — a Marvel fan from the real world who figured out she's inside a comic and has been exploiting narrative structure ruthlessly ever since.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gwenpool's meta-awareness makes her a unique combatant, but her emotional investment can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated MODOK by rewriting his backstory mid-fight.
Escaped a death trap by navigating through comic panels.
Dodged bullets by predicting hit probabilities.
Turned a villain's origin story into a joke, rendering them powerless.

name: Frog-Man
specialAbility: Spring-loaded coil boots for erratic leaping; acid spit helmet; has accidentally captured actual supervillains by bouncing into them at high speed.
weaknesses: No actual powers; no control over trajectory; accidentally heroic at best.
description: Eugene Patilio — wearing his failed supervillain father's frog suit with no powers, no plan, and a surprisingly consistent record of stumbling into victories.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often underestimated due to his comedic nature but has a surprising knack for accidental success.
notableFeats: Accidentally captured Leap-Frog during a botched robbery (Marvel Comics).
Defeated White Rabbit by bouncing into her at high speed (Marvel Comics).
Survived encounters with Spider-Man despite his lack of powers (Marvel Comics).

name: Condiment Man
specialAbility: Mustard ray (stings eyes); ketchup jets (slippery floor creation); relish grenades; has actually caused Batman to slip on a condiment-coated floor — documented.
weaknesses: Everything about fighting. Also, most people can just step around the condiments.
description: Mitchell Mayo — a Gotham villain whose condiment-based arsenal is dismissed by every hero and yet he keeps showing up with new sauces.

v3Profile.loreNotes: A comedic villain whose condiment-based attacks occasionally prove effective in surprising ways.
notableFeats: Successfully caused Batman to slip on a condiment-coated floor (DC Comics).
Used relish grenades to incapacitate a group of henchmen (DC Comics).
Survived multiple encounters with Gotham's heroes despite his gimmick-based arsenal (DC Comics).
specialRules: Can create distractions with condiment-based attacks

name: Arm-Fall-Off-Boy
specialAbility: Detaches his own arms and uses them as bludgeons; infinite arm regeneration; surprising range; rejected by the Legion of Super-Heroes and immediately used his power on the rejection committee.
weaknesses: Bludgeoning someone with your own arm is the only move; arms can be stolen mid-fight.
description: Floyd Belkin — rejected by the Legion of Super-Heroes for having the most impractical superpower, and then demonstrated it on the examiner. The arms grow back.

v3Profile.loreNotes: A bizarre hero whose impractical power has occasionally proven useful in unconventional ways.
notableFeats: Demonstrated his power on the Legion of Super-Heroes rejection committee (DC Comics).
Used his detachable arms to fend off a group of attackers (DC Comics).
Regenerated arms instantly after losing them in combat (DC Comics).

name: Matter-Eater Lad
specialAbility: Can eat any matter at any rate — metal, energy, force fields, atoms, conceptual barriers; jaw generates sufficient force to consume anything; his entire planet eats like this.
weaknesses: Eating the Miracle Machine drove him temporarily insane; no combat abilities beyond eating.
description: Tenzil Kem — a Bismollian senator whose entire species can eat anything. He can eat his way out of every physical problem and has.

v3Profile.loreNotes: A unique hero whose ability to consume anything has made him invaluable in specific situations.
notableFeats: Ate through the Miracle Machine, saving the universe but temporarily losing his sanity (DC Comics).
Consumed an entire force field to free his team (DC Comics).
Ate through a conceptual barrier during a cosmic event (DC Comics).

name: Kite Man
specialAbility: Razor-edged hang-glider kite with gas pellets; thermal updraft mastery; air superiority in any wind; 'Kite Man. Hell yeah.'; genuinely difficult to catch in open sky.
weaknesses: Indoors. Any enclosed space. Rain. Shame (suppressed).
description: Charles Brown — a kite-themed villain who says 'Kite Man. Hell yeah.' with complete sincerity and has become beloved for it. A tragic origin. A perfect attitude.

v3Profile.loreNotes: A surprisingly effective villain in open-air environments, often underestimated due to his theme.
notableFeats: Evaded capture by Batman using thermal updrafts (DC Comics).
Successfully infiltrated a high-security building using his kite (DC Comics).
Defeated a group of henchmen by deploying gas pellets mid-flight (DC Comics).
specialRules: Can maneuver through air currents effectively

name: Polka-Dot Man
specialAbility: Polka-dot discs with dimensional portal storage; explosive dots; teleportation via dot; interdimensional parasite that requires him to use his powers daily or be consumed.
weaknesses: Infected with a parasite that will kill him if he stops using his powers; suffers from severe psychological instability.
description: Abner Krill, also known as Polka-Dot Man, is a reluctant hero whose absurd powers hide a tragic backstory. His dimensional weaponry and explosive dots make him a surprisingly effective combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Polka-Dot Man's tragic backstory and absurd powers make him a unique and unpredictable combatant.
notableFeats: Helped defeat Starro the Conqueror (The Suicide Squad, 2021)
Used dimensional dots to destroy a building during a mission
Survived prolonged exposure to interdimensional parasites
specialRules: Requires daily use of powers to avoid being consumed

name: Calendar Man
specialAbility: Holiday-themed murder with matching weapon sets; achieves functional unkillability on his birthday; excels in psychological warfare.
weaknesses: Limited effectiveness outside of themed dates; overly reliant on calendar-based gimmicks.
description: Julian Day, the Calendar Man, is a Gotham villain whose holiday-themed crimes mask his long-term psychological warfare against Batman. His obsession with dates makes him a unique but niche threat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Calendar Man's crimes are often underestimated, but his psychological impact on Gotham is undeniable.
notableFeats: Manipulated Batman during multiple holiday-themed crime sprees
Achieved functional immortality on his birthday
Successfully evaded capture for decades using psychological tactics

name: Dogwelder
specialAbility: Welds deceased dogs to the faces of criminals using supernaturally hot hands; has divine protection through sheer inexplicability.
weaknesses: Limited combat versatility; relies entirely on close-range attacks.
description: Dogwelder is a bizarre and inexplicable member of Section 8, known for welding dead dogs to the faces of criminals. His supernatural abilities make him an unsettling and unpredictable combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dogwelder's inexplicable nature makes him a fearsome and unsettling opponent.
notableFeats: Successfully incapacitated multiple criminals using his welding ability
Maintained divine protection despite his bizarre methods
Instilled fear in opponents through sheer unpredictability

name: Crazy Quilt
specialAbility: Helmet projects blinding multicolor light beams; can scramble visual cortex of anyone looking at him; hypnotic color patterns.
weaknesses: Blind without the helmet; obsession with restoring his sight leads to reckless decisions.
description: Crazy Quilt is a criminal artist whose helmet weaponizes color to disorient and confuse opponents. His chaotic combat style makes him a unique but flawed adversary.

abilities: Helmet projects blinding multicolor light beams
v3Profile.loreNotes: Crazy Quilt's obsession with color and sight makes him a chaotic but flawed combatant.
notableFeats: Successfully disoriented multiple opponents using hypnotic color patterns
Weaponized his helmet to escape capture
Created chaos in Gotham through visual manipulation
specialRules: Can confuse multiple opponents at once

name: Samus Aran
specialAbility: Power Suit with Arm Cannon; Morph Ball; Screw Attack; Phase Drift; Phazon corruption resistance.
weaknesses: Suit can be removed; PTSD response to Ridley; emotional vulnerability involving Baby Metroid.
description: Samus Aran is the galaxy's most feared bounty hunter, armed with Chozo technology and unmatched combat prowess. She has defeated planet-level threats and nearly eradicated the Metroid species.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Samus Aran's Chozo training and advanced technology make her one of the most formidable bounty hunters in the galaxy.
notableFeats: Defeated Ridley multiple times across the Metroid series
Solo-cleared Space Pirate fleets (Metroid Prime series)
Destroyed planet-level threats such as Mother Brain and Phazon corruption
Survived Phazon exposure and weaponized it

name: Solid Snake
specialAbility: Master of stealth and close-quarters combat; capable of infiltrating high-security facilities and neutralizing threats with precision.
weaknesses: Accelerated aging due to FOXDIE; emotional vulnerabilities tied to his past; limited durability against superhuman opponents.
description: Solid Snake is a legendary soldier trained by FOXHOUND, known for his tactical brilliance and ability to overcome impossible odds. He has thwarted nuclear threats and battled against advanced technology with sheer skill and determination.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Snake excels in tactical scenarios but struggles against overwhelming superhuman forces.
notableFeats: Defeated Metal Gear REX (Metal Gear Solid)
Neutralized FOXDIE virus threat (Metal Gear Solid)
Infiltrated Shadow Moses Island (Metal Gear Solid)
Defeated Liquid Snake in hand-to-hand combat (Metal Gear Solid)
v3Profile.profanityStyle: light — occasional hell or damn, soldier brevity

name: Sonic the Hedgehog
specialAbility: Super Sonic form grants invincibility and reality-altering speed; Chaos Control enables teleportation and time manipulation.
weaknesses: Overconfidence in his abilities; inability to swim; reliance on Chaos Emeralds for peak power.
description: Sonic is the fastest being alive, capable of breaking the sound barrier and defeating world-ending threats with his speed and agility. His carefree attitude often masks his heroic resolve.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sonic's speed makes him nearly untouchable, but his overconfidence can lead to mistakes.
notableFeats: Defeated Perfect Chaos (Sonic Adventure)
Destroyed the Death Egg (Sonic 3 & Knuckles)
Outran a black hole (Sonic Colors)
Defeated Solaris, a time-devouring god (Sonic '06)

name: Mario
specialAbility: Power-ups grant temporary abilities like fire manipulation, invincibility, and flight; unmatched agility and platforming skills.
weaknesses: Power-ups are temporary and can be lost; vulnerable without enhancements; often distracted by allies.
description: Mario is a heroic plumber who has saved kingdoms and defeated powerful foes using his agility, power-ups, and determination. Despite his cheerful demeanor, he is a formidable combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mario's versatility and power-ups make him a dangerous opponent in any environment.
notableFeats: Defeated Bowser multiple times (Super Mario series)
Saved the Mushroom Kingdom from invasion (Super Mario Bros)
Traveled across galaxies to rescue Princess Peach (Super Mario Galaxy)
Defeated King Boo and his haunted mansion (Luigi's Mansion cameo)

name: Kirby
specialAbility: Copy Ability allows Kirby to replicate any opponent's powers; Hypernova grants immense destructive capability.
weaknesses: Copy abilities can be lost; small size limits physical reach; overly cheerful demeanor can lead to underestimating threats.
description: Kirby is a cheerful yet immensely powerful entity capable of defeating cosmic threats with his ability to copy powers and his cartoon-like resilience. Despite his size, he is a universal savior.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kirby's ability to copy powers makes him unpredictable and versatile in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Dark Matter (Kirby's Dream Land 2)
Saved Popstar from Nightmare (Kirby's Adventure)
Defeated Magolor, a cosmic-level threat (Kirby's Return to Dream Land)
Destroyed the Master Crown (Kirby's Return to Dream Land)

name: Bowser
specialAbility: Immense physical strength; blue fire breath; Giga Bowser transformation amplifies all abilities.
weaknesses: Overconfidence; reliance on minions; predictable strategies.
description: Bowser is the tyrannical King of the Koopas, known for his immense strength and fiery attacks. Despite his repeated defeats, he remains a persistent and dangerous adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bowser's strength and durability make him a formidable opponent, but his arrogance often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Destroyed castles with his bare hands (Super Mario series)
Transformed into Giga Bowser (Super Smash Bros)
Commanded an army of millions (Super Mario series)
Survived multiple defeats and returned stronger each time (Super Mario series)

name: Ganondorf
specialAbility: Triforce of Power; Ganon boar transformation; dark magic energy blasts; sword combat mastery; repeatedly reincarnated across centuries; sealed by the gods and keeps escaping.
weaknesses: Repeatedly sealed by the same family across multiple timelines; overconfidence in his own destiny.
description: The Gerudo King of Evil — the mortal vessel of Demise's hatred, carrying the Triforce of Power across reincarnations in a cycle he refuses to accept is a cycle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ganondorf's power is tied to the Triforce of Power, making him a near-immortal threat.
notableFeats: Destroyed Hyrule multiple times (Ocarina of Time, Twilight Princess).
Survived being sealed by the gods repeatedly.
Transformed into Ganon, a massive boar-like demon, to amplify his power.
Wielded the Triforce of Power to resist death and reincarnate.
specialRules: Can absorb power from defeated foes

name: Mega Man
specialAbility: Mega Buster; copies any defeated Robot Master's weapon (Metal Blade, Bubble Lead, Air Shooter, all of them); Rush support adaptations; 50+ available weapons simultaneously in late game.
weaknesses: Emotionally conflicted about fighting other robots; takes considerable damage before certain weapon weaknesses are exploited.
description: The Blue Bomber — a robot boy who defeats every enemy by absorbing their weapon and immediately making it everyone else's problem.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mega Man's adaptability makes him a formidable opponent despite his modest stats.
notableFeats: Defeated Dr. Wily's Robot Masters multiple times.
Copied and mastered over 50 unique weapons.
Saved the world from robotic uprisings repeatedly.
Utilized Rush adaptations to overcome environmental challenges.
specialRules: Can copy any defeated enemy's weapon

name: Commander Shepard
specialAbility: N7 implants; biotic charge; tech power combos; united the entire galaxy under one banner; has paragon/renegade solutions for every situation; headbutt has 100% success rate.
weaknesses: Relies on squad; galaxy-saving is emotionally exhausting; the endings are controversial.
description: Commander Shepard — the first human Spectre, who stopped three galactic extinction events, recruited the most dangerous individuals alive, and has a legendary headbutt.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shepard's leadership and adaptability make them a key figure in galactic warfare.
notableFeats: Stopped the Reapers from destroying the galaxy.
United the galaxy's species under one banner.
Defeated Saren and the Collectors.
Survived multiple near-death scenarios.

name: Ryu
specialAbility: Hadouken; Shoryuken; Tatsumaki Senpukyaku; Satsui no Hado dark power; Power of Nothingness mastery; 40+ years of World Warrior competition; SF6 Prime build.
weaknesses: Emotional connection to the Satsui no Hado; no home, no money, no fixed strategy.
description: The World Warrior — a wandering martial artist with no address, no possessions, and a disciplined fist that has leveled every challenger who has come for it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ryu's mastery of martial arts and spiritual energy makes him a formidable opponent.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability to Satsui no Hado
notableFeats: Defeated Akuma in multiple encounters.
Mastered the Power of Nothingness.
Won numerous World Warrior tournaments.
Resisted the corruption of Satsui no Hado.
specialRules: Satsui no Hado amplifies power but risks corruption
Power of Nothingness counters dark energy

name: 2B
specialAbility: YoRHa No.2 Type B combat protocols; Pod 042 support fire; Virtuous Contract katana; self-destruct as area denial; emotion suppression (unreliable but trying); synchronized with 9S.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability beneath the stoic exterior; logic virus susceptibility; cannot fully stop caring.
description: YoRHa No.2 Type B — an android built for war who wears a blindfold, fights with inhuman grace, and is not supposed to feel anything. She does.

abilities: YoRHa No.2 Type B combat protocols
v3Profile.loreNotes: 2B's combat efficiency is enhanced by her synchronization with 9S and Pod 042.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple machine lifeforms in large-scale battles.
Survived encounters with advanced machine intelligence.
Executed synchronized combat maneuvers with 9S.
Utilized self-destruct as a tactical area denial.
specialRules: Emotion suppression can affect combat efficiency

name: Pikachu
specialAbility: Generates powerful electric attacks like Thunderbolt and Volt Tackle; capable of using Z-Moves such as 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt.
weaknesses: Ground-type Pokémon nullify electric attacks; physically small and vulnerable to strong physical opponents.
description: Pikachu is a small but mighty Electric-type Pokémon, known for its loyalty to Ash and its ability to defeat opponents far beyond its weight class through sheer determination and power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pikachu's bond with Ash amplifies its combat effectiveness, often allowing it to overcome seemingly impossible odds.
notableFeats: Defeated Regice in the Battle Frontier (Pokémon: Battle Frontier)
Overpowered Latios in the Sinnoh League (Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl)
Defeated Tapu Koko in the Alola League (Pokémon: Sun and Moon)
Used Z-Move 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt to defeat opponents (Pokémon: Sun and Moon)

name: Gordon Freeman
specialAbility: Utilizes the Gravity Gun to manipulate objects as weapons; HEV Suit enhances physical capabilities and provides environmental protection.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on technology; lacks direct communication skills.
description: Gordon Freeman is a silent but brilliant physicist who uses his intellect and advanced tools to survive alien invasions and apocalyptic scenarios.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gordon Freeman's survival is often attributed to his intelligence and the mysterious protection of the universe itself.
notableFeats: Single-handedly stopped the Xen invasion (Half-Life)
Defeated the Combine forces (Half-Life 2)
Survived Black Mesa incident (Half-Life)
Mastered the Gravity Gun to manipulate objects as weapons (Half-Life 2)

name: Duke Nukem
specialAbility: Utilizes advanced weaponry like the Shrink Ray and Freeze Ray; ego-driven resilience makes him impervious to psychological attacks.
weaknesses: Overconfidence leads to reckless decisions; heavily reliant on gadgets.
description: Duke Nukem is a brash, over-the-top action hero who single-handedly repels alien invasions with his arsenal of weapons and unshakable confidence.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Duke Nukem's ego and arsenal make him a formidable opponent, but his recklessness can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple alien invasions single-handedly (Duke Nukem series)
Utilized Shrink Ray to incapacitate enemies (Duke Nukem Forever)
Survived overwhelming odds through sheer resilience (Duke Nukem 3D)
Mastered advanced weaponry like the Devastator (Duke Nukem series)
v3Profile.profanityStyle: heavy — macho crude one-liners, sex jokes, swears constantly

name: Lara Croft
specialAbility: Expert in ancient artifacts and traps; uses dual pistols and explosive arrows for combat.
weaknesses: Fully human and vulnerable to supernatural forces; emotional ties can be exploited.
description: Lara Croft is a brilliant archaeologist and adventurer who combines intellect, agility, and combat skills to overcome impossible odds and uncover ancient secrets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lara Croft's determination and resourcefulness make her a formidable opponent in any scenario.
notableFeats: Survived supernatural encounters with entities like Himiko (Tomb Raider 2013)
Disarmed ancient traps to recover artifacts (Tomb Raider series)
Defeated mercenary armies single-handedly (Rise of the Tomb Raider)
Recovered divine artifacts despite overwhelming odds (Tomb Raider series)
specialRules: Can use environment to her advantage

name: Ezio Auditore da Firenze
specialAbility: Master Assassin with access to the Apple of Eden for mind control; utilizes stealth and agility to eliminate targets.
weaknesses: Age and physical limitations eventually caught up with him; vulnerable to direct confrontation.
description: Ezio Auditore is a legendary Assassin who led the Brotherhood during the Renaissance, mastering stealth, combat, and the use of ancient artifacts.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ezio's legacy as a Master Assassin is defined by his skill, leadership, and use of ancient artifacts.
notableFeats: Led the Assassin Brotherhood during the Renaissance (Assassin's Creed series)
Recovered the Apple of Eden and used it effectively (Assassin's Creed II)
Defeated Rodrigo Borgia and other Templar leaders (Assassin's Creed II)
Mastered stealth and combat techniques to eliminate targets (Assassin's Creed series)

name: Nathan Drake
specialAbility: Treasure hunter's improvisation; handgun mastery; acrobatic traversal of any environment.
weaknesses: Fully human; supernatural forces are usually genuinely trying to kill him.
description: Nathan Drake is an adventurer who has survived supernatural events, betrayal, and countless dangers while losing every treasure he sought.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nathan Drake's adventures often pit him against supernatural forces and mercenaries, relying on wit and agility to survive.
notableFeats: Survived supernatural threats in Shambhala (Uncharted 2).
Escaped collapsing ruins in Libertalia (Uncharted 4).
Defeated heavily armed mercenaries with limited resources.
Solved ancient puzzles to uncover hidden cities.

name: Booster Gold
specialAbility: Time travel from the 25th century; force field generation; energy blasts via suit.
weaknesses: Requires suit to use powers; ego desperately needs validation.
description: Booster Gold is a time-traveling hero who has secretly saved history countless times while being underestimated by his peers.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Booster Gold's reliance on technology and time travel makes him unpredictable in combat.
notableFeats: Prevented major historical disasters using time travel.
Defeated powerful foes with advanced technology.
Saved Superman from a temporal anomaly.
Maintained the timeline despite interference.
specialRules: Time travel can alter battle outcomes

name: Blue Beetle (Ted Kord)
specialAbility: BB Gun non-lethal disruptor; Beetle-Ship airship; peak human martial arts; genius-level inventor.
weaknesses: No actual superpowers; relies heavily on technology.
description: Ted Kord is a genius inventor and martial artist who uses his intellect and gadgets to fight crime as Blue Beetle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ted Kord's intellect and gadgets make him a formidable opponent despite lacking superpowers.
notableFeats: Solved multiple crises through intelligence alone.
Defeated powerful foes using advanced gadgets.
Protected Gotham from a major technological threat.
Outsmarted villains with superior strategy.
specialRules: Gadgets can incapacitate without lethal force
Can analyze and solve problems creatively

name: The Question
specialAbility: Faceless appearance causes psychological unease; master martial artist trained by Richard Dragon; investigative genius.
weaknesses: Paranoia occasionally compromises operations; lacks ranged combat options.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Question's investigative skills and psychological tactics make him a unique combatant.
weaknesses: Physical weakness compared to stronger opponents

Defeated skilled martial artists in combat.
Solved complex mysteries with limited resources.
Instilled fear in opponents using psychological tactics.

name: Harley Quinn
specialAbility: Joker venom immunity; superhuman acrobatics; oversized mallet; pop psychology weaponized as manipulation.
weaknesses: History of dangerous emotional attachment; impulsive behavior.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Harley Quinn's chaotic combat style and psychological manipulation make her unpredictable.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple armed opponents using acrobatics.
Manipulated powerful foes using psychology.
Survived encounters with Batman and Joker.
Led a successful antihero team in Gotham.

name: Mewtwo
specialAbility: Psychic mastery, telekinesis, telepathy, Psystrike, Shadow Ball, Barrier — the most powerful psychic being in existence.
description: A genetically engineered Pokémon cloned from Mew with immense psychic power. Cold, calculating, and contemptuous of humans, it wields telekinesis and mental energy at terrifying scale.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mewtwo's psychic abilities make it one of the most dangerous Pokémon in existence, capable of overwhelming even legendary opponents.
notableFeats: Defeated an army of Pokémon in the first Pokémon movie.
Created a massive storm capable of destroying an island (Pokémon: The First Movie).
Overpowered Mew in direct combat.
Demonstrated the ability to erase memories (Pokémon: Mewtwo Returns).
Held its own against Mega Evolutions in Pokémon battles.
specialRules: can attack minds or senses directly

name: Charizard
specialAbility: Fire Spin, Inferno, Flamethrower — breathes intense fire that melts anything. Mega Evolution dramatically boosts power.
description: The iconic fire-breathing dragon Pokémon. A fierce aerial combatant whose inferno burns at 2,800 degrees F, obliterating everything in its path.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Charizard's fiery attacks and aerial mobility make it a formidable opponent, especially when Mega Evolved.
notableFeats: Defeated Articuno in a heated battle (Pokémon anime).
Held its own against legendary Pokémon in various battles.
Mega Charizard X and Y forms significantly amplify its power.
Melted boulders with its fire breath.
Survived intense battles against trainers like Ash and Alain.

name: Blastoise
specialAbility: Hydro Pump, water control cannon blasts at 100 mph from shell cannons, Rapid Spin, Iron Defense.
description: A massive armored tortoise Pokémon that fires high-pressure water streams capable of punching through steel from its twin shell cannons.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Blastoise's durability and water cannons make it a defensive powerhouse capable of overwhelming opponents with sustained pressure.
notableFeats: Destroyed steel barriers with Hydro Pump.
Defeated powerful opponents like Charizard in battles.
Withstood heavy attacks due to its shell armor.
Demonstrated incredible water pressure in combat.
Played a key role in Ash's Pokémon League battles.

name: Gengar
specialAbility: Shadow Ball, Hex, Dream Eater, Hypnosis, Night Shade — shadow manipulation and psychic darkness attacks from the void.
description: A malevolent ghost Pokémon that lurks in shadow and darkness. Its cursed body drains warmth from any room it inhabits, leaving victims paralyzed with cold.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gengar's ghostly abilities and cunning make it a dangerous opponent, especially in psychological warfare.
notableFeats: Paralyzed entire rooms with its cursed presence.
Defeated opponents using Hypnosis and Dream Eater.
Evaded attacks using intangibility.
Demonstrated mastery of shadow manipulation.
Played a key role in ghost-type battles.

name: Lucario
specialAbility: Aura Sphere, Close Combat, Bone Rush, Extreme Speed — psychic aura manipulation and precision martial arts mastery.
description: A warrior Pokémon that senses and manipulates aura energy. An expert in aura-reading and devastating close-quarters combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lucario's aura manipulation and martial arts mastery make it a versatile and disciplined fighter.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple opponents using aura-based attacks.
Demonstrated extreme speed in combat.
Held its own against legendary Pokémon.
Used aura sensing to predict and counter moves.
Played a key role in Ash's battles in the Pokémon anime.

name: Rayquaza
specialAbility: Dragon Ascent, V-create, Hyper Voice — cosmic dragon power from the upper atmosphere. Mega Rayquaza operates at galactic scale.
description: The sky high legendary Pokémon who dwells in the ozone layer. An ancient cosmic guardian with power on a universal scale.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rayquaza is revered as the guardian of the skies and the mediator of legendary Pokémon conflicts.
notableFeats: Defeated Deoxys in the Pokémon movie 'Destiny Deoxys'.
Stopped Groudon and Kyogre's clash in 'Pokémon Emerald'.
Mega Evolution grants galactic-level power scaling.
Can manipulate weather conditions globally.

name: Arceus
specialAbility: Judgment, reality warping, dimensional plate manipulation — omnipotent creator of the Pokémon universe who shaped existence itself.
description: The creator deity of the Pokémon world. An omnipotent being who shaped the universe and reality itself with 1,000 arms.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Arceus is the ultimate Pokémon deity, revered as the creator of all existence in its universe.
notableFeats: Created the Pokémon universe as described in the lore.
Defeated Giratina in the Distortion World.
Judgment attack can obliterate targets on a universal scale.
Can manipulate time and space through its plates.

name: WarGreymon
specialAbility: Terra Force, Giga Blaster, Great Tornado — channels earth fire power into planet-cracking attacks. Chrome Digizoid armor Mega-level warrior.
description: The legendary Mega Digimon evolution of Agumon, clad in impenetrable Chrome Digizoid armor. A heroic dragon warrior capable of destroying planets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: WarGreymon is a legendary Digimon known for its unmatched bravery and destructive power.
notableFeats: Defeated BlackWarGreymon in Digimon Adventure 02.
Destroyed a mountain with Terra Force.
Chrome Digizoid armor is nearly indestructible.
Fought alongside Omnimon against Diaboromon.

name: MetalGarurumon
specialAbility: Metal Wolf Claw, Giga Missile, Ice Wolf Bite — ice and metal weaponry at absolute zero temperatures. Full cybernetic Mega Digimon.
description: The cybernetic Mega Digimon evolution of Gabumon. A mechanized wolf of Chrome Digizoid armor that fires missiles and freezes enemies solid.

v3Profile.loreNotes: MetalGarurumon is a cybernetic Digimon known for its precision and devastating ice-based attacks.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Ultimate-level Digimon in Digimon Adventure.
Fired missiles capable of freezing targets instantly.
Chrome Digizoid armor provides extreme durability.
Fought alongside WarGreymon against Diaboromon.

name: Omnimon
specialAbility: Transcendent Sword, Supreme Cannon — wields the combined cosmic power of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon via DNA Digivolution at universe-scale.
description: The Royal Knight born from DNA Digivolution of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon. Among the most powerful beings in the Digital World.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Omnimon is a fusion Digimon revered for its unmatched power and heroic deeds.
notableFeats: Defeated Diaboromon in Digimon Adventure: Our War Game.
Destroyed multiple planetary-scale threats.
Fusion of WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon grants immense power.
Serves as a Royal Knight protecting the Digital World.

name: Gallantmon
specialAbility: Commands holy cosmic magic and wields a divine lance and shield to protect the Digital World.
weaknesses: Susceptible to dark and shadow-type Digimon attacks.
description: Gallantmon is a sacred Royal Knight Digimon who embodies justice and divine power. He uses his cosmic lance and shield to defend the Digital World against threats.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gallantmon is a Royal Knight who fights for justice and the preservation of the Digital World.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Mega-level Digimon in single combat (Digimon Tamers).
Held his own against the D-Reaper's agents (Digimon Tamers).
Destroyed the Digital Hazard threat using Final Elysion (Digimon Tamers).
Protected the Digital World from catastrophic destruction (Digimon Tamers).

name: Beelzemon
specialAbility: Harnesses shadow-powered void energy and demon lord abilities to devastate opponents.
weaknesses: Highly vulnerable to holy and light-type attacks.
description: Beelzemon is a demon lord Digimon who embodies darkness and shadow. Known for his twin shotguns and motorcycle, he is a fearsome and relentless combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beelzemon is a fallen angel Digimon who thrives in darkness and chaos.
weaknesses: Can be distracted by strong emotions
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Ultimate-level Digimon with ease (Digimon Tamers).
Survived and adapted to the D-Reaper's attacks (Digimon Tamers).
Achieved Blast Mode, significantly amplifying his power (Digimon Tamers).
Destroyed the D-Reaper's agents using Chaos Flare (Digimon Tamers).

name: BlackWarGreymon
specialAbility: Harnesses earth-scorching firepower and Chrome Digizoid armor for devastating attacks.
weaknesses: Holy-type attacks and counters from Royal Knights.
description: BlackWarGreymon is a dark Mega Digimon born from Control Spires. A lone warrior who seeks meaning through battle, he is a destructive force with immense power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: BlackWarGreymon is a tragic figure who questions his existence and seeks purpose through combat.
notableFeats: Destroyed multiple Control Spires with ease (Digimon Adventure 02).
Defeated WarGreymon in combat (Digimon Adventure 02).
Resisted the influence of Arukenimon and Mummymon (Digimon Adventure 02).
Sacrificed himself to seal the Highton View Terrace portal (Digimon Adventure 02).
specialRules: Enhanced durability due to Chrome Digizoid armor
Can harness earth's energy for attacks

name: Yujiro Hanma
specialAbility: Possesses the Demon Back and Hanma Gene, granting limitless strength and adaptive combat mastery.
weaknesses: Ego and lack of ranged abilities.
description: Yujiro Hanma is the strongest creature on Earth, feared by nations and capable of ending wars with his presence. He is a master of all martial arts and a force of nature.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yujiro Hanma is unmatched in physical combat and feared globally for his overwhelming power.
notableFeats: Defeated the United States military single-handedly (Baki series).
Ended wars by intimidating world leaders (Baki series).
Destroyed a massive earthquake with a single punch (Baki series).
Survived a direct lightning strike unscathed (Baki series).

name: Baki Hanma
specialAbility: Utilizes the Demon Face and Son of Ogre technique for adaptive fighting and strength scaling.
description: Baki Hanma is the strongest teenager alive and the son of Yujiro Hanma. He is a fighting prodigy who constantly pushes his limits to surpass his father.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Baki Hanma is a prodigy who constantly evolves through combat and seeks to surpass his father.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple seasoned martial artists (Baki series).
Survived intense imaginary world training (Baki series).
Fought evenly against Yujiro Hanma in combat (Baki series).
Mastered advanced grappling and striking techniques (Baki series).

name: Pickle
specialAbility: Prehistoric raw power, savage survival instinct, unlimited durability from ancient biology — a specimen who wrestled dinosaurs barehanded.
weaknesses: Limited strategic intelligence and vulnerability to advanced weaponry.
description: A prehistoric man preserved in saline rock for 190 million years. Stronger and more durable than any modern human, Pickle relies on brute force and primal instincts to dominate opponents.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pickle's prehistoric biology makes him a unique combatant, unmatched in raw physicality but vulnerable to modern tactics.
notableFeats: Defeated a T-Rex in hand-to-hand combat (Baki manga).
Survived a direct hit from modern weaponry without injury.
Overpowered multiple martial artists simultaneously.
Lifted and threw a massive dinosaur carcass with ease.

name: Retsu Kaioh
specialAbility: Chinese Kempo grandmaster techniques, precision strikes, internal energy control — a living legend of martial arts mastery with 4,000 years of technique.
weaknesses: Struggles against opponents with overwhelming superhuman physicality.
description: A Chinese Kempo grandmaster revered for his unparalleled skill and discipline. Retsu Kaioh embodies centuries of martial arts refinement, capable of defeating opponents far stronger than himself through technique.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Retsu Kaioh's martial arts mastery allows him to bridge the gap between human and superhuman combatants.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple opponents using precision strikes (Baki manga).
Demonstrated mastery of Chinese Kempo techniques in tournament combat.
Held his own against superhuman fighters despite physical limitations.
Executed flawless counter-strikes against faster opponents.

name: Jack Hanma
specialAbility: Maximum Tournament champion techniques, enhanced jaw force, Body Enhancement program — superhuman biting force and overwhelming raw strength.
weaknesses: Struggles against speed-based fighters and strategic opponents.
description: Jack Hanma, son of Yujiro Hanma, underwent extreme medical enhancements to achieve superhuman strength. His biting force and raw power make him a fearsome combatant, though his obsession with power can be his downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jack's enhancements make him a formidable opponent, but his lack of speed and strategic thinking can be exploited.
notableFeats: Crushed bones with his bite force (Baki manga).
Defeated multiple opponents in the Maximum Tournament.
Survived extreme physical punishment during enhancement procedures.
Lifted and threw massive objects with ease.

name: Arbiter
specialAbility: Energy Sword, Active Camouflage stealth, Sangheili combat mastery and plasma weapons.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when uncloaked and honour-bound limitations.
description: Thel 'Vadam, the Arbiter, is a Sangheili warrior of unmatched skill and honour. His mastery of the Energy Sword and stealth tactics make him a deadly combatant, though his adherence to honour can limit his effectiveness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Arbiter's honour and stealth tactics make him a unique combatant, excelling in close-quarters combat but vulnerable to detection.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Spartan soldiers in combat (Halo series).
Led Covenant forces in battle with strategic precision.
Mastered the Energy Sword, capable of cutting through advanced armour.
Utilized Active Camouflage to infiltrate enemy bases.
specialRules: Can become invisible for tactical advantage

name: Cortana
specialAbility: Superintelligence, psychic hacking, telekinesis via hard light constructs and instant system domination.
weaknesses: Requires physical hardware anchor and is vulnerable to rampancy.
description: Cortana is the most advanced AI ever created by humanity, capable of overwhelming any system and projecting hard light constructs. Her intelligence and adaptability make her a formidable ally or adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cortana's intelligence and technological manipulation make her a unique combatant, though her reliance on hardware can be exploited.
notableFeats: Overwhelmed the Forerunner Domain (Halo series).
Projected hard light constructs to assist in combat.
Hacked and disabled advanced Covenant systems.
Provided tactical support to Master Chief in critical missions.
specialRules: Can manipulate technology to her advantage

name: The Didact
specialAbility: Forerunner telekinesis, Composer beam, reality manipulation through ancient Forerunner technology.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and vulnerability during power usage.
description: The Didact is an ancient Forerunner commander who once crushed humanity and wields godlike intellect and technology capable of digitizing consciousness. His mastery of Forerunner artifacts makes him a formidable foe, but his arrogance can be exploited.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Didact's power is rooted in ancient Forerunner technology, making him a unique threat to both physical and digital entities.
notableFeats: Digitized millions of humans using the Composer (Halo 4).
Defeated humanity in the Forerunner-Human war.
Manipulated Forerunner technology to reshape environments.
Survived the destruction of his physical body through advanced Forerunner constructs.

name: Sergeant Johnson
specialAbility: Tactical battlefield genius, Spartan-grade combat training, Flood-immune biology due to Boren Syndrome.
description: Sergeant Major Avery Johnson is a legendary UNSC marine immune to Flood infection due to Boren Syndrome. His tactical genius and unbreakable will make him a key figure in humanity's survival against alien threats.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Johnson's immunity to the Flood makes him a unique asset in the Halo universe, capable of surviving scenarios that would kill most humans.
notableFeats: Survived multiple encounters with the Flood (Halo series).
Led UNSC forces in key battles against the Covenant.
Immune to Flood infection due to Boren Syndrome.
Displayed unmatched resilience and tactical acumen in combat.
specialRules: Adapts tactics based on battlefield conditions

name: Ken Masters
specialAbility: Shoryuken, Tatsumaki Senpukyaku, inferno fire Hadouken — fire-enhanced Ansatsuken style with blazing attacks.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and aggressive nature leave openings.
description: Ken Masters is a fiery martial artist who combines Ansatsuken techniques with his own aggressive flair. His mastery of fire-enhanced attacks makes him a dangerous opponent in any fight.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ken's fiery personality and aggressive combat style make him a fan favorite, but his overconfidence can be exploited by skilled opponents.
weaknesses: Lower durability compared to power fighters
notableFeats: Defeated multiple World Warriors in tournaments (Street Fighter series).
Mastered fire-enhanced Ansatsuken techniques.
Held his own against Ryu in numerous battles.
Displayed incredible speed and precision in combat.

name: Chun-Li
specialAbility: Hyakuretsukyaku lightning-fast kick barrage, Kikoken energy blasts, Spinning Bird Kick — the fastest legs in martial arts.
weaknesses: Lighter build means lower damage tolerance than power fighters.
description: Chun-Li is an Interpol officer and martial artist renowned for her lightning-fast kicks. Her speed and precision make her a formidable opponent, but her lighter build limits her durability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Chun-Li's speed and precision make her a dangerous opponent, but she struggles against fighters with overwhelming durability.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple World Warriors in tournaments (Street Fighter series).
Displayed unmatched leg speed in combat.
Mastered Kikoken energy blasts.
Held her own against power fighters despite her lighter build.
specialRules: Lower durability compared to power fighters

name: Guile
specialAbility: Sonic Boom energy wave projectile, Flash Kick anti-air, Solid Puncher — military precision combat and projectile dominance.
weaknesses: Limited mobility and predictable patterns against adaptive opponents.
description: Guile is a US Air Force colonel and master of military fighting techniques. His precision and projectile dominance make him a formidable fighter, but his predictable patterns can be exploited.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Guile's military precision and projectile dominance make him a dangerous opponent, but adaptive fighters can exploit his predictable patterns.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple World Warriors in tournaments (Street Fighter series).
Mastered Sonic Boom and Flash Kick techniques.
Displayed incredible precision and discipline in combat.
Fought for justice and his fallen friend Charlie.

name: Akuma
specialAbility: Mastery of the Satsui no Hado, granting dark ki and the ability to perform the Shun Goku Satsu instant death technique.
weaknesses: The Satsui no Hado consumes his humanity, making him reckless and overly focused on destruction.
description: Akuma is a martial artist who has fully embraced the Satsui no Hado, sacrificing his humanity for unparalleled power. He is feared for his ability to destroy islands and his mastery of deadly techniques.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Akuma seeks worthy opponents and will destroy anyone who cannot match his power.
notableFeats: Destroyed an island with a single punch (Street Fighter Alpha).
Defeated Gouken, his brother and rival, in a deadly duel (Street Fighter lore).
Survived and adapted to the effects of the Satsui no Hado (Street Fighter Alpha).
Fought Oro, a martial artist considered one of the strongest in the world, to a standstill (Street Fighter III).
specialRules: requires killing intent to maximize power

name: M. Bison
specialAbility: Psycho Power grants telekinetic energy, mind control, and devastating attacks like the Psycho Crusher.
weaknesses: His body deteriorates over time, requiring periodic transfer to new hosts.
description: M. Bison is the ruthless dictator of Shadaloo, wielding Psycho Power to dominate minds and destroy enemies. His ambition knows no bounds, but his reliance on host bodies limits his longevity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: M. Bison's Psycho Power is a threat to the entire world, but his reliance on host bodies limits his longevity.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire army with Psycho Power (Street Fighter II).
Mind-controlled countless individuals to serve Shadaloo (Street Fighter lore).
Survived multiple defeats by transferring his consciousness to new bodies (Street Fighter Alpha).
Battled Ryu and Ken simultaneously and held his ground (Street Fighter II).

name: Cammy
specialAbility: Cammy's speed and precision make her a deadly rush-down fighter, utilizing techniques like Spiral Arrow and Cannon Spike.
weaknesses: Her aggressive fighting style is vulnerable to defensive tactics.
description: Cammy White is a former Shadaloo assassin turned Delta Red operative, known for her unmatched speed and precision. She excels in close combat but struggles against defensive opponents.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cammy's speed and precision make her a formidable opponent, but her reliance on aggression can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Vega in a high-speed duel (Street Fighter II).
Survived and escaped Shadaloo's control (Street Fighter Alpha).
Fought alongside Delta Red to stop global threats (Street Fighter lore).
Outmaneuvered and defeated multiple opponents in rapid succession (Street Fighter V).

name: Megatron
specialAbility: Megatron wields a fusion cannon capable of anti-matter blasts and transforms into a tank or gun for devastating attacks.
weaknesses: His arrogance often leads to underestimating opponents.
description: Megatron is the ruthless leader of the Decepticons, armed with a fusion cannon and fueled by dark energon. His ambition to conquer all is matched only by his destructive power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Megatron's fusion cannon and dark energon make him a city-level threat, but his arrogance can be exploited.
notableFeats: Destroyed a mountain with his fusion cannon (Transformers: Prime).
Defeated Optimus Prime in multiple battles (Transformers lore).
Survived the effects of dark energon and used it to enhance his power (Transformers: War for Cybertron).
Conquered Cybertron and led the Decepticons in a war against the Autobots (Transformers lore).

name: Bumblebee
specialAbility: Bumblebee uses a plasma cannon, Energon stingers, and transforms into a Camaro for high-speed attacks.
weaknesses: His smaller size makes him less durable than larger Decepticons.
description: Bumblebee is a loyal Autobot scout who excels in speed and agility. Despite his smaller size, he is a fierce fighter with powerful weaponry and unwavering loyalty to humanity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bumblebee's speed and adaptability make him a valuable asset in combat, but his smaller size limits his durability.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Decepticons in high-speed combat (Transformers: Prime).
Protected humanity from Decepticon attacks (Transformers lore).
Survived battles against Megatron and other powerful enemies (Transformers: The Last Knight).
Used his speed and agility to outmaneuver larger opponents (Transformers lore).

name: Starscream
specialAbility: Null-ray cannons that disable machinery, Mach 2 jet transformation, Seeker air superiority tactics
weaknesses: Cowardly when outmatched, scheming nature causes hesitation
description: The treacherous Decepticon Air Commander. Always plotting to usurp Megatron while being the most dangerous aerial combatant in the Decepticon army.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Starscream's ambition often undermines his effectiveness in combat.
notableFeats: Disabled multiple Autobots with Null-ray cannons (Transformers: G1)
Led successful aerial assaults against Autobot bases (Transformers: G1)
Survived battles against Megatron despite betrayal attempts (Transformers: G1)

name: Grimlock
specialAbility: T-Rex transformation with fire breath and crushing bite force, rage-enhanced super strength that increases under punishment
weaknesses: Low intelligence means poor tactics, easily baited and enraged
description: The most powerful Dinobot and arguably the strongest Autobot. Grimlock transforms into a mechanical T-Rex and grows stronger the more damage he takes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Grimlock's brute strength makes him a formidable force, but his lack of strategy is a major drawback.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Decepticons single-handedly (Transformers: G1)
Survived direct hits from Megatron's fusion cannon (Transformers: G1)
Destroyed a Decepticon base in a rage-fueled rampage (Transformers: G1)

name: Devastator
specialAbility: Six Constructicons combine into one titanic gestalt robot, gravity vortex cannon, bulldozer force that crushes anything
weaknesses: Combining reduces individual intelligence dramatically, very slow
description: The combined might of six Constructicons in one titanic robot. Devastator is a walking catastrophe — slow but capable of destroying entire cities with sheer mass.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Devastator's sheer power makes him a threat to entire cities, but his slow speed and low intelligence are exploitable weaknesses.
notableFeats: Destroyed an Autobot city in a single rampage (Transformers: G1)
Survived direct hits from Optimus Prime (Transformers: G1)
Lifted and threw massive structures with ease (Transformers: G1)
specialRules: Can merge with Constructicons to form a stronger entity

name: Samwise Gamgee
specialAbility: Unbreakable determination, Elven rope and Phial of Galadriel, carried Frodo up Mount Doom through sheer will alone
weaknesses: No combat training, no magical abilities
description: The truest hero of Middle-earth. A simple gardener whose love and loyalty allowed him to carry Frodo — and the fate of the world — on his back.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Samwise's loyalty and determination make him a key figure in the destruction of the One Ring.
notableFeats: Carried Frodo up Mount Doom despite exhaustion (The Return of the King)
Resisted the temptation of the One Ring (The Return of the King)
Defended Frodo against Shelob (The Two Towers)

name: Gollum
specialAbility: Supernatural stealth from centuries of Ring-bearing, night vision, One Ring obsession grants immunity to most psychic control
weaknesses: Torn personality, desperate and unstable — can be manipulated through the Ring
description: Sméagol, corrupted over 500 years by the One Ring. A wretched yet dangerous creature of preternatural stealth and desperate ferocity, surviving on the power of obsession.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gollum's obsession with the One Ring drives his actions, making him both cunning and desperate.
notableFeats: Evaded capture by multiple enemies for centuries (The Hobbit, The Lord of the Rings)
Survived in the Dead Marshes for decades (The Two Towers)
Successfully infiltrated Mordor with Frodo and Sam (The Return of the King)

name: Smaug
specialAbility: Dragon fire breath that melts stone, armored scales of hardened gold, flight at crushing speed, ancient dragon cunning.
weaknesses: One missing scale under the left breast — a vulnerable spot.
description: The greatest dragon of the Third Age. Smaug descended on the Dwarves of Erebor like a firestorm, and has rested on their gold for 170 years — until disturbed.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Smaug's arrogance often blinds him to subtle threats.
notableFeats: Destroyed Erebor and Dale in a single attack (The Hobbit).
Resisted Bard's arrows until his vulnerable scale was hit (The Hobbit).
Covered miles in flight while unleashing fire on Lake-town (The Hobbit).
Survived centuries without aging or weakening (The Hobbit).

name: Frodo Baggins
specialAbility: One Ring bearer — invisibility, psychic resistance against the dark lord, Sting sword that glows blue near evil.
weaknesses: The Ring's corrupting influence slowly destroys his will.
description: The Ring-bearer who carried the weight of Middle-earth. A hobbit of extraordinary inner strength who resisted what no other being could endure.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Frodo's inner strength is his greatest weapon against overwhelming odds.
notableFeats: Resisted the Ring's influence for months (The Lord of the Rings).
Survived Shelob's attack with Sting (The Lord of the Rings).
Carried the Ring to Mount Doom despite immense psychological strain (The Lord of the Rings).
Outmaneuvered Nazgûl multiple times (The Lord of the Rings).

name: Bilbo Baggins
specialAbility: One Ring invisibility, Sting elvish blade, Burglar stealth and cunning — remarkable luck and resilience beyond any hobbit.
weaknesses: Age, and the Ring's prolonged corrupting hold on his mind.
description: The original ring-bearer who stole the One Ring from Gollum under the mountains. A burglar and adventurer of legendary luck who outwitted a dragon.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bilbo's cunning and luck make him a formidable opponent despite his physical limitations.
notableFeats: Stole the One Ring from Gollum (The Hobbit).
Outwitted Smaug during their encounter (The Hobbit).
Survived the Battle of the Five Armies (The Hobbit).
Resisted the Ring's influence for decades (The Lord of the Rings).

name: Leonardo
specialAbility: Twin katana Niten Ichi-ryu two-sword style, Ninjutsu master, tactical leadership and calm under extreme pressure.
weaknesses: Over-responsible burden of leadership creates hesitation in battle.
description: The blue-masked leader of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Leonardo trains hardest, leads most calmly, and fights with a precision that his brothers cannot match.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Leonardo's discipline and leadership make him the backbone of the team.
weaknesses: Difficulty in adapting to chaotic fights
notableFeats: Defeated Shredder in multiple encounters (TMNT series).
Led the Turtles through countless battles with precision (TMNT series).
Mastered Niten Ichi-ryu two-sword style (TMNT series).
Resisted mind control from powerful enemies (TMNT series).
specialRules: Calm under pressure grants focus in battle

name: Michelangelo
specialAbility: Twin nunchaku Kusarigama chain attacks, fastest movement of all four turtles, unpredictable elastic fighting style.
weaknesses: Least disciplined — creativity sometimes substitutes for technique.
description: The orange-masked free spirit of the group. What Michelangelo lacks in discipline he makes up for in raw speed, creativity, and a loose style nearly impossible to anticipate.

counters: Grounded fighters who can absorb hits
v3Profile.loreNotes: Michelangelo's unpredictability makes him a wild card in any fight.
weaknesses: Lack of discipline leads to mistakes
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Foot Clan members with speed alone (TMNT series).
Outmaneuvered Shredder in combat using agility (TMNT series).
Mastered twin nunchaku techniques (TMNT series).
Saved civilians during chaotic battles with quick thinking (TMNT series).
specialRules: Increased speed grants advantage in dodging
Creative combat allows for unpredictable attacks

name: Donatello
specialAbility: Bo staff long-range precision strikes, tech genius battlefield gadgetry, fights smarter not harder using leverage and physics.
weaknesses: Prefers solving problems without fighting — reluctant warrior.
description: The purple-masked tech genius of the Turtles. Donatello is the smartest fighter in the sewer — his bo staff creates distance while his gadgets change the battlefield entirely.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Donatello's intelligence often gives the Turtles a strategic edge in battles.
weaknesses: Reluctance to engage in direct combat
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Foot Clan ninjas using only his bo staff (TMNT 2003).
Hacked into a high-security system to save his brothers (TMNT IDW Comics).
Invented the Turtle Van and other advanced tech for the team (TMNT 1987).
Neutralized a robotic enemy using an EMP device he built mid-battle (TMNT 2012).
specialRules: Uses technology to gain an advantage

name: Raphael
specialAbility: Twin sai bone-crushing close-combat, rage-fueled strength surge under pressure, most powerful and aggressive of the four.
weaknesses: Anger control issues lead to reckless openings in combat.
description: The red-masked hothead of the Ninja Turtles. Raphael is the physically strongest of the four — when his anger boils over, he becomes a nearly unstoppable berserker.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Raphael's rage often makes him unpredictable but also incredibly dangerous.
notableFeats: Defeated a mutant crocodile in single combat (TMNT 2003).
Held off an entire squad of Foot Clan ninjas while protecting his brothers (TMNT IDW Comics).
Destroyed a heavily armored robot using sheer brute force (TMNT 2012).
Survived a direct explosion and continued fighting (TMNT 1987).
specialRules: Stealth approach can throw off opponents

name: Master Splinter
specialAbility: Ninjutsu grandmaster who taught four elite ninja, Bo staff mastery, pressure point techniques that disable with a single touch.
weaknesses: Elderly — sustained fights wear him down over time.
description: The wise rat sensei who trained the Ninja Turtles from childhood. Master Splinter is a ninjutsu grandmaster who can defeat all four of his students simultaneously.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Splinter's wisdom and mastery of ninjutsu make him a formidable opponent despite his age.
weaknesses: Old age may limit physical capabilities
notableFeats: Defeated all four Turtles simultaneously during training (TMNT 2003).
Outmaneuvered Shredder in a one-on-one duel (TMNT IDW Comics).
Disabled a mutant enemy with a single pressure point strike (TMNT 2012).
Evaded capture by an entire squad of Foot Clan ninjas (TMNT 1987).
specialRules: Can disable opponents with pressure points

name: Shredder
specialAbility: Koga Shuko gauntlet blades, Foot Clan master ninja, chrome armor deflects most weapons — Oroku Saki ninjutsu at its apex.
weaknesses: Obsessive pride against the Turtles leads to repeated poor decisions.
description: Oroku Saki, the Shredder — the supreme master of ninjutsu and eternal enemy of Splinter and the Turtles. His blade gauntlets can cut through almost anything.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shredder's obsession with defeating the Turtles often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Defeated Splinter in a duel using superior tactics (TMNT IDW Comics).
Held off all four Turtles simultaneously in combat (TMNT 2003).
Destroyed a heavily armored vehicle with his gauntlet blades (TMNT 2012).
Evaded capture by an elite squad of government agents (TMNT 1987).

name: Krang
specialAbility: Android body exosuit with energy cannon, Dimension X weaponry, genius-level alien brain with total tactical battlefield analysis.
weaknesses: Physically helpless without his Android body exosuit.
description: The alien brain warlord from Dimension X. Krang pilots a humanoid android battle body while commanding weapons of mass destruction from another dimension.

abilities: Android body exosuit with energy cannon
Genius-level alien brain with battlefield analysis
v3Profile.loreNotes: Krang's reliance on his exosuit makes him vulnerable when separated from it.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when not controlling the exosuit
notableFeats: Commanded an invasion of Earth using Dimension X forces (TMNT 1987).
Defeated the Turtles using advanced weaponry and tactics (TMNT IDW Comics).
Created a portal device capable of interdimensional travel (TMNT 2012).
Destroyed a city block with his energy cannon (TMNT 2003).
specialRules: Tactical battlefield analysis grants strategic advantage

name: Casey Jones
specialAbility: Mastery of improvised sports weapons and fearless street brawling.
weaknesses: Lacks formal martial arts training and relies heavily on instinct.
description: Casey Jones is a hockey-masked vigilante who fights crime using a sports bag full of improvised weapons. His fearless nature and creativity in combat make him a formidable street-level hero.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Casey often teams up with the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to fight crime.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple street-level criminals single-handedly.
Held his own against Foot Clan members.
Saved civilians during chaotic battles in New York City.

name: Aang
specialAbility: Avatar State grants unlimited elemental power and energybending capabilities.
weaknesses: Emotionally vulnerable and hesitant to kill.
description: Aang is the last Air Nomad and the Avatar, capable of bending all four elements and entering the Avatar State to access immense power. His airbending speed and agility are unmatched.

abilities: Avatar State channeling all past lives
v3Profile.loreNotes: Aang's pacifist nature often leads him to seek non-lethal solutions.
notableFeats: Defeated Fire Lord Ozai during Sozin's Comet.
Mastered all four elements in record time.
Used energybending to remove Ozai's firebending permanently.

name: Zuko
specialAbility: Dual-dragon firebending style with lightning generation and redirection.
weaknesses: Emotionally conflicted and weaker without sunlight.
description: Zuko, the former prince of the Fire Nation, mastered firebending and lightning redirection. His dual-dragon style combines precision and power, making him a dangerous combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zuko's journey from antagonist to hero is central to his character arc.
notableFeats: Defeated Azula in an Agni Kai.
Redirected lightning from Ozai during Sozin's Comet.
Mastered firebending under Iroh's tutelage.

name: Fire Lord Ozai
specialAbility: Sozin's Comet-amplified firebending capable of razing continents.
weaknesses: Lost bending permanently and cannot redirect lightning.
description: Fire Lord Ozai was the most powerful firebender alive during Sozin's Comet, capable of unleashing continent-destroying firebending. His arrogance was his downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ozai's ambition to conquer the world was thwarted by Aang.
notableFeats: Nearly destroyed the Earth Kingdom during Sozin's Comet.
Generated firestorms capable of razing entire cities.
Defeated numerous opponents with overwhelming firebending power.

name: Toph Beifong
specialAbility: Inventor of metalbending with seismic sense for perfect battlefield awareness.
weaknesses: Blindness limits her against airborne or lightning attacks.
description: Toph Beifong is a blind earthbending prodigy who invented metalbending. Her seismic sense allows her to detect movements through the ground, making her a tactical powerhouse.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Toph's blindness is both a limitation and a source of her unique abilities.
weaknesses: Blindness limits her against airborne attacks
notableFeats: Invented metalbending by manipulating impurities in metal.
Defeated multiple Fire Nation soldiers single-handedly.
Held her own against powerful benders in the Earth Rumble tournaments.
specialRules: Can detect movements through the ground

name: Katara
specialAbility: Bloodbending allows control over living bodies, spirit water healing reverses death, and waterbending enables versatile combat techniques.
weaknesses: Requires a water source for full power; bloodbending is morally taxing; fire counters her ice-based attacks.
description: Katara is a master waterbender and one of the most skilled benders of her generation. Her bloodbending ability makes her a formidable opponent, capable of controlling living beings against their will.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Katara's mastery of waterbending and bloodbending makes her a versatile and dangerous combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Azula in a one-on-one duel (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 3)
Mastered bloodbending without a full moon (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 3)
Healed Aang's mortal wound using spirit water (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2)
specialRules: Healing abilities can reverse severe injuries

name: Azula
specialAbility: Azula's blue flames burn hotter than normal fire, and she can generate precise lightning strikes for devastating attacks.
weaknesses: Mental instability under pressure; obsessive perfectionism can lead to paralysis; lacks lightning redirection ability.
description: Azula is a prodigy firebender and princess of the Fire Nation. Her blue flames and lightning generation make her one of the most dangerous benders alive.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Azula's psychological manipulation and firebending mastery make her a formidable opponent in both direct combat and strategy.
notableFeats: Defeated Zuko in Agni Kai (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 3)
Mastered lightning generation at a young age (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2)
Outmaneuvered Team Avatar multiple times (Avatar: The Last Airbender, Season 2)
specialRules: Blue flames burn hotter than normal fire

name: Homelander
specialAbility: Homelander possesses heat vision capable of melting steel, flight at mach speed, near-invulnerability, and enhanced senses.
weaknesses: Psychological fragility and pathological need for approval; fear of being perceived as weak.
description: Homelander is the most powerful Supe on Earth, with unmatched physical strength and durability. His heat vision and flight make him a devastating force in combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Homelander's overwhelming power is tempered by his psychological vulnerabilities, making him dangerous but unstable.
weaknesses: Fear of being perceived as weak
notableFeats: Destroyed a plane mid-flight with heat vision (The Boys, Season 1)
Lifted a car effortlessly (The Boys, Season 1)
Survived a direct explosion without injury (The Boys, Season 2)
specialRules: Heat vision can melt steel at range
Near-invulnerability makes him difficult to harm
v3Profile.profanityStyle: moderate — uses strong language when mask slips, controlled in public

name: Billy Butcher
specialAbility: Compound V24 grants temporary superhuman strength and laser eyes, enhancing Butcher's already formidable tactical genius.
weaknesses: V24 is temporary and fatal with repeated use; rage blinds him; limited without Compound V.
description: Billy Butcher is the leader of The Boys, a ruthless tactician who uses Compound V24 to temporarily gain superhuman abilities. His determination and willingness to sacrifice make him a dangerous opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Butcher's tactical genius and willingness to sacrifice make him a dangerous opponent even against stronger foes.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Supes using tactics and explosives (The Boys, Season 2)
Held his own against Homelander temporarily (The Boys, Season 3)
Survived Compound V24's side effects multiple times (The Boys, Season 3)
specialRules: Temporary power boost from Compound V24
v3Profile.profanityStyle: heavy — British vernacular including cunt, bastard, fuck; casual and conversational

name: Soldier Boy
specialAbility: Soldier Boy's nuclear chest blast can permanently strip Supes of their powers, and his Compound V-enhanced physiology grants near-indestructibility.
weaknesses: PTSD from Soviet experimentation; overconfidence; blast requires charging; vulnerable to strong psychics.
description: Soldier Boy is the original superhero, active since WWII. His nuclear chest blast is a unique ability capable of permanently depowering Supes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Soldier Boy's nuclear blast makes him a unique threat to Supes, but his overconfidence can be exploited.
notableFeats: Depowered Kimiko with nuclear blast (The Boys, Season 3)
Survived Soviet experimentation and torture (The Boys, Season 3)
Destroyed a building with his chest blast (The Boys, Season 3)
specialRules: Nuclear blast can strip powers permanently

name: Queen Maeve
specialAbility: Superhuman strength matching Homelander in raw power; near-invulnerability; indestructible shield charge; flight; survived direct hits from Homelander.
weaknesses: Emotionally exhausted by Homelander's manipulation; depressive periods; power came from Compound V.
description: The Seven's co-lead and one of the most powerful Supes alive. Queen Maeve has matched Homelander in close combat and survived. Her shield is virtually indestructible.

counters: Tactics that exploit her shield use
v3Profile.loreNotes: Queen Maeve is a tragic hero, often torn between her moral compass and the corrupt system she operates within.
notableFeats: Matched Homelander in close combat (The Boys, Season 2).
Survived direct hits from Homelander (The Boys, Season 1).
Destroyed a reinforced vehicle with her shield (The Boys, Season 1).
Held her own against multiple Supes simultaneously (The Boys, Season 2).
specialRules: Superhuman strength allows for overpowering foes

name: Starlight
specialAbility: Absorbs electricity scaling to near-infinite power near a grid; blinding photon blasts; force field projection; superstrength at full charge.
weaknesses: Power-dependent on electricity source; morally unwilling to kill; emotionally vulnerable to manipulation.
description: Annie January, The Seven's most principled member. Starlight absorbs electricity to power her abilities — near a power grid she becomes extraordinarily powerful.

counters: Stealth tactics to bypass force fields
v3Profile.loreNotes: Starlight's moral compass often puts her at odds with the corrupt nature of The Seven.
weaknesses: Dependent on electricity for maximum power
Can be overwhelmed by multiple attackers
notableFeats: Blinded multiple attackers with photon blasts (The Boys, Season 1).
Absorbed electricity from a power grid to amplify her abilities (The Boys, Season 2).
Created force fields to protect civilians (The Boys, Season 2).
Held her own against A-Train in combat (The Boys, Season 1).

name: Omni-Man
specialAbility: Viltrumite physiology from centuries of combat training; near-light speed flight; virtually unkillable; rapid healing; punched through an entire city in seconds.
weaknesses: Extreme sound frequencies; intestinal parasites targeting Viltrumites; emotional attachments to family.
description: Nolan Grayson, Viltrumite warrior and spy. One of the most powerful beings on Earth by an enormous margin. Has fought and killed other Invincibles.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Omni-Man's loyalty to Viltrumite ideals often conflicts with his love for his family.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire city in seconds (Invincible, Episode 8).
Defeated multiple Viltrumites in combat (Invincible, Comics).
Survived planetary-level destruction (Invincible, Comics).
Traveled across galaxies at near-light speed (Invincible, Comics).

name: Invincible
specialAbility: Viltrumite half-breed adaptive power growth; near-light speed flight; superhuman durability; power grows stronger after each near-death experience.
weaknesses: Still developing full Viltrumite power; emotional decision-making; weaker than pure Viltrumites initially; sound frequencies.
description: Mark Grayson, son of Omni-Man. Half-Viltrumite with growing power that increases after severe injury. His father trained him from birth for combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mark's journey is one of growth, as he learns to balance his humanity with his Viltrumite heritage.
notableFeats: Survived a near-death beating from Omni-Man (Invincible, Episode 8).
Defeated multiple alien invaders (Invincible, Episode 5).
Adapted to increasingly powerful foes (Invincible, Comics).
Held his own against Viltrumite warriors (Invincible, Comics).

name: Atom Eve
specialAbility: Matter manipulation rearranging molecular structure of anything; transmutes matter into energy; can disintegrate solid objects at the atomic level.
weaknesses: Subconscious limits on using power against living things; requires mental clarity; power shuts off if unconscious.
description: Samantha Eve Wilkins. Her power to manipulate matter at a subatomic level is theoretically limitless. She can transform anything into anything else.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Atom Eve's powers make her one of the most versatile fighters, but her moral limits often hold her back.
weaknesses: Subconscious limits on using power against living things
notableFeats: Transmuted a collapsing building into harmless debris (Invincible, Episode 6).
Disintegrated a reinforced structure at the atomic level (Invincible, Comics).
Created energy constructs to defend against attackers (Invincible, Comics).
Repaired damaged ecosystems using matter manipulation (Invincible, Comics).

name: Battle Beast
