specialAbility: Alien lion warrior physiology with natural armor; mace mastery; defeated Invincible and Omni-Man simultaneously; lives only to fight worthy opponents.
weaknesses: Leaves fights he finds unworthy; overconfident in combat dominance; no ranged capability.
description: An alien lion-warrior who exists only to find worthy opponents. Battle Beast defeated both Invincible AND Omni-Man simultaneously. His hide is natural armor.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Battle Beast seeks only worthy opponents, often leaving fights he deems unworthy.
notableFeats: Defeated Invincible and Omni-Man simultaneously (Invincible #19).
Survived a direct hit from Thragg (Invincible #100).
Destroyed an entire Viltrumite fleet single-handedly (Invincible #110).
Fought for days without rest against multiple opponents (Invincible #111).

name: Sosuke Aizen
specialAbility: Kyoka Suigetsu complete hypnosis of all five senses making every attack an illusion; Hogyoku transformation granting godlike power; Reiatsu so dense it stops blades in midair.
weaknesses: Extreme arrogance; hypnosis negated if you touch the sword before release; ultimately sealed not killed.
description: Former captain turned god. Aizen's Kyoka Suigetsu places everyone who sees it under perfect hypnosis. After Hogyoku fusion, he became a being beyond the laws of Soul Society.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Aizen's mastery of manipulation makes him one of the most dangerous foes in Soul Society.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple captains simultaneously (Bleach manga, Soul Society Arc).
Fused with the Hogyoku, transcending Shinigami limits (Bleach manga, Arrancar Arc).
Stopped Ichigo's blade mid-swing with reiatsu alone (Bleach manga, Deicide Arc).
Survived being sealed by Urahara's Kido (Bleach manga, Deicide Arc).
specialRules: hypnosis negated by touching Kyoka Suigetsu pre-release

name: Kenpachi Zaraki
specialAbility: Raw spiritual power so extreme he suppresses it with an eyepatch for fairness; no Shikai needed to obliterate captains; Kendo one-handed swing split a dimension; Bankai doubles already-unthinkable power.
weaknesses: No tactical intelligence; wants a good fight so deliberately holds back; no healing ability.
description: Captain of the 11th Division. Kenpachi's raw spiritual power is so immense he seals it. His killing intent alone is physically visible.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kenpachi's love for combat makes him one of the most unpredictable fighters in Bleach.
notableFeats: Split a dimension with a single Kendo strike (Bleach manga, Thousand-Year Blood War Arc).
Defeated multiple Sternritter without Bankai (Bleach manga, Thousand-Year Blood War Arc).
Survived a fight against Unohana, the original Kenpachi (Bleach manga, Thousand-Year Blood War Arc).
Unlocked Bankai, doubling his already immense power (Bleach manga, Thousand-Year Blood War Arc).

name: Byakuya Kuchiki
specialAbility: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi — ten million blade petals controlled telepathically at Bankai cutting anything in range; Shunpo flash step at near-teleport speed.
weaknesses: Pride follows rules even when disadvantageous; petals disrupted by extreme wind or electricity.
description: Captain of the 6th Division and head of the Kuchiki clan. Senbonzakura's Bankai creates a vast sea of ten million razor blades controlled by thought.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Byakuya's pride and discipline make him a formidable yet predictable opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated Renji with ease using Shikai (Bleach manga, Soul Society Arc).
Activated Senbonzakura Kageyoshi, overwhelming Ichigo (Bleach manga, Soul Society Arc).
Defeated multiple Espada with Bankai (Bleach manga, Arrancar Arc).
Survived against As Nodt's fear-inducing abilities (Bleach manga, Thousand-Year Blood War Arc).

name: Ulquiorra Cifer
specialAbility: Resurreccion Segunda Etapa — only Espada to achieve second release; Lanza del Relampago energy javelin destroying everything in a quarter mile; regeneration of lost limbs.
weaknesses: Nihilism prevents understanding human determination; cannot comprehend the heart — loses to spiritual resolve.
description: Espada No. 4 and the only Arrancar to achieve a second stage resurrection. In Segunda Etapa, Ulquiorra becomes a being of pure destruction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ulquiorra's nihilism makes him a relentless but emotionally blind opponent.
notableFeats: Achieved Segunda Etapa, surpassing all other Espada (Bleach manga, Hueco Mundo Arc).
Destroyed a quarter-mile radius with Lanza del Relampago (Bleach manga, Hueco Mundo Arc).
Defeated Ichigo in his Vasto Lorde form (Bleach manga, Hueco Mundo Arc).
Regenerated from fatal injuries multiple times (Bleach manga, Hueco Mundo Arc).

name: Endeavor
specialAbility: Hellflame Quirk allows him to generate and manipulate fire at extreme temperatures, including the devastating Prominence Burn.
weaknesses: Overheating from prolonged use of his Quirk; emotional instability stemming from family trauma.
description: Endeavor is the No. 1 Pro Hero after All Might's retirement, known for his fiery determination and unmatched mastery of his Hellflame Quirk. Despite his immense power, he struggles with personal demons and the consequences of his past actions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Endeavor's relentless pursuit of strength stems from his desire to surpass All Might, but his journey toward redemption defines his character arc.
notableFeats: Defeated a High-End Nomu with Prominence Burn (My Hero Academia, Episode 88)
Survived and fought through severe injuries during the Paranormal Liberation War (My Hero Academia, Chapter 296)
Became the No. 1 Pro Hero after All Might's retirement (My Hero Academia, Chapter 94)

name: All For One
specialAbility: All For One can steal, stockpile, and wield hundreds of Quirks simultaneously, making him a versatile and nearly unstoppable force.
weaknesses: Blindness and reliance on life-support technology; overloading his body with multiple Quirks can cause instability.
description: All For One is the ultimate villain in My Hero Academia, feared for his ability to steal and wield Quirks. His centuries of experience and cunning make him a formidable opponent, but his physical limitations are exploitable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: All For One's manipulative nature and vast arsenal of Quirks make him a threat to heroes and society alike.
notableFeats: Fought All Might to a standstill in Kamino Ward (My Hero Academia, Episode 48)
Survived decades of combat and manipulation (My Hero Academia, Chapter 59)
Stole and wielded hundreds of Quirks simultaneously (My Hero Academia, Chapter 89)

name: Tomura Shigaraki
specialAbility: Decay Quirk disintegrates anything touched with all five fingers, triggering a chain reaction that can destroy entire areas.
weaknesses: Emotional instability and susceptibility to All For One's mental control; decay chains can be dodged at range.
description: Tomura Shigaraki is the successor to All For One, wielding the devastating Decay Quirk. His transformation into a near-unstoppable force is marked by his tragic backstory and relentless pursuit of destruction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shigaraki's evolution into a destructive force mirrors his tragic upbringing and twisted ideology.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire city with Decay (My Hero Academia, Chapter 239)
Fought multiple Pro Heroes simultaneously (My Hero Academia, Chapter 273)
Resisted All For One's mental control during critical moments (My Hero Academia, Chapter 285)
specialRules: Decay activates without touch at full power

name: Dio Brando
specialAbility: The World Stand allows him to stop time for up to nine seconds, acting freely while the world is frozen.
weaknesses: Sunlight and Hamon energy are fatal; overconfidence and reliance on time stop can be exploited.
description: Dio Brando is an immortal vampire and Stand user, wielding The World to dominate his enemies. His arrogance and cunning make him a dangerous foe, but his weaknesses are exploitable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dio's mastery of The World and his vampiric abilities make him a nearly unstoppable force in combat.
notableFeats: Stopped time for nine seconds during his fight with Jotaro (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 3)
Survived decapitation and regenerated using Jonathan's body (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 1)
Defeated multiple Stand users with The World (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 3)
specialRules: Time stop duration scales with power

name: Yoshikage Kira
specialAbility: Killer Queen turns anything touched into a bomb, while Bites the Dust creates a time loop resetting events upon discovery of Kira's identity.
weaknesses: Risk-averse nature and preference for fleeing; Bites the Dust has complex activation conditions.
description: Yoshikage Kira is a cunning serial killer and Stand user, wielding Killer Queen to eliminate threats and conceal his identity. His obsession with living a quiet life drives his actions, but his abilities make him a dangerous adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kira's obsession with secrecy and his deadly Stand abilities make him a unique and dangerous opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Stand users with Killer Queen (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 4)
Used Bites the Dust to reset time and escape discovery (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 4)
Eliminated enemies with Sheer Heart Attack's autonomous pursuit (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Part 4)

name: Kars
specialAbility: Ultimate Life Form capable of adapting any biological trait instantly, rendering him immune to sunlight and virtually indestructible.
weaknesses: Overconfidence in his perfection and inability to counter battlefield removal.
description: Kars, the Ultimate Life Form, achieved perfection through the Stone Mask and Red Stone of Aja. His adaptive biology makes him immune to most forms of damage and grants him unparalleled versatility.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kars is virtually indestructible but can be defeated through unconventional means like battlefield removal.
notableFeats: Achieved Ultimate Life Form status through the Red Stone of Aja.
Instantly adapted to sunlight, overcoming the Pillar Men's primary weakness.
Survived being launched into space and frozen in orbit.
Demonstrated the ability to grow wings, claws, and venomous traits instantly.

name: Adult Gon Freecss
specialAbility: Sacrificed all future Nen potential for overwhelming power in the present, briefly rivaling Meruem's strength.
weaknesses: Irreversible sacrifice of Nen potential and lack of defensive strategies.
description: Adult Gon is the result of a forbidden transformation, trading his future for immense power. His aura was so dense it darkened the sky and matched the Chimera Ant King.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Adult Gon is a tragic figure, embodying the cost of ultimate power.
notableFeats: Matched Meruem's strength briefly in combat.
Darkened the sky with his aura density.
Sacrificed all future Nen potential for immediate power.

name: Isaac Netero
specialAbility: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva delivering 100 strikes per second and Zero Hand as a final trump card.
weaknesses: Age limits prolonged combat and Zero Hand is a self-sacrificial move.
description: Isaac Netero, the strongest Hunter, combines unmatched speed and skill with devastating Nen abilities. His Bodhisattva technique is a testament to his mastery.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Netero's techniques are a blend of speed, skill, and sacrifice.
notableFeats: Delivered 100 strikes per second with the Guanyin Bodhisattva.
Used Zero Hand to overwhelm Meruem.
Detonated the Poor Man's Rose as a failsafe.

name: Gregor Clegane
specialAbility: Reanimated physiology granting superhuman strength and pain immunity.
weaknesses: Slow movement and vulnerability to fire or brain destruction.
description: Gregor Clegane, the Mountain, is a monstrous warrior reanimated by dark experiments. His strength and resilience make him nearly unstoppable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gregor's reanimated state makes him a nearly unstoppable force in melee combat.
notableFeats: Crushed a man's skull with his bare hands.
Fought through catastrophic wounds without stopping.
Defeated multiple skilled fighters simultaneously.

name: Sandor Clegane
specialAbility: Superhuman size and strength combined with war-hardened combat experience.
description: Sandor Clegane, the Hound, is a brutal warrior feared across Westeros. His combat prowess and resilience make him a formidable opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sandor's fear of fire is his greatest vulnerability, but his sheer combat skill compensates.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple skilled fighters simultaneously.
Survived wounds that would kill most soldiers.
Faced undead Gregor head-on in combat.

name: Brienne of Tarth
specialAbility: Greatest swordswoman in Westeros; wields Oathkeeper, a Valyrian steel sword capable of cutting through most materials.
weaknesses: Bound by honor — cannot strike a defenseless opponent; emotionally driven; not a tactician.
description: Brienne of Tarth is the finest female knight in all of Westeros, known for her unmatched swordsmanship and unwavering sense of honor. She defeated The Hound in single combat and wields Oathkeeper, a Valyrian steel sword that makes her a formidable opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Brienne's unwavering honor and skill make her a respected figure in Westeros, but her emotional vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated The Hound in single combat (Game of Thrones, Season 4).
Knighted by Jaime Lannister (Game of Thrones, Season 8).
Protected Sansa Stark and Arya Stark against multiple threats (Game of Thrones, multiple seasons).
Survived and fought through the Battle of Winterfell (Game of Thrones, Season 8).

name: Sung Jin-Woo
specialAbility: Shadow Monarch — resurrects fallen enemies as eternal shadow soldiers; commands an army of thousands, including defeated Monarchs.
weaknesses: Shadows are weakened by extreme light; psychological vulnerability due to family ties.
description: Sung Jin-Woo, the Shadow Monarch, is the strongest Hunter in existence, capable of resurrecting any enemy he defeats as a permanent shadow soldier. His infinite leveling system and mastery of Rulers Authority make him a near-unstoppable force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sung Jin-Woo's ability to resurrect enemies as shadow soldiers makes him a unique and overwhelming force in battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Monarchs like Antares and Baran (Solo Leveling, Chapters 170–175).
Resurrected thousands of shadow soldiers, including Monarchs (Solo Leveling, multiple chapters).
Destroyed high-level dungeons single-handedly (Solo Leveling, Chapters 100–150).
Mastered Rulers Authority to manipulate gravity (Solo Leveling, Chapters 120–140).

name: Antares
specialAbility: Monarch of Destruction — commands Berserk Dragon shadows; Dragon Fear collapses all living beings in range; single breath destroys continents.
weaknesses: Immense size is a tactical liability; singular focus on destruction lacks adaptability.
description: Antares, the Monarch of Destruction, is the strongest of all eight Monarchs, capable of obliterating continents with a single breath. His Dragon Fear paralyzes all living beings within range.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Antares is a force of pure destruction, but his lack of adaptability makes him vulnerable to strategic counters.
notableFeats: Destroyed continents with a single breath (Solo Leveling, Chapters 170–175).
Paralyzed armies with Dragon Fear (Solo Leveling, Chapters 160–170).
Fought the Shadow Monarch in an apocalyptic battle (Solo Leveling, Chapters 170–175).
Commanded an army of Berserk Dragons (Solo Leveling, Chapters 150–170).
specialRules: Dragon Fear affects all living beings

name: Natsu Dragneel
specialAbility: Fire Dragon Slayer magic — eats fire to power up; Dragon Force transformation; E.N.D. Etherious demon form.
weaknesses: Motion sickness on vehicles; reckless decision-making; E.N.D. form risks losing self-control.
description: Natsu Dragneel, the Fire Dragon Slayer, is the strongest demon created by Zeref. He grows stronger by consuming fire and magic, and his Dragon Force transformation makes him a powerhouse.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Natsu's fiery determination and ability to consume magic make him a dangerous opponent, but his recklessness can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Zeref's Etherious demons (Fairy Tail, multiple arcs).
Activated Dragon Force to overpower Acnologia (Fairy Tail, Final Arc).
Consumed enemy magic to gain power (Fairy Tail, multiple arcs).
Survived battles against S-class mages (Fairy Tail, multiple arcs).
specialRules: Can consume fire to power up

name: Erza Scarlet
specialAbility: Requip: The Knight — swaps between 200+ armors mid-combat, each with unique abilities; Nakagami Armor cuts through magic itself.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on Requip — magical interference disrupts armor changes; pride can lead to tactical errors.
description: Erza Scarlet, Titania and Queen of the Fairies, is a master of Requip magic, allowing her to switch between over 200 armors mid-combat. Her Nakagami Armor can cut through magic itself, making her a formidable opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Erza's adaptability and mastery of Requip magic make her a versatile and dangerous combatant, but her reliance on armor can be exploited.
weaknesses: Pride can lead to tactical errors
notableFeats: Defeated multiple S-class opponents simultaneously (Fairy Tail, multiple arcs).
Used Nakagami Armor to cut through magic itself (Fairy Tail, Grand Magic Games Arc).
Survived critical injuries to defeat enemies (Fairy Tail, multiple arcs).
Fought Acnologia alongside Fairy Tail guild (Fairy Tail, Final Arc).

name: Gildarts Clive
specialAbility: Crush magic disintegrates anything touched at a molecular level, with no known resistance.
weaknesses: Missing body parts from past battles; occasionally reckless in combat.
description: Gildarts Clive is Fairy Tail's ace mage, renowned for his overwhelming Crush magic that can disassemble landscapes and obliterate opponents. Despite his immense power, he carries scars from past battles and remains a symbol of strength and resilience.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gildarts is a mentor figure to Natsu and the guild, embodying the pinnacle of magical strength and experience.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire mountain with Crush magic (Fairy Tail manga, Chapter 200).
Defeated God Serena, one of the strongest Spriggan 12 (Fairy Tail manga, Chapter 489).
Survived a battle against Acnologia, the Dragon King (Fairy Tail manga, Chapter 465).
Single-handedly defeated an army of enemies during the Tenrou Island arc (Fairy Tail manga, Chapter 250).

name: Ant-Man
specialAbility: Pym Particle manipulation allows size alteration and amplified impact force, with the ability to communicate with ants.
weaknesses: Suit malfunctions under stress; vulnerable when enlarged; overthinks in high-pressure situations.
description: Scott Lang, the second Ant-Man, is a reformed thief turned superhero who uses Pym Particle technology to shrink to subatomic levels or grow to giant proportions. His resourcefulness and humor make him a valuable member of the Avengers.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Scott Lang's ingenuity and humor make him a relatable hero, despite his unconventional powers.
notableFeats: Shrank to the Quantum Realm to retrieve Janet van Dyne (Ant-Man and the Wasp movie).
Defeated Yellowjacket by sabotaging his suit (Ant-Man movie).
Grew to giant size during the airport battle in Captain America: Civil War.
Helped the Avengers retrieve the Infinity Stones during the Time Heist (Avengers: Endgame).

name: Hawkeye
specialAbility: World-class marksman with trick arrows, including explosive, EMP, and sonic variants.
weaknesses: No superhuman powers; hearing impairment; vulnerable at close range without prep time.
description: Clint Barton, known as Hawkeye, is the Avengers' sharpshooter, relying on unparalleled skill and precision to overcome threats. Despite lacking superpowers, he is a master tactician and combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hawkeye's precision and adaptability make him a key member of the Avengers despite his lack of superhuman abilities.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Chitauri soldiers during the Battle of New York (The Avengers movie).
Held his own against Black Widow in hand-to-hand combat (Avengers movie).
Shot Loki mid-speech with a trick arrow (The Avengers movie).
Survived and fought during the Battle of Sokovia (Avengers: Age of Ultron).

name: Cyclops
specialAbility: Concussive optic blasts of immense force, paired with tactical genius and leadership skills.
weaknesses: Cannot control his power without his ruby quartz visor; vulnerable to psychic attacks; overreliance on strategy.
description: Scott Summers, Cyclops, is the X-Men's field leader, wielding devastating optic blasts and unmatched tactical acumen. His unwavering dedication to mutantkind defines his role as a hero.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cyclops' leadership and precision make him a cornerstone of the X-Men, balancing immense power with tactical brilliance.
notableFeats: Destroyed a Sentinel with a single optic blast (X-Men comics, various issues).
Led the X-Men to victory against Magneto multiple times (X-Men comics, various arcs).
Defeated Wolverine in a tactical duel during training (X-Men comics, various issues).
Held off Apocalypse's forces during the Twelve storyline (X-Men comics, The Twelve arc).

name: Jean Grey
specialAbility: Omega-level telepath and telekinetic, capable of reshaping matter and energy on a universal scale as the host of the Phoenix Force.
weaknesses: Phoenix Force can overwhelm her; emotional trauma triggers loss of control; immense psychic strain.
description: Jean Grey is one of the most powerful mutants alive, wielding unparalleled telepathic and telekinetic abilities. As the host of the Phoenix Force, she walks the fine line between heroism and cosmic destruction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jean Grey's connection to the Phoenix Force makes her a cosmic-level threat, capable of reshaping the universe.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire planet while under Phoenix Force influence (X-Men comics, Dark Phoenix Saga).
Defeated Gladiator, a cosmic-level opponent, with telekinesis (X-Men comics, various issues).
Resurrected herself from death using the Phoenix Force (X-Men comics, Phoenix Resurrection).
Held off the combined forces of the X-Men and Avengers during the Phoenix Five storyline (Avengers vs. X-Men).
specialRules: Can attack minds or senses directly

name: Rogue
specialAbility: Absorbs powers, memories, and life-force through touch; permanently absorbed Ms. Marvel's flight, strength, and near-invulnerability.
weaknesses: Cannot control absorption — touch is always dangerous; psychological burden of absorbed memories.
description: Rogue — the woman whose touch can steal your soul. A tragic powerhouse who fights for a world that fears her.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rogue's ability to absorb powers makes her a wildcard in any battle.
notableFeats: Permanently absorbed Ms. Marvel's powers, granting her superhuman strength, flight, and durability (Marvel Comics).
Defeated multiple X-Men during her initial encounter with the team (Uncanny X-Men #171).
Absorbed the powers of Thor temporarily, wielding Mjolnir (Avengers Annual #10).
Held her own against Captain Marvel in combat (X-Men Legacy #269).
specialRules: Powers absorbed can be used against opponents

name: Gambit
specialAbility: Charges any object with explosive kinetic energy; master hypnotic charm; master thief and hand-to-hand combatant.
weaknesses: Charging larger objects causes mental strain; hypnotic charm doesn't work on strong-willed targets; guilt over his past.
description: Remy LeBeau — the Cajun charmer with explosive playing cards and a complicated past who fights for the X-Men on his own terms.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gambit's charm and explosive abilities make him a versatile combatant.
notableFeats: Destroyed a Sentinel with charged playing cards (X-Men #8).
Defeated Wolverine in hand-to-hand combat (X-Men #5).
Outmaneuvered multiple X-Men during training sessions (X-Men Annual #1).
Used his charm to infiltrate high-security locations (Gambit #1).
specialRules: Can charge objects for explosive attacks

name: Colossus
specialAbility: Transforms into organic osmium steel — near-invulnerable, massively strong; artist at heart, warrior by necessity.
weaknesses: Magnetic fields can immobilize him; vibranium disrupts his steel form; his compassion makes him hesitate.
description: Piotr Rasputin — a gentle Russian artist who transforms into a steel titan. One of the X-Men's most powerful and principled members.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Colossus's steel form makes him one of the X-Men's most durable members.
notableFeats: Held off Juggernaut in a direct confrontation (Uncanny X-Men #183).
Survived a nuclear explosion in his steel form (X-Men #100).
Lifted and threw a Sentinel single-handedly (X-Men #8).
Defended the X-Mansion against an army of attackers (X-Men #200).

name: Nightcrawler
specialAbility: Teleportation (BAMF!) — up to 2 miles instantly; can port inside enemies or drop them from great heights; superhuman agility.
weaknesses: Cannot teleport to locations he hasn't seen; teleportation causes fatigue at long range; small frame limits durability.
description: Kurt Wagner — the swashbuckling blue elf of the X-Men. Looks like a demon, has the soul of a saint, fights like a dervish.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nightcrawler's teleportation makes him a highly unpredictable fighter.
notableFeats: Teleported an entire team of X-Men to safety during a battle (Uncanny X-Men #142).
Defeated multiple enemies using teleportation and agility (X-Men #95).
Evaded attacks from Wolverine during training sessions (X-Men Annual #4).
Rescued civilians from a collapsing building using teleportation (X-Men #200).

name: Beast
specialAbility: Superhuman strength and agility in a furry leonine body; one of Marvel's premier scientific minds — expert in genetics and biochemistry.
weaknesses: Feral instincts can surface under extreme stress; his mutations have layered unpredictably over time.
description: Dr. Hank McCoy — Ph.D., X-Man, Avenger, and walking contradiction. Equal parts philosopher and brawler.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beast's combination of intellect and physical prowess makes him a versatile combatant.
notableFeats: Developed a cure for the Legacy Virus (X-Men #100).
Defeated multiple enemies using agility and strength (X-Men #95).
Outsmarted advanced AI during a mission (X-Men Annual #4).
Rescued civilians from a collapsing building using acrobatics (X-Men #200).

name: War Machine
specialAbility: Variable-threat weapons platform — Gatling cannon, missile pods, repulsor blasts, military-grade ordinance; military combat training.
weaknesses: More weapon-focused than Iron Man; relies on the suit; not as innovative as Tony Stark.
description: James Rhodes — the no-nonsense military man who pilots a walking arsenal. Where Iron Man improvises, War Machine obliterates.

v3Profile.loreNotes: War Machine is a military powerhouse, often deployed for high-stakes missions requiring overwhelming firepower.
notableFeats: Held his own against Iron Man in a suit duel (Iron Man Vol. 1 #282).
Destroyed multiple enemy tanks in seconds during a military operation (War Machine Vol. 1 #1).
Defended against an alien invasion with advanced weaponry (Infinity War #3).
Survived a direct hit from a nuclear missile while in his armor (War Machine Vol. 2 #12).

name: Falcon
specialAbility: EXO-7 Falcon wingsuit with supersonic flight; Red Wing drone; can psionically communicate with birds; expert combatant.
weaknesses: Wings are vulnerable to energy weapons; no superhuman durability; relies on tech.
description: Sam Wilson — the man who became Captain America's partner, then Captain America himself. Flying into battle for those who can't.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Falcon excels in aerial combat and reconnaissance, making him a valuable asset in team operations.
notableFeats: Intercepted a missile mid-flight using his wingsuit (Captain America: The Winter Soldier).
Defeated multiple armed mercenaries while airborne (Falcon & Winter Soldier #1).
Outmaneuvered Iron Man in a training exercise (Avengers Vol. 5 #22).
Used Red Wing to disable enemy drones during a covert mission (Captain America Vol. 7 #25).
specialRules: Can use Red Wing for reconnaissance
Can communicate with birds for assistance

name: Winter Soldier
specialAbility: Vibranium bionic left arm with superhuman strength; peak human athlete; expert assassin, sniper, and infiltrator from decades of conditioning.
weaknesses: Psychological triggers from Hydra brainwashing; guilt over past as an assassin; protective of Steve Rogers to a fault.
description: Bucky Barnes — the boy who fell from the train, resurrected as the Soviet Union's most feared assassin, now fighting to reclaim his soul.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Winter Soldier is a deadly assassin with unmatched stealth and combat skills, but his past haunts him.
notableFeats: Defeated Captain America in hand-to-hand combat (Captain America: The Winter Soldier).
Assassinated high-profile targets across the globe (Winter Soldier Vol. 1 #1).
Survived a fall from a train and was rebuilt as a super-soldier (Captain America Vol. 5 #11).
Held his own against Black Panther in combat (Captain America: Civil War).

name: Adam Warlock
specialAbility: Soul Gem wielder; energy manipulation; cosmic awareness; capable of death and rebirth; former nemesis of Thanos.
weaknesses: Soul Gem can overwhelm him with trapped souls; emotionally detached — can be manipulated through others.
description: A perfect human created in a lab who ascended to become a cosmic messiah. Adam Warlock walks the line between savior and destroyer.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Adam Warlock is a cosmic powerhouse, often at the center of universal conflicts.
notableFeats: Defeated Thanos in a battle for the Infinity Gauntlet (Infinity Gauntlet #6).
Resurrected himself after being killed by Magus (Warlock Vol. 1 #11).
Absorbed the souls of countless beings trapped in the Soul Gem (Infinity War #4).
Destroyed an entire fleet of alien ships with energy blasts (Infinity Watch #3).

name: Moon Knight
specialAbility: Avatar of Khonshu — enhanced strength at night and under moonlight; dissociative identity disorder gives him unpredictability; crescent dart arsenal.
weaknesses: Mental instability; physical body has limits; can be manipulated through his alters.
description: Marc Spector — billionaire, mercenary, avatar of the moon god Khonshu. Whatever personality is driving today, he'll be brutal about it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Moon Knight's unpredictability and enhanced abilities under moonlight make him a dangerous combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Taskmaster in hand-to-hand combat (Moon Knight Vol. 5 #6).
Survived a direct confrontation with Werewolf by Night (Moon Knight Vol. 1 #1).
Took down an entire gang single-handedly under moonlight (Moon Knight Vol. 3 #3).
Resisted mental manipulation from Khonshu during a celestial event (Moon Knight Vol. 9 #12).

name: Elektra
specialAbility: Master assassin in multiple martial arts; psychic sai techniques; trained by the Hand and the Chaste; near-superhuman agility and speed.
weaknesses: No superhuman durability; vulnerable to high-powered weapons; her emotional past with Daredevil can be exploited.
description: Elektra Natchios — the deadliest woman in the Marvel universe. A ninja assassin of extraordinary skill who dances on the edge of villainy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Elektra's mastery of stealth and martial arts makes her a deadly opponent in close quarters.
weaknesses: Can be distracted by emotional ties
notableFeats: Defeated Bullseye in hand-to-hand combat (Marvel Comics).
Infiltrated high-security facilities undetected (Marvel Comics).
Fought Daredevil to a standstill multiple times (Marvel Comics).
Survived resurrection by the Hand and retained her skills (Marvel Comics).

name: Luke Cage
specialAbility: Steel-hard skin impervious to most conventional damage; superhuman strength; unbreakable will; street-level leader of the Defenders.
weaknesses: Adamantium and vibranium can still pierce; slower than most superheroes; no flight or range attacks.
description: Power Man. Hero for hire. Luke Cage grew up hard, survived the system, and came back with bulletproof skin to protect his neighborhood.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Luke Cage's durability makes him a cornerstone of any street-level team.
notableFeats: Survived a building collapse without injury (Marvel Comics).
Defeated Iron Fist in sparring matches (Marvel Comics).
Held his own against superhuman opponents like Rhino (Marvel Comics).
Led the Defenders in multiple successful missions (Marvel Comics).

name: Iron Fist
specialAbility: The Immortal Iron Fist — channels chi into superhuman strikes; can cure diseases and injuries; studied every martial art in K'un-Lun.
weaknesses: The Iron Fist can only be used a limited number of times before exhaustion; vulnerable when chi is depleted.
description: Danny Rand — raised in the mystical city of K'un-Lun to become its greatest warrior. His fist hits like a freight train made of destiny.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Iron Fist's chi manipulation makes him a versatile and deadly martial artist.
notableFeats: Defeated Shou-Lao the Undying to earn the Iron Fist (Marvel Comics).
Fought and defeated Davos, the Steel Serpent (Marvel Comics).
Healed severe injuries using chi (Marvel Comics).
Held his own against Spider-Man in combat (Marvel Comics).

name: Rocket Raccoon
specialAbility: Genius-level tactical mind; master weapons engineer and pilot; builds devastating guns from spare parts; expert marksman.
weaknesses: Small and physically fragile; deep emotional insecurity about his origins; reckless bravado covers real fear.
description: Rocket — genetically experimented upon and left angry about it. The foul-mouthed, trigger-happy tactical genius of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rocket's ingenuity and tactical mind make him a dangerous opponent despite his small size.
notableFeats: Built a massive cannon capable of destroying spaceships (Marvel Comics).
Outsmarted Thanos in tactical planning (Marvel Comics).
Piloted the Milano through dangerous asteroid fields (Marvel Comics).
Defeated multiple enemies using improvised weapons (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Can improvise weapons from the environment
Tactical use of gadgets in battle

name: Groot
specialAbility: Flora colossus — regenerates from a single twig; can grow and extend his wooden body; massively strong; absorbs ambient light for energy.
weaknesses: Fire causes serious damage; slow movement; limited verbal communication.
description: I am Groot. Flora colossus from Planet X, beloved member of the Guardians. Simple in speech, infinite in heart and power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Groot's regenerative abilities and strength make him a resilient ally in battle.
notableFeats: Regenerated from a single twig after being destroyed (Marvel Comics).
Defeated multiple enemies using his extended limbs (Marvel Comics).
Absorbed energy to enhance his strength (Marvel Comics).
Saved the Guardians by shielding them with his body (Marvel Comics).

name: Star-Lord
specialAbility: Element Guns capable of firing fire, electricity, water, and wind; Celestial heritage grants latent cosmic potential; expert starship pilot and tactician.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on his weapons and ship; untrained Celestial power limits potential; overconfidence often leads to reckless decisions.
description: Peter Quill, also known as Star-Lord, is a half-human, half-Celestial outlaw and leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy. His charm and resourcefulness make him a formidable hero despite his flaws.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Star-Lord's Celestial heritage remains largely untapped, leaving room for significant growth.
notableFeats: Defeated Ego the Living Planet with the Guardians (Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2).
Successfully stole the Orb containing the Power Stone (Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 1).
Outmaneuvered Ronan's fleet during the Battle of Xandar (Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 1).
Survived direct exposure to the Power Stone using Celestial heritage (Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 1).
Negotiated alliances with various alien factions to save the galaxy.

name: Nightwing
specialAbility: Master acrobat and martial artist trained by Batman; skilled in escrima stick combat; exceptional detective and charismatic leader.
weaknesses: No superhuman powers; avoids killing, limiting options; protective nature can lead to vulnerabilities.
description: Dick Grayson, formerly Robin and now Nightwing, is a hero who combines Batman's training with his own unique charisma and leadership. He protects Blüdhaven with unmatched skill and heart.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nightwing's acrobatics and detective skills make him one of the most versatile members of the Bat-family.
notableFeats: Defeated Blockbuster in hand-to-hand combat (Nightwing Vol. 2 #93).
Led the Teen Titans against Trigon (New Teen Titans Vol. 1).
Outmaneuvered Deathstroke in combat (Nightwing Vol. 2 #112).
Protected Blüdhaven from multiple criminal organizations.
Survived and escaped from the Court of Owls (Nightwing Vol. 4 #7).

name: Batgirl
specialAbility: Photographic memory; genius-level hacking; Cassandra Cain variant reads body language like text; stealth and infiltration expertise.
weaknesses: Physical injury limits combat effectiveness; operates in Batman's shadow; overprotective of allies.
description: Barbara Gordon, known as Batgirl and later Oracle, is a brilliant tactician and hacker. Her intellect and determination make her a key member of the Bat-family.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Batgirl's intellect and adaptability make her a formidable opponent despite her physical limitations.
notableFeats: Hacked the entire Gotham City surveillance network (Birds of Prey Vol. 1).
Defeated Lady Shiva in combat (Batgirl Vol. 1 #25).
Created the Oracle network to assist heroes worldwide.
Survived and adapted after being paralyzed by the Joker (The Killing Joke).
Led the Birds of Prey to multiple victories against high-level threats.

name: Red Hood
specialAbility: Trained by Batman but willing to kill; expert marksman; resurrected via Lazarus Pit granting enhanced aggression and resilience.
weaknesses: Rage compromises judgment; psychological trauma from his death; over-reliance on firearms.
description: Jason Todd, the Red Hood, is a former Robin turned antihero. His lethal methods and emotional scars make him a dangerous yet compelling figure in Gotham.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Red Hood's lethal methods and emotional instability make him unpredictable in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Batman in direct combat (Red Hood: Lost Days).
Took down Black Mask's criminal empire (Under the Red Hood).
Survived resurrection via Lazarus Pit and adapted to its effects.
Outmaneuvered Deathstroke in combat (Red Hood and the Outlaws Vol. 1).
Led the Outlaws to victory against alien threats.

name: Robin
specialAbility: Detective skills rivaling Batman; acrobatics; staff and batarang combat; exceptional hacker and strategist.
weaknesses: No superhuman powers; youth leads to underestimation; sometimes overly reliant on cleverness.
description: Tim Drake, the third Robin, is a brilliant detective and strategist. His intellect and determination make him a standout member of the Bat-family.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Tim Drake's intellect and strategic mind make him a key asset in any team dynamic.
notableFeats: Hacked the Batcave's systems at age 12 (Robin Vol. 1).
Defeated Ra's al Ghul in a battle of wits (Detective Comics #700).
Led the Teen Titans against multiple high-level threats.
Uncovered Batman's identity through deduction (Batman Vol. 1 #436).
Outmaneuvered Lady Shiva in combat (Robin Vol. 2 #25).

name: Catwoman
specialAbility: Master thief with unparalleled stealth and acrobatic prowess; expert whip fighter.
weaknesses: Primarily self-interested; vulnerable to manipulation through emotional ties; lacks superhuman attributes.
description: Selina Kyle is Gotham's most skilled thief and antihero, often walking the line between villainy and heroism. Her relationship with Batman is as complex as her moral compass.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often operates independently but occasionally allies with Batman for mutual goals.
notableFeats: Successfully infiltrated Wayne Enterprises to steal classified data (Batman: Hush).
Outmaneuvered multiple armed guards during a high-profile museum heist (Catwoman: When in Rome).
Defeated multiple League of Assassins members using agility and stealth (Batman: Gotham Knights).
Evaded capture by Batman during a rooftop chase (Batman: Year One).

name: Poison Ivy
specialAbility: Controls plant life, produces pheromones to manipulate humans, and is immune to toxins.
weaknesses: Weakened in environments without plant life; vulnerable to fire; irrational when deforestation is involved.
description: Pamela Isley, also known as Poison Ivy, is an eco-terrorist with a deep connection to the Green, granting her control over plant life. Her mission to protect nature often puts her at odds with humanity.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often allies with Harley Quinn but remains focused on her environmental goals.
notableFeats: Created a massive rainforest in Gotham overnight (Batman: Poison Ivy).
Defeated the Justice League by using pheromones to control their minds (JLA: Paradise Lost).
Survived a direct explosion due to her toxin immunity and plant regeneration (Batman: Hush).
Overpowered Swamp Thing in a battle for control of the Green (Swamp Thing Annual #2).
specialRules: Can rapidly grow plants in urban areas

name: Two-Face
specialAbility: Brilliant criminal strategist with exceptional marksmanship; unpredictable due to coin-flip decisions.
weaknesses: Obsessive coin-flip compulsion can lead to poor decisions; divided psyche creates internal conflict.
description: Harvey Dent, once Gotham's District Attorney, became Two-Face after a tragic accident. His duality drives his criminal actions and unpredictable nature.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often torn between his former ideals and his criminal persona.
weaknesses: Coin flip can lead to poor decisions
notableFeats: Outsmarted Batman during a hostage negotiation (Batman: The Long Halloween).
Defeated multiple armed guards using strategic ambushes (Batman: Dark Victory).
Successfully orchestrated a city-wide crime spree using Gotham's criminal factions (Batman: No Man's Land).
Survived a direct confrontation with Deathstroke using psychological manipulation (Batman: Arkham Knight).
specialRules: Legal knowledge aids in outsmarting opponents

name: Penguin
specialAbility: Trick umbrellas with various functions; master manipulator and arms dealer.
weaknesses: Physically unimposing; relies on henchmen; pride makes him predictable.
description: Oswald Cobblepot, known as the Penguin, is Gotham's most sophisticated crime lord. He uses his intellect and resources to control the city's underworld.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often uses his Iceberg Lounge as a front for criminal activities.
notableFeats: Outsmarted Batman using Gotham's criminal network (Batman: Penguin Triumphant).
Defeated rival crime lords to consolidate power in Gotham (Batman: No Man's Land).
Used trick umbrellas to incapacitate multiple armed guards (Batman: Arkham Origins).
Manipulated Gotham's elite to fund his criminal empire (Batman: The Penguin Affair).
specialRules: Umbrella tricks can vary based on situation

name: Mr. Freeze
specialAbility: Cryogenic suit grants superhuman strength and durability; freeze gun can encase targets in ice instantly.
weaknesses: Dies outside his suit above freezing temperatures; suit is power-hungry; singular motivation makes him predictable.
description: Victor Fries, known as Mr. Freeze, is a cryogenics scientist turned villain. His tragic quest to save his wife drives his cold-hearted actions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Driven by his love for Nora, his actions are often tragic rather than purely villainous.
notableFeats: Encased Batman in ice during a direct confrontation (Batman: The Animated Series).
Survived an explosion due to his cryogenic suit's durability (Batman: Arkham City).
Created a massive ice fortress in Gotham overnight (Batman: Snow).
Defeated multiple armed guards using his freeze gun and tactical planning (Batman: Gotham Knights).

name: Ra's al Ghul
specialAbility: Immortal via Lazarus Pit resurrections; 600+ years of combat mastery; commands the League of Assassins; unmatched tactical genius.
weaknesses: Lazarus Pit dementia with overuse; overconfidence in his plans; obsession with Batman as a 'worthy heir.'
description: Ra's al Ghul — the Demon's Head. Six centuries of living have made him the world's most dangerous man and its most patient villain.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ra's al Ghul is a master manipulator who often uses his immortality and vast resources to outlast his enemies.
notableFeats: Defeated Batman in direct combat (Detective Comics #411).
Successfully orchestrated global eco-terrorist plots (Batman: Birth of the Demon).
Survived centuries through Lazarus Pit resurrections.

name: Scarecrow
specialAbility: Fear toxin — induces vivid terror hallucinations; master psychologist who has studied fear his entire life; certified genius.
weaknesses: Physically weak; fear toxin has no effect on the truly fearless; can be overwhelmed by direct physical confrontation.
description: Jonathan Crane — expert in phobias who uses Gotham as his laboratory. If you can be afraid, Scarecrow has already won.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Scarecrow thrives in psychological warfare, exploiting fear as his primary weapon.
weaknesses: Fear toxin ineffective on fearless opponents
notableFeats: Induced mass hysteria in Gotham using fear toxin (Batman: The Long Halloween).
Manipulated Batman's psyche during Arkham Asylum breakout (Batman: Arkham Knight).
Created a fear toxin potent enough to incapacitate Superman temporarily (Injustice: Gods Among Us).

name: Riddler
specialAbility: Genius-level intellect; master puzzler and trap-builder; his compulsion to leave clues is both his greatest weakness and his calling card.
weaknesses: Pathological need to prove his superiority means he always tips his hand; physically average.
description: Edward Nygma — possibly Gotham's most brilliant criminal. He doesn't just commit crimes; he turns them into tests only a genius can solve.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Riddler's intellect makes him a dangerous foe, but his compulsions often lead to his downfall.
notableFeats: Outsmarted Batman in multiple encounters (Batman: Hush).
Created elaborate death traps that challenged the Justice League (Justice League: Doom).
Successfully manipulated Gotham's elite through riddles and puzzles (Batman: Zero Year).
specialRules: Compulsion to leave clues can be exploited

name: Cyborg
specialAbility: Boom tube teleportation; sonic cannon; hacks any technology instantly; can interface with the entire internet in real-time; auto-repairs.
weaknesses: EMP vulnerability; psychological struggle with his humanity; can be hacked by sufficiently advanced AI.
description: Victor Stone — a star athlete rebuilt as a machine after a catastrophic accident. Half man, half weapon, entirely determined to be more than both.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cyborg's technological prowess makes him a versatile combatant, but his humanity remains his core struggle.
notableFeats: Defended Earth from Apokolips invasion using boom tube technology (Justice League: War).
Hacked alien technology to disable a planetary threat (Justice League: Throne of Atlantis).
Survived and repaired himself after catastrophic damage in battle (Teen Titans: The Judas Contract).

name: Raven
specialAbility: Daughter of Trigon — empathic manipulation, soul-self astral projection, telekinesis, flight, healing; can open portals across dimensions.
weaknesses: Positive emotions can trigger her demonic side; her father Trigon attempts to control her; emotional extremes destabilize her power.
description: Raven — daughter of the demon Trigon, raised to be his portal to Earth. She chose the Teen Titans instead. That choice defines everything.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Raven's demonic heritage makes her a powerful ally, but her emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Trigon's influence and banished him from Earth (Teen Titans: The Judas Contract).
Sealed dimensional rifts threatening reality (Teen Titans Go!).
Healed teammates from near-death injuries using empathic powers (Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo).

name: Starfire
specialAbility: Absorbs ultraviolet radiation for flight and starbolts; superhuman strength surpassing most Kryptonians; learns languages through touch.
weaknesses: Naive about Earth culture; emotional connection to allies can be exploited; cold environments reduce her solar absorption.
description: Koriand'r of Tamaran — a Tamaranean princess who escaped slavery to become one of Earth's most powerful defenders and a Titan through and through. Her starbolts and solar absorption make her a formidable force in battle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Starfire's Tamaranean physiology makes her a powerhouse, but her emotional ties to her team often influence her decisions.
notableFeats: Defeated Blackfire in single combat (Teen Titans #23).
Destroyed an alien fleet with her starbolts (New Teen Titans #1).
Held her own against Wonder Woman in sparring (Wonder Woman Annual #2).
Absorbed enough solar energy to power a city (Teen Titans #12).

name: Beast Boy
specialAbility: Transforms into any animal — extinct, alien, or mythological; can become microscopic organisms or massive prehistoric creatures; connects to The Red.
weaknesses: Animal instincts can overwhelm him; transformation takes a moment; tends to underestimate threats.
description: Garfield Logan — the green kid who can be a dinosaur. Beast Boy hides genuine trauma behind the jokes, and genuine power behind the silliness. His connection to The Red grants him unparalleled versatility in combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beast Boy's versatility makes him unpredictable, but his reliance on animal forms can be exploited by skilled opponents.
weaknesses: Limited combat experience in human form
notableFeats: Transformed into a Kryptonian beast to fight Superboy (Teen Titans #45).
Held off an alien invasion by transforming into a swarm of insects (Teen Titans Annual #1).
Survived a nuclear explosion by transforming into a cockroach (Teen Titans #30).
Defeated a mythological Chimera in single combat (Teen Titans #12).
specialRules: Animal transformation grants unique abilities per form
Connects to The Red for enhanced abilities

name: Green Arrow
specialAbility: World-class archer — trick arrows (explosive, EMP, net, putty, fire); master of multiple martial arts; left-wing vigilante with a cause.
weaknesses: No powers; arrows can be dodged by speedsters; relies on prep time for specialty arrows.
description: Oliver Queen — billionaire, archer, and righteous loudmouth. Green Arrow punches up at the powerful and fights for Starling City with every arrow. His trick arrows and tactical mind make him a dangerous opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Green Arrow's resourcefulness and precision make him a formidable foe, even against superpowered opponents.
notableFeats: Defeated Deathstroke using trick arrows (Green Arrow #45).
Shot an arrow through a sniper's scope from a mile away (Green Arrow #12).
Held off an alien invasion with explosive arrows (Justice League #5).
Defeated Merlyn in a duel (Green Arrow #30).
specialRules: Can adapt arrows for various situations

name: Black Canary
specialAbility: Canary Cry — supersonic scream that shatters steel and can incapacitate entire armies; one of the world's greatest martial artists.
weaknesses: Canary Cry can be neutralized by sound-dampening tech; her compassion makes her predictable.
description: Dinah Lance — a world-class fighter with a sonic scream that levels buildings. The most capable combatant in the DC universe without a cape. Her martial arts mastery and Canary Cry make her a dual threat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Black Canary's combination of martial arts and sonic power makes her a versatile and dangerous combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Lady Shiva in hand-to-hand combat (Birds of Prey #12).
Shattered a tank with her Canary Cry (Justice League #8).
Held off an entire army with her scream (Birds of Prey #25).
Defeated Deathstroke in a sparring match (Green Arrow #45).
specialRules: Canary Cry can incapacitate multiple foes

name: Hawkman
specialAbility: Nth metal wings and body armor — flight, enhanced strength, can remember all of his past lives' skills; master of every ancient weapon.
weaknesses: Memories of past lives cause psychological confusion; relies on Nth metal; not subtle.
description: Carter Hall — an Egyptian prince, a Thanagarian police officer, and countless heroes across thousands of years. He always comes back fighting. His Nth metal armor and mastery of ancient weapons make him a formidable warrior.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hawkman's resilience and combat experience across lifetimes make him a dangerous and relentless fighter.
notableFeats: Defeated Solomon Grundy in single combat (Hawkman #15).
Destroyed a Thanagarian warship with his mace (Hawkman #8).
Held off an army of undead warriors (Hawkman #20).
Defeated Vandal Savage using ancient weaponry (Hawkman #25).

name: Firestorm
specialAbility: Nuclear transmutation — can rearrange the atomic structure of non-living matter; flight; nuclear blasts; two minds sharing one body.
weaknesses: Cannot transmute organic matter; the two personalities sharing a body can disagree at critical moments.
description: Ronnie Raymond and Martin Stein — two men merged into a nuclear-powered hero. Firestorm can rewrite the physical world, if his two minds can agree.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Firestorm's dual personalities can be both a strength and a liability in combat.
notableFeats: Transmuted a skyscraper into water (DC Comics, Firestorm #5).
Absorbed a nuclear explosion without harm (DC Comics, Firestorm #12).
Fought and defeated Multiplex, a villain with cloning powers (DC Comics, Firestorm #3).
Created complex machinery from raw materials using transmutation (DC Comics, Firestorm #8).

name: Captain Atom
specialAbility: Quantum field manipulation — absorbs and projects unlimited nuclear energy; flight at near-light speed; matter manipulation; effectively immortal.
weaknesses: Extended power use risks quantum leaps through time; his power can cause collateral devastation; psychologically unstable.
description: Nathaniel Adam — a soldier who became a living nuclear reactor. Captain Atom has the power to destroy a continent. He'd rather save one.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Captain Atom's immense power makes him both a savior and a potential threat.
notableFeats: Absorbed a nuclear explosion without harm (DC Comics, Captain Atom #1).
Manipulated matter on a molecular level to create weapons (DC Comics, Captain Atom #5).
Flew at near-light speed to intercept a missile (DC Comics, Captain Atom #3).
Survived a quantum leap through time and returned (DC Comics, Captain Atom #10).

name: Power Girl
specialAbility: Kryptonian power set without the weaknesses tied to Earth's yellow sun history; solar energy absorption; heat vision; arctic breath; flight.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to raw, unprocessed quarantine ore; magic affects her; occasionally underestimated.
description: Kara Zor-L from Earth-2 — Power Girl doesn't apologize for being one of the strongest people on the planet. She owns it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Power Girl's confidence and strength make her a formidable force in any battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Superman in a sparring match (DC Comics, Power Girl #7).
Lifted an entire cruise ship out of the ocean (DC Comics, Power Girl #3).
Destroyed a meteor threatening Earth with heat vision (DC Comics, Power Girl #5).
Survived a direct hit from a nuclear explosion (DC Comics, Power Girl #10).

name: Supergirl
specialAbility: Full Kryptonian power set under yellow sun; sometimes argued to be more powerful than Superman; deep connection to Krypton's legacy.
weaknesses: Kryptonite; red sun radiation; magic; younger and less experienced than Superman.
description: Kara Zor-El — she remembers Krypton. She carries that loss into every battle, fighting for a planet she chose just as fiercely as one she was born on.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Supergirl's determination and Kryptonian heritage make her a powerful protector of Earth.
notableFeats: Defeated Wonder Woman in a sparring match (DC Comics, Supergirl #12).
Stopped a runaway train with her bare hands (DC Comics, Supergirl #3).
Destroyed a rogue satellite threatening Earth (DC Comics, Supergirl #5).
Survived a battle against Doomsday (DC Comics, Supergirl #15).

name: Steel
specialAbility: Powered steel armor with incredible strength; massive kinetic hammer; one of the world's premier engineers; inspired by Superman.
weaknesses: Technology-dependent; armor can be damaged; physically normal without the suit.
description: John Henry Irons — a weapons engineer who built a Superman suit from scratch to honor a hero's memory. Steel is what happens when a man refuses to give up.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Steel's ingenuity and determination make him a valuable ally in any battle.
notableFeats: Defeated Metallo in a one-on-one battle (DC Comics, Steel #5).
Lifted a collapsing bridge to save civilians (DC Comics, Steel #3).
Designed and built his own advanced armor (DC Comics, Steel #1).
Held his own against Superman in a sparring match (DC Comics, Steel #7).
specialRules: Engineering skills allow for improvised weaponry

name: Lobo
specialAbility: Unkillable — regenerates from a single drop of blood; superhuman strength rivaling Superman; master bounty hunter and biker across the galaxy.
weaknesses: Can't break an oath he's sworn; tends to be distracted by fighting when he should be thinking; no army — just Lobo.
description: The Main Man. Lobo killed his entire species for a science fair project and got an A. He's been the universe's most feared bounty hunter ever since.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lobo's regeneration and durability make him nearly impossible to kill, but his recklessness can be exploited.
notableFeats: Destroyed his entire species for a science project (DC Comics).
Fought Superman to a standstill multiple times (DC Comics).
Survived being reduced to a single drop of blood and regenerated fully (DC Comics).
Captured countless intergalactic criminals as a bounty hunter (DC Comics).
v3Profile.profanityStyle: heavy — extremely crude intergalactic trash-talk, makes up profane slang

name: Constantine
specialAbility: Master occultist and con artist; commands demons through cunning rather than power; has outsmarted the Devil multiple times; chain smokes for luck.
weaknesses: Physically fragile; his plans always cost someone else dearly; has burned every bridge in the supernatural community at least once.
description: John Constantine — the world's greatest magical bastard. He can't throw a fireball, but he'll con the demon throwing one into aiming at itself.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Constantine's cunning and magical expertise make him a dangerous opponent, but his physical fragility is a major weakness.
notableFeats: Outsmarted the Devil multiple times (DC Comics).
Banished Nergal, a powerful demon, using trickery (DC Comics).
Survived Hell itself through sheer cunning (DC Comics).
Manipulated the Spectre into sparing him (DC Comics).

name: Swamp Thing
specialAbility: Avatar of the Green — controls all plant life on Earth; can rebuild his body from any organic matter; essentially immortal; planet-scale empathy.
weaknesses: Relies on plant matter to exist; fire destroys him temporarily; separated from the Green he is weakened.
description: Alec Holland — or what remains of him. Swamp Thing isn't a man who became a plant. He's a plant who thinks it was once a man.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Swamp Thing's connection to the Green makes him a formidable force, but his reliance on nature can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated the Parliament of Trees to become the ultimate Avatar of the Green (DC Comics).
Regenerated from complete destruction using plant matter (DC Comics).
Stopped global ecological disasters using his powers (DC Comics).
Fought and defeated Anton Arcane multiple times (DC Comics).

name: Blue Beetle
specialAbility: Scarab alien armor — flight, plasma cannons, creates any weapon construct, scans and adapts to any threat, symbiotic alien AI co-pilot.
weaknesses: Scarab can be hacked by Reach technology; new to heroics; scarab sometimes has its own agenda.
description: Jaime Reyes — a high school kid from El Paso who found an alien scarab and became a one-man army. The most powerful legacy hero DC has.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Blue Beetle's scarab armor makes him highly versatile, but his inexperience can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Reach agents using scarab's adaptive capabilities (DC Comics).
Held his own against Green Lantern in combat (DC Comics).
Saved his hometown from alien invasion (DC Comics).
Created complex weapon constructs mid-battle (DC Comics).

name: Solomon Grundy
specialAbility: Immortal zombie powerhouse — virtually unlimited strength and durability; resurrects with different power levels each time; immune to pain.
weaknesses: Very low intelligence; fire causes lasting damage; manipulable due to child-like mind.
description: Born on a Monday — Cyrus Gold died in Slaughter Swamp and rose as Solomon Grundy. Each resurrection brings a new monster to Gotham's streets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Solomon Grundy's immense strength and durability make him a formidable tank, but his low intelligence is a major liability.
notableFeats: Fought Superman and held his own (DC Comics).
Resurrected multiple times with varying power levels (DC Comics).
Destroyed Gotham City infrastructure during rampages (DC Comics).
Defeated Green Lantern in direct combat (DC Comics).

name: Killer Croc
specialAbility: Reptilian mutation — armored scales deflect bullets; superhumanly strong; can survive underwater indefinitely; apex predator instincts.
weaknesses: Low intelligence; mutation is progressing — he's slowly becoming more animal than man; exploitable through basic animal instincts.
description: Waylon Jones — a man condemned by a genetic condition that made the world treat him as a monster. Killer Croc became what Gotham made him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Often underestimated due to his animalistic nature, but his raw power makes him a dangerous foe.
notableFeats: Survived a direct explosion in Gotham sewers (Detective Comics #523).
Overpowered Batman in hand-to-hand combat multiple times.
Destroyed reinforced steel doors with raw strength.
Held his breath underwater for hours while evading capture.

name: Red Tornado
specialAbility: Android body generates tornado-force winds and vacuum vortices; flight; can create category 5 storms; cybernetic mind with supercomputer processing.
weaknesses: Android body can be damaged and hacked; wind powers can be redirected; psychological identity crisis between android and soul.
description: An android who contains the soul of an air elemental. Red Tornado fights to understand humanity while generating winds that level cities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His dual nature as an android and elemental makes him a unique combatant with both precision and raw power.
weaknesses: Power drain from prolonged storm generation
notableFeats: Generated winds strong enough to lift buildings (Justice League of America #192).
Defeated multiple Justice League members in combat using tornadoes.
Created a storm that spanned an entire city.
Survived direct attacks from Superman and Wonder Woman.

name: Killer Frost
specialAbility: Generates and projects extreme cold; can freeze targets solid instantly; absorbs heat energy to amplify her power; creates ice constructs.
weaknesses: Warmth-generating environments reduce her power; her need to absorb heat makes her dependent on targets; former villain instincts resurface.
description: Caitlin Snow — a scientist turned into a heat vampire who chose to be a hero anyway. Killer Frost fights her own nature every single day.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her cryokinetic abilities make her a versatile combatant, but her reliance on heat absorption limits her in certain environments.
notableFeats: Froze an entire lake solid in seconds (Justice League #12).
Defeated Firestorm in direct combat using heat absorption.
Created ice constructs strong enough to withstand Superman's punches.
Survived prolonged combat against the Suicide Squad.
specialRules: Can absorb heat to boost power

name: Black Lightning
specialAbility: Generates and controls electricity — lightning blasts, EMP fields, electromagnetic force fields; former teacher turned protector of Suicide Slum.
weaknesses: Rubber and insulated materials can block his electricity; power level fluctuates with emotional state.
description: Jefferson Pierce — Olympic athlete, high school teacher, and Freeland's protector. Black Lightning brought metahuman power to the streets that needed it most.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His ability to generate and control electricity makes him a versatile combatant, but his emotional state can affect his power output.
weaknesses: Limited to urban environments for power
notableFeats: Defeated Tobias Whale using electromagnetic force fields (Black Lightning #5).
Created an EMP that disabled an entire city's power grid.
Survived direct combat against Superman using lightning blasts.
Protected Freeland from a metahuman invasion using strategic lightning strikes.
specialRules: Can quickly recharge his abilities from nearby electrical sources

name: Metamorpho
specialAbility: Transforms his body into any element or compound on the periodic table — becomes gas, metal, acid, oxygen, or any combination at will.
weaknesses: Orb of Ra can affect him; his bizarre appearance means he can never return to a normal life; unstable when emotionally distressed.
description: Rex Mason — an adventurer who touched an ancient meteor and gained the power to become anything except himself. The Element Man.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His ability to transform into any element makes him highly versatile, but his emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Transformed into a gas to infiltrate a secure facility (The Brave and the Bold #57).
Survived a direct attack from Superman by turning into Kryptonite gas.
Created acid strong enough to dissolve reinforced steel.
Defeated multiple enemies by adapting his form to counter their attacks.
specialRules: Can adapt his form to counter attacks

name: Martian Manhunter's Nemesis (Despero)
specialAbility: Third eye telepathy overwhelming even the strongest minds; vast physical power surpassing Superman; telekinesis; telepathic destruction.
weaknesses: Arrogance — underestimates opponents; has been defeated through his own telepathic connection being turned against him.
description: Despero — conqueror of three galaxies and tyrant of Kalanor. When the Justice League needs their most powerful members, it's usually because of Despero.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Despero is one of the Justice League's most dangerous foes, often requiring their strongest members to defeat him.
notableFeats: Defeated Superman in direct combat (Justice League of America #133).
Conquered three galaxies single-handedly (Justice League of America #251).
Overpowered Martian Manhunter's telepathy (Justice League of America #38).
Destroyed entire fleets with telekinesis (Justice League of America #251).
Resisted the combined efforts of the Justice League (Justice League of America #38).
specialRules: Can lift and throw immense objects

name: Moana
specialAbility: Chosen by the ocean itself; master navigator and sailor; heart of Te Fiti grants reality-restoring power at the finale.
weaknesses: No supernatural combat ability; relies on courage and wits over brute force.
description: Daughter of the chief, chosen by the ocean. Moana crossed the open sea alone to restore the heart of the world — and succeeded.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Moana's strength lies in her courage, determination, and connection to the ocean.
notableFeats: Restored the heart of Te Fiti, saving the world (Moana, 2016).
Navigated across the open ocean using ancient techniques (Moana, 2016).
Convinced Maui to join her quest despite his reluctance (Moana, 2016).
Defeated Te Kā through courage and cleverness (Moana, 2016).
specialRules: Heart of Te Fiti amplifies abilities

name: Aladdin
specialAbility: Extraordinary improvisational cunning; three wishes from the Genie (historically); expert thief, acrobat, and street fighter.
weaknesses: No inherent superpowers; relies on resourcefulness; insecurity leads him to lie when honesty would serve better.
description: The diamond in the rough. Aladdin survived the streets of Agrabah on cleverness alone, then used a genie's power with his heart, not his ego.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Aladdin's resourcefulness and cleverness make him a formidable opponent despite his lack of raw power.
notableFeats: Outsmarted Jafar multiple times (Aladdin, 1992).
Survived the Cave of Wonders using agility and wit (Aladdin, 1992).
Defeated Jafar's schemes with cleverness (Aladdin, 1992).
Used Genie wishes to save Agrabah (Aladdin, 1992).

name: Jafar
specialAbility: Sorcerer Supreme of Agrabah — hypnosis staff, shape-shifting into a giant cobra; as a genie: nearly omnipotent cosmic power.
weaknesses: His boundless ambition is exploitable — tricked into wishing to be a genie, which imprisoned him in a lamp.
description: The most cunning and power-hungry sorcerer in Arabia. Jafar's brilliance is exceeded only by his ego — which is also his fatal flaw.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jafar's cunning and magical prowess make him a dangerous adversary, but his ego often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Hypnotized the Sultan to gain control of Agrabah (Aladdin, 1992).
Transformed into a giant cobra to battle Aladdin (Aladdin, 1992).
Achieved near-omnipotence as a genie (Aladdin, 1992).
Manipulated events to gain the lamp (Aladdin, 1992).

name: Ursula
specialAbility: Dark sea magic — steals voices, transforms bodies, commands kraken-like power; grows to enormous size using King Triton's trident.
weaknesses: Overconfidence at the moment of victory; can't resist monologuing; her power ultimately depends on contracts.
description: The sea witch of the deep. Ursula deals in dreams — takes everything you value, gives you exactly what you asked for, and calls it a fair trade.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ursula's cunning and magical abilities make her a formidable foe, especially in aquatic environments.
notableFeats: Stole Ariel's voice and transformed her into a human (The Little Mermaid, 1989).
Grew to enormous size using King Triton's trident (The Little Mermaid, 1989).
Commanded sea creatures to do her bidding (The Little Mermaid, 1989).
Manipulated Ariel into signing a contract that nearly doomed her (The Little Mermaid, 1989).

name: Gaston
specialAbility: Peak human specimen — no one fights like Gaston, no one's quite as big; expert hunter, wrestler, and bare-handed brawler.
weaknesses: Catastrophically overconfident; zero emotional intelligence; cannot conceive of failure.
description: No one hits like Gaston, nobody's built like Gaston. The definitive peak human predator — massive, brutal, and dangerously skilled at hunting.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gaston thrives in physical confrontations but falters against cunning or supernatural foes.
notableFeats: Lifted a full-grown deer over his head (Disney's Beauty and the Beast).
Defeated multiple opponents in a tavern brawl single-handedly.
Climbed the Beast's castle despite adverse conditions.

name: Scar
specialAbility: Mastermind schemer — orchestrated regicide without touching a weapon; commands hyena armies; vicious lion combat when cornered.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on manipulation over direct power; collapses without his hyena army; his treachery ultimately betrays him.
description: The pride lands' most dangerous mind in a lion's body. Scar didn't claw his way to the throne — he talked, manipulated, and waited.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Scar excels in psychological warfare but struggles in direct physical combat.
notableFeats: Successfully manipulated Mufasa's death (The Lion King).
Took control of the pride lands through fear and deception.
Held his own against Simba in a final confrontation.

name: Stitch
specialAbility: Alien experiment #626 — can lift 3000x his weight, is bulletproof, can see in darkness, is virtually indestructible, and is a genius.
weaknesses: Drawn to ohana — his adopted family is his weakness; his violent programming fights his heart constantly.
description: Experiment 626 — designed to be an unstoppable force of destruction. Then he met a little girl named Lilo and chose to be something more.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Stitch balances raw power with emotional vulnerability, making him unpredictable in combat.
notableFeats: Lifted a massive vehicle with ease (Lilo & Stitch).
Survived a high-speed crash without injury.
Outsmarted Gantu multiple times despite overwhelming odds.

name: Genie
specialAbility: Near-omnipotent reality manipulation — can grant any wish, transform matter and energy freely; imprisoned only by his lamp's master.
weaknesses: Cannot grant wishes without being summoned; bound by three rules (no killing, no forcing love, no reviving the dead).
description: Phenomenal cosmic power — itty bitty living space. The Genie is arguably the most powerful being in the Disney universe, and he knows it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Genie is a cosmic powerhouse but limited by his master's commands.
notableFeats: Transformed Aladdin into a prince (Aladdin).
Defeated Jafar's schemes using wit and cosmic power.
Created entire landscapes and armies with a single wish.

name: Chernabog
specialAbility: Demon lord of Bald Mountain — summons the dead, commands hellfire, transforms souls, grows to mountain scale at night.
weaknesses: Power weakens at dawn; retreats from holy light and church bells; only active at night.
description: The demon on Bald Mountain. Disney's darkest creation — a colossal night-god who summons the damned for a single glorious midnight revel.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Chernabog is a nightmarish force of destruction but vulnerable to light-based attacks.
notableFeats: Summoned an army of the dead (Fantasia).
Controlled hellfire to destroy landscapes.
Terrified entire villages with his presence alone.

name: The Beast
specialAbility: Enchanted prince in monstrous form — superhuman strength, enormous fangs and claws; can withstand arctic cold and devastating injury.
weaknesses: His temper destroys what he loves; the curse's time limit is his existential pressure; love is his only salvation.
description: A prince cursed into a monster who had to learn to love before he could become human again. The Beast is exactly as dangerous as his rage.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Beast's strength and durability are amplified by his emotional state, making him unpredictable in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated a pack of wolves single-handedly (Disney's Beauty and the Beast).
Survived a fall from a castle tower.
Demonstrated immense strength by breaking through heavy doors.

name: Wreck-It Ralph
specialAbility: Wrecks anything — his fists can demolish steel, concrete, and entire buildings; programmed for destruction with invulnerable hands.
weaknesses: Slow and lumbering; predictable destructive pattern; enormous heart means he can be emotionally manipulated.
description: The bad guy of Fix-It Felix Jr. — in the game and sometimes in life. Ralph has the strongest fists in the arcade and the biggest heart in any game.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ralph's strength is unmatched in the arcade, but his emotional vulnerability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire building with his fists (Wreck-It Ralph).
Survived falling into Diet Cola Mountain.
Lifted and threw massive debris during combat.

name: Syndrome
specialAbility: Zero-Point Energy gauntlet immobilizes anything; Omnidroid series robots; zero suit flight; reverse-engineered superhero technology.
weaknesses: His cape — literally. Overconfident; obsessed with recognition; physically unremarkable without his tech.
description: If everyone is super, no one will be. Syndrome was the world's most dangerous fanboy, who built weapons out of bitterness and called it a plan.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Syndrome's intellect and gadgets make him a formidable foe despite his lack of physical prowess.
notableFeats: Immobilized Mr. Incredible using Zero-Point Energy (The Incredibles).
Created the Omnidroid series capable of defeating superheroes.
Achieved flight using his zero suit.

name: Mr. Incredible
specialAbility: Superhuman strength and durability — lifts freight trains, stops 200 mph locomotives; nearly invulnerable to physical damage.
weaknesses: Pride and nostalgia blind him; weakest against mental manipulation; wants to work alone.
description: Bob Parr — the greatest superhero of his generation, forced into suburban mediocrity. When the call comes again, Mr. Incredible answers it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mr. Incredible's raw strength makes him a force to be reckoned with, but his pride can be exploited.
notableFeats: Stopped a speeding train with his bare hands (The Incredibles).
Lifted a massive robot during combat.
Survived explosions and heavy impacts.

name: Buzz Lightyear
specialAbility: Space Ranger combat training; laser wrist weapon; wing-assisted gliding; unshakeable tactical discipline and leadership under pressure.
weaknesses: Operates on regulations; can be deactivated by a child; in early form believed he was a real Space Ranger.
description: To infinity and beyond. Buzz Lightyear is the definitive heroic archetype — disciplined, brave, loyal, and always the one who actually has a plan.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Buzz's tactical acumen and gadgets make him a versatile combatant, but his rigidity can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Zurg in combat (Toy Story 2).
Led a successful rescue mission for Woody.
Demonstrated exceptional agility and precision in combat.

name: Dr. Facilier
specialAbility: Shadow magic — reads tarot, commands shadow demons, transforms targets via voodoo; backed by his Friends on the Other Side.
weaknesses: His power is borrowed — the Friends will collect if he fails; physically fragile; his shadow can be stolen.
description: The Shadow Man. Dr. Facilier offers everyone exactly what they want, ensures they can never pay for it, and profits from the difference.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dr. Facilier's power is entirely dependent on his connection to the Friends on the Other Side.
notableFeats: Summoned shadow demons to overpower Prince Naveen (The Princess and the Frog).
Transformed Lawrence into Prince Naveen using voodoo magic.
Manipulated multiple characters into deals that benefited him.

name: Raya
specialAbility: Master sword fighter trained since childhood; Kumandra's last guardian; wields the Dragon Gem that defeated the Druun.
weaknesses: Deep distrust from betrayal makes her slow to accept allies; fighting alone when teamwork is needed.
description: The last guardian of Kumandra. Raya trained her whole life for a war that destroyed her world, then had to learn that trust was the only real weapon.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Raya's journey is defined by her struggle to balance independence with the need for trust.
notableFeats: Defeated Namaari in single combat multiple times (Raya and the Last Dragon).
Successfully united the fractured lands of Kumandra.
