weaknesses: Blood rituals require an opponent to be hit three times — it can be disrupted; his entire dynasty is built on a deity whose existence is disputed.
description: Lord of Blood, Consort to the Formless Mother. Mohg built a dynasty in the depths of the earth using a demigod's stolen grace and a god of blood nobody else believed in. He did it anyway. With enough ritual, faith is real.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mohg's blood magic is both his greatest strength and his Achilles' heel.
weaknesses: Rituals take time to set up
notableFeats: Created a blood dynasty underground (Elden Ring lore).
Performed the Nihil ritual to devastating effect.
Communed with the Formless Mother for enhanced power.
Defeated numerous Tarnished warriors in combat.
specialRules: Blood rituals weaken enemies over time
Nihil explosions deal massive AoE damage

name: Elden Beast
specialAbility: Cosmological attacks — golden rings that track through teleportation; Elden Stars meteor barrage; Elden Ring blade that spans entire arenas; embodiment of the Greater Will itself.
weaknesses: Relies on maintaining distance; the Elden Ring can be destroyed by a Tarnished who has been hollowed enough; its vessel (Radagon) is a separate point of vulnerability.
description: The final form of the Greater Will's instrument. Not a creature — a concept made manifest. The Elden Beast exists beyond time and space as we understand it, yet a mortal Tarnished walked through its attacks and broke the Golden Order.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Elden Beast is the ultimate representation of the Greater Will's power.
notableFeats: Manifested as the embodiment of the Greater Will (Elden Ring lore).
Defeated countless Tarnished warriors in its role as a final boss.
Created golden rings that track through teleportation.
Unleashed Elden Stars meteor barrages to devastating effect.
specialRules: Attacks can track targets through teleportation
Cosmic nature makes it hard to counter
Embodiment of the Greater Will grants divine authority

name: Godfrey First Elden Lord
specialAbility: Axe of Godrick — destroys the ground itself; stomps that create earthquakes; Serosh — the Great Lion he killed and merged with, unleashing pure bloodlust; Horah Loux Earthshaker throws and throws and throws.
weaknesses: Banished from the Lands Between — fought his entire second life without a Grace; deliberately restrains himself until the opponent demonstrates worth.
description: The First Elden Lord. Marika stripped him of his Grace and exiled him so he would grow harder through adversity. He did. He wandered the world as Horah Loux, a warrior with nothing left but the fight. That was enough.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Godfrey's exile forged him into a relentless warrior, embodying raw physical power.
notableFeats: Merged with Serosh, the Great Lion, to enhance his combat abilities (Elden Ring lore).
Defeated countless warriors during his exile.
Created earthquakes with his stomps to disrupt opponents.
Fought as Horah Loux, a warrior stripped of Grace.
specialRules: Restrains power until opponent proves worthy

name: Stormfront
specialAbility: Lightning projection — kills with bioelectricity; supersonic flight; extreme durability; propaganda and mass psychological manipulation; survived severe injury and continued fighting.
weaknesses: Fire is particularly effective; sustained burns overwhelm her regeneration; ideological rigidity makes her predictable in political scenarios.
description: The first supe created by Compound V — born in Nazi Germany and used ever since. Stormfront's real weapon is not lightning. It's a century of psychological warfare and mass manipulation. The lightning just closes the argument.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Stormfront's ideological rigidity makes her predictable in certain scenarios.
notableFeats: Survived severe injuries and continued fighting (The Boys TV series).
Manipulated public opinion through propaganda.
Defeated numerous opponents using lightning projection.
Displayed supersonic flight capabilities.
specialRules: Regeneration allows survival of severe injuries
Psychological manipulation enhances control over groups

name: Gilgamesh
specialAbility: Two-thirds divine — superhuman strength and endurance beyond mortal limits; wielded weapons forged by the gods; friendship with Enkidu amplified both beyond individual limits; near-immortal body.
weaknesses: Pride prevented him from accepting mortality until the death of Enkidu; grief destabilized his judgment; mortal one-third creates genuine vulnerability.
description: King of Uruk. The original hero. Gilgamesh was so powerful the gods created Enkidu specifically to humble him. They became best friends instead. He sought immortality after losing Enkidu. He didn't find it. He found the truth.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gilgamesh's divine lineage and friendship with Enkidu make him a formidable force, but his mortal vulnerabilities keep him grounded.
notableFeats: Defeated Humbaba, the guardian of the Cedar Forest (Epic of Gilgamesh).
Survived the Bull of Heaven sent by Ishtar (Epic of Gilgamesh).
Sought the secret of immortality from Utnapishtim (Epic of Gilgamesh).
Built the walls of Uruk, a feat of engineering and strength (Epic of Gilgamesh).

name: Beowulf
specialAbility: Thirty men's grip strength — tore Grendel's arm from its socket bare-handed; dived into a lake and fought for hours without air; defeated three monsters in succession across decades; armor-breaking physical strikes.
weaknesses: Aging — his final battle came at 70 years old; dragon venom is his only canonical weakness; pride demanded he fight alone.
description: The mightiest warrior of the Geats. He tore a monster's arm off with his bare hands because he thought it would be fair. He slew Grendel, Grendel's mother, and a dragon. He is the template for every hero who came after.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beowulf's strength and courage define him, but his pride and aging body ultimately lead to his downfall.
notableFeats: Defeated Grendel bare-handed by tearing off his arm (Beowulf).
Killed Grendel's mother in her underwater lair (Beowulf).
Fought and killed a dragon at the cost of his own life (Beowulf).
Ruled as a wise and powerful king for decades (Beowulf).

name: Odysseus
specialAbility: Greatest strategic mind of the ancient world — conceived the Trojan Horse; divine favor from Athena; master archer (strung a bow no other man could); survived encounters with Cyclops, Sirens, Scylla, and Circe through cunning alone.
weaknesses: Physically below demigod peers; Poseidon's decade-long divine vendetta; hubris caused him to reveal his name to the Cyclops.
description: The man of twists and turns. Odysseus won the Trojan War with a wooden horse and won his way home with nothing but his mind. He outsmarted gods, monsters, and an island of suitors. He is not the strongest warrior. He is the last one standing.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Odysseus relies on his intellect and cunning to overcome challenges that would crush physically stronger opponents.
notableFeats: Conceived the Trojan Horse strategy (The Iliad).
Outsmarted Polyphemus the Cyclops (The Odyssey).
Survived encounters with Sirens, Scylla, and Circe (The Odyssey).
Defeated the suitors upon his return to Ithaca (The Odyssey).

name: Cuchulainn
specialAbility: Warp Spasm — a berserker transformation that distorts his body into a terrifying killing machine; Gáe Bulg — a barbed spear thrown with the foot that enters the body and shreds organs; divine parentage from Lugh.
weaknesses: Warp Spasm is indiscriminate — he cannot distinguish friend from foe; bound by geasa (magical prohibitions) that enemies exploit; the spasm burns his body from within.
description: The Hound of Ulster. Ireland's greatest hero held an army at a ford for months, single-handed. His battle spasm twisted his body inside out and made him unrecognizable. He fought armies. He killed his own son by accident. He was seventeen.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cuchulainn's Warp Spasm makes him a terrifying force, but his lack of control and geasa create exploitable weaknesses.
weaknesses: Loss of control during Warp Spasm
notableFeats: Held off an army single-handedly at the ford (Táin Bó Cúailnge).
Killed his own son in combat unknowingly (Irish Mythology).
Defeated numerous warriors in Warp Spasm form (Irish Mythology).
Used Gáe Bulg to kill his greatest enemies (Irish Mythology).
specialRules: Berserker transformation enhances strength and ferocity
Gáe Bulg inflicts severe internal damage

name: Bruce Lee
specialAbility: Jeet Kune Do founder — intercepting fist philosophy adapts to eliminate any opponent's style; one-inch punch (750 lbs of force from 1 inch); two-finger push-ups; philosophy as combat strategy.
weaknesses: No superhuman attributes — human physical limits apply; 135 lbs — overpowered by sheer strength disparities; cerebral edema susceptibility.
description: The Father of Mixed Martial Arts, before the term existed. Bruce Lee's philosophy was simple: use what works, discard what doesn't. He trained to be faster than thought. His speed was measured and couldn't be accurately clocked. He still wasn't superhuman. He was just closer than anyone else.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bruce Lee's mastery of martial arts and philosophy makes him a near-perfect human combatant, but he remains bound by human limitations.
notableFeats: Created Jeet Kune Do, a revolutionary martial arts philosophy (Bruce Lee Biography).
Performed the one-inch punch with 750 lbs of force (Bruce Lee Demonstrations).
Executed two-finger push-ups, showcasing extreme physical control (Bruce Lee Training).
Defeated multiple opponents in sparring matches with superior speed and technique (Bruce Lee Films).

name: Muhammad Ali
specialAbility: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee — footwork that made punches miss by inches; will-in-chin that absorbed Joe Frazier and George Foreman's hardest shots; psychological warfare before, during, and after a fight.
weaknesses: No power against superhuman strength; Parkinson's complications later in career; later fights took irreversible toll.
description: The Greatest. Muhammad Ali didn't just win fights — he told you he would win, explained how, then did it. He outpointed, outlasted, and outmaneuvered the hardest punchers in history.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ali's psychological warfare and endurance made him a legend in boxing history.
notableFeats: Defeated George Foreman in the Rumble in the Jungle (1974).
Outlasted Joe Frazier in the Thrilla in Manila (1975).
Won Olympic gold medal in 1960.
Regained heavyweight title three times.

name: Mike Tyson
specialAbility: Peak knockout power — devastating body shots and uppercuts delivered at speeds that bypassed defense; Peek-a-boo style slipping under shots and countering; psychological intimidation before the first bell.
weaknesses: Stamina limitations in later rounds exposed by Buster Douglas; psychological fragility under unexpected adversity; no answer for sustained lateral movement.
description: The Baddest Man on the Planet. At 20 years old, Mike Tyson was the most terrifying athlete on Earth. He didn't just knock opponents out — he made them reconsider their career path before the first punch landed.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Tyson's raw power and aggression made him a force of nature in the ring.
notableFeats: Youngest heavyweight champion in history at age 20.
Unified WBC, WBA, and IBF titles.
Knocked out Trevor Berbick in two rounds to win the title.
Defeated Michael Spinks in 91 seconds.

name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
specialAbility: All Killing Ash Bones — disintegrates targets on contact; dimension-shifting; Infinite Tsukuyomi genjutsu over the entire planet; chakra absorption; flight; Byakugan and Rinne-Sharingan.
weaknesses: Requires her sons Hagoromo and Hamura combining power to seal her; limited experience in actual combat compared to her sons; over-reliance on dimensional manipulation.
description: The Rabbit Goddess. The original source of all chakra on Earth. Kaguya consumed the fruit of the God Tree, becoming the first wielder of chakra and the progenitor of all shinobi.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kaguya's overwhelming power requires teamwork and sealing techniques to counter.
notableFeats: Cast Infinite Tsukuyomi over the entire planet.
Fought Naruto and Sasuke simultaneously.
Created dimensions with unique physics.
Absorbed chakra from the God Tree.

name: Hashirama Senju
specialAbility: Wood Release — creates entire forests from nothing; Sage Mode amplifying all statistics; Thousand-Armed Kannon wooden Buddha statue; only person who could suppress the Nine-Tails with Wood Release alone.
weaknesses: Overly trusting and merciful — has spared enemies who later betrayed him; Sage Mode requires time to gather natural energy; emotional investment in rivals creates blind spots.
description: The God of Shinobi. Founder of the Hidden Leaf and the only man Madara Uchiha ever considered an equal. Hashirama's Wood Release is considered the most powerful kekkei genkai in history.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hashirama's power and leadership shaped the shinobi world.
notableFeats: Defeated Madara Uchiha multiple times.
Created the Hidden Leaf Village.
Suppressed the Nine-Tails with Wood Release.
Mastered Sage Mode.

name: Hagoromo Otsutsuki
specialAbility: Creation of All Things — manifests matter and living beings from nothing; Rinne-Sharingan; Infinite Tsukuyomi; Six Paths chakra distribution; sealed his own mother using his brother's eyes as the seal itself.
weaknesses: Bound by karmic cycles — his actions set in motion events he could not fully control; relies on successors rather than direct action in modern era; aged and diminished compared to prime.
description: The Sage of Six Paths. Son of Kaguya, father of chakra culture, and the man who sealed the God Tree. Everything the shinobi world is — every jutsu, every bloodline, every ideology — flows from Hagoromo Otsutsuki.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hagoromo's wisdom and power shaped the shinobi world's foundation.
notableFeats: Sealed Kaguya Otsutsuki with his brother.
Distributed chakra to humanity.
Created the Moon using the Ten-Tails.
Mastered the Rinne-Sharingan.

name: Isshiki Otsutsuki
specialAbility: Sukunahikona — shrinks himself or any object instantaneously and removes it from spacetime; Daikokuten — stores shrunken objects in a separate dimension for instant deployment; cannot be sensed while shrinking.
weaknesses: Parasitic existence in human hosts depletes his lifespan rapidly; his full plan requires a ten-tails and a massive chakra vessel — logistical dependency; Karma seal can be used to resurrect him, but also destroyed.
description: An Otsutsuki who was betrayed, stabbed, and left for dead — then spent 1,000 years slowly cultivating revenge from inside a human body. Isshiki came to Earth for a harvest. Everything else is collateral.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Isshiki's mastery of shrinking and dimensional manipulation makes him nearly impossible to counter without specialized abilities.
notableFeats: Defeated Naruto and Sasuke simultaneously (Boruto manga, Chapter 51).
Shrank and stored massive objects instantaneously (Boruto manga, Chapter 50).
Overpowered Jigen's body despite its limitations (Boruto manga, Chapter 47).
Manipulated Kawaki's Karma seal for his resurrection plan (Boruto manga, Chapter 55).

name: Obito Uchiha
specialAbility: Kamui — phasing ability that makes him intangible and allows teleportation; Ten-Tails Jinchuriki form; Sharingan and Rinnegan; Infinite Tsukuyomi orchestration; manipulated global geopolitics for 15 years.
weaknesses: The same eye that is intangible is vulnerable to a synchronized Kamui from Kakashi; emotional conflict over Rin's death destabilizes his resolve; Ten-Tails form burns through his body.
description: Tobi. Madara's plan. A boy who watched the person he loved die and decided the real world was not worth saving. He orchestrated a world war. When he finally changed his mind, he used what was left of himself to hold back the God Tree.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Obito's Kamui ability makes him nearly untouchable, but his emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Orchestrated the Fourth Great Ninja War (Naruto manga, Chapters 467–469).
Activated the Infinite Tsukuyomi (Naruto manga, Chapter 678).
Defeated multiple Kage-level opponents simultaneously (Naruto manga, Chapter 609).
Held back the God Tree with his remaining chakra (Naruto manga, Chapter 690).

name: Killer Bee
specialAbility: Eight-Tails Jinchuriki — full Gyuki transformation; ink attacks; Tailed Beast Bomb; seven-sword fighting style (holds blades with every limb including neck); rapping in the middle of combat.
weaknesses: Overconfidence in his rap abilities as combat communication; limited tactical flexibility beyond overwhelming power; Gyuki can be extracted if the seal is broken.
description: Killer Bee. The strongest Jinchuriki in history because he actually befriended his tailed beast instead of suppressing it. He fights with eight swords and raps his battle strategy out loud. He has never once been embarrassed about this.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Killer Bee's bond with Gyuki gives him unparalleled control over his tailed beast powers.
notableFeats: Defeated Sasuke and his team single-handedly (Naruto manga, Chapter 412).
Mastered full Gyuki transformation (Naruto manga, Chapter 467).
Held his own against Taka and the Raikage simultaneously (Naruto manga, Chapter 414).
Survived extraction of Gyuki and continued fighting (Naruto manga, Chapter 573).

name: Izuku Midoriya
specialAbility: One For All at 100% — full power of eight previous users amplified; Blackwhip, Fa Jin, Float, Danger Sense, Smokescreen, and Tracer from predecessor quirks; Full Cowling hyperactivation.
weaknesses: Overusing 100% risks destroying his own body permanently; emotional decision-making over tactical — will sacrifice himself to save enemies; Danger Sense does not work against mindless attacks.
description: Deku. Born quirkless, gifted the greatest power in history, and almost destroyed both in the process. Midoriya's real weapon is the fact that he never stopped analyzing, never stopped caring, and never gave up on anyone — including his worst enemy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Midoriya's ability to adapt and synergize quirks makes him a versatile powerhouse.
notableFeats: Defeated Overhaul using 100% One For All (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 136).
Mastered multiple quirks simultaneously (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 285).
Held his own against Class 1-A while injured (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 320).
Saved civilians while fighting Shigaraki at full power (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 286).

name: Dabi
specialAbility: Blueflame — cremation at 2000°C, surpassing his father Endeavor's Hellflame; sustained full-body immolation; fire intense enough to vaporize opponents before they react; psychological warfare through identity reveals.
weaknesses: His own DNA is incompatible with his quirk — his body is burning from the inside; prolonged use accelerates self-incineration; fighting is slowly killing him and he knows it.
description: Toya Todoroki. The son Endeavor broke and then forgot about. Dabi doesn't fight to win — he fights to burn everything his father built. His flames are hotter than the No.1 hero's. His motivation is hotter than that.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dabi's flames are unmatched in intensity, but his body is his greatest limitation.
notableFeats: Incinerated an entire city block during his reveal (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 290).
Overpowered multiple heroes simultaneously (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 293).
Survived prolonged self-immolation despite his body's incompatibility (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 294).
Psychologically destabilized Endeavor with his identity reveal (My Hero Academia manga, Chapter 290).

name: Father
specialAbility: Absorbed God — contains all five Philosopher's Stones and God itself; negates alchemy across an entire country; creates nuclear blasts; perfect immortal body; embodiment of all seven deadly sins.
weaknesses: God is too vast for any container — absorbing divinity is inherently unstable; Truth extracted his gate for attempting to become God; can be overwhelmed when his container is broken.
description: The Dwarf in the Flask. He came from a flask, became a homunculus, learned alchemy, created an entire civilization as a sacrifice, and absorbed God. Then a pair of teenagers figured out the one thing a being of infinite knowledge could not anticipate: sacrifice.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Father's power is immense but inherently unstable due to his attempt to contain divinity.
notableFeats: Absorbed God and negated alchemy across Amestris (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 60).
Created nuclear-level explosions with Philosopher's Stones (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 61).
Survived multiple attacks from alchemists and Homunculi simultaneously (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 62).
Was defeated by Truth after attempting to surpass divine limits (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 64).

name: Pride
specialAbility: Shadow manipulation — near-infinite tendrils of darkness that can slice through everything in his line of sight; ability to absorb and copy Alchemists' knowledge; requires only a single small core body.
weaknesses: Requires shadows to exist — total darkness or total light negates his power; the child body is fragile once shadows are removed; his true face reveals all the humans he has devoured.
description: Selim Bradley. The first Homunculus, disguised as a child, living as the Fuhrer's adopted son. Pride considers himself the most powerful of Father's creations and is correct about most of it. He underestimated humanity's capacity for sacrifice.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pride's shadow manipulation makes him a formidable opponent, but his reliance on shadows is a critical weakness.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple alchemists simultaneously using shadow tendrils (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 53).
Absorbed Gluttony to enhance his own abilities (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 54).
Held off Edward Elric and allies in a prolonged battle (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 61).
Was defeated when his core body was exposed (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 62).

name: Roy Mustang
specialAbility: Flame Alchemy — controls oxygen density in the air with a snap of his fingers, igniting targets from the inside out; temperature control precise enough to boil blood; immolates without fire under wet conditions by drying the air.
weaknesses: Rain neutralizes alchemy by wetting his ignition gloves; blindness makes him dependent on a spotter; emotional attachment to subordinates clouds mission priority.
description: The Flame Alchemist. Mustang boils people alive from the inside without producing a single visible flame. He is the most efficient killer in the Amestris military. He's also using all of it to become Fuhrer and fix the country. One atrocity at a time.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mustang's flame alchemy is devastating but requires environmental conditions to be optimal.
notableFeats: Defeated Lust with precise flame attacks (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 19).
Held off Envy and multiple enemies simultaneously (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 54).
Boiled blood of enemies without visible flames (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 55).
Used flame alchemy to destroy massive enemy forces during the Promised Day (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 61).

name: Olivier Mira Armstrong
specialAbility: Peak human swordsmanship — blade forged from northern ore and Armstrong's family mastery; tactical command genius; survived Briggs Mountain conditions that kill most soldiers; cuts Homunculi apart without blinking.
weaknesses: Human physical limits — cannot engage supernatural threats indefinitely; no alchemy; political isolation within the military.
description: General Armstrong of Briggs. She commands the most brutal outpost in Amestris and personally fights anything that threatens it. She cut a Homunculus apart bare-handed and negotiated with a god the same afternoon. The North made her. Nothing else could.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Armstrong's leadership and combat prowess make her a formidable force despite her lack of supernatural abilities.
notableFeats: Defeated Sloth using sheer physical strength and tactical precision (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 60).
Survived extreme conditions in Briggs Mountain (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 37).
Negotiated with Father during the Promised Day (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 61).
Led Briggs forces to defend against overwhelming enemy attacks (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Episode 62).

name: Durin's Bane
specialAbility: Ancient Maia spirit in fire demon form — whip of flame and shadow; wings of darkness that span caverns; immune to mortal weapons; fell Gandalf the Grey with a single clash across an entire bridge.
weaknesses: Defeated by Gandalf the White across ten days of combat through the depths of Moria; physical form can be destroyed even if the spirit is ancient; cold water weakens fire form.
description: A servant of Morgoth since before the world was young. The Balrog drove the Dwarves from Moria and killed Gandalf on the Bridge of Khazad-dûm. They then fought for ten days through the earth, fire, water, and mountain peak. The Balrog lost. Eventually.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Durin's Bane is a devastating force of fire and shadow, but its weaknesses to light and water are exploitable.
notableFeats: Killed Gandalf the Grey during the battle on the Bridge of Khazad-dûm (The Fellowship of the Ring).
Fought Gandalf for ten days through Moria and the mountain peak (The Two Towers).
Drove the Dwarves from Moria and claimed it as its domain (The Silmarillion).
Survived millennia as a servant of Morgoth (The Silmarillion).

name: Khal Drogo
specialAbility: Undefeated Dothraki war-leader — commands 40,000 horse warriors and excels in close combat.
weaknesses: Hubris and refusal to treat wounds properly; lacks ranged combat capabilities.
description: The Great Khal. Drogo's undefeated record and ferocious combat style made him a legend among the Dothraki. His downfall came from pride and neglecting a minor wound that led to infection.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Drogo's strength lies in his unmatched combat skill and leadership, but his pride led to his downfall.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple challengers in single combat (Game of Thrones, Season 1).
Led 40,000 Dothraki warriors across Essos.
Survived a severe arakh wound during combat.

name: Tyrion Lannister
specialAbility: Political genius — excels in strategy, psychological manipulation, and survival through alliances.
weaknesses: Physically weak and underestimated; alcohol dependence and emotional blind spots.
description: The Imp. Tyrion Lannister's wit and intelligence made him one of the most influential figures in Westeros, despite his physical limitations. His ability to outthink opponents is unparalleled.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Tyrion's strength lies in his mind, making him a dangerous opponent in political and strategic arenas.
notableFeats: Orchestrated the defense of King's Landing during the Battle of Blackwater (Game of Thrones, Season 2).
Manipulated his way into positions of power under multiple regimes.
Survived multiple assassination attempts through wit and alliances.

name: Cersei Lannister
specialAbility: Master manipulator — excels in political strategy, wildfire deployment, and deception.
weaknesses: Overreliance on others to execute plans; pride and emotional vulnerability for her children.
description: The Queen. Cersei Lannister's cunning and ruthlessness allowed her to outmaneuver her enemies, but her pride and emotional attachments often led to her downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cersei's ability to manipulate and strategize makes her a formidable opponent in political arenas.
notableFeats: Destroyed the Great Sept of Baelor with wildfire (Game of Thrones, Season 6).
Outmaneuvered multiple political rivals to secure the throne.
Maintained control over King's Landing during turbulent times.

name: Jaime Lannister
specialAbility: Master swordsman — excels in one-handed combat and tactical battlefield command.
weaknesses: Lost dominant sword hand; emotional dependency on Cersei clouds judgment.
description: The Kingslayer. Jaime Lannister's unmatched swordsmanship and tactical acumen made him a legend, but his reputation for betrayal haunted him throughout his life.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jaime's skill and adaptability make him a dangerous opponent, even with his physical handicap.
notableFeats: Killed the Mad King to prevent mass destruction (Game of Thrones, Season 1).
Defeated multiple skilled opponents in single combat.
Adapted to fighting with one hand after losing his dominant hand.

name: Oberyn Martell
specialAbility: Master poisoner — uses Manticore venom and excels in speed-based spear combat.
weaknesses: Fragile durability; emotional need for revenge overrides tactical decisions.
description: The Red Viper. Oberyn Martell's speed and precision made him a deadly opponent, but his emotional need for revenge led to his downfall against the Mountain.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Oberyn's speed and poison make him a lethal combatant, but his emotional need for revenge led to his downfall.
notableFeats: Defeated Ser Gregor Clegane in single combat (Game of Thrones, Season 4).
Used Manticore venom to incapacitate opponents.
Outmaneuvered heavily armored foes with speed and precision.

name: Stannis Baratheon
specialAbility: Relentless duty — a tactical military commander who held Dragonstone against overwhelming odds.
weaknesses: Inflexibility — his rigid principles alienate allies and prevent political adaptability.
description: Stannis Baratheon, the One True King, was a brilliant military strategist whose stubbornness and inability to navigate politics led to his downfall. His relentless pursuit of justice and duty defined his character, but also isolated him from potential allies.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Stannis' rigid adherence to justice and duty made him a formidable commander but a poor politician.
notableFeats: Held Dragonstone against overwhelming odds.
Won key battles during Robert's Rebellion.
Led the siege of Storm's End and ensured survival through sheer persistence.
specialRules: Never backs down from a fight

name: Gellert Grindelwald
specialAbility: Elder Wand mastery — unparalleled magical dueling and large-scale spellcasting.
weaknesses: His ideology makes him predictable to those who understand his motives.
description: Gellert Grindelwald, the dark wizard who nearly reshaped the wizarding world, wielded the Elder Wand and commanded a global network of followers. Despite his power, his defeat by Dumbledore revealed the limits of his ideology-driven approach.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Grindelwald's defeat by Dumbledore marked the end of his dark reign but solidified his legacy as one of the most powerful wizards in history.
notableFeats: Defeated numerous Aurors in single combat.
Created a global network of dark wizard followers.
Held the Elder Wand for decades, mastering its power.

name: Vergil
specialAbility: Yamato — a blade capable of cutting through dimensions and separating man from devil.
weaknesses: Pride and refusal to retreat often lead to tactical disadvantages.
description: Vergil, the son of Sparda, embodies the pursuit of power at all costs. His mastery of Yamato and Devil Trigger transformation make him a formidable opponent, but his pride and suppression of his humanity often lead to his downfall.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vergil's obsession with power often blinds him to the value of his human side, which is both his weakness and his potential strength.
notableFeats: Split the Temen-ni-gru tower.
Defeated Arkham with precision strikes.
Fought Dante to a standstill multiple times.

name: Sekiro
specialAbility: Resurrection — dies and comes back mid-combat, combined with versatile Shinobi prosthetic tools.
weaknesses: Resurrection has limits and corrupts those around him with Dragonrot.
description: Sekiro, the One-Armed Wolf, is defined by his persistence and adaptability. His Shinobi prosthetic arm and resurrection ability make him a versatile and relentless fighter, but his mortality and inner conflict remain his greatest challenges.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sekiro's persistence and adaptability make him a formidable opponent despite his human limitations.
notableFeats: Defeated Genichiro multiple times.
Overcame the Divine Dragon.
Mastered Shinobi prosthetic tools for versatile combat.

name: Arthas Menethil
specialAbility: Frostmourne — a soul-consuming blade that grows stronger with each kill.
weaknesses: Frostmourne traps his soul, limiting his free will and requiring isolation to maintain power.
description: Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, commands the Scourge with Frostmourne, a blade that consumes souls. His descent into darkness was driven by grief and desperation, making him one of the most tragic and powerful figures in Azeroth.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Arthas' tragic fall from hero to villain is one of the most compelling stories in Warcraft lore.
notableFeats: Defeated Uther and claimed Frostmourne.
Commanded the Scourge to destroy Lordaeron.
Merged with Ner'zhul to become the Lich King.
specialRules: Can absorb souls to enhance power
Undead allies can resurrect fallen foes

name: Diablo
specialAbility: Projects primal fear that paralyzes opponents; lightning breath and fire nova; corruption of the Worldstone to affect all of Sanctuary.
weaknesses: Prime Evil form is unstable and burns through the host's body; repeatedly defeated by individual Nephalem heroes; Hell's political instability limits his full power.
description: The Lord of Terror, Diablo has been destroyed and resurrected countless times. He corrupted the Worldstone to spread chaos across Sanctuary, wielding fear as his ultimate weapon.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Diablo thrives on fear and chaos, making him a nightmare for unprepared opponents.
notableFeats: Corrupted the Worldstone (Diablo II: Lord of Destruction)
Defeated multiple Nephalem heroes (Diablo III)
Merged into the Prime Evil form (Diablo III: Reaper of Souls)

name: Asura
specialAbility: Mantra of Wrath — anger literally powers him; six-armed Asura form; Berserker Form that destroys his body but increases power infinitely.
weaknesses: Power is entirely emotion-driven — calm opponents can disorient his rage; self-destruction in Berserker Form; his love for his daughter creates a permanent tactical vulnerability.
description: The Demigod of Wrath, Asura's limitless anger fuels his godlike strength. He has defeated planet-sized deities and punched his way back from death, driven by his love for his daughter.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Asura's wrath makes him nearly unstoppable, but his emotional vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Deus, a god-like being (Asura's Wrath)
Destroyed a planet-sized deity (Asura's Wrath)
Survived being killed multiple times (Asura's Wrath)

name: A2
specialAbility: Self-destruct-level power via removing her limiter; dual-sword style more aggressive than 2B; hacks machine cores mid-combat.
weaknesses: Removing her limiter risks self-destruction; emotionally isolated — no support network; trauma from Yorha Unit betrayal creates trust issues in tactical alliances.
description: YoRHa No.2 Type A, A2 is a rogue android who fights with unmatched aggression. Her years of solo combat have honed her into a lethal weapon, but her emotional scars remain.

v3Profile.loreNotes: A2's aggressive combat style makes her a deadly opponent, but her emotional vulnerabilities can be exploited.
notableFeats: Survived years of solo combat against machines (NieR: Automata)
Defeated multiple high-level machine lifeforms (NieR: Automata)
Removed limiter for devastating attacks (NieR: Automata)

name: 9S
specialAbility: Scanner unit — hacks any machine or android in range, commandeering their actions mid-fight; information extraction from enemies.
weaknesses: Combat stats below Type B units; emotionally devastated after 2B's death — makes reckless decisions at the cost of effectiveness; hacking requires proximity.
description: 9S is a Scanner android who excels in intelligence and hacking. His grief over 2B's death drives him to reckless decisions, but his tactical genius remains unmatched.

v3Profile.loreNotes: 9S's hacking abilities make him a dangerous opponent, but his emotional instability can be exploited.
notableFeats: Hacked high-level machine lifeforms (NieR: Automata)
Extracted critical war information (NieR: Automata)
Supported 2B in multiple battles (NieR: Automata)

name: Yhwach
specialAbility: The Almighty — sees and rewrites all possible futures; absorbs souls across all of Soul Society; Auswählen steals Schrift powers from his own Quincy.
weaknesses: Relies on The Almighty — opponents who can sever the future or act outside causality can blind him temporarily; requires sleep cycles that create narrow vulnerability windows.
description: Yhwach, the Quincy King, wields The Almighty to rewrite reality itself. His foresight makes him nearly invincible, but his reliance on causality creates exploitable weaknesses.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yhwach's foresight makes him nearly unbeatable, but his arrogance and reliance on causality can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Yamamoto Genryusai (Bleach)
Absorbed the Soul King's power (Bleach)
Rewrote Ichigo's attacks mid-battle (Bleach)

name: Genryusai Yamamoto
specialAbility: Ryujin Jakka — the most powerful fire-type Zanpakuto in existence; Zanka no Tachi transforms his blade into black ash that incinerates everything; dead flame construct Bankai summons all of history's deceased; temperature reaches the sun's core.
weaknesses: Zanka no Tachi slowly incinerates the world around him — he cannot hold it indefinitely; his trust in Soul Society's laws created systematic blind spots; Yhwach defeated him with a fake.
description: Head Captain of the Gotei 13. Yamamoto has defended Soul Society for 2000 years with a sword hot enough to vaporize anything it touches. He was taken down once — through deception, not strength. His power level was never the question.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yamamoto's strength is unmatched in Soul Society, but his adherence to tradition has been exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated two Sternritter simultaneously (Bleach manga, Chapter 506).
Incinerated an entire battlefield with Ryujin Jakka (Bleach manga, Chapter 392).
Held off Yhwach's forces single-handedly for an extended period (Bleach manga, Chapter 505).
Destroyed Wonderweiss with a single strike (Bleach manga, Chapter 392).

name: Kisuke Urahara
specialAbility: Benihime Bankai — near-full-hollow transformation; Kakushitsuijaku tracking kidō; reverse engineering any technique after seeing it once; invented the Hogyoku and hid it inside Rukia's soul; set in motion every major event across the entire series.
weaknesses: Deliberately hides his capability — which means opponents never know his true power until too late; emotional investment in Ichigo and Yoruichi creates blind spots.
description: The most dangerous person in Bleach who never needs to fight. Urahara invented three separate world-changing items, exiled himself, opened a candy store, and orchestrated the defeat of Aizen and Yhwach from behind a fan and a bucket hat. He has already won when you meet him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Urahara's intelligence and preparation make him a threat far beyond his combat stats.
notableFeats: Invented the Hogyoku (Bleach manga, Chapter 423).
Defeated Aizen using a combination of kidō and strategy (Bleach manga, Chapter 421).
Created a portal to the Soul King Palace (Bleach manga, Chapter 611).
Reverse-engineered Yhwach's power to assist Ichigo (Bleach manga, Chapter 681).

name: Toshiro Hitsugaya
specialAbility: Daiguren Hyorinmaru — the most powerful ice-type Zanpakuto in Soul Society; creates ice dragon constructs; freezes enemies within crystal flowers; heavenly chains of ice restrict movement; flash-freezes the atmosphere within range.
weaknesses: Bankai's dragon form gradually melts in hot environments; ice attacks require atmospheric moisture; loses tactical creativity when emotionally provoked regarding Momo.
description: The child captain. Hitsugaya achieved his Bankai in record time and commands the most powerful ice-type sword in Soul Society. He is routinely underestimated for his age. This has never benefited any opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hitsugaya's ice-based abilities are devastating but require careful environmental management.
notableFeats: Flash-froze an entire battlefield (Bleach manga, Chapter 392).
Defeated Harribel using Daiguren Hyorinmaru (Bleach manga, Chapter 364).
Held off multiple Sternritter simultaneously (Bleach manga, Chapter 546).
Achieved Bankai at an unprecedented age (Bleach manga, Chapter 133).

name: Genghis Khan
specialAbility: Military genius — invented psychological warfare, feigned retreats, and scorched earth that broke every civilization it faced; unified Mongol tribes through charisma and terror; conquered more land than anyone in history on horseback.
weaknesses: Human body — mortal without supernatural protection; died of causes historians still debate; empire required his presence to hold together.
description: The Great Khan. Temujin started as a slave with nothing and built the largest contiguous land empire in human history. He didn't win through numbers — he won through psychology, logistics, and the willingness to do what his enemies refused to consider.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Genghis Khan's empire was built on fear, strategy, and adaptability.
notableFeats: Unified Mongol tribes under his rule (Historical records).
Conquered the largest contiguous empire in history (Historical records).
Defeated the Khwarezmian Empire through psychological warfare (Historical records).
Invented feigned retreat tactics (Historical records).

name: Alexander the Great
specialAbility: Military genius of the ancient world — never lost a battle in 15 years of constant warfare; Companion cavalry charge personally led from the front; psychological dominance through declared divine lineage; conquered from Greece to India.
weaknesses: Drank heavily in his later years; died at 32 of disputed causes; empire fractured immediately upon his death due to no succession plan.
description: The Undefeated. Alexander conquered the known world before he was 30, personally riding at the front of every cavalry charge. He slept with a copy of the Iliad under his pillow. He wept because there were no more worlds to conquer. Then he died before anyone could stop him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Alexander's leadership and strategy made him unstoppable in battle.
notableFeats: Conquered the Persian Empire (Historical records).
Defeated Darius III at the Battle of Gaugamela (Historical records).
Led the Companion Cavalry in every major battle (Historical records).
Established cities across his empire, including Alexandria (Historical records).

name: Julius Caesar
specialAbility: Tactical genius — Gallic Wars, civil war victories, and crossing the Rubicon; political manipulation that rewrote Roman governance; legendary dictation while doing something else simultaneously; wrote his own propaganda.
weaknesses: Trust in senators — famously failed to anticipate that 23 men with daggers would succeed where armies hadn't; epilepsy; ego occasionally overrode strategic caution.
description: Veni, vidi, vici. Caesar came, saw, and conquered Gaul, Egypt, and Rome's political system in the same lifetime. He crossed the Rubicon to start a civil war, won it, and was given a throne he tactically refused. The daggers he didn't see coming were the ones held by friends.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Caesar's unmatched political and military acumen reshaped Rome forever.
notableFeats: Conquered Gaul in the Gallic Wars (58–50 BCE).
Crossed the Rubicon in 49 BCE, initiating a civil war.
Defeated Pompey at the Battle of Pharsalus (48 BCE).
Reformed Roman governance as dictator perpetuo.
Expanded Rome's territory significantly during his campaigns.

name: Napoleon Bonaparte
specialAbility: Artillery doctrine revolution; corps system that allowed rapid independent maneuver; Maneuver on the central position (defeat armies in detail); psychological hold over his entire army through personal presence.
weaknesses: Russia; overextension; Britain's naval superiority he could never solve; hubris that came from never having truly failed until it mattered most.
description: Napoleon rose from Corsican artillery officer to Emperor of France and master of Europe. He rewrote military doctrine, civil law, and the borders of a continent. Then he invaded Russia. Everything after that was a different story.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Napoleon's military genius and ambition reshaped Europe, but his hubris led to his downfall.
notableFeats: Won the Battle of Austerlitz (1805), considered his greatest victory.
Implemented the Napoleonic Code, influencing legal systems worldwide.
Conquered much of Europe during the Napoleonic Wars.
Revolutionized military tactics with the corps system.
Survived exile and returned to power during the Hundred Days.

name: Miyamoto Musashi
specialAbility: Niten Ichi-ryu — two-sword style he invented; won 61 duels without a single loss; deliberately arrived late to unsettle opponents; fought with bokken (wooden swords) against opponents with steel and won.
weaknesses: Human physical limits; no supernatural ability; refused formal service which limited resources; later in life favored philosophy over fighting.
description: The Sword Saint. Miyamoto Musashi was undefeated in 61 duels from age 13 to his death. He arrived late to his most famous duel, let his opponent wait in the sun, then killed him in seconds. He wrote A Book of Five Rings in a cave after he stopped needing to fight.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Musashi's unmatched skill and psychological tactics made him a legend in martial arts history.
notableFeats: Defeated Sasaki Kojiro in a legendary duel on Ganryu Island.
Invented the Niten Ichi-ryu two-sword style.
Wrote 'A Book of Five Rings,' a martial arts and strategy classic.
Won 61 duels without a single loss.
Fought and won against armed opponents using wooden swords.

name: Sun Tzu
specialAbility: The Art of War — defined strategy for 2,500 years; turned a harem of concubines into a military unit through disciplined execution; won wars before battles were fought; all 13 chapters have never been improved upon.
weaknesses: Personal combat ability not recorded; historical accounts of his life are disputed; operates at the level of generals, not individual fighters.
description: The Art of War. Sun Tzu wrote 13 chapters on military strategy that are still taught in military academies, business schools, and law schools. He did not invent war. He just explained it so clearly that everyone who read him stopped losing.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sun Tzu's strategic brilliance transcends time, making him a cornerstone of military theory.
notableFeats: Wrote 'The Art of War,' a timeless military strategy guide.
Turned concubines into disciplined soldiers to prove his methods.
Won wars through psychological manipulation and strategy.
Defined principles of warfare still used today.
Influenced countless leaders across history.

name: Lelouch vi Britannia
specialAbility: Geass — absolute order given once per person through eye contact, compelling obedience even to self-destruction; chess-genius strategic mind; Zero Requiem — a plan to unite the world against himself so his death ends all conflict.
weaknesses: Physical combat ability is nearly zero; Geass cannot be used twice on the same person; emotional investment in Nunnally creates decisive vulnerability.
description: Zero. Lelouch Lamperouge orchestrated a world revolution, toppled an empire, and arranged his own public execution to achieve permanent peace. He was 17. The plan worked. He had calculated every move including the last one.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lelouch's strategic brilliance and self-sacrifice made him a revolutionary icon.
notableFeats: Toppled the Holy Britannian Empire through strategic manipulation.
Orchestrated the Zero Requiem to achieve world peace.
Used Geass to compel obedience from key figures.
Outmaneuvered Schneizel in a chess-like strategic battle.
Sacrificed himself to unite the world against a common enemy.
specialRules: Ability to compel obedience with eye contact

name: Tetsuo Shima
specialAbility: Unlimited psychokinesis — reshapes matter and energy at will; absorbs matter to expand himself; psychic power that rivals Akira's complete awakening.
weaknesses: Cannot control his own power — it consumes him; psychological instability under pressure; requires Akira's intervention to contain his final form.
description: Tetsuo Shima started as a biker gang member in Neo-Tokyo. His psychic awakening tore the city apart, destroyed a military satellite, and culminated in a catastrophic biological singularity that consumed everything near it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Tetsuo's power rivals Akira's, but his instability makes him a danger to himself and others.
notableFeats: Destroyed SOL satellite with psychic power (Akira manga).
Created a singularity that consumed parts of Neo-Tokyo (Akira manga).
Fought Akira-level psychic entities and survived (Akira manga).
Absorbed massive amounts of matter to expand his form (Akira manga).

name: Judge Dredd
specialAbility: Lawmaster motorcycle and full-body combat armor; Lawgiver smart-gun with armor-piercing, incendiary, and ricochet rounds; Judge training from age 5 — peak human combat conditioning.
weaknesses: Rigid adherence to the law creates tactical inflexibility; mortal human beneath the armor; physically unsustainable against Mega-City One's criminal ecosystem indefinitely.
description: Judge Dredd has protected Mega-City One for decades against mutants, alien invasions, and the end of civilization itself. He embodies the law, refusing higher positions to remain on the streets where he is needed most.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dredd's unwavering commitment to the law makes him a symbol of justice but limits his flexibility.
notableFeats: Defeated Judge Death and other Dark Judges (Judge Dredd comics).
Survived multiple alien invasions of Mega-City One (Judge Dredd comics).
Refused Chief Judgeship to remain active on the streets (Judge Dredd comics).
Single-handedly quelled riots in Mega-City One (Judge Dredd comics).

name: Shrek
specialAbility: Ogre physiology — superhuman strength and durability; belch weaponization; intimidation aura that disperses entire armies; swamp terrain mastery.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability to rejection; prefers non-combat resolution when possible; underestimates foes.
description: Shrek is an ogre who wanted solitude but became a hero, befriended a donkey, married a princess, and saved a kingdom. His roar scattered armies, but his emotional depth defines him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shrek's strength and durability make him formidable, but his emotional vulnerability is exploitable.
notableFeats: Scattered a tournament crowd with his roar (Shrek movie).
Defeated Farquaad's knights single-handedly (Shrek movie).
Survived being thrown into a dragon's lair and befriended the dragon (Shrek movie).
Saved Fiona and defeated Farquaad's forces (Shrek movie).

name: William Wallace
specialAbility: Claymore swordsmanship of brutal effectiveness; tactical genius at Stirling Bridge; rallied an entire nation through force of will.
weaknesses: Human limits — betrayed by nobles; no answer to political maneuvering; was tortured and executed.
description: William Wallace led Scotland's rebellion against Edward I with no army, no money, and no support from the nobility. He won Stirling Bridge against all odds and inspired a nation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Wallace's leadership and swordsmanship made him a legend, but his human limits were exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated the English at Stirling Bridge using terrain advantage (historical record).
Rallied Scottish forces despite lack of noble support (historical record).
Refused to confess under torture (historical record).
Inspired Scotland's continued rebellion after his death (historical record).

name: Maximus Decimus Meridius
specialAbility: Roman legion general's tactical mind in gladiatorial arena; unification of prisoners into a coordinated fighting unit; exceptional swordsmanship.
weaknesses: Mortal — can be killed by enough men; grieving and suicidal; stabbed before his final fight.
description: Maximus Decimus Meridius went from Roman general to gladiator to the most popular man in Rome. He defeated the Emperor in combat despite being mortally wounded.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Maximus's tactical brilliance and swordsmanship make him a formidable fighter, but his emotional wounds are exploitable.
notableFeats: Defeated Commodus in the Colosseum despite being stabbed (Gladiator movie).
Unified gladiators into a cohesive fighting unit (Gladiator movie).
Led Rome's Felix Legions to victory in Germania (Gladiator movie).
Earned the loyalty of the Colosseum crowd (Gladiator movie).

name: King Leonidas
specialAbility: Elite Spartan combat training and phalanx tactics, enabling him to hold the pass at Thermopylae against overwhelming odds.
weaknesses: Human mortality and susceptibility to betrayal; pride occasionally clouds judgment.
description: King Leonidas led 300 Spartans in a legendary last stand at Thermopylae, delaying the Persian army and securing Greece's future. His strategic brilliance and courage are immortalized in history.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Leonidas' sacrifice was pivotal in delaying the Persian invasion, allowing Greece to prepare for future battles.
notableFeats: Held the pass at Thermopylae for three days against hundreds of thousands of Persian soldiers.
Personally killed Persian generals in one-on-one combat.
Inspired the Greek city-states to unite against Persia.

name: Aurelion Sol
specialAbility: Cosmic dragon capable of creating and destroying stars, with galaxy-scale teleportation and devastating energy projection.
weaknesses: Bound by the Crown of Shurima, which restricts his full power; pride and disdain for mortals make him predictable.
description: Aurelion Sol is an ancient cosmic dragon enslaved by mortals through a magical crown. Despite his resentment, he wields the power to forge and annihilate stars, making him a universal threat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Aurelion Sol's enslavement fuels his hatred for mortals, making him a volatile ally or enemy.
notableFeats: Created stars across the universe.
Destroyed celestial bodies with cosmic breath.
Resisted enslavement by Targon despite the Crown of Shurima.

name: Viego the Ruined King
specialAbility: Black Mist corruption that consumes entire regions, with possession abilities and continent-scale Ruination waves.
weaknesses: Emotionally unstable due to grief; Isolde's rejection undermines his power source.
description: Viego, the Ruined King, is a tragic figure consumed by grief for his lost wife. His obsession has turned the Shadow Isles into a realm of undead horror.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Viego's grief-driven actions make him a tragic yet dangerous figure in the League of Legends universe.
notableFeats: Corrupted the Shadow Isles into a realm of undead.
Possessed enemy champions mid-battle.
Released continent-scale Ruination waves.

name: Zed
specialAbility: Shadow mastery allows him to create duplicates, execute Deathmark, and escape into shadows.
weaknesses: Shadow abilities require line of sight; predictable due to ideology; vulnerable to Shen's counters.
description: Zed, the Master of Shadows, broke the rules of his order to master forbidden techniques. His shadows are lethal extensions of his will.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zed's mastery of shadows makes him a dangerous assassin, but his ideology creates predictable enemies.
notableFeats: Surpassed Master Yi in combat skill.
Defeated Shen in direct combat.
Mastered forbidden shadow techniques.

name: Yasuo
specialAbility: Wind manipulation extends sword range, creates tornadoes, and blocks projectiles with Windwall.
weaknesses: Overconfidence and guilt cloud judgment; Windwall has exploitable gaps; vulnerable to Yone's counters.
description: Yasuo, the Unforgiven, is a master swordsman who manipulates wind to enhance his combat abilities. His pride and guilt drive him forward.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yasuo's wind manipulation makes him a versatile fighter, but his emotional baggage often clouds his judgment.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple pursuers while on the run.
Mastered wind techniques to extend sword range.
Blocked projectiles with Windwall in critical battles.

name: Tryndamere
specialAbility: Undying Rage — literally cannot die for 5 seconds regardless of damage received; infinite fury stacking that increases critical hit probability; spinning blade charge that covers vast distances; survived Ryze's runic imprisonment for years.
weaknesses: No magic resistance beyond his immortality window; intelligence limitations — a tactically sophisticated opponent can exploit the 5-second window; the Undying Rage cooldown creates vulnerability.
description: The Barbarian King. Tryndamere made a deal with an ancient dark power to survive long enough to avenge his tribe. His undying rage means you cannot kill him when he decides to live. You have to wait. He uses that time to hit you with a very large sword.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Tryndamere's rage stems from the destruction of his tribe, fueling his relentless combat style.
notableFeats: Survived Ryze's runic imprisonment for years.
Defeated multiple foes while under Undying Rage.
Destroyed enemy armies single-handedly using his fury.
specialRules: Rage stacking increases critical hit probability

name: Syndra
specialAbility: Unlimited power — telekinetic control of dark sphere orbs at massive scale; Unleashed Power hurls every sphere simultaneously for crushing impact; her magic has no theoretical ceiling; expelled from the Placidium for being uncontrollable.
weaknesses: Physical fragility — all offense, minimal defense; requires charging sphere arsenal for peak damage; opponents who close distance immediately neutralize most of her advantage.
description: The Dark Sovereign. Syndra was told her magic was too dangerous to be trusted. She decided the people doing the telling were the problem. She has no ceiling on her power — a fact that terrifies the Ionian magical establishment and should terrify everyone else.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Syndra's power is feared across Ionia, with no known limit to her magical potential.
notableFeats: Destroyed an Ionian fortress with her spheres.
Defeated multiple Ionian mages simultaneously.
Created a sphere storm that devastated an entire battlefield.
specialRules: Requires sphere charging for peak damage

name: Meliodas
specialAbility: Full Counter — reflects any magic attack at amplified power; Demon Mark amplification; Assault Mode removes all emotional limiters for maximum demonic power; Dragon Handle of Lostvayne; cursed immortality.
weaknesses: Full Counter only works on magical attacks — physical strikes bypass it; emotional suppression via the curse creates blind spots; love for Elizabeth creates tactical vulnerabilities.
description: The Dragon's Sin of Wrath. Captain of the Seven Deadly Sins, former leader of the Ten Commandments, and the son of the Demon King. Meliodas has died hundreds of times across multiple timelines. Each time, his curse resurrects him with slightly less emotion intact.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Meliodas's cursed immortality makes him a relentless force in battle.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Commandments in Assault Mode.
Reflected a mountain-destroying spell with Full Counter.
Survived countless deaths due to his curse.

name: Escanor
specialAbility: The One — at high noon his power reaches a pinnacle that makes him invincible for one minute; Sunshine ability grows exponentially with the sun's position; his axe Rhitta stores solar energy for nighttime use; one-shots demon lords.
weaknesses: Nighttime reduces him to a frail, powerless human; The One burns his own body to ashes — one use and he dies; he accepts this completely.
description: The Lion's Sin of Pride. At noon, Escanor is unkillable. He walked through the Supreme Deity's assault and declared he alone decided when he would die. Then he used The One to save everyone, burned to ash, and went out smiling. No regrets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Escanor's pride and power make him a formidable ally and a terrifying opponent.
notableFeats: Defeated Demon King Zeldris with The One.
Survived Supreme Deity's assault at noon.
Destroyed multiple demon lords in a single strike.
specialRules: Power grows with the sun's position

name: Gogeta
specialAbility: Fusion Dance combination of Goku and Vegeta's full power; Stardust Breaker destroys evil energy; Big Bang Kamehameha; 30-minute fusion window; outclassed Broly in seconds before the fusion broke.
weaknesses: 30-minute fusion limit — powerful opponents can stall; requires precise Fusion Dance synchronization which fails if one partner is off; defuses under extreme circumstances.
description: The Legendary Fusion. When Goku and Vegeta perform the Fusion Dance perfectly, the result is Gogeta — a combatant so dominant he was defeating Broly, the Legendary Super Saiyan, before the fusion timed out. He fights with Goku's instinct and Vegeta's pride.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gogeta's fusion combines the best traits of Goku and Vegeta, making him a nearly unstoppable force.
notableFeats: Defeated Broly in seconds during fusion.
Destroyed Janemba with Stardust Breaker.
Matched Super Saiyan Blue power levels effortlessly.

name: Vegito
specialAbility: Potara earring fusion — superior to Fusion Dance in power and stability; Final Kamehameha; Spirit Sword energy blade; fought Fused Zamasu while continuously absorbing the effects of Universe-splitting attacks.
weaknesses: Can defuse inside powerful magic absorption barriers; Potara fusion has a time limit for mortals; the arrogance of both component personalities amplified.
description: The Potara Fusion. Goku and Vegeta merged via Potara earrings into Vegito — the most powerful individual fighter in Dragon Ball Z. He fought the Supreme Kai-powered Majin Buu while joking about it. He was winning. He deliberately defused to save those absorbed.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vegito represents the pinnacle of mortal fusion in Dragon Ball, combining Goku's and Vegeta's strengths into an unstoppable force.
notableFeats: Fought Fused Zamasu while absorbing universe-splitting attacks (Dragon Ball Super).
Overpowered Majin Buu with Supreme Kai powers (Dragon Ball Z).
Defused deliberately to save absorbed allies (Dragon Ball Z).
Executed Final Kamehameha with devastating effect (Dragon Ball Super).

name: Zamasu
specialAbility: Holy Wrath energy projection; Fused Zamasu form with Goku Black; immortality via Super Dragon Balls; divine energy that specifically burns mortal life force; spreads as a multiversal infection when destroyed.
weaknesses: Immortality merged with a mortal half — his body continually degrades; ideology of divine supremacy creates tactical blind spots; love of his own plan over effective execution.
description: The Future Fallen Supreme Kai. Zamasu used the Super Dragon Balls to switch bodies with Goku, killed all the gods, and merged with himself across timelines to create an unkillable divine being. His plan was flawless. Trunks stabbed him with a sword made of humanity's hope.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zamasu's divine ambition and immortality make him one of the most dangerous foes in Dragon Ball.
notableFeats: Merged with Goku Black to become Fused Zamasu (Dragon Ball Super).
Survived multiversal destruction and spread as an infection (Dragon Ball Super).
Killed all gods in his timeline (Dragon Ball Super).
Fought Vegito and held his ground (Dragon Ball Super).
specialRules: Immortal unless Super Dragon Balls are used against him

name: Zeno
specialAbility: Erase — instantaneous deletion of anything from existence, including universes; no technique, no kata, no explanation; erased two universes in anger as a child; Future Zeno + Present Zeno deleted all surviving universes in the Tournament of Power timeline.
weaknesses: Child-like intelligence — easily bored, easily manipulated; relies entirely on bodyguards for anything below extinction-level decisions; has no concept of fighting.
description: The Omni-King. Zeno doesn't fight. He erases. He deleted six of the original eighteen universes because he was bored. He watched the Tournament of Power and clapped at things he found interesting. He is the single most powerful entity in Dragon Ball and understands essentially nothing.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zeno's power is absolute, but his childlike nature makes him unpredictable and dangerous.
notableFeats: Erased six universes out of boredom (Dragon Ball Super).
Deleted Future Zamasu's multiversal infection (Dragon Ball Super).
Erased all universes in the Tournament of Power timeline (Dragon Ball Super).
Maintains absolute authority over all gods (Dragon Ball Super).
specialRules: No physical combat; relies solely on erasure

name: Saber
specialAbility: Excalibur — the sword of promised victory, concentrating magical energy into a beam of pure light that obliterates everything in its path; Avalon divine sheath grants near-total healing; Invisible Air conceals blade dimensions.
weaknesses: Magical energy reserves are finite — Excalibur requires enormous mana from her Master; without a strong Master connection, she operates at reduced capacity.
description: King Arthur. The King of Knights who pulled the sword from the stone and carried Britain through its golden age. As a Servant, she is one of the strongest Sabers in history — a warrior who fought until she had nothing left, then fought more.

finishers: Excalibur: The Sword of Promised Victory
v3Profile.loreNotes: Saber's noble phantasms and swordsmanship make her a formidable warrior, but her reliance on mana limits her sustained power.
signatures: Excalibur: The Sword of Promised Victory
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Servants in the Holy Grail War (Fate/Stay Night).
Used Excalibur to obliterate powerful enemies (Fate/Stay Night).
Survived near-fatal battles using Avalon (Fate/Stay Night).
Demonstrated unmatched swordsmanship against legendary foes (Fate/Stay Night).

name: Archer Gilgamesh
specialAbility: Gate of Babylon — contains every Noble Phantasm ever created, launched as projectiles simultaneously; Ea / Enuma Elish — a sword that was present at the creation of the world and can split reality; he is the original hero — every legend flows from him.
weaknesses: Extreme arrogance — fights from the Gate of Babylon instead of personally engaging, which costs him against berserkers; loses to opponents who close distance before projectiles can be saturated.
description: The King of Heroes. Gilgamesh owns the original version of every Noble Phantasm because he was humanity's first hero. He fights by opening a vault containing the prototype of every legendary weapon and firing them like artillery. He finds this beneath him. He still does it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gilgamesh's overwhelming arsenal makes him nearly unbeatable at range, but his arrogance often leads to tactical errors.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Servants using Gate of Babylon (Fate/Stay Night).
Used Ea to split reality and obliterate enemies (Fate/Stay Night).
Demonstrated mastery over countless Noble Phantasms (Fate/Stay Night).
Held his ground against legendary foes despite arrogance (Fate/Stay Night).

name: Ciri
specialAbility: Space-time blink — teleports across distances at will mid-combat; Elder Blood gives her power over space-time itself.
weaknesses: Teleportation is instinctive under stress — she cannot always control the destination; Elder Blood makes her a target for every power in multiple worlds; emotionally driven.
description: The Child of Elder Blood. Ciri can move through space-time with a thought, visiting multiple parallel worlds. Witches, mages, and emperors have spent years trying to capture or kill her, but her Witcher training and Elder Blood powers make her a formidable force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ciri's Elder Blood heritage makes her a key figure in multiversal events.
notableFeats: Defeated the White Frost, preventing universal destruction (The Witcher 3).
Trained with Geralt and surpassed his expectations (The Witcher series).
Escaped multiple assassination attempts by teleporting across dimensions.
Defeated powerful mages and warriors using Elder Blood powers.
specialRules: Can open portals to other worlds

name: Aloy
specialAbility: Focus — a device giving combat-time analysis of machine weak points; Shieldweaver armor enhances survivability.
weaknesses: Human physical limits without armor; reliance on technology; isolationist tendencies limit coordination.
description: The Seeker. Aloy was an outcast who became the only person capable of saving the world twice. Using her Focus device and hunting skills, she defeated machines and shut down an extinction-level AI.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Aloy's genetic link to GAIA makes her uniquely capable of saving her world.
notableFeats: Defeated HADES, an AI designed to end all organic life (Horizon Zero Dawn).
Shut down corrupted Cauldrons to stop machine production.
Overrode machines to turn them into allies.
Survived against Deathbringers and Thunderjaws using strategy and precision.

name: Ellie
specialAbility: Immune to Cordyceps fungal infection — can move freely through contaminated zones; exceptional stealth and survival skills.
weaknesses: Human physical limits — smaller and lighter than most adult threats; PTSD and emotional trauma create unpredictable combat state.
description: Immune. Ellie survived a fungal apocalypse, a cannibal commune, and a cross-country survival journey. Her immunity to Cordyceps makes her a unique survivor in a world overrun by infection.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ellie's immunity makes her a key figure in the fight against Cordyceps infection.
notableFeats: Killed David's entire cult from the inside (The Last of Us).
Survived against infected and human threats using stealth and traps.
Navigated contaminated zones freely due to immunity.
Defeated armed enemies despite being outnumbered.

name: Joel Miller
specialAbility: Survivor's calculus — resource management and improvised weapon construction in post-collapse environments.
weaknesses: Human physical limits and aging body; emotional decisions override tactical ones — he will save one person over a million.
description: A survivor. Joel carried Ellie across a dead America and burned the Fireflies' operation to save her life. His brutal combat style and resourcefulness make him a dangerous opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Joel's emotional decisions often define his combat choices.
notableFeats: Destroyed the Fireflies' operation to save Ellie (The Last of Us).
Survived against infected and human threats for over 20 years.
Tracked and hunted enemies across post-apocalyptic terrain.
Defeated armed groups using stealth and brutality.

name: Arthur Morgan
specialAbility: Dead Eye — slows time perception to land multiple precision shots; expert lasso and melee combat.
weaknesses: Tuberculosis ravages his body in the game's final act; code of honor creates vulnerability to betrayal.
description: An outlaw who tried to become something better when it was almost too late. Arthur Morgan's Dead Eye ability and survival skills make him a formidable combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Arthur's Dead Eye ability gives him a significant edge in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple armed groups using Dead Eye precision (Red Dead Redemption 2).
Survived against bounty hunters and rival gangs.
Tracked and hunted enemies across diverse terrains.
Protected his gang despite overwhelming odds.
specialRules: Can slow down time for precise shots
v3Profile.profanityStyle: moderate — period-appropriate western cursing, hell, bastard, damn

name: Zagreus
specialAbility: Immortal resurrection and combat adaptability through Olympian boons.
weaknesses: Death resets his combat loadout, requiring him to rebuild his boons; emotional vulnerability toward Hades and Persephone.
description: Zagreus, Prince of the Underworld, is an immortal warrior who uses death as a learning tool to escape Hades' realm. His mastery of various weapons and Olympian boons makes him a versatile combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zagreus thrives in prolonged battles due to his ability to resurrect and adapt.
notableFeats: Escaped the Underworld multiple times (Hades game canon).
Defeated legendary heroes like Theseus and Asterius.
Mastered six unique weapons with varying combat styles.
Adapted to Olympian boons to enhance his abilities.

name: Noctis Lucis Caelum
specialAbility: Armiger Arsenal allows simultaneous warp-strikes with all royal arms.
weaknesses: Final power costs his life; emotionally destabilized by Luna's death; vulnerable to Ardyn's specific counters.
description: Noctis Lucis Caelum, the True King, sacrificed himself to end eternal darkness. His mastery of warp-strikes and royal arms makes him a formidable combatant.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Noctis excels in high-speed combat and tactical strikes but is limited by his ultimate sacrifice.
notableFeats: Defeated Ardyn and ended eternal darkness (Final Fantasy XV).
Mastered all thirteen royal arms.
Warp-struck across massive distances in battle.
Sacrificed himself to restore light to the world.

name: Harry Potter
specialAbility: Immune to Avada Kedavra through sacrificial magic; skilled in Unforgivable Curses and Patronus Charm.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability and protective instincts can be exploited.
description: Harry Potter, the Boy Who Lived, survived the Killing Curse and became a master of defensive and offensive magic. His courage and resourcefulness define him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Harry's defensive magic and resourcefulness make him a formidable opponent in magical duels.
notableFeats: Defeated Voldemort in the Battle of Hogwarts (Harry Potter series).
Survived the Killing Curse multiple times.
Mastered advanced spells like the Patronus Charm.
Chosen by the Elder Wand.

name: Severus Snape
specialAbility: Master Occlumens and Legilimency; inventor of spells like Sectumsempra.
description: Severus Snape, the Half-Blood Prince, was a master of potions and spells who played a pivotal role in Voldemort's downfall. His intelligence and cunning were unmatched.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Snape's intelligence and mastery of mental manipulation make him a dangerous opponent.
notableFeats: Fooled Voldemort for years as a double agent (Harry Potter series).
Invented spells like Sectumsempra.
Mastered Occlumency and Legilimency.
Played a key role in Voldemort's downfall.

name: Bellatrix Lestrange
specialAbility: Cruciatus Curse mastery and wandless magic; expert in the Dark Arts.
weaknesses: Obsession with Voldemort clouds judgment in battle.
description: Bellatrix Lestrange, Voldemort's most fanatical lieutenant, is a master of the Dark Arts and wandless magic. Her cruelty and loyalty make her a dangerous adversary.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bellatrix's aggression and mastery of dark magic make her a formidable but reckless opponent.
notableFeats: Killed Sirius Black and Nymphadora Tonks (Harry Potter series).
Mastered the Cruciatus Curse.
Demonstrated proficiency in wandless magic.
Fought multiple skilled wizards simultaneously.

name: Sirius Black
specialAbility: Animagus transformation into a giant black dog; exceptional duelist and spellcaster.
weaknesses: Impulsive and reckless due to years of imprisonment; emotionally driven in combat.
description: Sirius Black, a member of the original Marauders, was wrongly imprisoned in Azkaban for 12 years. He escaped and became a key ally in the fight against Voldemort, showcasing his loyalty and bravery.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sirius is a skilled duelist and Animagus, but his impulsive nature can lead to tactical errors.
notableFeats: Escaped Azkaban, the most secure wizarding prison.
Defeated multiple Death Eaters in duels.
Protected Harry Potter during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries.
specialRules: Animagus form enhances physical durability and mobility

name: Remus Lupin
specialAbility: Werewolf transformation enhances physical attributes; master of Defense Against the Dark Arts.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable transformations during full moons without Wolfsbane Potion.
description: Remus Lupin, a werewolf and member of the Marauders, is a skilled wizard and beloved professor. He played a pivotal role in the fight against Voldemort, showcasing his mastery of defensive magic.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lupin's werewolf form grants him immense physical power, but his human form relies on magical skill.
notableFeats: Fought against Voldemort's forces during the Battle of Hogwarts.
Mastered the Patronus Charm despite his lycanthropy.
Survived years of prejudice and discrimination as a werewolf.

name: Draco Malfoy
specialAbility: Expert in Occlumency and Disillusionment Charms; skilled in Unforgivable Curses.
weaknesses: Hesitates under pressure; lacks physical durability.
description: Draco Malfoy, heir to the Malfoy fortune, was recruited as a Death Eater at sixteen. Despite his cruelty, he struggles with inner conflict and fear.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Draco's magical skill is undermined by his lack of confidence and hesitation in critical moments.
notableFeats: Successfully infiltrated Hogwarts under Voldemort's orders.
Mastered Occlumency to protect his mind from intrusion.
Cast Unforgivable Curses under duress.

name: Neville Longbottom
specialAbility: Killed Nagini with the Sword of Gryffindor; herbology expertise.
weaknesses: Underestimated by enemies; lacks advanced magical skill.
description: Neville Longbottom, once dismissed as a weak wizard, rose to heroism by destroying the final Horcrux and resisting Voldemort.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Neville's bravery and determination make him a formidable opponent despite his lack of magical versatility.
notableFeats: Destroyed Nagini, the final Horcrux, during the Battle of Hogwarts.
Resisted Voldemort's forces while others fled.
Mastered the Sword of Gryffindor in combat.
specialRules: Sword of Gryffindor scales with bravery

name: Ron Weasley
specialAbility: Strategic chess-master intellect; skilled at Auror combat.
weaknesses: Self-doubt and susceptibility to emotional manipulation.
description: Ron Weasley, Harry's loyal companion, is a skilled tactician and Quidditch keeper. He played a key role in the fight against Voldemort.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ron's strategic mind and loyalty make him a valuable ally, but his self-doubt can hinder his performance.
notableFeats: Defeated Death Eaters during the Battle of Hogwarts.
Mastered strategic planning in combat scenarios.
Recovered from splinching during high-stress situations.

name: Luna Lovegood
specialAbility: Sees through Thestrals and hidden truths; Wrackspurt perception; expert duelist
weaknesses: Perceived as odd; her unconventional thinking confuses allies too
description: Gifted witch with unique magical perception. Fought Death Eaters at the Ministry aged 15.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her unconventional thinking often leads to creative solutions in battle.
notableFeats: Fought Death Eaters at the Ministry of Magic (Order of the Phoenix).
