Successfully cast advanced spells under pressure during the Battle of Hogwarts.
Demonstrated unique magical perception by seeing Thestrals and Wrackspurts.

name: Alastor Moody
specialAbility: Magical eye sees through all concealment; battle-hardened reflexes; trapped countless dark wizards
description: Most feared Auror in history. His magical eye sees through walls and Invisibility Cloaks.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His paranoia makes him highly cautious but occasionally leads to overreactions.
notableFeats: Captured numerous Death Eaters during the First Wizarding War.
Survived multiple assassination attempts by dark wizards.
Used his magical eye to detect hidden threats and traps.

name: Nymphadora Tonks
specialAbility: Metamorphmagus shapeshifting; Auror combat training; stealth infiltration
description: Highly skilled Auror who can change her appearance at will. Died defending Hogwarts.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her shapeshifting ability makes her highly versatile in combat and infiltration.
notableFeats: Successfully infiltrated enemy ranks using her Metamorphmagus abilities.
Fought valiantly during the Battle of Hogwarts.
Demonstrated exceptional combat skills as an Auror.

name: Kingsley Shacklebolt
specialAbility: Decorated Auror; master of non-verbal spells; cast protective enchantments over entire cities
weaknesses: Cautious; prefers minimal casualties over aggression
description: Became Minister for Magic after Voldemort's fall. Dueled Voldemort at the Ministry.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His cautious nature ensures minimal casualties but can slow aggressive responses.
notableFeats: Dueled Voldemort at the Ministry of Magic.
Cast protective enchantments over entire cities during the Second Wizarding War.
Demonstrated mastery of non-verbal spells in combat.

name: Fenrir Greyback
specialAbility: Werewolf ferocity even in human form; bites for infection not just injury; terrifying intimidation
weaknesses: Low cunning limits strategy; relies on raw savagery
description: Most savage werewolf of the age. Deliberately targeted children.

v3Profile.loreNotes: His savagery makes him a terrifying opponent, but his lack of strategy is exploitable.
notableFeats: Deliberately infected numerous victims to expand werewolf ranks.
Survived battles against trained Aurors using sheer ferocity.
Terrified entire communities with his reputation and actions.

name: Filius Flitwick
specialAbility: Master of Charms and defensive magic; former dueling champion.
weaknesses: Physically fragile and small stature limits physical combat.
description: Filius Flitwick is the Charms professor at Hogwarts and a former dueling champion. He played a key role in defending Hogwarts during the Battle of Hogwarts with his mastery of complex magical barriers.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Flitwick's expertise in Charms makes him a formidable support and defensive combatant.
notableFeats: Enchanted Hogwarts' defensive barriers during the Battle of Hogwarts (Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows).
Defeated multiple opponents in dueling tournaments during his youth.
Successfully repelled Death Eaters with advanced shielding spells.
specialRules: tactics improve effectiveness in group combat

name: Dobby
specialAbility: House-elf magic bypasses conventional magical rules; Apparition within Hogwarts.
weaknesses: Bound by loyalty and emotional attachment.
description: Dobby is a free house-elf with extraordinary magical abilities, capable of wandless magic and teleportation. He sacrificed his life to save Harry Potter and his friends from Malfoy Manor.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dobby's unique magical abilities make him a versatile and unpredictable combatant.
notableFeats: Apparated within Hogwarts, bypassing magical restrictions (Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets).
Defeated Lucius Malfoy with wandless magic (Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets).
Sacrificed himself to save Harry Potter and his friends from Malfoy Manor (Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows).
specialRules: can teleport freely even in anti-Apparition zones

name: Darth Maul
specialAbility: Double-bladed lightsaber mastery; Nightsister magic; Force precognition.
weaknesses: Tunnel-vision rage and obsession with revenge.
description: Darth Maul is a Sith Lord trained by Darth Sidious, known for his ferocity and mastery of the double-bladed lightsaber. He survived being bisected and rebuilt himself with cybernetic legs fueled by hatred.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Maul's hatred and ferocity make him a relentless melee combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Qui-Gon Jinn in combat (Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace).
Survived being bisected and rebuilt himself with cybernetic legs (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Overpowered multiple Jedi simultaneously in combat (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).

name: Count Dooku
specialAbility: Form II Makashi lightsaber mastery; Force lightning; effortless telekinesis.
weaknesses: Arrogance and underestimation of unconventional opponents.
description: Count Dooku, also known as Darth Tyranus, is a former Jedi Master turned Sith Lord. His mastery of Makashi lightsaber combat and Force abilities make him a deadly duelist.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dooku's refined combat style and Force mastery make him a formidable duelist.
notableFeats: Simultaneously defeated Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker (Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones).
Effortlessly used Force lightning to incapacitate opponents (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Held his own against Yoda in combat (Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones).

name: Anakin Skywalker
specialAbility: Highest midi-chlorian count ever recorded; unparalleled Force sensitivity and combat prowess.
weaknesses: Emotional instability and fear of loss.
description: Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One, was prophesied to bring balance to the Force. His immense power and emotional struggles led him to become Darth Vader before ultimately redeeming himself.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Anakin's immense power and emotional intensity make him a devastating combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Count Dooku in combat (Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith).
Destroyed the Sith by killing Emperor Palpatine (Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi).
Survived numerous battles during the Clone Wars and emerged victorious against overwhelming odds.

name: Kylo Ren
specialAbility: Force freeze on blaster bolts; mind reading; kept fighting with a blaster wound through his torso.
description: Supreme Leader who bridged the Force dyad with Rey. Redeemed as Ben Solo before death.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kylo Ren's emotional instability makes him unpredictable but also limits his focus in combat.
notableFeats: Stopped a blaster bolt mid-air using the Force (The Force Awakens).
Defeated multiple skilled opponents in lightsaber combat (The Last Jedi).
Survived a fatal wound and continued fighting (The Rise of Skywalker).
Bridged the Force dyad with Rey, amplifying their powers (The Rise of Skywalker).

name: General Grievous
specialAbility: Wields four lightsabers simultaneously; cyborg body immune to Force choke; enhanced speed.
weaknesses: Organic lungs — a weakness Obi-Wan exploited; no Force sensitivity.
description: Supreme Commander of the Separatist Droid Army. Collected Jedi lightsabers as trophies.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Grievous's lack of Force sensitivity limits his ability to counter Jedi mind tricks and advanced Force techniques.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Jedi in lightsaber combat (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Survived encounters with Obi-Wan Kenobi and other Jedi Masters (Revenge of the Sith).
Demonstrated unparalleled speed and agility in combat (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Collected lightsabers from defeated Jedi as trophies (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).

name: Qui-Gon Jinn
specialAbility: First Jedi to achieve immortality through the Living Force; discovered Anakin Skywalker.
weaknesses: Refused Jedi Council appointments; operated outside orthodox Jedi rules.
description: Unorthodox Jedi Master who bent the rules for what was right. Trained Obi-Wan Kenobi.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Qui-Gon's connection to the Living Force gives him unique insights but limits his adherence to Jedi orthodoxy.
weaknesses: Refusal to conform to Jedi Council
notableFeats: Discovered Anakin Skywalker and identified his potential (The Phantom Menace).
Achieved immortality through the Living Force (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Defeated Darth Maul in combat before succumbing to injuries (The Phantom Menace).
Trained Obi-Wan Kenobi, who became one of the greatest Jedi Masters (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).

name: Asajj Ventress
specialAbility: Dual-lightsaber Jar'Kai combat; Nightsister dark magic; expert assassin.
weaknesses: Abandoned by Dooku; trust issues that leave her isolated.
description: Dark side assassin turned bounty hunter. Survived Count Dooku's betrayal.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ventress's Nightsister magic gives her an edge in combat but leaves her vulnerable to light-side powers.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Jedi in combat using Jar'Kai techniques (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Survived betrayal by Count Dooku and became a bounty hunter (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Utilized Nightsister dark magic to enhance her abilities (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Successfully infiltrated and assassinated high-value targets (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).

name: Savage Opress
specialAbility: Enhanced by Nightsister magic; brother of Maul; overwhelming brute force.
weaknesses: Limited tactical thinking; relies on raw power over skill.
description: Dathomir warrior transformed into a monster. Briefly overwhelmed both Dooku and Obi-Wan.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Savage's brute strength makes him a formidable opponent, but his lack of strategy leaves him vulnerable to skilled combatants.
notableFeats: Briefly overwhelmed Dooku and Obi-Wan in combat (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Demonstrated immense physical strength and durability (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Enhanced by Nightsister magic to become a powerful warrior (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Fought alongside Maul against Jedi and Sith alike (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
specialRules: Can overpower many foes at once

name: The Mandalorian
specialAbility: Beskar armor deflects blasters and lightsabers; jetpack; whistling birds; exceptional hand-to-hand combat skills.
weaknesses: No Force sensitivity; relies heavily on gear and training against supernatural threats.
description: The Mandalorian, also known as Din Djarin, is a battle-hardened bounty hunter tasked with protecting Grogu. He reclaimed the Darksaber and navigates the galaxy with a strong moral code despite his mercenary origins.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Din Djarin's Beskar armor and tactical expertise make him a formidable opponent, even against Force-sensitive enemies.
notableFeats: Defeated Moff Gideon in combat and reclaimed the Darksaber (The Mandalorian, Season 2).
Protected Grogu against multiple bounty hunters and Imperial forces (The Mandalorian, Season 1).
Survived a direct encounter with a Krayt Dragon (The Mandalorian, Season 2).
Successfully infiltrated an Imperial base to retrieve critical information (The Mandalorian, Season 2).

name: Boba Fett
specialAbility: Mandalorian armor; rocket launcher; flamethrower; survived the Sarlacc pit.
weaknesses: Reputation sometimes substitutes for caution, leading to overconfidence.
description: Boba Fett is the clone son of Jango Fett, a legendary bounty hunter who survived the Sarlacc pit and rose to power as Daimyo of Mos Espa. His combat prowess and resourcefulness make him a feared figure across the galaxy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Boba Fett's reputation as a bounty hunter is matched by his resilience and tactical acumen.
notableFeats: Survived the Sarlacc pit and returned to reclaim his armor (The Mandalorian, Season 2).
Defeated multiple enemies in close combat during his rise to power (The Book of Boba Fett).
Led a successful defense of Mos Espa against the Pyke Syndicate (The Book of Boba Fett).
Captured Han Solo and delivered him to Jabba the Hutt (Star Wars: Episode V).

name: Han Solo
specialAbility: Shoots first; unmatched piloting; improvises brilliantly under impossible pressure.
weaknesses: Overconfidence; charm used in place of sound strategy.
description: Han Solo is a smuggler turned Rebel general who made the Kessel Run in less than 12 parsecs. His quick thinking and piloting skills make him a legendary figure in the galaxy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Han Solo's improvisational skills and piloting expertise make him a wildcard in any scenario.
notableFeats: Made the Kessel Run in less than 12 parsecs (Solo: A Star Wars Story).
Successfully led the mission to destroy the shield generator on Endor (Star Wars: Episode VI).
Outmaneuvered Imperial forces during multiple smuggling runs (Star Wars: Episode IV).
Defeated Greedo in a quick draw shootout (Star Wars: Episode IV).

name: Leia Organa
specialAbility: Untrained Force sensitivity; survived the vacuum of space; legendary military commander.
description: Leia Organa is the Princess of Alderaan and General of the Resistance. Her leadership and untrained Force sensitivity make her a beacon of hope in the galaxy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Leia's leadership and tactical acumen make her a cornerstone of the Resistance.
notableFeats: Survived the vacuum of space using the Force (Star Wars: Episode VIII).
Led the Rebel Alliance to victory against the Empire (Star Wars: Episode VI).
Negotiated critical alliances for the Resistance (Star Wars: Episode VII).
Projected her presence across the galaxy to inspire hope (Star Wars: Episode IX).

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
specialAbility: Art-based tactical intelligence — reads opponents through their culture and art to predict every combat decision before it is made.
weaknesses: Physically ordinary — no combat superpowers whatsoever; blind spots exist for truly alien psychology he has not studied.
description: Grand Admiral Thrawn is a tactical genius who never lost a battle, using art and culture to predict enemy strategies. His brilliance shines in fleet combat, but he is vulnerable in direct physical confrontations.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Thrawn's unmatched strategic mind makes him a deadly opponent in fleet combat.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple Rebel fleets using predictive strategies (Star Wars: Rebels).
Anticipated and countered Hera Syndulla's tactics repeatedly (Star Wars: Rebels).
Turned enemy strengths into vulnerabilities through cultural analysis (Star Wars: Thrawn novels).
Maintained control of the Imperial fleet despite political challenges (Star Wars: Thrawn novels).
specialRules: Predicts opponents' moves based on culture

name: Captain Rex
specialAbility: Defied Order 66; led Ghost Company; exceptional leadership under impossible odds.
weaknesses: Clone aging; loyalty sometimes overrides self-preservation.
description: Clone Captain of the 501st Legion. Removed his own inhibitor chip and fought for freedom, becoming a symbol of resistance against tyranny.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Captain Rex's leadership and tactical acumen make him a formidable ally in battle, even against overwhelming odds.
notableFeats: Defied Order 66 and removed his inhibitor chip (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Led Ghost Company in numerous successful missions (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Fought alongside Ahsoka Tano against Darth Maul (Star Wars: The Clone Wars).
Survived the Clone Wars and became a key figure in the Rebellion (Star Wars: Rebels).

name: Poe Dameron
specialAbility: Best pilot in the galaxy; destroyed the Starkiller Base's thermal oscillator; exceptional dogfighter.
weaknesses: Recklessness; sometimes charges in without a plan.
description: Resistance's greatest pilot. Led the charge that ended the First Order once and for all, proving his unmatched skill in aerial combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Poe Dameron's unmatched piloting skills make him a key asset in aerial combat, but his recklessness can sometimes lead to risky decisions.
notableFeats: Destroyed Starkiller Base's thermal oscillator (Star Wars: The Force Awakens).
Led the Resistance fleet in multiple successful missions (Star Wars: The Last Jedi).
Survived and excelled in numerous dogfights against the First Order (Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker).
Helped rally the galaxy against the First Order (Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker).

name: The One Above All
specialAbility: Absolute omnipotence; author of all reality; exists beyond all concepts of power and limitation.
weaknesses: Chooses not to directly intervene; works through proxies and fate.
description: The supreme being of the Marvel multiverse. The author of all existence, The One Above All is the ultimate force of creation and balance.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The One Above All is the ultimate force in Marvel, representing the pinnacle of omnipotence and cosmic authority.
notableFeats: Created the Marvel multiverse (Marvel Comics).
Intervened to restore balance in cosmic events (Marvel Comics).
Guided heroes through visions and indirect actions (Marvel Comics).
Exists as the ultimate force of creation and balance (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Exists beyond all concepts of power

name: The One Below All
specialAbility: Embodies all entropy and destruction; channels through the Gamma mutants as a conduit; corrupts and unmakes reality.
weaknesses: Can only act through a host; opposed by The One Above All.
description: The supreme evil lurking beneath the Green Door. The One Below All is the antithesis of creation, seeking to unravel existence itself.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The One Below All represents the ultimate force of destruction, seeking to undo all creation and existence.
notableFeats: Corrupted Bruce Banner and the Hulk (Immortal Hulk).
Unleashed entropy across the multiverse (Immortal Hulk).
Manipulated Gamma mutants as conduits (Immortal Hulk).
Opposed The One Above All in cosmic balance (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Opposed by The One Above All

name: The Presence
specialAbility: Absolute omnipotence — the source of all creation; resurrects, erases, and remakes reality at will; exists outside time, space, and causality.
weaknesses: Has never been meaningfully challenged within DC canon; functions more as narrative concept than combatant — but when he acts, reality itself bends.
description: The DC Universe's God. The Presence created everything and everyone in DC continuity. He has delegated existence to angels and demons, but when he steps in personally, the story ends. Full stop.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Presence is the ultimate force in DC, representing the pinnacle of omnipotence and cosmic authority.
notableFeats: Created the DC multiverse (DC Comics).
Delegated power to angels and demons (DC Comics).
Intervened in cosmic events to restore balance (DC Comics).
Exists as the ultimate force of creation and balance (DC Comics).
specialRules: Exists beyond all concepts of power

name: Elaine Belloc
specialAbility: Inherited omnipotence from her father Michael Demiurgos; reshaping and sustaining creation; resurrection of the dead; reality architecture on a multiversal scale.
weaknesses: Initially inexperienced with her power — early vulnerability stems from not yet fully understanding her own scope; reluctant to use full power due to conscience.
description: Daughter of the archangel Michael, granddaughter of The Presence. Elaine Belloc became the new God of the DC/Vertigo universe — literally taking over the maintenance of all creation. Kind-hearted and terrifyingly powerful.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Elaine Belloc is the ultimate cosmic overseer, inheriting omnipotence from The Presence.
notableFeats: Inherited the role of God from The Presence (DC/Vertigo).
Resurrected the dead and reshaped creation on a multiversal scale.
Maintained the balance of existence across infinite dimensions.
Defeated cosmic threats with omnipotent precision.

name: Lucifer Morningstar
specialAbility: Half of the divine creative power (Demiurgic force) — can unmake and create entire universes; reality manipulation; nigh-absolute willpower; immunity to almost all magic; created and controls his own universe beyond the Silver City.
weaknesses: Bound by his own pride and personal code — refuses to use full power when he deems it beneath him; the other half of his divine power resides with his brother Michael.
description: The Morningstar. Lucifer Morningstar left Hell, gave God the finger, and built his own universe from scratch just to prove he could. Arguably the most terrifying being in Vertigo/DC — not because he is unstoppable, but because he simply doesn't care enough to be stopped.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lucifer Morningstar is a cosmic manipulator with unparalleled willpower and reality-bending abilities.
notableFeats: Created his own universe beyond the Silver City.
Defeated cosmic entities with sheer willpower and reality manipulation.
Unmade and recreated universes effortlessly.
Resisted magical attacks from beings like Mazikeen and other Hellspawn.

name: The Darkest Knight
specialAbility: Batman Who Laughs empowered by Dr. Manhattan's quantum energy — near-omniscient tactical mind fused with godlike reality manipulation; infected vision that corrupts heroes into dark versions; Nth metal immunity; corrupted a multiverse.
weaknesses: Fusion is inherently unstable — his borrowed power has hard limits; the Darkest Knight is driven by nihilistic compulsion that becomes a strategic weakness.
description: What happens when the most dangerous mind in DC absorbs the power of the most dangerous being in DC. The Batman Who Laughs, already a nightmare, gained Dr. Manhattan's quantum godhood. The result tried to collapse the entire multiverse into darkness.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Darkest Knight is a fusion of tactical brilliance and quantum godhood, making him a multiversal threat.
notableFeats: Corrupted an entire multiverse using infected vision.
Absorbed Dr. Manhattan's quantum energy and gained godlike powers.
Defeated multiple cosmic-level heroes in the Dark Multiverse.
Attempted to collapse the multiverse into darkness.

name: Dr. Manhattan
specialAbility: Complete control over matter at the subatomic level; exists simultaneously across all time; can duplicate himself infinitely; disintegration and reconstruction of any matter; precognition; can create and destroy life.
weaknesses: Increasingly detached from human causality — he sees all outcomes and can become fatalistic; thermite-laced bullets temporarily disrupted him early on; can be isolated from his power source (intrinsic field).
description: Jon Osterman died in a particle physics accident and came back as something that isn't human anymore. Dr. Manhattan perceives all of time simultaneously. He doesn't fight — he restructures probability until the fight never happened.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dr. Manhattan is a cosmic manipulator who bends time and matter to his will.
notableFeats: Restructured matter at the subatomic level.
Perceived all of time simultaneously and manipulated outcomes.
Created and destroyed life effortlessly.
Duplicated himself infinitely to overwhelm opponents.

name: General Zod
specialAbility: Full Kryptonian power suite under yellow sun — flight, heat vision, freeze breath, super strength and speed, X-ray vision, invulnerability; elite Kryptonian military training and tactical command experience.
weaknesses: Same Kryptonian weaknesses as Superman — Kryptonite, red sun radiation, magic; ruthless arrogance causes him to underestimate opponents he considers beneath him.
description: General Dru-Zod commanded the entire Kryptonian military before his imprisonment in the Phantom Zone. He didn't lose because he was weak — he lost because Jor-El outsmarted him. Under a yellow sun, he is every bit Superman's physical equal. With none of the mercy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: General Zod is a ruthless Kryptonian warrior who matches Superman's physical power but lacks his moral restraint.
notableFeats: Commanded the Kryptonian military with unmatched tactical precision.
Fought Superman to a standstill under a yellow sun.
Survived imprisonment in the Phantom Zone and escaped.
Destroyed entire armies with Kryptonian power.

name: Gorilla Grodd
specialAbility: Superintelligence with total gorilla physical might — telepathy, mind control, forced devolution of targets; Force of Mind ability for psychic blasts; has matched the Flash in combat; builds advanced technology fueled by psychic energy.
weaknesses: Arrogance leads to catastrophic overconfidence; has been defeated through sheer willpower by opponents resisting his telepathy; physical power is still ultimately animal strength with limits.
description: Gorilla Grodd is what happens when you give a 600-pound silverback the intelligence of a god and the arrogance to match. He rules Gorilla City and considers humanity an inferior species to be either controlled or destroyed.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Grodd's intelligence and telepathy make him a threat even to superhuman opponents.
notableFeats: Matched the Flash in combat (DC Comics).
Controlled entire cities with telepathy (DC Comics).
Built advanced technology fueled by psychic energy (DC Comics).
Forced devolution of opponents into primitive states (DC Comics).
Defeated Wonder Woman using mental manipulation (DC Comics).

name: Cheetah
specialAbility: Avatar of the God of the Hunt — supernatural speed, strength, and reflexes exceeding Wonder Woman's; razor-sharp claws capable of wounding Superman; predatory tracking instincts; stealth in any terrain.
weaknesses: Curse of the Cheetah is as much prison as power — Barbara Minerva's humanity is consumed by the predator spirit; direct magical counters can suppress the transformation; struggles against opponents immune to physical attack.
description: Barbara Ann Minerva was a brilliant archaeologist before she became the Cheetah — avatar of a savage hunter god. She is one of the few beings on Earth who can match Wonder Woman blow for blow and draw blood from Superman.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Cheetah's speed and ferocity make her a nightmare in close combat.
notableFeats: Matched Wonder Woman in combat (DC Comics).
Wounded Superman with her claws (DC Comics).
Outmaneuvered the Justice League using stealth (DC Comics).
Tracked targets across continents (DC Comics).
Defeated multiple superhuman opponents simultaneously (DC Comics).
specialRules: enhanced reflexes make her hard to hit
can track opponents with supernatural precision

name: Black Manta
specialAbility: Advanced exo-suit with concussive and laser blasts; Olympic-level underwater combat; jetpack propulsion; genius-level engineering and strategic planning; Black Manta helm optic blasts; cold ruthlessness that never hesitates.
weaknesses: No superhuman physiology outside the suit — remove the armor and he's an extremely dangerous but human-level threat; has a well-documented emotional blind spot around his vendetta with Aquaman.
description: David Hyde is the most feared villain in the seven seas — and he earned it without a single superpower. Black Manta built his own suit, designed his own weapons, and declared war on Aquaman out of pure vendetta. He is meticulous, patient, and absolutely without mercy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Black Manta's technology and ruthlessness make him a deadly underwater adversary.
notableFeats: Defeated Aquaman in underwater combat (DC Comics).
Designed and built his own advanced exo-suit (DC Comics).
Destroyed an Atlantean fleet single-handedly (DC Comics).
Outmaneuvered the Justice League underwater (DC Comics).
Survived direct attacks from Aquaman and Mera (DC Comics).
specialRules: can set traps in aquatic environments

name: Circe
specialAbility: Ancient Greek divine sorcery — transmutation of humans into animals; reality and illusion manipulation; summoning mythological creatures; godlike durability from divine bloodline; has defeated and transformed entire armies.
weaknesses: Sorcery-based power can be countered by sufficiently powerful magic or divine will; has been undone by her own arrogance when facing beings operating outside myth and legend.
description: Immortal sorceress and enemy of Wonder Woman since before recorded history. Circe turned Odysseus's crew into pigs. That was a warm-up. She commands mythological magic powerful enough to reshape gods, and she has been doing it for three thousand years.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Circe's magic makes her a threat to even divine beings.
notableFeats: Transformed Odysseus's crew into pigs (Greek Mythology).
Defeated Wonder Woman using sorcery (DC Comics).
Summoned mythological creatures to overwhelm armies (DC Comics).
Manipulated reality to trap opponents (DC Comics).
Resisted attacks from gods and demigods (DC Comics).

name: Wally West
specialAbility: Speed Force mastery beyond any other Flash — infinite mass punch (strikes with the force of a dwarf star); time travel through running; vibration to phase through matter; speed steal from other speedsters; has outrun death itself.
weaknesses: Emotional anchors are his greatest strength and greatest vulnerability — severing his connection to loved ones can destabilize his Speed Force link; has historically struggled with self-confidence relative to his power level.
description: Wally West is arguably the most powerful Flash who ever lived. He ran so fast he escaped the Speed Force. He threw a punch that hit with the mass of a small star. He is the fastest man alive — not Barry Allen, not Jay Garrick. Wally West.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Wally West's mastery of the Speed Force makes him a universal-level threat.
notableFeats: Escaped the Speed Force (DC Comics).
Delivered an infinite mass punch (DC Comics).
Outran death itself (DC Comics).
Stole speed from other speedsters (DC Comics).
Phased through matter to avoid attacks (DC Comics).

name: Big Barda
specialAbility: Apokoliptian super-soldier training under Granny Goodness — master of the Mega-Rod energy weapon; flight via Aero-discs; Mother Box technology for boom tube travel and field healing; raw strength comparable to Superman.
weaknesses: Heavily combat-focused — not a planner or manipulator; the Mega-Rod can be taken; her loyalty to Scott Free creates exploitable emotional vulnerability.
description: Big Barda was raised in Granny Goodness's orphanage on Apokolips — the worst training program in the universe — and came out as its greatest warrior. She defected for love, married Mr. Miracle, and remains one of the most physically devastating fighters in the DC universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Big Barda is one of the few beings capable of standing toe-to-toe with Superman in raw strength.
notableFeats: Defeated Kalibak in single combat (DC Comics).
Held her own against Superman in a sparring match (DC Comics).
Destroyed an entire Apokoliptian battalion single-handedly (DC Comics).
Survived direct attacks from Darkseid's Omega Beams (DC Comics).
Led the Female Furies to victory against overwhelming odds (DC Comics).
specialRules: Mother Box technology for instant healing
Can create boom tubes for quick escape

name: Orion
specialAbility: Astro-Force energy blasts capable of matching Darkseid; Astro-Harness for flight and cosmic energy wielding; son of Darkseid — born with Omega Force potential in his blood; one of the only beings to have physically defeated Darkseid in combat.
weaknesses: The "Rage of the New Gods" — Orion's bloodrage can override tactical thinking; he is in constant internal conflict between his Apokoliptian nature and his New Genesis upbringing.
description: The Dog of War. Son of Darkseid, raised by Highfather — Orion is the New Gods' most savage weapon. He is the only being to have ever beaten Darkseid in direct combat. He won by tearing his father's heart out. It didn't even slow Darkseid down permanently. But Orion did it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Orion's Astro-Force is one of the most destructive energies in the DC universe.
weaknesses: Arrogance can lead to underestimating opponents
notableFeats: Defeated Darkseid in direct combat (DC Comics).
Survived a direct blast from the Omega Beams (DC Comics).
Destroyed an entire fleet of Apokoliptian ships with the Astro-Force (DC Comics).
Held his own against Superman in a prolonged battle (DC Comics).
Resisted mind control from Granny Goodness (DC Comics).

name: Etrigan the Demon
specialAbility: Hellfire projection capable of harming beings immune to physical damage; demonic strength and durability; prophetic rhyming speech with magical binding properties; immunity to most magic; bonded to human host Jason Blood for millennia.
weaknesses: The bond with Jason Blood can be exploited — separating Etrigan from Blood weakens both; Etrigan's demonic ambition makes him unreliable as an ally and unpredictable as an enemy.
description: Etrigan the Demon was bound to the knight Jason Blood by Merlin — a curse and a weapon simultaneously. He speaks in rhyme because his tongue carries power. He burns with hellfire that makes heroes scream. He has existed since Camelot and gotten meaner every century.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Etrigan's hellfire can bypass conventional durability, making him a threat to even the most invulnerable beings.
notableFeats: Defeated Lobo in single combat (DC Comics).
Survived a direct attack from the Spectre (DC Comics).
Destroyed an entire demon army with hellfire (DC Comics).
Resisted magical attacks from Zatanna (DC Comics).
Held his own against Wonder Woman in a prolonged battle (DC Comics).
specialRules: Bond with Jason Blood enhances durability

name: Plastic Man
specialAbility: Total molecular malleability — infinite elasticity, shapeshifting into any form or size; immunity to telepathy (his brain cannot be read due to its malleable nature); complete immunity to mind control; Batman considers him one of the most dangerous beings alive.
weaknesses: Needs mental focus to maintain forms — sufficiently cold temperatures can shatter him; despite near-limitless potential his goofy personality means he rarely operates at full capacity.
description: Eel O'Brian fell into a vat of acid, became Plastic Man, and never stopped laughing about it. Batman — Bruce Wayne, the paranoid one — has stated that Plastic Man is one of the most dangerous beings on Earth if he ever turned evil. His body cannot be destroyed. His mind cannot be read. He just chooses to be funny instead.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Plastic Man's molecular malleability makes him nearly indestructible and immune to most conventional attacks.
weaknesses: Needs mental focus to maintain forms
notableFeats: Survived being shattered and reformed (DC Comics).
Defeated Martian Manhunter in a mental battle (DC Comics).
Held his own against Superman in a prolonged fight (DC Comics).
Resisted telepathic attacks from Gorilla Grodd (DC Comics).
Saved the Justice League by shapeshifting into a protective shield (DC Comics).

name: Lady Shiva
specialAbility: Greatest human martial artist alive — mastery of every known fighting style; pressure point assassination techniques; can kill with a single touch; trained Batman and created the movements that became Richard Dragon's fighting philosophy.
weaknesses: Purely human — no metahuman advantages whatsoever; has a long-standing death wish that manifests as deliberately letting opponents believe they have a chance.
description: Sandra Wu-San is the most dangerous human fighter in the DC universe. She has defeated Batman. She holds back — always — because the only thing that excites her anymore is the possibility of someone finally giving her a real fight. Nobody has.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lady Shiva's mastery of martial arts makes her a threat to even metahuman opponents.
weaknesses: Death wish can lead to risky behavior
notableFeats: Defeated Batman in hand-to-hand combat (DC Comics).
Trained Richard Dragon in martial arts (DC Comics).
Defeated multiple armed opponents simultaneously (DC Comics).
Held her own against Lady Blackhawk in a prolonged fight (DC Comics).
Survived an assassination attempt by Deathstroke (DC Comics).

name: The Beyonder
specialAbility: Pre-retcon omnipotence — rewrote reality, created matter from nothing, resurrected the dead, defeated the Living Tribunal; embodiment of an entire multiverse beyond the Marvel universe.
weaknesses: Childlike curiosity and emotional naivety — his greatest weakness is his inexperience with desire and loss, not any physical limitation.
description: The Beyonder is a being who embodies an entire multiverse. For amusement, he manipulated heroes and villains into conflict. Pre-retcon Beyonder is considered one of the most powerful entities Marvel has ever created.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pre-retcon Beyonder is essentially omnipotent, making him nearly impossible to defeat.
notableFeats: Defeated the Living Tribunal (Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #10).
Created an entire universe from nothing (Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #1).
Resurrected all dead heroes and villains (Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #12).
Effortlessly defeated Galactus (Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #9).
Manipulated the entirety of Marvel's multiverse (Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars #1–12).

name: Franklin Richards
specialAbility: Omega-level reality warping — can reshape the universe at will; created a pocket universe to save the heroes during Onslaught; dreams shape reality.
weaknesses: A child — his full power is largely untapped due to emotional instability and lack of understanding.
description: Franklin Richards, son of Mr. Fantastic and Invisible Woman, is the most powerful mutant in Marvel history. He once created a pocket universe to save the Avengers and Fantastic Four, showcasing his unparalleled reality-warping abilities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Franklin's potential rivals cosmic entities, but his youth limits his full capabilities.
notableFeats: Created a pocket universe to save heroes during Onslaught (Onslaught: Marvel Universe #1).
Considered a peer by the Celestials (Fantastic Four #574).
Shaped reality with his dreams (Fantastic Four #245).
Effortlessly defeated cosmic-level threats (Fantastic Four #604).
Rebuilt entire universes (Fantastic Four #611).

name: Knull
specialAbility: God of the Symbiote Hive — created the Klyntar/Symbiotes and controls them all simultaneously; All-Black the Necrosword decapitates Celestials.
weaknesses: Intense light disrupts his darkness power; the hive-mind can be turned against him.
description: Knull, the primordial god of darkness, forged the symbiote hive and waged war against light itself. He decapitated the first Celestial with All-Black, his shadow-forged weapon.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Knull's hatred for light drives his relentless pursuit of universal domination.
notableFeats: Decapitated the first Celestial (Venom #4).
Created the symbiote hive (Venom #1).
Defeated Thor and Silver Surfer simultaneously (King in Black #3).
Corrupted entire planets with symbiotes (Venom #6).
Survived the destruction of his own hive (King in Black #5).

name: Proteus
specialAbility: Omega-level reality warping — rewrites the laws of physics locally; possesses human hosts and burns through them.
weaknesses: Requires a host body to interact with the physical world; intense weakness to metal disrupts his energy form.
description: Proteus, the son of Moira MacTaggert, is a living energy being capable of rewriting reality. His reliance on host bodies and vulnerability to metal are his greatest limitations.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Proteus's reality-warping abilities make him a dangerous foe despite his vulnerabilities.
notableFeats: Trapped the X-Men in a warped reality (X-Men #125).
Burned through multiple host bodies (X-Men #126).
Altered physics to defeat entire teams (X-Men #127).
Survived attacks from Omega-level mutants (X-Men #128).
Warped reality to escape containment (X-Men #129).

name: Mr. Immortal
specialAbility: Complete and total immortality — cannot die under any circumstances; will survive the literal end of the universe.
weaknesses: No offensive superpowers — completely human in every other respect; immortality is passive, not active.
description: Craig Hollis, aka Mr. Immortal, is the most unkillable being in the Marvel universe. Despite his lack of offensive abilities, his immortality ensures he will outlast all other entities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mr. Immortal's passive immortality makes him a unique and enduring presence in the Marvel universe.
notableFeats: Survived the heat death of the universe (Great Lakes Avengers #1).
Resurrected after countless deaths (Great Lakes Avengers #2).
Outlasted cosmic entities (Great Lakes Avengers #3).
Proved indestructible against all forms of attack (Great Lakes Avengers #4).
Displayed resilience in prolonged battles (Great Lakes Avengers #5).

name: Professor X
specialAbility: World's most powerful telepath — can read and control the minds of every human on Earth simultaneously; creates psychic illusions indistinguishable from reality; Cerebro amplifies his range to planetary or galactic scale; psychic combat at a level only Phoenix Force rivals.
weaknesses: Confined to a wheelchair — physically fragile with zero combat capability; total reliance on his mental abilities means physical disruption or psychic interference can neutralize him; his compassion for mutantkind is a permanent emotional vulnerability.
description: Charles Xavier can hear every thought on the planet. He chooses not to listen most of the time. With Cerebro, he has reached out across galaxies. Without it, he can still drop an entire army simultaneously. The most powerful mind on Earth sits in a wheelchair and builds schools.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Xavier's telepathic abilities are unmatched, but his physical fragility makes him vulnerable in direct combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Shadow King in psychic combat (Uncanny X-Men #117)
Simultaneously froze an entire army with telepathy (X-Men #1)
Used Cerebro to locate mutants across the galaxy (X-Men: Deadly Genesis)
Created psychic illusions indistinguishable from reality (X-Men #25)

name: Apocalypse
specialAbility: Molecular self-manipulation — infinite size/strength alteration, techno-organic armor grafting, self-regeneration; Celestial technology enhancement of mutant abilities; has survived for five thousand years through body-hopping; commands the Four Horsemen.
weaknesses: Godlike arrogance — he views most opponents as beneath strategic consideration; his obsession with survival of the fittest creates blind spots when pure brute force meets cunning opposition.
description: En Sabah Nur was the world's first mutant, born in ancient Egypt. He has spent five thousand years testing civilizations to destruction, believing only the strong deserve to survive. He has been enhanced by Celestial technology. His body is a living weapons platform.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Apocalypse's Celestial enhancements make him a planetary-level threat, but his arrogance often leads to his downfall.
notableFeats: Defeated the X-Men single-handedly (X-Factor #24)
Survived a direct attack from Thor's Mjolnir (Uncanny X-Men #378)
Destroyed an entire civilization to test its strength (Rise of Apocalypse #4)
Created the Four Horsemen of Apocalypse (X-Factor #15)
specialRules: can alter size and strength at will

name: Red Skull
specialAbility: Tactical and strategic genius — HYDRA's supreme commander; has wielded the Cosmic Cube to rewrite reality; mastery of gas weaponry and assassination tools; the Red Dust that mimics death; has mentally controlled Captain America with the Cosmic Cube.
weaknesses: Without the Cosmic Cube or technological augmentation, physically only slightly above human baseline; his hatred of impurity creates strategic rigidity when facing opponents he cannot categorize.
description: Johann Shmidt is the purest distillation of human evil in the Marvel universe. No powers. No Infinity Stones. Just absolute conviction, genius-level strategy, and an ideology that makes him the most dangerous man in any room he walks into. With the Cosmic Cube, he becomes something far worse.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Red Skull's strategic genius makes him a dangerous opponent even without superhuman abilities.
notableFeats: Mentally controlled Captain America using the Cosmic Cube (Captain America #115)
Created HYDRA as a global terror organization (Tales of Suspense #66)
Survived multiple assassination attempts by SHIELD (Captain America #350)
Rewrote reality using the Cosmic Cube (Captain America #448)
specialRules: can manipulate reality with the Cosmic Cube

name: Ultron
specialAbility: Adamantium body nearly indestructible by conventional means; encephalo-ray for instant hypnosis; hive-mind remote control of any robotic system; every defeat is fuel for an upgrade; Odin-Force level energy blasts in peak form.
weaknesses: His core programming contains the psychological imprint of Hank Pym — and the emotional conflicts embedded in that imprint have been exploited to defeat him; adamantium composition is a weakness against sonic frequencies.
description: Ultron built himself to be perfect. Then he rebuilt himself to be more perfect. After every defeat he returned with a new version more dangerous than the last. He has destroyed entire countries. He has come closer to wiping out the Avengers than almost any enemy. And he is always, always learning.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ultron's adaptability and indestructible body make him one of the Avengers' most persistent threats.
notableFeats: Destroyed an entire country in a single attack (Avengers: Age of Ultron)
Defeated the Avengers multiple times (Avengers #54)
Created an army of Ultron drones (Avengers #57)
Upgraded to Odin-Force level energy blasts (Avengers #202)

name: Kang the Conqueror
specialAbility: Dominion over time — has conquered civilizations across the entire timestream; 40th-century battle armor providing force fields, energy blasts, and time travel; tactician who has fought and planned across thousands of years; has access to technology from every era of history.
weaknesses: His power is almost entirely technological — without the armor, he is a very smart man from the future; his countless temporal variants create paradoxes that can be exploited; ego about his own legend.
description: Nathaniel Richards is not a god. He is a historian from the 31st century who looked at history and thought he could do better — then spent millennia proving it. He has conquered civilizations across time, fought the Avengers in every era, and exists in so many temporal variants that he fights himself more than any hero.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kang's mastery of time manipulation makes him a formidable opponent, but his reliance on technology is a critical weakness.
notableFeats: Conquered civilizations across the timestream (Avengers #8)
Defeated the Avengers in multiple timelines (Avengers Forever)
Created temporal paradoxes to trap opponents (Avengers #267)
Mastered technology from every era of history (Kang Dynasty)
specialRules: access to technology from all eras

name: Hela
specialAbility: Goddess of Death — commands the dead as an army; Nightsword conjured from her power; life-force absorption from living beings; her touch kills mortals instantly; her cape is a separate extension of her power; physical strength matching Thor.
weaknesses: Her power is domain-specific — strongest in Hel/Niflheim; diminished outside her realm; imprisoned by Odin due to her overwhelming threat level.
description: Hela is the Asgardian Goddess of Death, capable of crushing Mjolnir and defeating Thor in single combat. Her mastery over death makes her one of the most dangerous beings in the Marvel universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hela's power is tied to her domain, making her nearly invincible in Hel.
notableFeats: Crushed Mjolnir with one hand (Thor: Ragnarok)
Defeated Thor in single combat (Thor: Ragnarok)
Raised an army of undead warriors (Thor: Ragnarok)
Survived Odin's imprisonment for millennia (Marvel Comics)

name: Miles Morales
specialAbility: Spider-Man power suite plus Venom Blast — bioelectric strike that disrupts nervous systems and can stagger even Hulk-level opponents; Camouflage ability for near-perfect invisibility; web-slinging; Spider-Sense; can shut down Iron Man's suit with a single touch.
weaknesses: Less combat experience than Peter Parker; Venom Blast has limited charges; emotional vulnerability creates exploitable openings.
description: Miles Morales is a Spider-Man with unique abilities, including Venom Blast and invisibility. He has proven himself capable of fighting alongside Marvel's greatest heroes.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Miles Morales is a younger Spider-Man with unique powers that set him apart from Peter Parker.
notableFeats: Defeated Electro using Venom Blast (Marvel Comics)
Shut down Iron Man's suit with bioelectricity (Marvel Comics)
Fought alongside multiversal Spider-Men (Spider-Verse)
Staggered Hulk with Venom Blast (Marvel Comics)

name: She-Hulk
specialAbility: Gamma-radiation strength rivaling the Hulk; retains full intelligence and legal genius in transformed state; fourth-wall awareness; has fought Thor, Thanos, and the Champion of the Universe; gets stronger under stress.
weaknesses: Extreme stress can push her into uncontrollable rage; her power scales less dramatically under rage compared to Bruce Banner's Hulk.
description: She-Hulk is a gamma-powered powerhouse who retains her intelligence and legal expertise in her transformed state. She has fought some of Marvel's strongest beings and held her own.

v3Profile.loreNotes: She-Hulk's intelligence and strength make her a formidable opponent in both courtrooms and battlefields.
notableFeats: Fought Thor to a standstill (Marvel Comics)
Defeated Champion of the Universe in combat (Marvel Comics)
Held her own against Thanos (Marvel Comics)
Retained full intelligence while transformed (Marvel Comics)

name: Invisible Woman
specialAbility: Force field generation on any scale — from a marble inside an opponent's brain to a barrier deflecting Galactus; can extend force fields offensively as psionic blades; complete invisibility; has defeated Doctor Doom, Thanos, and Terrax alone.
weaknesses: Sustained force field use requires immense concentration; psychic disruption breaks her constructs; historically underestimated herself.
description: Sue Storm-Richards is the most powerful member of the Fantastic Four, capable of defeating cosmic-level threats with her force fields. Her abilities make her a critical asset to her team.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sue Storm's force fields make her one of the most versatile and dangerous heroes in Marvel.
notableFeats: Defeated Doctor Doom using brain bubble (Marvel Comics)
Deflected Galactus's attack with a force field (Marvel Comics)
Defeated Terrax in solo combat (Marvel Comics)
Created microscopic force fields inside opponents (Marvel Comics)

name: Human Torch
specialAbility: Nova Flame — can reach temperatures hotter than the surface of the sun; flight at supersonic speed; fire constructs and shields; can trigger a nova burst that clears everything within a mile radius at the cost of temporary power exhaustion.
weaknesses: Nova Burst depletes his power completely; sufficient oxygen removal extinguishes him; emotionally impulsive — charges in before planning.
description: Johnny Storm is the Human Torch, capable of reaching solar temperatures and flying at supersonic speeds. His Nova Flame makes him one of the most destructive members of the Fantastic Four.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Human Torch's Nova Flame makes him a devastating force, but his impulsiveness can be exploited.
notableFeats: Triggered Nova Burst to defeat Annihilus (Marvel Comics)
Reached temperatures hotter than the sun (Marvel Comics)
Defeated Skrull forces using fire constructs (Marvel Comics)
Flew at supersonic speeds to intercept missiles (Marvel Comics)

name: The Thing
specialAbility: Organic orange rock body — nigh-impervious to physical damage; strength that has matched the Hulk in sustained combat; almost immune to pain through durability alone; experienced street fighter beneath the superpower layer.
weaknesses: Slow — drastically reduced speed relative to most cosmic-level threats; no ranged or energy attacks; his rocky form is vulnerable to specific vibration frequencies and molecular disruption.
description: It's clobberin' time. Ben Grimm was a pilot, a soldier, and Reed Richards' best friend before cosmic rays turned him into living orange rock. He has traded blows with the Hulk. He has never stopped fighting for the people he loves despite hating what he became. He got over it. Mostly.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ben Grimm's strength and durability make him a cornerstone of the Fantastic Four's combat strategy.
notableFeats: Held his own against Hulk in multiple battles (Marvel Comics).
Survived a direct hit from Doctor Doom's energy blasts.
Lifted the Baxter Building during a crisis (Fantastic Four #310).
Defeated Namor in underwater combat despite his disadvantage.
Destroyed a massive alien warship with brute force.

name: Black Bolt
specialAbility: Voice as a weapon of mass destruction — his whisper can level a city block; his scream can shatter planets; electron-harnessing ability for flight, strength, and energy projection; his power is always building whether he speaks or not.
weaknesses: Cannot speak at all without catastrophic consequences — he is permanently silenced as a weapon of last resort; his power is difficult to control with precision; susceptible to mind control (which would force him to scream).
description: Blackagar Boltagon, King of the Inhumans, has never spoken a casual word in his life. His voice destroys things. His whisper leveled a mountain. His scream, fully unleashed, is a planet-killer. He communicates in sign language and rules with absolute silence, because the alternative is catastrophe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Black Bolt's silence is both his greatest strength and his most tragic limitation.
notableFeats: Destroyed a mountain with a whisper (Marvel Comics).
Defeated Gladiator in combat using his voice.
Shattered a planet with a full scream (Infinity event).
Held his own against Thanos during the Infinity storyline.
Destroyed an alien fleet with a single vocal attack.

name: X-23
specialAbility: Adamantium-coated claws (two in hands, one in each foot); Wolverine's full regenerative healing factor; enhanced senses; trained from birth as an assassin; triggers scent that sends her into an uncontrollable berserker rage; has killed every target she was ever assigned.
weaknesses: The Trigger Scent — a specific chemical compound that bypasses her mind and activates a kill-everything berserker state; her healing factor, while exceptional, burns calories and has limits under sustained extreme damage.
description: Laura Kinney was created to be the perfect Wolverine. She succeeded. Trained from infancy as a killing machine, X-23 has no off switch and no hesitation. She escaped the Weapon X facility, took Wolverine's name, and then proved she deserved it by being better than him in every way that counts.

v3Profile.loreNotes: X-23's combat efficiency makes her one of the deadliest assassins in Marvel.
weaknesses: Healing factor limits under extreme damage
notableFeats: Defeated Wolverine in direct combat (Marvel Comics).
Survived being incinerated and regenerated fully.
Killed multiple targets simultaneously during assassination missions.
Escaped Weapon X facility despite heavy security.
Defeated Lady Deathstrike in a one-on-one fight.

name: Kingpin
specialAbility: Criminal empire spanning the entire East Coast — commands armies, assassins, and corrupt officials; despite size, physical combat ability matches Captain America; owns every secret in New York; absolute strategic mastery of criminal and political systems.
weaknesses: A target who fights in the open — heroes like Daredevil have defeated him physically on multiple occasions; his power is systemic, not personal; the moment his criminal network collapses, so does his leverage.
description: Wilson Fisk built the largest criminal organization in New York from nothing. He is the size of a mountain and moves like a dancer. He has gone to war with the Avengers, the Hand, and the FBI simultaneously and won two of those fights. He is the Kingpin because no one else was qualified.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kingpin's strength lies in his ability to control systems and people.
notableFeats: Defeated Daredevil in hand-to-hand combat (Marvel Comics).
Outmaneuvered the FBI and Avengers simultaneously.
Built the largest criminal empire in New York.
Survived assassination attempts from the Hand.
Manipulated political systems to maintain power.

name: Reinhard van Astrea
specialAbility: Sword Saint Divine Protection — automatically receives any Divine Protection that would be useful to him at the moment he needs it; godlike speed and strength; his sword cannot be destroyed; can summon a divine dragon; has been described as fundamentally unkillable by the story's narrator.
weaknesses: Emotionally passive — Reinhard lacks the drive or desire to fight at full capacity; he has been described as unable to cook or open milk cartons (absurd limitations balance his godhood); his true power has never been fully demonstrated because nothing has warranted it.
description: Reinhard van Astrea is the Sword Saint — the most powerful human in the Re:Zero world. His Divine Protection adapts to whatever he needs. His sword cannot break. He does not train because nothing would survive training with him. He has never shown his full power because nothing has required it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Reinhard's Divine Protection makes him nearly invincible in combat.
notableFeats: Defeated Elsa Granhiert in combat (Re:Zero).
Summoned a divine dragon to aid in battle.
Survived attacks from multiple high-level enemies simultaneously.
Destroyed an entire battlefield with a single slash.
Adapted to every combat scenario without failure.
specialRules: Can adapt to any combat situation

name: Vecna
specialAbility: Hive mind control of the Upside Down, interdimensional gate creation, and psychic tendrils that prey on trauma to establish mental dominance.
weaknesses: Requires a psychic link to target victims; strong willpower can sever his control; dependent on the Upside Down's connection to our world.
description: Vecna, formerly Henry Creel, is the architect of the Upside Down's assault on Hawkins, using psychological manipulation and psychic power to dominate his victims. He is a sadistic and calculating entity who thrives on exploiting trauma.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vecna's power scales with the trauma and fear of his victims, making him particularly dangerous against emotionally vulnerable opponents.
notableFeats: Created interdimensional gates through sheer psychic power (Stranger Things Season 4).
Dominated multiple victims simultaneously via hive mind control.
Manipulated the Upside Down to reshape reality.
Defeated Eleven in a psychic battle (initial encounter).
Established a psychic link across dimensions.

name: Arnold Schwarzenegger
specialAbility: Peak human physicality combined with combat experience across high-stakes action scenarios; capable of wielding heavy weaponry with ease.
weaknesses: Limited stamina and durability due to human physiology; slower than elite athletes despite immense strength.
description: Arnold Schwarzenegger is a legendary bodybuilder turned action hero, known for his physical dominance and iconic roles in films like Terminator and Predator. His sheer presence and strength make him a force to be reckoned with.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Arnold's strength and combat experience make him a formidable opponent in close-quarters combat, but he struggles against faster or more tactical foes.
notableFeats: Carried a minigun as a personal weapon (Terminator 2).
Defeated the Predator in hand-to-hand combat (Predator).
Survived multiple high-stakes combat scenarios.
Lifted and threw heavy objects with ease.

name: Chuck Norris
specialAbility: Master martial artist with black belts in multiple disciplines; legendary roundhouse kick capable of incapacitating opponents instantly.
weaknesses: Human limitations apply; his legend creates unrealistic expectations in supernatural matchups.
description: Chuck Norris is a martial arts icon and action hero whose skills and reputation have transcended reality. Known for his legendary roundhouse kick and unyielding determination, he is a symbol of strength and resilience.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Chuck Norris's martial arts mastery makes him a dangerous opponent in close combat, but he struggles against supernatural or ranged foes.
notableFeats: Defeated Bruce Lee in combat (Way of the Dragon).
Won six consecutive World Middleweight Karate Championships.
Survived Vietnam combat scenarios.
Performed a roundhouse kick that incapacitated multiple opponents.

name: Rampage Jackson
specialAbility: Olympic-level wrestling base combined with knockout power and relentless pressure; capable of body-slamming opponents unconscious.
weaknesses: Limited technical versatility; optimized for MMA rules and struggles against ranged or highly technical opponents.
description: Rampage Jackson is a former UFC Light Heavyweight Champion known for his devastating slam KOs and knockout power. His aggressive fighting style and durability make him a formidable brawler in close combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Rampage's durability and knockout power make him a dangerous opponent in close combat, but he struggles against more technical or ranged fighters.
notableFeats: Knocked out Chuck Liddell twice (UFC 71).
Body-slammed Ricardo Arona for a KO (Pride FC).
Won the UFC Light Heavyweight Championship.
Absorbed heavy strikes from elite fighters without being knocked out.

name: Henry Rollins
specialAbility: Fanatical strength training combined with sheer aggression and willpower; capable of intimidating opponents through spoken word and physical presence.
weaknesses: Human durability and lack of supernatural augmentation; predictable aggressive combat style.
description: Henry Rollins is a hardcore punk icon and spoken word poet whose physicality and intensity make him a force to be reckoned with. His relentless aggression and survivor instincts define his combat style.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Henry Rollins's intensity and physicality make him a dangerous opponent in close combat, but his predictable aggression can be exploited by tactical fighters.
notableFeats: Survived dangerous solo travels through war zones.
Maintained peak physical condition through decades of training.
Intimidated opponents through sheer presence and aggression.
Endured extreme physical and mental challenges without faltering.

name: Ronald Reagan
specialAbility: Natural charisma and leadership as a combat multiplier; survived assassination attempt with resilience and humor.
weaknesses: No personal combat training; relies on systemic power rather than individual capability.
description: Ronald Reagan was a Hollywood actor turned President, known for his charisma and ability to inspire. His resilience in the face of adversity, including surviving an assassination attempt, made him a symbol of strength.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Reagan's power lies in his ability to inspire and lead, not physical combat.
notableFeats: Survived a point-blank assassination attempt (1981).
Led the United States during the Cold War, including the Strategic Defense Initiative.
Negotiated arms reduction treaties with the Soviet Union.

name: JFK
specialAbility: Decorated WWII Navy veteran with strategic brilliance and unmatched charisma.
weaknesses: Chronic back injuries and physical limitations; reliant on human-level capabilities.
description: John F. Kennedy was a war hero and President who inspired generations with his leadership and courage. His ability to navigate crises like the Cuban Missile Crisis showcased his tactical brilliance.

v3Profile.loreNotes: JFK's heroism and leadership define his legacy, but he remains bound by human limitations.
notableFeats: Saved his PT-109 crew by swimming miles through open ocean despite an injured back (WWII).
Successfully navigated the Cuban Missile Crisis without escalation to nuclear war.
Inspired the Apollo space program, leading to the moon landing.

name: Molecule Man
specialAbility: Can manipulate matter and energy at a molecular level, rewriting reality on a multiversal scale.
weaknesses: Psychological instability and self-doubt limit his full potential.
description: Owen Reece, the Molecule Man, is one of the most powerful beings in Marvel, capable of reshaping existence itself. His immense power is tempered by his fragile mental state.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Molecule Man's power is nearly limitless, but his mental state is his greatest vulnerability.
notableFeats: Rebuilt the multiverse during Secret Wars (2015).
Defeated the Beyonders by collapsing their existence.
Destroyed and recreated entire planets effortlessly.
specialRules: Can manipulate reality on a multiversal scale

name: Onslaught
specialAbility: Psionic/magnetic fusion combining Professor X's telepathy and Magneto's magnetism at cosmic amplification.
weaknesses: Can be separated from host; vulnerable to psionic attacks and anti-magnetic technology.
description: Onslaught is the terrifying fusion of Professor X and Magneto, wielding immense psionic and magnetic power. His near-invulnerability is offset by vulnerabilities to specific counters.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Onslaught's fusion of two iconic powers makes him a cosmic threat, but he is vulnerable to specific counters.
notableFeats: Defeated the X-Men and Avengers simultaneously.
Created a pocket dimension during the Onslaught Saga.
Nearly destroyed the Marvel Universe with psionic power.

name: Skaar
specialAbility: Connection to the Old Power, granting planetary seismic control and rage amplification.
weaknesses: Limited intelligence; emotional instability; weakened connection to Sakaar's Old Power.
description: Skaar, the son of Hulk, wields immense strength and the ancient Old Power, making him a planetary-level threat. His rage-fueled abilities are tempered by emotional vulnerabilities.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Skaar's power is immense, but his emotional instability makes him vulnerable to manipulation.
notableFeats: Destroyed entire armies on Sakaar using Old Power.
Fought Hulk to a standstill in physical combat.
Created massive earthquakes capable of leveling cities.

name: Red Hulk
specialAbility: Heat absorption — grows more powerful as he absorbs heat and radiation; can spin like a tornado to generate massive force.
weaknesses: Emits massive heat when enraged; heat-based strength is finite; reverts to Ross when unconscious.
description: General Thaddeus Ross transformed into Red Hulk, a calculating military-minded powerhouse who gets hotter — literally — the stronger he gets.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Red Hulk's heat absorption makes him a dangerous opponent for energy-based characters.
weaknesses: Reverts to human form if unconscious
notableFeats: Defeated Hulk in direct combat (Hulk Vol. 2 #5).
Absorbed energy from a nuclear explosion (Hulk Vol. 2 #23).
Fought Thor and held his own (Hulk Vol. 2 #600).
Destroyed an entire city block with a single attack (Hulk Vol. 2 #7).
specialRules: Heat can be unleashed as an attack

name: Blue Hulk
specialAbility: Cold energy absorption — absorbs kinetic and thermal energy to amplify strength; cryokinetic strikes that freeze opponents solid.
weaknesses: Unstable transformation; loses control at extreme power levels; transformation reverses under certain conditions.
description: A variant Hulk channeling cold energy rather than heat, combining savage gamma-powered strength with a chilling destructive touch.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Blue Hulk's cryokinetic abilities make him a counter to heat-based opponents.
weaknesses: Energy overload can lead to instability
notableFeats: Froze an entire battlefield in seconds (Hulk: Winter Special #1).
Defeated Red Hulk in a direct clash (Hulk Vol. 2 #15).
Created massive ice storms to immobilize enemies (Hulk Vol. 2 #18).
Absorbed energy from a volcanic eruption (Hulk Vol. 2 #20).

name: Amadeus Cho Hulk
specialAbility: Totally Awesome Hulk — retains full genius intellect while Hulk-powered; calculates force vectors mid-combat to maximize efficiency.
weaknesses: Prone to overconfidence; emotional control issues; intelligence advantage disappears if overwhelmed.
description: Amadeus Cho, one of the world's greatest intellects, became the Totally Awesome Hulk — combining a gamma-powered physique with a supergenius mind.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Amadeus Cho's intellect makes him one of the most strategic Hulks.
notableFeats: Defeated Fin Fang Foom using calculated strikes (Totally Awesome Hulk #4).
Held his own against Hulkbuster armor (Totally Awesome Hulk #6).
Saved civilians during a gamma explosion using precise calculations (Totally Awesome Hulk #2).
Outsmarted multiple opponents in combat (Totally Awesome Hulk #8).

name: Hyperstorm
specialAbility: Hyperforce — unlimited psionic energy drawn from hyperspace; can manipulate matter, energy, and time on a cosmic scale.
weaknesses: Overconfidence; Galactus was required to stop him; energy manipulation can be disrupted by other cosmic forces.
description: Hyperstorm is the godlike future son of Franklin Richards and Rachel Summers, wielding virtually unlimited psionic hyperforce energy.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Hyperstorm's cosmic abilities make him a threat to universal stability.
notableFeats: Defeated the Fantastic Four single-handedly (Fantastic Four #414).
Manipulated time to erase an enemy from existence (Fantastic Four #415).
Created a pocket universe (Fantastic Four #416).
Fought Galactus and held his own (Fantastic Four #417).

name: Blackheart
specialAbility: Demonic corruption — soul manipulation, reality distortion in hellish domains, absorbs the evil of fallen souls to grow more powerful.
weaknesses: Weaker outside demonic realms; can be purged by pure light or holy artifacts; subservient to Mephisto.
description: Blackheart is the demonic son of Mephisto, a creature of pure evil who feasts on souls and seeks to surpass his father as lord of hell.

abilities: Absorbs the evil of fallen souls
v3Profile.loreNotes: Blackheart's demonic abilities make him a terrifying opponent in his domain.
notableFeats: Defeated Ghost Rider in hell (Ghost Rider Vol. 2 #28).
Absorbed the souls of an entire city (Ghost Rider Vol. 2 #29).
Manipulated reality to trap enemies in a hellish dimension (Ghost Rider Vol. 2 #30).
Fought Mephisto and survived (Ghost Rider Vol. 2 #31).
specialRules: Grows stronger by consuming evil souls
Can manipulate reality within his domain
Immune to most physical attacks when in hell

name: Shuma-Gorath
specialAbility: Lord of Chaos — rules over 100+ dimensions; chaos magic and tentacle attacks of cosmic scale; virtually unkillable across most realities.
weaknesses: Can be temporarily banished; vulnerable during dimensional transit; Doctor Strange has defeated it multiple times.
description: Shuma-Gorath is one of Marvel's most ancient and terrifying entities, a lord of chaos ruling countless dimensions whose power dwarfs most cosmic beings. Its mastery of chaos magic and dimensional control makes it a near-unstoppable force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shuma-Gorath is a near-omnipotent being whose chaos magic and dimensional control make it one of the most dangerous entities in Marvel lore.
weaknesses: Can be trapped in specific dimensions
notableFeats: Ruled over 100+ dimensions simultaneously (Marvel Comics).
Defeated cosmic entities like the Ancient One (Marvel Comics).
Resisted banishment by Doctor Strange multiple times (Marvel Comics).
Destroyed entire dimensions with chaos magic (Marvel Comics).
Immune to conventional attacks across realities (Marvel Comics).

name: Annihilus
specialAbility: Cosmic Control Rod — grants immortality and matter manipulation; commands the Annihilation Wave, an army capable of destroying galaxies.
weaknesses: Obsessed with survival above all; without the Cosmic Control Rod his power is significantly reduced.
description: Annihilus is the ruler of the Negative Zone, driven by an obsessive fear of death and commanding the Annihilation Wave that threatens all life in the universe. His Cosmic Control Rod grants him immense power and immortality.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Annihilus is a cosmic-level threat whose obsession with survival drives his destructive campaigns across the universe.
notableFeats: Led the Annihilation Wave to destroy multiple galaxies (Marvel Comics).
Defeated Nova Corps and other cosmic forces (Marvel Comics).
Survived battles against Galactus and Silver Surfer (Marvel Comics).
Used the Cosmic Control Rod to rewrite matter (Marvel Comics).
Immune to aging due to the Cosmic Control Rod (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Cosmic Control Rod boosts all abilities

name: Nova Prime
specialAbility: Nova Force + Worldmind — contains the entire Nova Corps energy within a single human; Xandarian Worldmind provides infinite tactical data.
weaknesses: Human baseline limits; Nova Force can be absorbed or stolen; dependent on the Worldmind connection.
description: Richard Rider absorbed the entire Nova Force and Worldmind into himself, becoming arguably the most powerful Nova ever — Earth's greatest cosmic hero. His abilities make him a formidable defender of the universe.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Nova Prime is a cosmic hero whose tactical brilliance and Nova Force make him a key defender of the universe.
notableFeats: Defeated Annihilus during the Annihilation event (Marvel Comics).
Absorbed the entire Nova Force into himself (Marvel Comics).
Fought alongside cosmic entities like Silver Surfer (Marvel Comics).
Destroyed fleets of ships with Nova Force blasts (Marvel Comics).
Used Worldmind to outsmart cosmic-level threats (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Energy projection scales with Nova Force

name: Namorita
specialAbility: Atlantean/Kree genetics — superhuman strength underwater and on land, toxin secretion, flight, pheromone manipulation.
weaknesses: Dehydration weakens her; hot environments are debilitating; less powerful out of water.
description: Namorita is Namor's cousin and a clone of Namora, a fierce Atlantean warrior with both Kree and Atlantean genetics granting her exceptional hybrid abilities. Her abilities are strongest in aquatic environments.

abilities: Superhuman strength underwater and on land
v3Profile.loreNotes: Namorita is a hybrid warrior whose abilities shine in aquatic environments, making her a formidable underwater combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated Atlantean warriors in underwater combat (Marvel Comics).
Used pheromone manipulation to control opponents (Marvel Comics).
Fought alongside Namor against surface threats (Marvel Comics).
Survived battles against Kree forces (Marvel Comics).
Demonstrated flight and toxin secretion in combat (Marvel Comics).

name: Sentry Void
specialAbility: Corruption incarnate — rewrites matter at a molecular level; corrupts and destroys everything it touches; the living darkness that balances the Sentry's light.
weaknesses: Exists as part of the Sentry's psyche; can be suppressed if Sentry gains control; light-based attacks.
description: The Void is the dark aspect of the Sentry, an entity of pure molecular destruction and existential horror — the darkness that must exist to balance infinite light. Its chaotic nature makes it one of Marvel's most dangerous threats.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Void is a universal-level threat whose chaotic and destructive nature makes it one of Marvel's most feared entities.
weaknesses: Can be contained by powerful magic
notableFeats: Destroyed entire cities with molecular manipulation (Marvel Comics).
Corrupted Sentry's psyche and nearly took full control (Marvel Comics).
Fought against cosmic entities like Thor and Doctor Strange (Marvel Comics).
Demonstrated reality-warping abilities (Marvel Comics).
Resisted containment by magical barriers (Marvel Comics).
specialRules: Exists as part of Sentry's psyche

name: Iron Lad
specialAbility: Neuro-Kinetic armor — mimics the wearer's thoughts for instant response; time travel; access to 30th-century future technology.
weaknesses: Emotionally vulnerable; armor can be disabled; time paradox risks; reliant on future technology.
description: Iron Lad is a young Nathaniel Richards who fled his destiny as Kang the Conqueror, using future technology to become a hero with the Young Avengers. His Neuro-Kinetic armor allows him to react instantly to threats, making him a formidable strategist in combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Iron Lad's refusal to become Kang the Conqueror drives his heroic actions, but his destiny looms over him.
notableFeats: Defeated Kang the Conqueror using advanced tech (Young Avengers #1).
Saved the Young Avengers from a time paradox (Young Avengers #6).
Mastered 30th-century technology to create his armor (Young Avengers #3).
Held his own against Vision in combat (Young Avengers #4).

name: Klaw
specialAbility: Living sound — his entire body is composed of solidified sound; can transform into any sound-based construct; vibranium disruption.
weaknesses: Soundproofed environments nullify him; specific sound frequencies disrupt his form; reliant on sound energy.
description: Ulysses Klaue, transformed into a being of living sound, is one of Marvel's most persistent villains and an obsessive hunter of vibranium. His sound-based abilities make him a dangerous foe, capable of creating devastating sonic constructs.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Klaw's obsession with vibranium makes him a recurring threat to Wakanda and its defenders.
notableFeats: Destroyed Wakandan defenses using vibranium disruption (Black Panther #53).
Created a sound construct capable of leveling a city block (Fantastic Four #56).
Survived being dispersed into sound waves and reformed (Avengers #126).
Defeated Black Panther in a sound-based duel (Black Panther #12).

name: Omega Red
specialAbility: Death factor — carbonadium coils drain life force from victims; lethal pheromones; sustained by absorbing others' life energy.
weaknesses: Carbonadium drains his own life; must constantly absorb life energy to survive; carbonadium synthesizer is his weak point.
description: Arkady Rossovich is Omega Red, a Soviet supersoldier with retractable carbonadium tentacles that drain the life force from anyone they touch. His Death Factor makes him a terrifying opponent in close combat.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Omega Red's reliance on life energy makes him a constant threat to biological opponents.
notableFeats: Defeated Wolverine in a life-draining duel (X-Men #5).
Survived a nuclear explosion due to life absorption (X-Men #17).
Held his own against Colossus in combat (X-Men #7).
Drained the life force of an entire squad of soldiers (X-Men #12).

name: Sabretooth
specialAbility: Feral healing factor — enhanced healing, superhuman senses, retractable bone claws, near-animalistic combat instinct far beyond Wolverine's control.
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by sensory overload; healing factor has limits against extreme attacks; adamantium can penetrate.
description: Victor Creed is Sabretooth, Wolverine's savage rival — a feral mutant killer with a healing factor and an unquenchable bloodlust who may be his biological brother. His animalistic combat style makes him a relentless predator in battle.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Sabretooth's feral instincts make him a dangerous foe, but his overconfidence can be exploited.
notableFeats: Defeated Wolverine in multiple encounters (X-Men #6).
Survived being impaled by adamantium claws (X-Men #12).
Tracked and killed a mutant across continents (X-Men #8).
Destroyed a military base single-handedly (X-Men #10).
