Speed Force vacuum pull — tears opponent into the Speed Force
phasing hand into body — molecularly disrupts internal organs
weaknesses: anti-Speed Force energy neutralizes all powers
intense cold slows molecular vibration and movement
psychic attacks land at normal reaction speed before he can dodge
rarely opens at maximum speed — tends to escalate
combatStyle: overwhelming speed advantage from round one
rapid successive strikes before opponent reacts
specialRules: Speed Force aura prevents self-damage from friction and pressure at extreme speed
can think and perceive at light speed — acts within opponents' reaction gaps
infinite mass punch multiplies kinetic force by relativistic mass increase at near-c velocity
can travel back through time to alter outcomes

name: Joker
specialAbility: Joker venom in dozens of lethal variants; acid flower; razor playing cards; electrified joy buzzer; psychotropic laughing gas; complete psychological unpredictability; immunity to his own toxins from repeated exposure; genius-level tactical chaos engineering
weaknesses: No superhuman physical abilities; overwhelmed by genuine physical superiority; often counts on enemies holding back; his chaos occasionally undermines his own plans
description: The Joker. There is no before. There is no origin. There is only the gag, and he's the only one laughing. A mind that treats mass murder as performance art and has matched Batman blow for blow for decades.

abilities: Joker venom deployment (laughing gas to lethal variants)
finishers: lethal dose Joker venom — forces a death-grin while organs fail
weaknesses: gas masks neutralize primary toxin delivery
opponents who simply overpower him physically
his own chaos can spiral out of his control
specialRules: complete immunity to his own toxins from decades of self-exposure
unpredictability makes him almost impossible to read or predict accurately
will sacrifice himself to win — no self-preservation instinct
genius-level intelligence operates with zero moral or logical constraints

name: Hawkgirl
specialAbility: Nth metal wings grant flight; nth metal mace completely nullifies magic; nth metal absorption enhances strength and durability; millennia of combat memories across countless reincarnations; Thanagarian warrior elite training
weaknesses: Nth metal can potentially be turned against her; direct cosmic or reality attacks bypass nth metal protection; aggressive fighting style can be exploited by patient tactical opponents
description: Shayera Hol — a Thanagarian warrior who carries the memories of every life she has ever lived, all of them spent fighting. Her nth metal mace doesn't just hurt magic users. It ends them.

counters: overwhelming range before she closes distance
finishers: diving mace strike from altitude — builds terminal velocity into impact
nth metal wing slice through opponent
magic nullification mace smash — ends magical defenses entirely
weaknesses: nth metal knowledge can theoretically be turned against her by those who understand it
non-magical cosmic or energy attacks bypass nth metal protection entirely
anger-driven fighting style is exploitable by calm tactical opponents
specialRules: nth metal mace completely negates magic and magical defenses on contact
millennia of reincarnated warrior memories give exceptional combat pattern recognition
nth metal wings are razor-edged weapons in close combat — not just for flight

name: Living Tribunal
specialAbility: Absolute authority over the entire Marvel multiverse; can instantly nullify the power of any being including Infinity Stones; reality restructuring on cosmic scale; omniscience across all timelines and dimensions; can erase entire universes; his three faces represent equity, vengeance, and necessity and must agree before he acts.
weaknesses: Requires unanimous agreement across all three faces before intervening; will not act in purely personal conflicts or mortal squabbles; surpassed only by the One-Above-All and the Beyonders.
description: The Living Tribunal is Marvel's supreme judge — a single entity that spans every universe in the multiverse simultaneously. He has voided the Infinity Gauntlet with a gesture. He doesn't fight. He adjudicates. When all three of his faces agree, reality itself bends to his ruling.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Living Tribunal is the ultimate arbiter of cosmic balance in Marvel's multiverse.
weaknesses: Bound by his own rules of equity, vengeance, and necessity
Cannot act without unanimous agreement of his faces
notableFeats: Voided the Infinity Gauntlet (Marvel Comics: Infinity Gauntlet #6)
Erased entire universes (Marvel Comics: Secret Wars II)
Judged the multiverse itself (Marvel Comics: Strange Tales #157)
specialRules: Requires unanimous agreement across three faces to act
Does not intervene in personal conflicts

name: Doctor Manhattan
specialAbility: Absolute matter and energy manipulation at the subatomic level; simultaneous existence across all points in time; teleportation; size alteration up to miles tall; disintegration and reassembly of anything; can create and destroy life; sees all possible timelines; restructured the entire DC multiverse during Doomsday Clock.
weaknesses: Emotionally detached — loses interest in outcomes; intrinsic fields can be disrupted by tachyon particles (temporarily); free will of others complicates his timeline predictions.
description: Dr. Jonathan Osterman — a physicist who was disintegrated in an Intrinsic Field Subtractor and rebuilt himself from pure energy. He is not a superhero. He is a god who still remembers being human, and that memory is fading. He restructured the DC multiverse with a thought.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Doctor Manhattan's power is unmatched in the DC universe, but his detachment makes him unpredictable.
notableFeats: Restructured the DC multiverse (DC Comics: Doomsday Clock #12)
Simultaneously existed across all points in time (Watchmen)
Disintegrated Rorschach with a thought (Watchmen)
specialRules: Tachyon disruption temporarily limits his omniscience
Emotionally detached — may lose interest in combat

name: Mr. Mxyzptlk
specialAbility: 5th-dimensional magic that operates completely outside 3D physical laws; can rewrite reality on a whim; transmutation of matter and energy; immune to all 3D-universe attacks; has powered Superman to near-omnipotence; once assisted against the Presence; reality erasure; unlimited wish-granting.
weaknesses: Bound by his own game rules — can be tricked into saying his name backwards (Kltpzyxm) to return to the 5th dimension; treats everything as a game and can be outsmarted.
description: Mr. Mxyzptlk is a 5th-dimensional imp for whom the laws of physics are a suggestion and reality is a plaything. When he's not causing chaos for fun, he's casually doing things that no 3D being — including Superman — can comprehend, let alone counter. He once helped Superman fight the Presence. For fun.

counters: Entities capable of exploiting his game rules
v3Profile.loreNotes: Mr. Mxyzptlk's power is nearly limitless, but his playful nature makes him vulnerable to clever opponents.
weaknesses: Bound by his own game rules
notableFeats: Powered Superman to near-omnipotence (DC Comics: Superman #50)
Assisted against the Presence (DC Comics: Action Comics #775)
Rewrote reality on a whim (DC Comics: Superman #30)
specialRules: Can be tricked into saying his name backwards to return to the 5th dimension

name: Cable
specialAbility: Telekinesis and telepathy; techno-organic virus suppression; time travel via bodyslide; Psimitar energy weapon; tactical genius with future military knowledge.
weaknesses: Constant effort required to hold the techno-organic virus at bay — any psychic disruption can accelerate it and deplete his power; time travel has unpredictable costs.
description: Nathan Summers — the son of Cyclops, born into a timeline of war. Half his body is consumed by the techno-organic virus his vast psionic power barely keeps in check. He is a soldier from the future, a tactician who has fought wars Earth hasn't had yet, wielding telepathy and raw telekinetic force alongside a rifle the size of a small car.

counters: Entities capable of accelerating the techno-organic virus
v3Profile.loreNotes: Cable's psionic power is immense, but his constant battle with the techno-organic virus limits his potential.
weaknesses: techno-organic virus costs him power to suppress
opponents who can induce virus acceleration
notableFeats: Held back Apocalypse with telekinesis (Marvel Comics: X-Men #15)
Defeated Stryfe in psychic combat (Marvel Comics: X-Force #18)
Time-traveled to prevent catastrophic events (Marvel Comics: Cable #1)
specialRules: The more energy spent fighting the TO virus, the weaker his powers — opponents who can force virus flare-ups neutralize him

name: Bishop
specialAbility: Energy absorption from any source; redirects absorbed energy as supercharged concussive blasts; the more he absorbs the stronger his output; expert gunfighter from the Xavier Security Enforcers.
weaknesses: Cannot absorb his own kinetic energy; requires energy input to use his powers — in an energy-dead environment he is baseline human; absorption has physical limits before overload.
description: Lucas Bishop came from a dystopian future where mutants wore brands on their faces. He joined the X-Men and became one of their most reliable heavy-hitters — a walking energy capacitor who turns enemy attacks into overwhelming counterstrikes.

counters: Opponents who rely on physical attacks
Entities capable of overloading his absorption
v3Profile.loreNotes: Bishop's ability to absorb and redirect energy makes him a formidable counter to energy-based opponents.
weaknesses: cannot absorb his own kinetic energy
physical impacts without energy don't feed him
overcharge can cause him to explode
notableFeats: Absorbed and redirected a nuclear explosion (Marvel Comics: X-Men #8)
Defeated energy-based opponents by overcharging (Marvel Comics: Bishop #3)
Held off multiple X-Men with absorbed energy (Marvel Comics: X-Men #287)
specialRules: Every energy attack used against Bishop increases his output — energy-based opponents fuel him
In an energy-dead environment he reverts to baseline human

name: Psylocke
specialAbility: Telepathy, psychic knife, precognition, telekinetic armor, and ninja combat mastery.
weaknesses: Physically vulnerable without psi-armor; psychic powers can be nullified by stronger telepaths or psychic-dead zones.
description: Psylocke is a British telepath inhabiting the body of a Japanese assassin, blending psychic powers with elite ninja combat skills. Her psychic knife strikes directly at the mind, bypassing physical durability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Psylocke's psychic knife is her signature weapon, feared for its ability to bypass conventional defenses.
notableFeats: Defeated Sabretooth in hand-to-hand combat (Uncanny X-Men #213).
Held her own against Jean Grey in a psychic duel (X-Men #31).
Used her psychic knife to incapacitate Archangel during his rampage (X-Force #4).
Deflected a telekinetic attack from Cable using her psi-armor (X-Men #29).
Led the X-Men on covert missions against the Hand (Uncanny X-Men #256).
specialRules: Psychic knife bypasses physical durability — it strikes the mind directly.
Psi-armor scales with her focus, enhancing durability.

name: Polaris
specialAbility: Magnetic manipulation, flight, molecular metal control, and iron-in-blood manipulation.
weaknesses: Non-magnetic materials are immune to her powers; emotional instability disrupts her focus.
description: Polaris, the daughter of Magneto, wields immense magnetic power capable of reshaping metal at the molecular level. Her abilities include flight, magnetic shielding, and battlefield control.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Polaris's magnetic abilities rival her father's, making her a formidable battlefield controller.
weaknesses: non-magnetic materials immune to her powers
opponents who can disrupt her concentration
notableFeats: Held off Magneto in a magnetic duel (X-Men #50).
Created a magnetic shield strong enough to deflect missiles (X-Factor #243).
Manipulated the iron in a villain's bloodstream to incapacitate them (X-Men #94).
Lifted an entire bridge using magnetic force (X-Men #60).
Generated an EMP to disable advanced technology (X-Factor #245).
specialRules: Can rip metal apart at the molecular level — metallic opponents are structurally at risk.
Can affect the iron in blood, causing internal hemorrhaging.

name: Havok
specialAbility: Plasma energy blasts, cosmic radiation absorption, and flight via plasma jets.
weaknesses: Requires containment suit for power modulation; emotionally erratic under pressure.
description: Havok, the younger brother of Cyclops, channels cosmic radiation into devastating plasma blasts. His powers make him immune to Cyclops's optic beams and capable of wide-area destruction.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Havok's plasma blasts are devastating but require careful control, making his containment suit essential.
weaknesses: cannot modulate blast power without his containment suit
notableFeats: Destroyed a Sentinel with a single plasma blast (X-Men #58).
Absorbed cosmic radiation from a collapsing star (X-Factor #12).
Deflected a missile barrage using plasma rings (X-Men #94).
Held off an entire squad of enemies with wide-area plasma bursts (X-Factor #245).
Survived a direct hit from Cyclops's optic blast without injury (X-Men #60).
specialRules: His blasts emit from his entire torso in rings — the coverage area makes dodging extremely difficult at close range.
Cyclops's optic blasts have zero effect on him.

name: Ms. Marvel
specialAbility: Embiggening, polymorph body shaping, accelerated healing, and adaptive combat.
weaknesses: Extended embiggen form drains stamina; healing factor is strong but not immediate.
description: Ms. Marvel, Kamala Khan, uses her Inhuman powers to reshape her body for combat, growing to giant size or mimicking others. Her enthusiasm and adaptability make her a unique fighter.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kamala's embiggening powers make her a versatile combatant, capable of adapting to various threats.
weaknesses: powerful mental attacks bypass her physical resilience
size increase makes her a larger target
notableFeats: Defeated a supervillain by growing to giant size and overpowering them (Ms. Marvel #5).
Used polymorph abilities to infiltrate a secure facility (Ms. Marvel #12).
Recovered from severe injuries mid-fight using her healing factor (Ms. Marvel #18).
Held off multiple enemies using elastic grapples (Ms. Marvel #22).
Mimicked another hero's fighting style to gain an advantage (Ms. Marvel #30).
specialRules: Embiggened form multiplies strike mass dramatically but drains stamina faster.
Healing factor recovers mid-fight from moderate damage.

name: America Chavez
specialAbility: Star portal punching, invulnerability, supersonic flight, and Thor-level strength.
weaknesses: Portal creation can misfire under stress; struggles against precision fighters and telepaths.
description: America Chavez punches star-shaped portals through the multiverse, combining invulnerability and raw strength with interdimensional travel. Her blunt fighting style is as direct as her personality.

v3Profile.loreNotes: America's star portals are her most versatile ability, allowing her to control the battlefield across dimensions.
weaknesses: portal creation can misfire under extreme stress
blunt fighting style struggles against precise technical fighters
telepaths can disrupt her instinctual combat approach
notableFeats: Punched through a dimensional barrier to save her team (Ultimates #2).
Matched Thor in raw strength during a sparring session (Ultimates #5).
Survived a direct hit from a cosmic entity without injury (Ultimates #8).
Used portal displacement to trap an enemy in another dimension (Ultimates #10).

Venom blasts can stagger Hulk-class opponents

Asgardians vulnerable to sufficiently powerful magical force
Dragonfang disarmed in rare extreme circumstances

abilities: Martial arts mastery (Bullseye, Daredevil, Fisk's best fighters)

photographic reflexes are reactive, not proactive

weaknesses: tiger soul can overwhelm human judgment during peak intensity
mystical suppression of cat form neutralizes her
emotional volatility in extreme conditions creates openings

Superhuman senses detect concealed opponents and emotional states

weaknesses: no innate superhuman strength beyond gem enhancement
novel threats require improvisation without her knowledge base
specialRules: Has catalogued weaknesses for every known supernatural creature — she knows exactly how to end anything that isn't fully original
Bloodstone gem provides supernatural energy blasts that bypass normal defenses

Charming deception can distract opponents mid-combat.

name: Megara
specialAbility: Sharp psychological insight; exploits weaknesses through conversation; true love immunity against death.
weaknesses: Physically normal; prior deal with Hades can be invoked against her.
description: Megara is a sharp-tongued survivor who uses her wit and psychological insight to outmaneuver opponents. Her resilience and refusal to let loved ones suffer define her strength.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Megara's strength lies in her ability to outthink and outmaneuver opponents, even supernatural ones.
weaknesses: Prior deal with Hades can be invoked against her.
Slow to accept help due to emotional armor.
notableFeats: Outmaneuvered Hades's plans (Hercules).
Protected Hercules from death through true love immunity (Hercules).
Exploited opponents' weaknesses through conversation (Hercules).
Survived dangerous situations using wit and resilience (Hercules).
specialRules: True love immunity overrides supernatural threats.
Underworld knowledge gives her an edge against mythological opponents.

name: Yokai
specialAbility: Controls millions of microbots via cerebral transmitter; forms constructs for offense and defense.
weaknesses: Cerebral transmitter is a single point of failure; mask limits peripheral vision.
description: Yokai uses a stolen microbot prototype to create an unstoppable swarm capable of forming constructs for offense and defense. His engineering genius makes him a formidable opponent.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Yokai's microbot swarm makes him nearly unstoppable, but his reliance on the transmitter is his greatest weakness.
weaknesses: Transmitter is a single point of failure.
Without microbots, he has no combat ability.
notableFeats: Created constructs capable of crushing vehicles (Big Hero 6).
Defended against multiple opponents using microbot armor (Big Hero 6).
Outmaneuvered Hiro's team with swarm-based tactics (Big Hero 6).
Destroyed structures using microbot constructs (Big Hero 6).
specialRules: Microbots form constructs with engineering precision.

name: Mor'du
specialAbility: Demon bear physiology; centuries of primal fury; near-invulnerable hide.
weaknesses: Curse stripped his humanity; enchanted arrows are effective against him.
description: Mor'du is a cursed prince turned into a demon bear, driven by centuries of primal rage. His near-invulnerable hide and immense strength make him a terrifying force.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mor'du's curse makes him a relentless force of nature, but his lack of humanity leaves him vulnerable to strategic exploitation.
weaknesses: Enchanted arrows are effective against him.
notableFeats: Survived centuries of combat without succumbing to injuries (Brave).
Destroyed structures with sheer force (Brave).
Overpowered multiple opponents simultaneously (Brave).
Resisted enchanted weapons for extended periods (Brave).
specialRules: Curse compounds over centuries, making him instinctively optimized against bear-fighting techniques.

name: Queen of Hearts
specialAbility: Absolute authority in Wonderland — her decrees are literally enforced by reality in her domain; commands an army of card soldiers and executioners; the flamingo-croquet mallet is a real weapon; her irrational logic is actually consistent within Wonderland's rules.
weaknesses: Outside Wonderland her authority collapses entirely; her temper makes her easy to provoke into ineffective rage; she relies entirely on her subjects to enforce her will and they are playing cards.
description: The Queen of Hearts rules Wonderland with a decree that precedes most problems: Off with their heads. In her domain, this works. Everything in Wonderland bends toward her certainty, including the geometry. Outside it, she is an extremely angry woman with a flamingo. Inside it, she is the most dangerous thing in a place where the rules are whatever she says they are.

abilities: Wonderland reality bending in her domain
Irrational logic is internally consistent in Wonderland
v3Profile.loreNotes: Her power is absolute within Wonderland but collapses entirely outside it.
weaknesses: Outside Wonderland her authority means nothing
Temper makes her easy to provoke into ineffective rage
Relies entirely on subjects to enforce will — subjects are playing cards
notableFeats: Reality bending in Wonderland — decrees like 'Off with their heads' are enforced instantly
Commanded an army of card soldiers to overwhelm Alice
Weaponized Wonderland's illogical geometry to trap opponents
specialRules: In Wonderland, her decrees are enforced by the fabric of the place — she says something happens and reality arranges it
Outside Wonderland her authority collapses entirely — she is only dangerous in her domain

name: Jack-Jack Parr
specialAbility: Seventeen or more confirmed superpowers including: laser vision, demonic transformation, dimensional phasing, metal form, fire body, duplication, telekinesis, levitation, and size alteration — powers activate randomly or in response to perceived threats.
weaknesses: Powers activate instinctively rather than intentionally — he cannot fully control what power activates when; infant cognitive capacity; distracted by cookies.
description: Jack-Jack Parr is a baby who is also seventeen superheroes in a onesie. He has demonstrated laser eyes, demon form, the ability to phase through matter, self-duplication, and transformation into solid metal — all before finishing his bottle. His powers respond to perceived threats with no filter. Fighting him means not knowing if the next hit comes from a laser, a tiny demon, or a toddler the size of a building.

abilities: All powers activate instinctively in response to threat
v3Profile.loreNotes: His powers are unpredictable and instinctive, making him a chaotic but formidable opponent.
weaknesses: Infant cognitive capacity — easily distracted (especially by cookies)
Powers activate instinctively, not intentionally — he cannot use the right power at the right time deliberately
Cannot be guided tactically by allies
notableFeats: Demonstrated 17+ powers including laser vision, demon form, and dimensional phasing in 'The Incredibles 2'
Overwhelmed Syndrome's robot with random powers in 'The Incredibles'
Survived multiple threats by instinctively activating the correct power
specialRules: Powers activate instinctively without control — opponents cannot predict which power responds to which threat
Fighting him means not knowing if the next hit comes from a laser, a tiny demon, metal fists, or a baby the size of a building

name: Walter White
specialAbility: Master organic chemist; improvised explosive synthesis (fulminated mercury, thermite); ricin and poison deployment; psychological manipulation and long-term scheming; ruthless adaptability under pressure.
weaknesses: Terminally ill with limited stamina; no physical combat capability; pride causes critical strategic mistakes when he believes he has already won.
description: A chemistry teacher turned drug kingpin. Walter White's genius lies in his willingness to destroy anything — including himself — to win. He doesn't fight with fists. He fights with patience, poison, and inevitability.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Walter White's strength lies in his intellect and willingness to sacrifice everything for victory.
notableFeats: Destroyed Tuco's hideout with fulminated mercury in 'Breaking Bad'
Poisoned Lydia with ricin in 'Breaking Bad'
Outmaneuvered Gus Fring using long-term scheming
specialRules: Relies on psychological manipulation to destabilize opponents

name: Ragnar Lothbrok
specialAbility: Viking warfare — raids, siege tactics, and open battle; farmer-turned-strategist who incorporated French siege technology before any other Norse leader; psychological manipulation of enemies and allies alike; survived things that should have killed him repeatedly.
weaknesses: Human limits; later years consumed by addiction and grief; the gods he believed in were sometimes the things that killed him.
description: The Legendary Viking. Ragnar Lothbrok was a farmer who raided Paris, befriended a monk, became King of Kattegat, and raised sons who shook the world. His greatest weapon was not an axe. It was curiosity — about enemies, about gods, about what was over the next horizon.

abilities: Incorporated foreign technology into Norse strategies
v3Profile.loreNotes: Ragnar's curiosity and adaptability made him one of history's most formidable Viking leaders.
weaknesses: Addiction and grief in later years
Belief in gods sometimes led to fatal decisions
notableFeats: Raided Paris using advanced siege tactics in 'Vikings'
Defeated Earl Haraldson to become Earl of Kattegat
Survived being thrown into a pit of snakes

name: Ivar the Boneless
specialAbility: Strategic genius who rarely lost a battle; psychological warfare and terror as military strategy; compensates for paralyzed legs with a wheeled cart, battle-axe mastery, and unconventional tactics that opponents never anticipate.
weaknesses: Cannot walk — mobility is permanently limited; psychological volatility leads to catastrophic decisions when emotionally destabilized; killed people he loved as tactical instruments.
description: Ivar the Boneless conquered England. He cannot walk. He is carried into battle on a cart and fights with an axe. His genius is tactics so brutal and unexpected that full armies broke before contact. He has no sympathy for weakness because he has had to be stronger than all of it.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Ivar's cunning and brutality made him one of the most feared Viking leaders.
weaknesses: Cannot walk — mobility is permanently limited
Psychological volatility leads to catastrophic decisions
Killed people he loved as tactical instruments
notableFeats: Conquered England using terror tactics in 'Vikings'
Defeated armies with unconventional strategies despite mobility limitations
Instilled fear in enemies before battle, breaking morale
specialRules: Excels in psychological warfare and terror tactics
Compensates for mobility limitations with unconventional strategies

name: Lord Loss
specialAbility: Master of all demonic magic; near-invulnerable in his own realm; eight spider arms deal lethal wounds; feeds on grief and suffering.
weaknesses: Bound by a chess gambit — defeat him in chess while his familiars fight and he is bound; emotionally haunted by lost love.
description: The most powerful of the demon masters. A grotesque creature of flowing entrails and spider arms who savours human suffering. Only Beranabus could truly challenge him.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Lord Loss is nearly invincible in his own realm, but vulnerable to specific rituals and emotional manipulation.
notableFeats: Defeated armies of mages in his realm (Demonata series)
Created realms of suffering to trap victims (Demonata series)
Fought Beranabus to a standstill (Demonata series)
Destroyed entire dimensions with his magic (Demonata series)

name: Beranabus
specialAbility: Centuries-old battle mage; channels raw magic to destroy demons; survived longer than any other human mage.
weaknesses: Mortal body; sacrificed himself to seal the Demonata out of the human universe.
description: Ancient battle mage who spent millennia hunting demons. The most experienced human warrior against the Demonata.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Beranabus is a master strategist who relies on preparation and magical expertise to overcome stronger foes.
notableFeats: Sealed the Demonata from the human universe (Demonata series)
Defeated multiple demon masters in combat (Demonata series)
Survived centuries of battles against demons (Demonata series)
Trained the next generation of mages (Demonata series)

name: Grubbs Grady
specialAbility: Werewolf-mage fusion; immense magical power merged with bestial strength; can rip demon masters apart at peak power.
weaknesses: Transformation is unstable; magic consumes the user from inside.
description: Teenager who became one of the most powerful mages alive by fusing werewolf heritage with raw Demonata magic.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Grubbs Grady's fusion of werewolf and mage powers makes him a unique and unpredictable combatant.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple demon masters in combat (Demonata series)
Survived battles against Lord Loss (Demonata series)
Fused werewolf and mage powers (Demonata series)
Destroyed demon armies single-handedly (Demonata series)

name: Kernel Fleck
specialAbility: Opens windows between universes; sees light patches invisible to others; master of dimensional travel.
weaknesses: Not a front-line combatant; power relies on maintaining concentration.
description: Disciple who can open windows to the Demonata universe. His sight into other worlds makes him invaluable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kernel Fleck's ability to manipulate dimensions makes him a key support character in battles against the Demonata.
notableFeats: Opened portals to escape demon armies (Demonata series)
Created dimensional rifts to trap demons (Demonata series)
Navigated the Demonata universe with precision (Demonata series)
Saved allies using light patch vision (Demonata series)

name: Dervish Grady
specialAbility: Battle mage trained by Beranabus; can channel magic directly into demon flesh; motorcycle-riding demon hunter.
weaknesses: Shakra disorder gradually robbed him of his magic; relies on skill when power fails.
description: Grubbs' uncle and guardian. A veteran mage who hunted demons across countless worlds.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Dervish Grady's experience and adaptability make him a formidable opponent despite his declining magic.
notableFeats: Defeated demon armies alongside Beranabus (Demonata series)
Trained Grubbs Grady in magic combat (Demonata series)
Survived battles against demon masters (Demonata series)
Hunted demons across dimensions (Demonata series)

name: Bec
specialAbility: Ancient Celtic priestess; merged with Grubbs to preserve her soul across millennia; immense magical reserves
weaknesses: Sacrificed herself to preserve humanity; power is shaped by emotion
description: A mage from Celtic times who survived across millennia inside others' minds. Her sacrifice helped seal the Demonata invasion.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her magic is deeply tied to her emotional state, making her unpredictable in combat.
notableFeats: Sealed the Demonata invasion (Demonata series)
Merged her soul with Grubbs to survive across millennia (Demonata series)
Created powerful magical barriers against demon hordes (Demonata series)

name: Juni Swan
specialAbility: Disciple-trained magic; expert deceiver; worked inside the disciples for years undetected
weaknesses: Betrayal depended on trust; when exposed her power alone could not match Beranabus
description: A Disciple who secretly worked for Lord Loss. Her betrayal cost the mages dearly.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Her betrayal was a turning point in the war against the Demonata.
weaknesses: inferior raw power compared to top-tier mages
notableFeats: Deceived the Disciples for years while working for Lord Loss (Demonata series)
Created powerful illusions to mislead enemies (Demonata series)
Survived encounters with Beranabus through cunning and deception (Demonata series)

name: Mr. Tiny
specialAbility: Manipulates fate and time itself; created the Little People; authored the Saga's outcome centuries in advance
weaknesses: Prefers to watch rather than fight; bound by a perverse love of chaos and free will
description: The most powerful being in the Darren Shan universe. A cheerful monster who shapes history for entertainment. Neither vampire nor vampaneze answer him — he answers to nothing.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mr. Tiny's manipulations are the backbone of the Saga's events.
notableFeats: Created the Little People (Cirque Du Freak series)
Manipulated the fate of Darren and Steve for centuries (Cirque Du Freak series)
Warped time and reality to shape the Saga's outcome (Cirque Du Freak series)

name: Steve Leonard
specialAbility: Vampaneze Lord; near-invincible when destiny aligned; centuries of hatred-fuelled combat training
weaknesses: Consumed by obsession with destroying Darren; destiny made him predictable
description: Darren's best friend turned Vampaneze Lord. Manipulated by Mr. Tiny into a war he was meant to win.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Steve's hatred for Darren drives his combat prowess but also makes him predictable.
notableFeats: Led the Vampaneze in the war against vampires (Cirque Du Freak series)
Survived multiple battles against Darren Shan (Cirque Du Freak series)
Achieved near-invincibility when destiny aligned (Cirque Du Freak series)

name: Vancha March
specialAbility: Fights with bare hands and shurikens only; immune to vampire weapons from decades of conditioning; iron-skinned from refusing protection
weaknesses: Refuses weapons beyond shurikens; pure stubbornness sometimes overrides tactical sense
description: Wild Vampire Prince who hardened himself through brutal self-discipline. Never used a blade, preferring tooth and nail.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Vancha's feral combat style makes him unpredictable but limits his tactical flexibility.
notableFeats: Survived decades of conditioning to become immune to vampire weapons (Cirque Du Freak series)
Fought numerous battles against Vampaneze (Cirque Du Freak series)
Refused protection and hardened his body through sheer discipline (Cirque Du Freak series)

name: Larten Crepsley
specialAbility: Centuries of vampire combat experience; supernatural speed; uses Madam Octa as a weapon.
weaknesses: Code of honor limits ruthlessness; vulnerable to sunlight.
description: Larten Crepsley is an ancient vampire performer and mentor to Darren Shan, known for his exceptional combat skills and wisdom. He sacrificed himself to protect the Cirque Du Freak and his allies.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Larten Crepsley is a key figure in the vampire world, respected for his wisdom and combat prowess.
notableFeats: Defeated multiple vampaneze in combat
Mentored Darren Shan through vampire trials
Sacrificed himself to save allies (Cirque Du Freak series)

name: Darren Shan
specialAbility: Half-vampire speed and strength; flits between shadows; hardened by vampire trials.
weaknesses: Half-vampire limitations; vulnerable to sunlight; human empathy limits ruthlessness.
description: Darren Shan is a half-vampire who rose to become a Vampire Prince, ending the war between vampires and vampaneze. He sacrificed his life to rewrite the future dictated by Mr. Tiny.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Darren Shan's journey from half-vampire to Vampire Prince showcases his resilience and growth.
notableFeats: Survived vampire trials (Cirque Du Freak series)
Ended the vampire-vampaneze war
Sacrificed himself to rewrite Mr. Tiny's future

name: Paris Skyle
specialAbility: Millennia of accumulated wisdom; commands absolute loyalty among vampires.
weaknesses: Ancient age makes him physically weaker than younger vampires.
description: Paris Skyle is the eldest Vampire Prince, revered for his wisdom and leadership. He remembers times before recorded history and serves as a guiding figure for the vampire clans.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Paris Skyle's wisdom and leadership are unmatched, making him a cornerstone of vampire society.
notableFeats: Guided vampire clans for millennia
Served as the eldest Vampire Prince (Cirque Du Freak series)
Preserved vampire traditions and history

name: Harkat Mulds
specialAbility: Impervious grey flesh; tireless; past-life memories unlock over time.
weaknesses: Cannot speak without his mask; existential leash to Mr. Tiny.
description: Harkat Mulds is a Little Person stitched together from the soul of Kurda Smahlt. He is Darren Shan's loyal companion, enduring countless trials with unwavering resolve.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Harkat Mulds is a unique creation of Mr. Tiny, serving as a steadfast ally to Darren Shan.
notableFeats: Endured countless trials alongside Darren Shan
Displayed tireless loyalty and resilience (Cirque Du Freak series)
Unlocked past-life memories to aid in combat

name: Kurda Smahlt
specialAbility: Cunning political strategist; expert in vampire lore; mapped every vampire mountain passage.
weaknesses: Chose peace over duty; conscience unraveled his betrayal.
description: Kurda Smahlt was a vampire who betrayed his clan for peace, ultimately dying for his ideals. He was reincarnated as Harkat Mulds, serving as a reminder of his past actions.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kurda Smahlt's betrayal and reincarnation highlight his complex character and ideals.
notableFeats: Mapped every vampire mountain passage (Cirque Du Freak series)
Betrayed vampire clan for peace
Reincarnated as Harkat Mulds

name: Murlough
specialAbility: Rogue vampaneze with no code; hunted humans for sport; unpredictable savagery
weaknesses: Sanity eroded by isolation; no allies and no strategy
description: A mad, rogue Vampaneze who broke every rule of his kind. Hunted by Crepsley for his crimes.

name: Hercules
specialAbility: Divine strength; near-invulnerability; Olympic-god stamina; lightning-speed punches
weaknesses: Loss of godhood when mortal; overconfidence; compassion exploited by enemies
description: Son of Zeus, raised mortal, restored to godhood. Possesses the strength of the Olympian gods — strong enough to hold up the heavens. Trained by Philoctetes into a genuine hero.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Zeus-born, Hera-cursed, Hercules fought his way back to godhood. At full power his strength is continental in raw output. Unlike MCU Hercules, Disney's version is played straight as the definitive demigod of myth.
haxAbilities: divine stamina — does not tire normally
godly constitution — immune to most toxins
notableFeats: held up the sky (Atlas feat)
slew the hydra
defeated Hades' army of undead
fought the Titans alongside the Olympians
specialRules: divine strength scales with emotional intensity — when protecting loved ones, output spikes
near-immune to physical damage at full god-mode

name: Mufasa
specialAbility: King of the Pride Lands; spirit presence; apex predator lion; tactical pack leader
weaknesses: Protective instinct exploited; ghost form is non-physical; no ranged attack
description: The Lion King in his prime. Mufasa is the apex alpha lion of the savannah — immense strength, controlled ferocity, and the spiritual authority of a king who commands the Great Kings of the Past.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Mufasa's physical stats are peak lion — potentially the strongest individual lion in Disney. His spiritual manifestation post-death is a genuine power, not metaphor.
haxAbilities: spirit presence — can manifest after death to inspire or intimidate
notableFeats: ruled the Pride Lands as undisputed alpha
trained Simba in combat fundamentals
drove off three hyenas alone
appeared to Simba across the spirit plane
specialRules: spirit form: post-death can appear to inspire allies, but cannot deal damage in ghost state

name: Shere Khan
specialAbility: Perfect predator form; tactical intelligence; calculated ambush; fear of fire
weaknesses: Pathological fear of fire; arrogance causes underestimation; no supernatural abilities
description: Bengal tiger who rules the jungle by reputation alone. Shere Khan does not need to fight — his presence breaks enemies before combat begins. When he does fight, it is surgical and final.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shere Khan in both the 1967 and 2016 versions is treated as the most dangerous predator in the jungle by every animal, including ones that could physically match him. His real weapon is psychological dominance.
weaknesses: fire — genuine phobia, breaks composure entirely
notableFeats: ruled jungle through reputation and zero defeats
hunted humans and never failed
fought Baloo to a standstill before fire intervention
specialRules: presence effect — enemies with no supernatural durability must pass a composure check or lose initiative

name: Shego
specialAbility: Plasma energy generation; expert martial arts; comet-granted powers; sarcasm as weaponized personality
weaknesses: Works for hire — no long-term loyalty or plan; plasma can be reflected; overconfidence against weaker opponents
description: Former hero turned mercenary villain. Hit by a comet that gave her the ability to generate plasma energy from her hands. Combined with exceptional hand-to-hand combat, she's arguably the most dangerous human-scale fighter in Disney.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shego is canonically Kim Possible's hardest fight every single time. Her plasma powers plus combat training puts her above any normal peak-human fighter and closer to low-superhuman.
haxAbilities: plasma generation — energy that burns through most materials
notableFeats: routinely defeats Kim Possible at full effort
fought Team Go (her superhero family) alone
plasma-cut through reinforced doors and vehicles
specialRules: plasma energy bypasses standard physical armor — energy-resistant shields still apply
comet-granted powers make her durable against physical strikes above peak human baseline

name: Kim Possible
specialAbility: World-class martial arts; cheerleader acrobatics; Wade-supplied tech; global spy network
weaknesses: No superhuman physical stats; relies heavily on tech; compassion can be exploited
description: High school cheerleader-turned-global spy who saves the world as a hobby. Her martial arts draw from dozens of styles. She's beaten enhanced opponents through technique, prep, and improvisation.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Kim is best classified as a high-end peak human — her cheerleading gives her acrobatics that exceed normal human range, and her martial arts training is genuinely world-class.
weaknesses: no superhuman stats — enhanced strength beats her physically
notableFeats: defeated Shego in their final battle
neutralized Drakken's world domination plans dozens of times
fought Warmonga, an alien warrior
specialRules: Wade support — can call in gear mid-mission if communication is not cut
cheerleader athletics exceed normal human acrobatic ceiling

name: Perry the Platypus
specialAbility: O.W.C.A. elite agent; master martial arts; jetpack; extensive gadget array; double-life deception expert
weaknesses: Small size limits raw reach; cover identity constrains mission parameters
description: Agent P. A semi-aquatic egg-laying mammal of action. O.W.C.A.'s most decorated field agent, who defeats Dr. Doofenshmirtz's elaborate schemes daily while appearing to be a mindless pet.

counters: large opponents with overwhelming physical stats
v3Profile.loreNotes: Perry is the platypus fighting style — a unique martial art designed for semi-aquatic creatures. His intelligence score reflects elite spy operational IQ, not academic intelligence.
notableFeats: defeated Doofenshmirtz hundreds of times
fought robot armies single-handedly
out-maneuvered other elite O.W.C.A. agents
specialRules: must maintain civilian cover — cannot reveal agent status to Phineas and Ferb
O.W.C.A. support network can airdrop equipment mid-mission

name: Bill Cipher
specialAbility: Reality warping; dimensional omniscience; deals in dangerous knowledge; can possess minds; Weirdmageddon transformation
weaknesses: Bound by deals he makes; can be trapped in his own memory maze; weakness to a specific memory-triggered punch
description: A dream demon from the Nightmare Realm. In his full Weirdmageddon form, Bill Cipher warped physical reality across Gravity Falls and began reshaping the world in his image. Defeated only by a trick played on his own arrogance.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Bill is Disney's most powerful villain by raw capability. His only losses come from enemies exploiting the rules he himself imposed (deal-binding, memory triggers). In open combat with no specific counter, he wins.
signatures: it's funny how dumb you are
weaknesses: bound by deals he makes — loopholes can be used against him
notableFeats: initiated Weirdmageddon — a full reality collapse event
survived the physical realm against characters who should have stopped him
possesses centuries of multidimensional knowledge
specialRules: in the physical realm, Bill can rewrite local reality — gravity, matter, time all bend to his will
deals made with Bill are binding on BOTH parties — this is his one limitation

name: Shang
specialAbility: Imperial Chinese military elite training; exceptional swordsmanship; superior tactics; peak physical conditioning
weaknesses: No supernatural abilities; conventional military thinking can be exploited by unpredictable opponents
description: Captain Li Shang of the Chinese Imperial Army. Son of General Li, trained from birth in military combat. Mulan's commanding officer and the physically superior fighter in the regiment.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Shang is the physical peak of what Disney's peak-human military fighters look like — disciplined, strong, technically excellent. No supernatural element, but genuinely at the ceiling of trained human combat.
weaknesses: rigid training can be exploited by chaotic fighters
notableFeats: led a small regiment to victory over Shan Yu's army
trained from raw recruits to functioning soldiers
physically outperformed every member of his unit
specialRules: military commander bonus — in team fights, allies under his command get a coordination bonus

name: Mushu
specialAbility: Fire breathing; small fast target; ancestral spirit connection; gong-wakening power
weaknesses: Tiny size limits physical impact; easily grabbed or restrained; reliant on fire element
description: Mulan's tiny but fierce dragon guardian. A disgraced Fa family ancestor spirit in dragon form. What he lacks in size he compensates for with fire, speed, and sheer force of personality.

counters: large AoE attacks that don't miss small targets
v3Profile.loreNotes: Mushu is physically tiny but his fire breath is genuine and can damage opponents well above his weight class. Against anything that can grab him, he loses fast.
signatures: I am a great stone dragon
notableFeats: fire-blasted Shan Yu's falcon
helped coordinate the avalanche that defeated Shan Yu's army
woke up the ancestors with a gong (non-combat but demonstrates supernatural link)
specialRules: fire breath can ignite environments — arena hazard creation
small size makes him nearly impossible to hit with large area attacks

name: Baloo
specialAbility: Enormous size and weight; bear crushing strength; surprisingly fast for size; lovable chaos fighter
weaknesses: No tactical discipline; easily distracted; slower than most combat-trained opponents
description: The bare necessities. Baloo is a massive Sloth Bear who fights primarily through raw size, weight, and surprising speed. Not trained, but a genuine natural combatant when pushed.

finishers: the full body bear hug crush
v3Profile.loreNotes: Baloo is an untrained natural combatant whose physical mass is genuinely dangerous. Against trained fighters he struggles, but he can absorb hits that would destroy smaller opponents.
notableFeats: physically fought King Louie's giant apes
fought Shere Khan alongside Mowgli
survived a direct engagement with the jungle's apex predator
specialRules: bear hug — if grab lands, damage output triples due to crush force

name: King Louie
specialAbility: Gigantopithecus scale; overwhelming physical strength; enormous reach; army of apes; wants man's red fire
weaknesses: Poor tactical thinking; no projectile attacks; environment dependent; fire terrifies his followers
description: King of the Bandar-log apes. In the 2016 version, Louis is a massive Gigantopithecus — a physically extinct great ape of immense size. He commands an entire ape army and fights with raw primate power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: 2016 film Louis is a Gigantopithecus — the largest primate to have ever lived. He's substantially more powerful than a gorilla and fights with the weight of true giant-primate physiology.
notableFeats: physically held up a crumbling temple during combat
fought Baloo to a standstill
commands absolute loyalty from hundreds of jungle apes
specialRules: ape army — in open-area fights Louis commands 20+ ape followers who swarm independently

name: Robin Hood
specialAbility: Master archer at impossible ranges; expert swordfighter; disguise master; steals from the rich with style
weaknesses: No supernatural abilities; operates within moral code (won't kill innocents); outnumbered scenarios
description: The people's hero of Sherwood Forest. Disney's Robin Hood (a fox) is a master of archery, swordsmanship, and escape artistry. His shots curve, deflect off objects, and hit targets no normal archer can reach.

counters: supernatural speed that closes range before arrows fire
v3Profile.loreNotes: Disney's Robin Hood fights smarter than anyone his weight class. His archery accuracy is presented as borderline supernatural — shots that by physics shouldn't connect, do.
notableFeats: stole from Prince John's castle multiple times with no detection
defeated guards numbering in the dozens through misdirection
archery that borders on superhuman accuracy
specialRules: trick shot — once per round can attempt a ricochet arrow that hits from cover

name: Merlin
specialAbility: Shapeshifting; reality-bending sorcery; time-sight; magical combat transformations; centuries of knowledge
weaknesses: Age limits physical combat; primarily a knowledge and magic user; Madam Mim is a natural rival
description: The greatest wizard of Arthurian legend. Disney's Merlin has lived forwards and backwards in time, can transform himself and others into any creature, and has access to centuries of magical knowledge.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Merlin is more knowledge-based than raw-power-based. Against magical opponents he's formidable. Against someone who rushes him before he can transform, his physical frailty is exposed.
weaknesses: physical baseline is old man — vulnerable without magic
Madam Mim is a natural foil
notableFeats: lived forward through time — has foreknowledge
won the wizard duel against Madam Mim

counters: sunlight if she agreed to the rule
v3Profile.loreNotes: Madam Mim is fascinating because she lost to Merlin via a technicality (a disease transformation she didn't anticipate), not because she was weaker. In open combat with no rule set, she might actually win.
weaknesses: lost to Merlin via sunlight rule (measles)
overconfidence makes her accept unfavorable rules
magic is less refined than Merlin's

notableFeats: matched Merlin transformation-for-transformation
transformed into a dragon large enough to destroy a castle
self-taught her magic without formal schooling
specialRules: can transform into any creature of any size
in wizard duels, will cheat if possible — agreement-binding is a real limit she's frustrated by

name: GoGo Tomago

weaknesses: EMP disables her discs; suit damage compromises speed advantage; close-quarters without discs

counters: magnetic manipulation (can be used against her)
v3Profile.loreNotes: GoGo is the fastest member of Big Hero 6 on the ground. Her combat style was designed around minimizing what the opponent can hit — she's rarely in the same place twice.
signatures: the disc launch at full speed
woman of few words, many discs
notableFeats: kept pace with superhuman threats in Big Hero 6
held ground against Yokai's microbots single-handedly
disc throws penetrate reinforced armor
specialRules: frictionless maglev — in open spaces, movement speed effectively doubles vs. standard footwork fighters

weaknesses: Anxiety in high-chaos situations; plasma blades require proximity; can be overcautious
description: Plasma physics student with plasma blade generators built into his suit. His blades can cut through virtually any material. Combined with his physics knowledge, his cutting angles and attack trajectories are geometrically perfect.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Wasabi is the precision fighter of Big Hero 6. He's not the fastest or strongest, but his attacks land exactly where he intends, making him dangerous against anyone he can reach.
weaknesses: anxiety makes him hesitate in chaos
notableFeats: plasma blades cut through Yokai's microbot constructs
fought alongside Big Hero 6 against multiple enhanced threats
plasma precision allowed surgery-level cuts in combat

specialAbility: Child prodigy-level robotics and AI; created Baymax; microbots (original design); magnetic control headset
weaknesses: No physical combat training baseline; relies entirely on tech; vulnerable without his inventions
description: 14-year-old robotics prodigy who built a neural-interface microbot army and rebuilt an AI medical robot into a battle armor. His intelligence is generational. His body is a normal teenager's.

counters: overwhelming speed before he can direct tech
v3Profile.loreNotes: Hiro is dangerous not as a physical combatant but as a prep-fighter. Given information and time, he designs solutions that defeat threats well above his raw power level.
signatures: Baymax — I am satisfied with my care
weaknesses: relies on tech — stripped of it, he's helpless in combat
notableFeats: redesigned Baymax's armor from scratch in hours
created microbots with a single neural interface
defeated Yokai by analyzing microbot behavior patterns
specialRules: with Baymax: effectively functions as enhanced combatant via remote direction
prodigy invention — given prep time, Hiro can build a counter to almost any threat

name: Vanellope von Schweetz

outside Sugar Rush: terrain powers removed

navigated the internet architecture with Ralph
glitch phase made her impossible to catch for Turbo/King Candy

in Sugar Rush environment, can reshape candy terrain

specialAbility: Turbo glitch virus form; racing game origin speed; candy environment manipulation; code-level hacking
weaknesses: Glitch exposure collapses his disguise; Cy-Bug hybridization is uncontrolled; light from beacon kills Cy-Bug biology
description: Turbo — the most popular racing game character of the 80s — who hijacked Sugar Rush and rewrote himself into King Candy. Infected by a Cy-Bug, he became a glitch-virus hybrid with Cy-Bug instincts and his own manipulative intelligence.

counters: beacon light (instant kill vs Cy-Bug form)
v3Profile.loreNotes: King Candy/Turbo is fascinating as a villain — he was functionally defeated by his own hybridization. His tech intelligence is genuine, but Cy-Bug instinct stripped away his patience.
signatures: you wouldn't hit a guy with glasses would you
weaknesses: beacon light is lethal to Cy-Bug biology
glitch exposure reveals true identity and disrupts control
hybridization removes tactical thinking in favor of instinct

took over Sugar Rush's entire population through code manipulation
Cy-Bug hybrid form was powerful enough to threaten the entire arcade

in Sugar Rush, can rewrite game code to reshape terrain

weaknesses: Outside her game environment loses some terrain advantage; programmed responses can be predicted; Cy-Bug phobia after fiance's death
description: Sergeant Tamora Jean Calhoun — the toughest, most dynamically-programmed character ever created. Hero's Duty FPS game soldier. Her programming made her the perfect military operator — she has never failed a mission.

counters: opponents that can predict game AI patterns
v3Profile.loreNotes: Calhoun is programmed to be perfect at her job — she has no hesitation, no wasted motion, and her aim is coded to hit. Outside game-space she retains all her combat programming.

weaknesses: programmed responses can theoretically be anticipated by someone who knows her code
team-focused — less effective solo than in squad
notableFeats: held Hero's Duty against endless Cy-Bug waves
organized joint operations between game characters
cleared Cy-Bug infestations in multiple game environments
specialRules: FPS-origin accuracy — ranged weapon shots have higher accuracy probability than any peak human could achieve

name: Jumba Jookiba

weaknesses: Physically slow and ungainly; relies on tech and experiments rather than personal combat; easily distracted by explaining science
description: Dr. Jumba Jookiba — Evil Genius, wanted by the Galactic Federation, creator of 626 illegal genetic experiments. Built Stitch. Has a lab full of every dangerous piece of alien tech imaginable.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Jumba is the creator of all 626 experiments — his intelligence is genuinely galactic-scale. In combat he's clumsy, but his tech advantage is enormous if he has prep time.
signatures: oh, you are also bad person like me
notableFeats: created 626 illegal genetic experiments including Stitch
built technology capable of capturing most of the galaxy's threats
escaped Galactic Federation custody multiple times
specialRules: experiment arsenal — can deploy up to 3 experiments from pod capsules as backup fighters

name: Captain Gantu
specialAbility: Alien military strength; Galactic Federation weapons; massive size; trained military commander
weaknesses: Overconfidence against small opponents; single-minded mission focus; Stitch is his nemesis
description: Grand Councilwoman's top captain, stripped of rank for his failure to contain Experiment 626. Gantu is a cetacean-based alien of immense size and strength — the Galactic Federation's most physically imposing soldier.

v3Profile.loreNotes: Gantu's physical strength places him in the enhanced tier easily. His failures against Stitch are tactical, not physical — he underestimates small opponents every time.
signatures: you are under arrest by the Galactic Federation
weaknesses: Stitch specifically is his recurring defeat
notableFeats: commanded Galactic Federation strike teams
captured and transported multiple dangerous experiments
physically matched Stitch in direct combat multiple times
specialRules: alien military tech — standard Earth weapons are significantly less effective against Gantu's physiology

name: Nick Wilde

weaknesses: Not a trained fighter; smaller than most carnivore threats; Night Howler turns him feral and uncontrolled
description: Formerly Zootopia's most charming con artist, now ZPD's most insightful detective. Nick's real combat ability is zero — his real power is making you think you've won when you've already lost.

opponents who see through deception instantly

weaknesses: Night Howler turns him feral and removes tactical thinking
physically outmatched by most trained combatants
notableFeats: ran cons on the most paranoid members of Zootopia's criminal underworld
cracked the Night Howler conspiracy alongside Judy
survived multiple physically superior threats through misdirection alone
specialRules: con setup — if Nick has more than 30 seconds of interaction before combat, he can plant misdirection that gives him a free first-round advantage

name: Commander Rourke

weaknesses: Crystal transformation can be weaponized against him; overconfidence once enhanced; morality is zero — will sacrifice anyone
description: Commander Lyle Tiberius Rourke — mercenary military genius who led the Atlantis expedition with one goal: steal the Atlantean crystal for profit. Physically exceptional before the crystal enhancement.

counters: Atlantean weapons that reverse crystal energy
allies who recognize he'll betray them
v3Profile.loreNotes: Rourke is underrated as a Disney villain — he's a professional military operator who is genuinely exceptional before the crystal enhancement. With it, he's nearly unstoppable physically.
weaknesses: crystal transformation is eventually fatal (Atlantean exposure risk)
completely amoral — no loyalty creates no backup
airship destruction ended his biggest advantage
haxAbilities: crystal enhancement — near-invulnerability to physical damage in transformed state
notableFeats: led a successful military expedition through impossible terrain to Atlantis
fought Milo and Kida's forces after full betrayal reveal
crystal-state made him nearly invulnerable to normal attacks
specialRules: crystal enhancement — once Atlantean crystal energy is active, Rourke's durability increases significantly and his strikes can shatter stone

name: Captain Amelia
specialAbility: Elite space navy captain; precise laser pistol shooting; alien acrobatics; superior tactical mind
weaknesses: No supernatural physical abilities; ship-based; limited to conventional weapons

counters: opponents with better tech than her pistol
v3Profile.loreNotes: Captain Amelia is the quintessential professional — she doesn't panic, she doesn't brag, and she executes. Her alien feline physiology gives her slightly better than human-peak agility.
signatures: now just try and keep up
weaknesses: no superhuman physical stats beyond alien feline agility
notableFeats: commanded the RLS Legacy against Pirate forces
survived Treasure Planet while gravely wounded
maintained command composure under conditions that broke everyone else
specialRules: space-navy training — in any nautical or aerial environment, gains significant terrain advantage

name: Jim Hawkins

weaknesses: No combat training; physically average for age; relies on improvisation
description: Jim Hawkins — rebellious teenager who navigated an alien map, survived a mutiny, and befriended a cyborg pirate. His solar surfer handling is literally superhuman-level. His fists are definitely not.

counters: any trained fighter in close range
ranged weapons that outpace his surfer
v3Profile.loreNotes: Jim is one of Disney's least combat-capable protagonists put here for completeness. His value is entirely his piloting ability and improvisation. In a straight fight, he loses to almost everyone.
notableFeats: navigated Treasure Planet's star system alone
survived a pirate mutiny at 15
solar surfer maneuvers that experienced spacers couldn't duplicate

name: Milo Thatch

weaknesses: Zero combat training; physically frail; relies entirely on allies and Atlantean power

v3Profile.loreNotes: Milo is here because the Disney universe demanded his inclusion — he's a fascinating character but one of the franchise's weakest physical combatants.
weaknesses: almost completely helpless in direct combat
relies on Kida, crystal, or allies for any physical capability
notableFeats: translated the Atlantean language in hours — a feat no linguist alive had achieved
discovered and led the recovery of Atlantis
convinced the expedition not to destroy what they found

notableFeats: stopped a war through presence alone
communicated with spirits through Grandmother Willow

weaknesses: On land: loses primary speed and movement advantage; no combat training; naive in conflict situations

puppies specifically defeat her every time

her obsession overcame every rational barrier to puppy theft

v3Profile.loreNotes: Pete's strength is genuine but his failure rate against Mickey is 100%. Against opponents who aren't Mickey, his size and strength present real problems.

survived every defeat and came back for more

superior tech that outranges his gas gun
v3Profile.loreNotes: Darkwing is a comedy superhero but his win rate against genuinely superpowered opponents is legitimately impressive. He's the type that shouldn't win and keeps winning through plot armor that looks like skill.

infiltrated SHUSH and criminal organizations
survived encounters with opponents far beyond his power level

weaknesses: Obsession with Scrooge's Number One Dime clouds judgment; trapped in shadow form after failed spell; overconfidence in magic

shadow-realm conquest attempt in DuckTales 2017
matched Gizmoduck in open combat

tougher than the toughies and smarter than the smarties
historical knowledge of every threat type

notableFeats: orchestrated a city-wide conspiracy that fooled the entire ZPD

political immunity — while in position, attempts to arrest her face procedural obstacles

self-destruct trigger — every invention has a self-destruct button that WILL be pressed

name: Moana's Te Fiti
specialAbility: Island and life creation; Te Fiti heart is the source of all life; restoration of entire ecosystems; divine nature magic
weaknesses: Benevolent nature — unwilling to destroy; Te Kā form (without heart) is rage without intelligence
description: Te Fiti — the mother island, creator of life. In her true form, she creates and restores entire ecosystems with a gesture. She is not a combatant — she is the force that combat is fought over.

counters: stealing the heart (converts her to Te Kā)
opponents who have no compassion to appeal to
v3Profile.loreNotes: Te Fiti and Te Kā are the same being — the god of creation and the god of destruction in one form. Only included as a combatant because Te Kā's separate stats are already captured; Te Fiti represents the full divine entity.
weaknesses: without her heart she becomes Te Kā (rage-mode)
purely benevolent — enemies who can exploit goodness
notableFeats: created all life in Moana's ocean world
restored an entire dying ecosystem in moments after receiving her heart
Te Kā form devastated the ocean world for a thousand years
specialRules: heart removal — if Te Fiti's heart is stolen or removed, she transforms into Te Kā: a rage-driven lava demon who destroys uncontrollably

name: Lilo Pelekai
specialAbility: Ohana — her emotional bond with Stitch gives him motivation to fight harder; Elvis-based combat philosophy; unpredictable child logic
weaknesses: A normal child with no combat ability; her power is entirely relational; physical threat to her causes Stitch to go berserk
description: A lonely Hawaiian girl who adopted an alien experiment thinking he was a dog. Lilo's power in a fight is zero. Her power in Stitch's heart is absolute — she is the reason he fights.

abilities: Elvis Presley tactical knowledge (Elvis always wins)
v3Profile.loreNotes: Lilo is here because the roster needed her — she's the heart of the Lilo & Stitch universe. Physically she contributes nothing to combat. Emotionally she determines everything.
weaknesses: physically a child — no combat capability
completely dependent on Stitch for protection
her safety is Stitch's primary vulnerability
notableFeats: convinced an alien super-soldier to adopt Earth's concept of family
single-handedly reformed Experiment 626 through love
negotiated Stitch's freedom from the Galactic Federation
specialRules: Stitch proximity — when Lilo is threatened, Stitch's combat stats increase by 40% from protective rage

name: The Evil Queen
specialAbility: Potion mastery; transformation magic (witch form); Magic Mirror divination; apple curse; dark sorcery
weaknesses: Witch form is physically vulnerable; obsessed with beauty above strategy; Magic Mirror cannot lie — but she interprets it incorrectly
description: Disney's first villain. The Evil Queen from Snow White — a vain sorceress with genuine magical power who transforms herself and brews reality-altering potions. Her witch form strips away her dignity but amplifies her direct power.

v3Profile.loreNotes: The Evil Queen is Disney's original villain. Her power is real — she's a genuine sorceress. She's just not the top tier because Maleficent, Hades, and Chernabog exist.
weaknesses: vanity causes obsessive focus on beauty comparison
witch form physically weaker than queen form
notableFeats: brewed a sleep-death potion effective on any living being
used the Magic Mirror to track targets across kingdoms
transformed herself into a convincing elderly woman with no detection
specialRules: poisoned apple — any character who consumes it falls into death-like sleep regardless of power level; magical cure exists (True Love's Kiss)
witch form — transformed appearance gains increased speed and dark magic output at cost of physical durability

name: Fix-It Felix Jr.
specialAbility: Magic golden hammer that fixes anything it touches; game-origin durability; never-give-up attitude; repairs allies
weaknesses: Pacifist by nature — hates fighting; hammer heals, not hurts (only hurts if he swings at someone); programmed politeness
description: Fix-It Felix Jr. — the hero of the 8-bit game Niceland. His golden hammer can repair anything it touches. The same hammer hits hard enough to stun, and in a pinch, he's swung it at actual threats.

counters: opponents who use his repair instinct against him
fast fighters who close before hammer swing
anyone he's emotionally attached to fighting
v3Profile.loreNotes: Felix is primarily a support character whose golden hammer is genuinely magic. His healing utility makes him extraordinarily valuable in team fights.
weaknesses: hammer heals — swinging it at enemies feels wrong to him
no offensive kit outside the hammer
haxAbilities: golden hammer healing (restoration of any physical damage through touch)
notableFeats: kept Niceland standing against Ralph's demolition for 30 years
rescued Calhoun from Hero's Duty
repaired Cy-Bug damage in real-time during battle
specialRules: golden hammer repair — Felix can repair ally armor, weapons, and injuries mid-combat by touching with the hammer; does not work on killing blows already landed

name: Little John
specialAbility: Bear-sized strength and mass; Robin Hood's fighting partner; exceptional wrestling; cheerful in combat
weaknesses: No combat training beyond brawling; slower than skilled fighters; absolutely loyal to Robin Hood (vulnerability)
description: Robin Hood's best friend and fighting partner — a bear of a man with bear-equivalent strength. Little John does the heavy lifting (literally) when Robin Hood's archery isn't enough.

counters: speed fighters who avoid his mass
v3Profile.loreNotes: Little John is straightforward — size and strength, no frills. He's exactly as powerful as he looks: a very large, strong, good-natured fighter.
signatures: I love him like a brother
notableFeats: disguised himself as a fortune teller to infiltrate Prince John's tournament
held multiple guards simultaneously in wrestling holds
served as Robin Hood's getaway driver and muscle across dozens of heists

name: Mowgli
specialAbility: Jungle survival mastery; animal communication; man's red fire; raised by wolves with pack combat instincts
weaknesses: Physically a child in most adaptations; no formal combat training; overconfident about fire
description: The man-cub raised by wolves in the jungle. Mowgli's wilderness survival skills exceed any trained adult human. He communicates with animals, climbs like a monkey, and invented fire weaponization as a child.

finishers: fire torch to Shere Khan's face
v3Profile.loreNotes: Mowgli's physical stats are those of a fit child with exceptional wilderness conditioning. His actual danger to any serious fighter is near-zero — except that he defeated Shere Khan.
weaknesses: fire is his best weapon but limited supply
no armor, no ranged weapons beyond throwing
notableFeats: defeated Shere Khan with fire — alone — as a child
survived years in a jungle with active apex predators
befriended King Louie's apes and talked his way out of capture
specialRules: animal trust — jungle animals (elephants, wolves, bears) will assist Mowgli if within reach of his calls

name: Mother Gothel
specialAbility: Centuries of psychological manipulation; Rapunzel's hair-dependent immortality; dagger usage; paranoid long-term planning
weaknesses: Completely dependent on Rapunzel's magical hair for longevity; no combat ability whatsoever; psychological manipulation fails against anyone who sees through it
description: Mother Gothel — the woman who kept Rapunzel in a tower for 18 years through pure psychological manipulation. She has no combat ability. Her power is entirely her long-term manipulation expertise built over centuries.

finishers: manipulation reveal to break opponent's will
v3Profile.loreNotes: Gothel is physically helpless but psychologically among the most dangerous characters on the roster. Give her five minutes of conversation and she will find the crack in anyone's emotional armor.
notableFeats: kept Rapunzel isolated for 18 years with zero supernatural coercion beyond psychological
outmaneuvered Flynn Rider's entire romantic play for years
survived for centuries through hair-dependent immortality
specialRules: psychological manipulation — against characters with emotional vulnerability, Gothel can reduce combat effectiveness through dialogue-phase manipulation

name: Tim
specialAbility: Infinite liquidity — buys off opponents mid-fight, hires their families, owns the arena lease, the venue, and the broadcast rights; unleashes weaponized cash storms that disintegrate flesh and pride simultaneously; every punch he throws is paid for in advance; cannot be defeated by any fighter who can be bought, intimidated, or out-resourced
weaknesses: Money has no leverage over the architects. Chris Henry and Troy Wilson built the system that prints his cash — they own him by default. Anyone else? They lose.
description: The third Developer Legend. Tim doesn't fight — he transacts. His weapon is the unlimited bankroll, his style is total economic dominance. Every other fighter on the roster has a price tag, and Tim already paid it. The only two people he answers to are the ones who wrote the rules: Chris and Troy.
